Chapters II-1, II-2, III, and V shall apply to ensure compliance with the requirements of this Convention, that the equipment is in satisfactory condition, and that it is suitable for the intended purpose of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)年度检验应包括(b)(ⅰ)所述设备的一般检查，以保证设备已按第11(a)条进行了维护保养，并保持在合格状况，适合该船预定的用途。
Translation: (iii) The annual inspection shall include a general examination of the equipment referred to in (b)(i) to ensure that it has been maintained in accordance with Article 11(a) and remains in satisfactory condition, suitable for the intended use of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 参见认可的货船安全设备记录(SLS.14/Circ.1)。
Translation: Refer to the Record of Approved Cargo Ship Safety Equipment (SLS.14/Circ.1).

Query_Text_cn: (c)本条(a)(ⅲ)和(a)(ⅳ)所述的定期检验和年度检验应在货船设备安全证书上签署。
Translation: (c) The periodic inspection and annual inspection referred to in paragraphs (a)(iii) and (a)(iv) of this Article shall be endorsed on the Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅳ)第7(b)(ⅲ)条对客船所规定的附加检验。
Translation: (iv) The additional inspections for passenger ships as stipulated in Regulation 7(b)(iii).

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)换证检验和定期检验应包括货船无线电设备，包括在救生设备上使用的无线电设备的检查，以保证设备符合本公约的各项要求。
Translation: (ii) Renewal and periodic inspections shall include the examination of radio equipment on cargo ships, including radio equipment used in life-saving appliances, to ensure that the equipment complies with all the requirements of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (c)本条(a)(ⅲ)所述的定期检验应在货船无线电安全证书上签署。
Translation: (c) The periodical inspections referred to in paragraph (a)(iii) of this Article shall be endorsed on the Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 参见关于船底外部检验的通函(PSLS.2/Circ.5)。
Translation: Refer to the circular regarding external bottom inspection of ships (PSLS.2/Circ.5).

Query_Text_cn: (ⅴ)在任何5年期内，船底外部应至少进行2次检查，但如适用第14(e)或(f)条时除外。
Translation: (v) In any five-year period, the underwater parts of the ship's bottom shall be inspected at least twice, except where Regulation 14(e) or (f) applies.

Query_Text_cn: 如第14(e)或(f)条适用时，此5年期限可展期至与证书有效期展期期限相一致。
Translation: If Article 14(e) or (f) applies, the five-year period may be extended to coincide with the extension period of the certificate's validity.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅵ)第7(b)(ⅲ)条对客船所规定的附加检验。
Translation: (vi) Additional inspections for passenger ships as stipulated in Regulation 7(b)(iii).

Query_Text_cn: (ⅰ)初次检验应包括船体、机器和设备在内的全面检查。
Translation: (i) The initial inspection shall include a comprehensive examination of the hull, machinery, and equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 此项检验应能保证包括船舶的布置、材料、结构尺寸和工艺，锅炉和其他受压容器及其附件，主辅机包括舵机及与其相关的控制系统，电气设备以及其他设备符合本公约的各项要求，且处于合格状况，适合该船预定的用途，并备有要求的稳性资料。
Translation: This inspection shall ensure that the ship's arrangement, materials, structural dimensions and workmanship; boilers and other pressure vessels and their fittings; main and auxiliary machinery including steering gear and associated control systems; electrical equipment; and other equipment comply with the requirements of this Convention, are in satisfactory condition, suitable for the intended service of the ship, and are provided with the required stability information.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)中间检验应包括船体、锅炉和其他受压容器、机器和设备、舵机及与其相关的控制系统和电气设备的检查，以保证其保持在合格的状况，适合该船预定的用途。
Translation: (iii) Intermediate inspections shall include examinations of the hull, boilers and other pressure vessels, machinery and equipment, steering gear and its associated control systems, as well as electrical equipment, to ensure that they remain in satisfactory condition and are suitable for the intended purpose of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅴ)对船底外部的检查以及与此同时对有关检查项目的检验，以保证其保持在合格状况，适合该船预定的用途。
Translation: (v) Inspection of the external hull and simultaneous examination of relevant inspection items to ensure that they remain in satisfactory condition and are suitable for the vessel's intended purpose.

Query_Text_cn: (c)本条(a)(ⅲ)、(a)(ⅳ)和(a)(ⅴ)所述的中间检验、年度检验和船底外部的检查均应在货船构造安全证书上签署。
Translation: (c) The intermediate survey, annual survey, and bottom inspection referred to in paragraphs (a)(iii), (a)(iv), and (a)(v) of this Article shall all be endorsed on the Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (a)应保持船舶及其设备状况符合本公约的各项规定，以保证该船在各方面保持适合于出海航行而不致对船舶及船上人员产生危险。
Translation: (a) The condition of the ship and its equipment shall be maintained in accordance with the requirements of this Convention to ensure that the ship remains fit for sea-going voyages in all respects and does not pose any danger to the vessel or persons on board.

Query_Text_cn: (b)根据第7、8、9条或第10条的规定，对船舶所进行的任何检验完成以后，非经主管机关认可，已检验过的结构布置、机器、设备及其他项目，概不得变动。
Translation: (b) After any inspection of a ship conducted in accordance with the provisions of Articles 7, 8, 9, or 10, no changes shall be made to the inspected structural arrangements, machinery, equipment, or other items without the approval of the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: (c)当船舶发生事故或发现缺陷，且不管是影响该船的安全，还是影响该船救生设备或其他设备的有效性或完整性时，该船的船长或船东应尽快向负责发给有关证书的主管机关、指定的验船师或认可的组织报告。主管机关、指定的验船师或认可的组织在收到报告以后，应即进行调查研究，以确定是否有必要进行第7、8、9条或第10条所要求的检验。
Translation: (c) When a ship is involved in an accident or a defect is discovered, whether it affects the safety of the ship or the effectiveness or integrity of its lifesaving appliances or other equipment, the master or owner of the ship shall promptly report to the competent authority responsible for issuing the relevant certificates, the designated surveyor, or the recognized organization. Upon receipt of such a report, the competent authority, designated surveyor, or recognized organization shall immediately conduct an investigation to determine whether it is necessary to carry out the inspections required by Articles 7, 8, 9, or 10.

Query_Text_cn: 如该船系在另一缔约国的港口内，船长或船东亦应立即向该港口国的有关当局报告。而指定的验船师或认可的组织则应弄清楚此项报告是否业已递交。
Translation: If the ship is in the port of another contracting party, the master or owner shall also immediately report to the relevant authorities of the port State. The designated surveyor or recognized organization shall ascertain whether such a report has been submitted.

Query_Text_cn: (a)(ⅰ)客船经过初次检验或换证检验，符合第II-1、II-2、III、IV和V章的要求及本公约其他有关要求后，应发给客船安全证书。
Translation: (a)(i) After a passenger ship has undergone an initial inspection or a renewal inspection and is found to comply with the requirements of Chapters II-1, II-2, III, IV, and V, as well as other relevant provisions of this Convention, a Passenger Ship Safety Certificate shall be issued.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)货船经过初次检验或换证检验，符合除有关消防安全系统和防火控制图以外的第II-1章和第II-2章中有关的要求以及本公约其他有关要求后，应发给货船构造安全证书②。
Translation: (ii) After a cargo ship has undergone an initial inspection or a renewal inspection and is found to comply with the relevant requirements of Chapter II-1 and Chapter II-2, except those concerning fire safety systems and fire control plans, as well as other applicable requirements of this Convention, a Cargo Ship Construction Safety Certificate shall be issued.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)货船经过初次检验或换证检验，符合第II-1、II-2、III和V章的有关要求及本公约其他有关要求，应发给货船设备安全证书②。
Translation: (iii) When a cargo ship has undergone an initial or renewal survey and is found to comply with the relevant requirements of Chapters II-1, II-2, III, and V, as well as other applicable requirements of this Convention, a Cargo Ship Equipment Safety Certificate shall be issued.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅳ)货船经过初次检验或换证检验，符合第IV章的有关要求及本公约其他有关要求后，应发给货船无线电安全证书。
Translation: (iv) After a cargo ship has undergone an initial inspection or a renewal inspection and is found to comply with the relevant requirements of Chapter IV and other applicable provisions of this Convention, a Cargo Ship Radio Safety Certificate shall be issued.

Query_Text_cn: (2)如货船安全证书用以取代货船构造安全证书、货船设备安全证书或货船无线电安全证书时，则无论何时，在本章涉及有关这些证书的事项时，亦应适用于货船安全证书。
Translation: (2) When a Cargo Ship Safety Certificate is used to replace the Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate, the Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate, or the Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate, the provisions of this chapter relating to any of these certificates shall also apply to the Cargo Ship Safety Certificate whenever relevant.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅵ)(ⅰ)、(ⅲ)、(ⅳ)和(ⅴ)所述的客船安全证书、货船设备安全证书、货船无线电安全证书和货船安全证书均应备有一份设备记录。
Translation: The Passenger Ship Safety Certificate, Cargo Ship Equipment Safety Certificate, Cargo Ship Radio Safety Certificate, and Cargo Ship Safety Certificate referred to in (vi)(i), (iii), (iv), and (v) shall each be accompanied by an equipment record.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅶ)对于根据和按照本公约的规定受到某项免除的船舶，除发给本条所述的证书以外，还应发给免除证书。
Translation: (vii) For any ship which is granted an exemption under the provisions of this Convention, in addition to the certificates referred to in this Article, an exemption certificate shall also be issued.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.791(19)决议《1969国际吨位丈量公约对现有船舶的应用》。
Translation: Refer to this Organization’s Resolution A.791(19) “Application of the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships, 1969, to Existing Ships.”

Query_Text_cn: ②参见关于签发补录和附录的通函(PSLS.2/Circ.1)。
Translation: See the circular on the issuance of supplements and annexes (PSLS.2/Circ.1).

Query_Text_cn: (b)在缔约国政府对本公约的接受生效之日后，不应再根据和按照1960、1948或1929年国际海上人命安全公约的规定签发证书。
Translation: (b) After the date on which the acceptance of this Convention by the Government of a Contracting State takes effect, no further certificates shall be issued under and in accordance with the provisions of the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, 1960, 1948 or 1929.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国政府可应主管机关请求对船舶进行检验，如认为该船符合本公约的要求，应按照本公约规定发给或授权发给该船证书，或如适用，对船上证书进行签署或授权签署。
Translation: The government of a contracting state may, at the request of the competent authority, inspect a ship. If it considers that the ship complies with the requirements of this Convention, it shall issue or authorize the issuance of the relevant certificate to the ship in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, or, where applicable, sign or authorize the signing of certificates on board the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 如此签发的任何证书必须载明是受船旗国政府的委托而签发的。此证书与根据第12条所发的证书具有同等效力，并受同样的承认。
Translation: Any certificate so issued must indicate that it has been issued under the authority of the Government of the flag State. Such a certificate shall have the same validity and shall be recognized in the same manner as a certificate issued under Article 12.

Query_Text_cn: (a)签发客船安全证书的有效期限不应超过12个月。
Translation: (a) The validity period for the issuance of a passenger ship safety certificate shall not exceed 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: 签发货船构造安全证书、货船设备全证书和货船无线电安全证书的有效期限应由主管机关规定，但不得超过5年。
Translation: The validity period for the issuance of the Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate, the Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate, and the Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate shall be determined by the competent authority, but shall not exceed five years.

Query_Text_cn: 免除证书的有效期限不应长于其有关证书的有效期限。
Translation: The validity period of the exemption certificate shall not exceed that of the relevant certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (2)对货船，自换证检验完成之日起不超过5年的日期内有效。
Translation: (2) For cargo ships, the certificate is valid for a period not exceeding five years from the date of completion of the renewal inspection.

Query_Text_cn: (c)除客船安全证书外，如果所发证书的有效期限少于5年，主管机关可延长证书的有效期自证书期满日至本条(a)规定的最长期限，条件是在签发5年期的证书时进行了第8、9和10条所述的相应的检验。
Translation: (c) Except for passenger ship safety certificates, if the validity period of a certificate issued is less than five years, the competent authority may extend the validity of the certificate from the date of expiry to the maximum period specified in paragraph (a) of this Article, provided that the relevant inspections referred to in Articles 8, 9, and 10 have been carried out at the time the five-year certificate is issued.

Query_Text_cn: (d)如果换证检验已完成，而新证书在现有证书期满之日前不能签发或不能存放在船上，主管机关授权的人员或组织可在现有证书上签署，签署后的证书自期满之日起不超过5个月的期限内应视为有效。
Translation: (d) If the renewal survey has been completed but the new certificate cannot be issued or placed on board before the expiry date of the existing certificate, the person or organization authorized by the competent authority may endorse the existing certificate, which shall then be regarded as valid for a period not exceeding five months from the date of expiry.

Query_Text_cn: (e)如果证书期满时船舶不在应进行检验的港口，主管机关可延长该证书的有效期，但此项展期仅以能使船舶完成其驶抵应进行检验的港口的航次为限，并且仅在正当和合理的情况下才能如此办理。
Translation: (e) If, at the time of expiry of the certificate, the ship is not in a port where it is to be surveyed, the competent authority may extend the validity of the certificate, but such extension shall be limited to the voyage necessary for the ship to reach the port where the survey is to be conducted, and shall only be granted under proper and reasonable circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 展期不得超过3个月。经展期的船舶在抵达应进行检验的港口后，不得因有此项展期而在未获得新证书前驶离该港口。
Translation: The extension shall not exceed three months. After the extended period, a ship that has arrived at the port where inspection is required shall not depart from the port without obtaining a new certificate, regardless of the granted extension.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)对货船，自现有证书展期前的期满日起不超过5年。
Translation: (ii) For cargo ships, the extension shall not exceed five years from the expiration date of the current certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (f)发给短程航行船舶的证书未按本条前述之规定展期，主管机关可给予自该证书期满之日起至多1个月的宽限期。
Translation: (f)If the certificate issued to a short-range voyage ship is not extended in accordance with the provisions of this Article, the competent authority may grant a grace period of up to one month from the date of expiry of the certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (g)在特殊情况下(由主管机关确定)，新证书无需按(b)(ⅱ)、(e)或(f)的要求从现有证书期满日起计算日期。
Translation: (g) In special circumstances (as determined by the competent authority), the new certificate does not need to have its date calculated from the expiry date of the existing certificate as required under (b)(ii), (e), or (f).

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)对货船，自换证检验完成之日起不超过5年。
Translation: (ii) For cargo ships, no more than five years from the date of completion of the self-renewal inspection.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)若进行一次或多次相宜的年度检验、中间检验或定期检验，而使有关规则规定的检验最长间隔期不超过，该期满日可保持不变。
Translation: (iii) If one or more appropriate annual, intermediate, or periodic inspections are carried out, ensuring that the maximum interval between inspections specified by the relevant regulations is not exceeded, the expiry date may remain unchanged.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)船舶变更船旗国时。
Translation: (iii) When a vessel changes its flag state.

Query_Text_cn: 只有当换发新证书的政府确认该船业已满足第11(a)及(b)条的要求时，才换发新证书。
Translation: A new certificate shall be issued only when the government issuing the new certificate has confirmed that the ship has complied with the requirements of paragraphs 11(a) and (b).

Query_Text_cn: 如果变更船旗系在两个缔约国之间进行，则在变更船旗后的3个月内，前一个船旗国政府如接到申请，应尽快将变更船旗前该船所携证书的副本以及有关的检验报告(如备有时)，送交该船的新主管机关。
Translation: If the change of flag takes place between two Contracting Governments, the government of the former flag State shall, within three months after the change of flag and upon request, as soon as possible transmit to the new administration of the ship copies of the certificates carried by the ship prior to the change of flag and, if available, copies of the relevant inspection reports.

Query_Text_cn: 各种证书和设备记录应按本公约附则的附录中给出的相应格式制定。
Translation: All certificates and equipment records shall be drawn up in the respective forms set out in the appendix to the annexes of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果使用的文字既非英文又非法文，则文本应包含其中一种文字的译本。
Translation: If the text is neither in English nor in French, it should include a translation into one of these languages.

Query_Text_cn: 根据第12和13条签发的船上各种证书应随时可用，以供检查。
Translation: All certificates issued under Articles 12 and 13 shall be readily available on board for inspection at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应视为这种证书与由其本国政府所签发的证书同样有效。
Translation: The governments of all contracting parties shall regard such certificates as equally valid as those issued by their own governments.

Query_Text_cn: (a)如船舶在某一特定航次中所载人数少于客船安全证书中所载的总数，从而按照本规则规定可配置少于证书中所载的救生艇和其他救生设备，本章第12条或第13条所指的政府、个人或组织可签发一份证书附件。
Translation: (a) If the number of persons carried on a particular voyage is less than the total number stated in the passenger ship safety certificate, thereby permitting, in accordance with these regulations, the carriage of fewer lifeboats and other lifesaving appliances than those specified in the certificate, the government, individual, or organization referred to in Article 12 or 13 of this chapter may issue an attachment to the certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在此项附件上应载明在当时情况下并无违反本规则规定之处。
Translation: (b)This annex shall state that, under the circumstances at the time, there was no violation of the provisions of these rules.

Query_Text_cn: 上述附件应附于证书之后，并仅在救生设备方面代替该证书。
Translation: The above annex should be attached to the certificate and shall only replace the certificate with regard to lifesaving appliances.

Query_Text_cn: 这种附件仅对该特定航次有效。
Translation: This annex is valid only for this specific voyage.

Query_Text_cn: (a)每艘船舶当其在另一缔约国政府的港口时，应受该国政府正式授权官员的控制。这种控制的目的，仅在于查明该船根据第12条或第13条所签发的各种证书是否有效。
Translation: (a)Every ship, while in the port of another Contracting Government, shall be subject to the control of officers duly authorized by that Government. The purpose of such control shall be limited to verifying whether the certificates issued under Article 12 or Article 13 are valid.

Query_Text_cn: (b)除有明显理由确信该船或其设备的情况实质上与任一证书所载情况不符，或该船及其设备不符合第11(a)及(b)条的规定外，这些证书，如属有效，即应被承认。
Translation: (b) Except where there are clear grounds for believing that the condition of the ship or its equipment does not substantially correspond with the particulars stated in any certificate, or that the ship and its equipment do not comply with the provisions of Article 11(a) and (b), these certificates, if valid, shall be recognized.

Query_Text_cn: (d)如因这种控制而引起任何干涉，执行控制的官员应将认为必须进行干涉的一切情况，立即书面通知船旗国的领事，或当领事不在时，则通知其最近的外交代表。
Translation: (d) If any interference arises as a result of such control, the officer carrying out the control shall immediately notify in writing all circumstances deemed necessary for such interference to the consul of the flag State, or, in the absence of the consul, to the nearest diplomatic representative.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还应通知负责发证的指定验船师或认可组织。
Translation: In addition, the designated surveyor or recognized organization responsible for issuing the certificate should also be notified.

Query_Text_cn: 有关干涉的事实应向本组织报告。
Translation: Facts concerning interference should be reported to this organization.

Query_Text_cn: (e)如未能按本条(c)及(d)的规定采取措施，或如已允许该船驶往下一停靠港时，港口国的有关当局应将所有有关该船的情况，除通知本条(d)所述有关方面外，还要通知下一停靠港当局。
Translation: (e) If measures have not been taken in accordance with paragraphs (c) and (d) of this Article, or if the ship has been permitted to proceed to the next port of call, the relevant authorities of the port State shall, in addition to notifying the parties referred to in paragraph (d) of this Article, also inform the authorities of the next port of call of all relevant circumstances concerning the ship.

Query_Text_cn: (f)根据本条规定执行控制时，应尽一切努力避免对船舶作不当扣留或延误。
Translation: (f)When exercising control under this provision, every effort shall be made to avoid undue detention or delay of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 如船舶被不当扣留或延误，应有权对所受的任何损失或损害要求赔偿。
Translation: If a vessel is improperly detained or delayed, it shall have the right to claim compensation for any loss or damage suffered.

Query_Text_cn: 任何船舶除持有相应的有效证书外，不可要求本公约所赋予的各项特权。
Translation: No ship may claim any of the privileges conferred by this Convention unless it holds the appropriate valid certificates.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.787(19)决议通过的，经A.882(21)决议修正的《港口国控制程序》。
Translation: Refer to the "Procedures for Port State Control" adopted by this Organization under Resolution A.787(19), as amended by Resolution A.882(21).

Query_Text_cn: (a)各主管机关对其所属的受本公约规定约束的任何船舶所发生的任何事故，当其认为调查该项事故有助于确定本规则可能所需要的何种修改时，即应承担义务进行调查。
Translation: (a) Whenever the appropriate authorities consider that an investigation into any casualty occurring to any of their ships subject to the provisions of this Convention may assist in determining what changes, if any, may be required in the present regulations, such authorities shall undertake to conduct such an investigation.

Query_Text_cn: (b)各缔约国政府有义务将有关此项调查所获得的适当资料提供给本组织。
Translation: (b) The governments of the contracting parties are obligated to provide the Organization with appropriate information obtained from the relevant investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织根据此项资料所作的报告或建议，一律不得泄露有关船舶的辨认特征或国籍，或以任何方式确定或暗示任何船舶或个人承担的责任。
Translation: Any report or recommendation made by this organization based on this information shall not disclose identifying features or nationality of any vessel, nor in any way determine or imply the responsibility of any vessel or individual.

Query_Text_cn: 经A.884(21)决议修正的A.849(20)决议：海难与事故调查规则。
Translation: Resolution A.849(20), as amended by Resolution A.884(21): Code for the Investigation of Marine Casualties and Incidents.

Query_Text_cn: 还参见：MSC/Circ.953海安会通函：关于海难与事故的报告。
Translation: See also: MSC/Circ.953 Maritime Safety Committee Circular: Reports on Marine Casualties and Incidents.

Query_Text_cn: 经修订的协调报告程序-SOLAS公约第I/21条和MARPOL73/78公约第8条和第12条所要求的报告。
Translation: Revised Harmonized Reporting Procedures—Reports required under SOLAS Convention Regulation I/21 and MARPOL 73/78 Convention Articles 8 and 12.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅷ)本条所述的各种证书均应由主管机关或主管机关授权的任何个人或组织签发或签署，但无论由谁签发或签署，主管机关都应对证书完全负责。
Translation: (viii) All certificates referred to in this Article shall be issued or signed by the competent authority or by any person or organization authorized by the competent authority, but regardless of who issues or signs them, the competent authority shall be fully responsible for the certificates.

Query_Text_cn: (c)在本条(b)所述情况下或当证书过期或失效时，执行控制的官员应采取措施，以保证该船在未具备对船舶或船上人员都无危险的条件前，不得开航出海或离港驶往适当的修船厂。
Translation: (c) In the circumstances described in paragraph (b) of this Article, or when the certificate has expired or become invalid, the officer exercising control shall take measures to ensure that the ship does not proceed to sea or leave port for an appropriate repair yard until it can do so without danger to the ship or persons on board.

Query_Text_cn: 1本部分的要求适用于船长（Ls）超过100m的货船，但不包括表明是符合本组织制定的其他文件②中分舱和破损稳性规则的那些船舶。
Translation: The requirements of this section apply to cargo ships with a length (Ls) exceeding 100 meters, but do not include those ships that are indicated as complying with the subdivision and damage stability rules set out in other documents developed by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 本部分要求也适用于1998年7月1日或以后建造的船长（Ls）为80m及以上但不超过100m的货船。
Translation: This section also applies to cargo ships constructed on or after July 1, 1998, with a length (Ls) of 80 meters or more but not exceeding 100 meters.

Query_Text_cn: 2下文提到的规则系指本部分所包含的整套规则。
Translation: The rules referred to below mean the entire set of rules contained in this section.

Query_Text_cn: 3对某一特定船舶或一组船舶，如果主管机关确信至少能达到与本规则同等的安全程度，可以接受变通的布置。
Translation: For a particular ship or a group of ships, if the competent authority is satisfied that at least an equivalent level of safety to that required by these regulations can be achieved, alternative arrangements may be accepted.

Query_Text_cn: 凡允许采取此类变通布置的任何主管机关均应将其详细情况通报本组织。
Translation: Any competent authority that permits such alternative arrangements shall report the details thereof to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1分舱载重线系指用以确定船舶分舱的水线。
Translation: 1.1 The compartment load line refers to the waterline used to determine the subdivision of a ship into compartments.

Query_Text_cn: 1.2最深分舱载重线系指相应于核定的船舶夏季吃水的分舱载重线。
Translation: 1.2 The deepest subdivision load line refers to the subdivision load line corresponding to the vessel's assigned summer draft.

Query_Text_cn: 1.3部分载重线系指空船吃水加上空船吃水与最深分舱载重线之间差值的60%。
Translation: Section 1.3 Partial Load Line refers to the sum of the light ship draft and 60% of the difference between the light ship draft and the deepest subdivision load line.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1船舶分舱长度（Ls）系指船舶处于最深分舱载重线时限制垂向浸水范围的甲板及其以下部分最大投影型长度。
Translation: 2.1 The subdivision length (Ls) of a ship refers to the maximum projected length of the deck that limits the vertical extent of flooding, and the parts below it, when the ship is at its deepest subdivision load line.

Query_Text_cn: ①在采用包含在B-1部分的规则时，海上安全委员会提请各主管机关注意，这些规则应与本组织A.684(17)决议通过的《关于SOLAS公约中对100m及以上货船的分舱和破损稳性规则的解释》一起使用，以确保应用的一致性。
Translation: When adopting the rules contained in Part B-1, the Maritime Safety Committee draws the attention of all relevant authorities to the fact that these rules should be used in conjunction with the “Interpretation of the provisions of the SOLAS Convention regarding subdivision and damage stability of cargo ships of 100 m in length and upwards” adopted by the Organization by resolution A.684(17), in order to ensure consistency in their application.

Query_Text_cn: 还参见MSC.76(69)决议《关于SOLAS公约中对100m及以上货船的分舱和破损稳性规则的解释的扩展应用（A.684(17)决议）》。
Translation: See also MSC.76(69) Resolution, "Extended Application of the Interpretation of the Subdivision and Damage Stability Regulations for Cargo Ships of 100 m in Length and Above in the SOLAS Convention (Resolution A.684(17))".

Query_Text_cn: 6采用《1966载重线公约》第27条的破损稳性要求且同时符合A.320(IX)和A.514(13)决议的规定，但是对适用该公约第27(9)条的船舶而言，被认为有效的主水密横舱壁应按A.320(IX)决议中(12)(f)规定的间距设置。
Translation: The damaged stability requirements of Article 27 of the 1966 Load Line Convention are adopted, and compliance with Resolutions A.320(IX) and A.514(13) is also required. However, for ships to which Article 27(9) of the Convention applies, the main watertight transverse bulkheads considered effective shall be spaced in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (12)(f) of Resolution A.320(IX).

Query_Text_cn: 2.2船长中点系指船舶分舱长度的中点。
Translation: 2.2 The midpoint of the ship's compartment length refers to the central point of the vessel's compartment length.

Query_Text_cn: 2.3后端点系指分舱长度的最后一点。
Translation: 2.3 The aft endpoint refers to the rearmost point of the compartment length.

Query_Text_cn: 2.4前端点系指分舱长度的最前一点。
Translation: 2.4 The foremost point of the compartment length refers to the front endpoint of the compartment.

Query_Text_cn: 3船宽（B）系指在最深分舱载重线或其下的船舶最大型宽。
Translation: The breadth (B) of a ship refers to the maximum molded breadth of the vessel at or below the deepest subdivision load line.

Query_Text_cn: 4吃水（d）系指在船长中点处从船型基线至所述水线间的垂直距离。
Translation: 4. Draft (d) refers to the vertical distance at the midship point of the vessel from the baseline to the specified waterline.

Query_Text_cn: 5某一处所的渗透率（μ）系指该处所浸水容积与浸没容积之比。
Translation: The penetration rate (μ) at a given location refers to the ratio of the inundated volume to the submerged volume at that location.

Query_Text_cn: 1本规则旨在给船舶规定一个最低的分舱标准。
Translation: The purpose of this regulation is to establish a minimum subdivision standard for ships.

Query_Text_cn: 式中：R0为上述.1公式算出的R值。
Translation: In the formula, R0 is the R value calculated according to formula.1 above.

Query_Text_cn: 1按本条计算所得的达到的分舱指数A应不小于按第25-3.2条计算所得的要求的分舱指数R。
Translation: The attained subdivision index A calculated in accordance with this article shall not be less than the required subdivision index R calculated in accordance with 25-3.2.

Query_Text_cn: si表示所考虑的舱或舱组浸水后生存概率，包括任何水平分隔的影响。
Translation: si represents the probability of survival after flooding of the compartment or group of compartments under consideration, including the effects of any horizontal subdivision.

Query_Text_cn: 3在计算A时应采用水平纵倾。
Translation: Horizontal inclination should be used when calculating A.

Query_Text_cn: 4该总和仅包括那些有助于增加达到的分舱指数A值的浸水情况。
Translation: This total only includes flooding scenarios that contribute to an increase in the attained subdivision index A.

Query_Text_cn: 5上述公式所表示的总和应计及整船长范围内单个舱或两个或更多相邻舱浸水的所有情况。
Translation: The total sum represented by the above formula should account for all cases of flooding involving a single compartment or two or more adjacent compartments throughout the entire length of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，边舱或舱组和其相邻的内侧舱或舱组间同时浸水的所有情况也应加入总和，此时假定一矩形穿透扩展至船中心线但不包括中心线处舱壁的破损。
Translation: In addition, all cases of simultaneous flooding between the side compartment or compartment group and its adjacent inner compartment or compartment group should also be included in the total. In these cases, it is assumed that a rectangular penetration extends to the ship's centerline but does not include damage to the bulkhead at the centerline.

Query_Text_cn: 7破损的垂向范围假定为从基线向上扩展至水线以上或更高的任一水密水平分隔。
Translation: The assumed vertical extent of damage is from the baseline upward to the waterline or to any higher watertight horizontal subdivision.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果一个较小范围的破损会产生更为严重的后果，则须假定为该范围。
Translation: However, if a smaller area of damage would result in more severe consequences, it must be assumed as the relevant scope.

Query_Text_cn: 8如在假定浸水舱范围内设有管子、管弄或隧道，其布置必须保证累进浸水不会扩展到那些假定浸水的舱室以外的其他舱室。
Translation: If pipes, ducts, or tunnels are installed within the assumed flooded compartment range, their arrangement must ensure that progressive flooding will not extend to compartments other than those assumed to be flooded.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果证实累进浸水的影响能被容易地控制并且不损害船舶的安全，则主管机关可允许较小的累进浸水。
Translation: However, if it is confirmed that the effects of progressive flooding can be easily controlled and do not compromise the safety of the ship, the competent authority may permit a smaller degree of progressive flooding.

Query_Text_cn: 9在根据规则进行浸水计算时，只需假定船壳有一个破洞。
Translation: When calculating flooding according to the regulations, it is only necessary to assume a single breach in the hull.

Query_Text_cn: 48最大无因次破损长度Jmax=Ls，但不大于0.24。
Translation: The maximum dimensionless failure length Jmax is equal to Ls, but not greater than 0.24.

Query_Text_cn: 破损位置沿船长的假定分布密度a=1.2+0.8E，但不大于1.2。
Translation: The assumed distribution density of damage location along the ship's length is a = 1.2 + 0.8E, but not greater than 1.2.

Query_Text_cn: Fy2y12=-+其他情况。
Translation: Fy2y12=-+Other situations.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1.5在应用本条1.1.2、1.1.3和1.1.4公式时，当所考虑的舱室跨越“船长中点”时，这些公式的值应减去一个按公式求得的q值，在此公式中取y=J'/Jmax计算F2。
Translation: 1.1.5 When applying the formulas in 1.1.2, 1.1.3, and 1.1.4 of this section, if the compartment under consideration extends across the "midship point," the values obtained from these formulas shall be reduced by a q value calculated according to the formula, in which y = J'/Jmax is used to calculate F2.

Query_Text_cn: 2若设有边舱，某一边舱的pi值应以按本条3得到的值乘以本条2.2表示内侧处所不浸水的概率的缩减因数r求得。
Translation: If wing compartments are provided, the pi value for a given wing compartment should be calculated by multiplying the value obtained in paragraph 3 of this article by the reduction factor r, which represents the probability of the inner space remaining unflooded as specified in paragraph 2.2 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1某一边舱和其相邻的内侧舱室同时浸水的情况，其pi值应以本条3各公式所得的值乘以因数（1-r）求得。
Translation: 2.1 In the event that one side compartment and its adjacent inner compartment are flooded simultaneously, the value of pi shall be obtained by multiplying the value calculated from the formulas in paragraph 3 of this article by the factor (1-r).

Query_Text_cn: 当J＜0.2b/B时，缩减因数r应在J=0时的r=1，和J=0.2b/B时，r按上述公式所得值之间用线性内插法求得。
Translation: When J < 0.2b/B, the reduction factor r should be obtained by linear interpolation between r = 1 at J = 0 and the value of r calculated by the above formula at J = 0.2b/B.

Query_Text_cn: b计算因数pi所用的纵向限界之间的平均横向距离（m）。该距离在最深分舱载重线处由船壳板至通过纵舱壁最外部分并与其平行的平面之间向中心线垂直量计。
Translation: b is the average transverse distance (in meters) between the longitudinal boundaries used for calculating the factor pi. This distance is measured at the deepest subdivision load line, from the shell plating to the outermost part of the longitudinal bulkhead, along a plane parallel to it and perpendicular to the centerline.

Query_Text_cn: 3对几个舱作为一个舱的pi值，可直接应用本条1和2的公式计算。
Translation: The pi value for three pairs of several compartments as one compartment can be directly calculated using the formulas in items 1 and 2 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: pi=p23-p2-p3，等。
Translation: pi = p23 - p2 - p3, etc.

Query_Text_cn: 应按本条1和2对单个舱的公式计算，其无因次长度J取p的下标所标明的舱组的无因次长度。
Translation: The formula for a single compartment should be calculated in accordance with paragraphs 1 and 2 of this article, with the dimensionless length J taken as the dimensionless length of the compartment group indicated by the subscript p.

Query_Text_cn: 3.2对三个或更多相邻舱室为一组的舱组，如果该舱组的无因次长度减去该舱组最前和最后舱室的无因次长度大于Jmax，则其因数pi等于零。
Translation: For a group of three or more adjacent compartments, if the dimensionless length of the group minus the dimensionless lengths of the foremost and rearmost compartments exceeds Jmax, then the factor pi for this group shall be zero.

Query_Text_cn: range超出平衡角的正复原力臂的范围（°），但不大于20°；但是此范围应在不能被风雨密关闭的开口被淹没的角度处终止。
Translation: The range exceeds the limits of the positive righting arm within the angle of equilibrium (°), but does not exceed 20°; however, this range should terminate at the angle at which openings that cannot be closed weathertight become submerged.

Query_Text_cn: θe=最终横倾平衡角（°）。
Translation: θe = final roll equilibrium angle (°).

Query_Text_cn: 1.2如考虑下沉、横倾和纵倾后的最终水线浸没某些开口的下缘,且通过该开口可能发生累进浸水时，取s=0。
Translation: 1.2 If, after accounting for subsidence, heel, and trim, the final waterline submerges the lower edge of certain openings and progressive flooding may occur through these openings, s shall be taken as 0.

Query_Text_cn: 这些开口应包括空气管、通风筒和用风雨密门或舱口盖关闭的开口，但可以不包括那些用水密人孔盖和平面舱盖，保持甲板高度完整性的小型水密舱口盖，遥控操作的水密滑动门，通常在海上关闭的水密完整的出入门和舱口盖，以及非打开型的舷窗关闭的开口。
Translation: These openings should include air pipes, ventilators, and openings closed by weather-tight doors or hatch covers, but may exclude those closed by watertight manhole covers and flush hatch covers, small watertight hatch covers that maintain the integrity of the deck height, remotely operated watertight sliding doors, watertight doors and hatch covers that are normally kept closed at sea, and openings closed by non-opening type portlights.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果在计算中计及那些累进浸水的舱室，则本条的要求也应适用。
Translation: However, if the calculation takes into account those compartments subject to progressive flooding, the requirements of this article shall also apply.

Query_Text_cn: sp在部分载重线处的s因数。
Translation: The s factor of sp at certain load lines.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于防撞舱壁前面的所有舱室计算所得的s值应等于1，此时假定船舶位于最深分舱载重线并且不限制垂向破损范围。
Translation: For all compartments located forward of the collision bulkhead, the calculated s-value should be equal to 1, assuming the ship is at the deepest subdivision load line and there is no limitation on the vertical extent of damage.

Query_Text_cn: 3.1对水平分隔以下的舱或舱组，其s值应以本条1.1所得的值乘以按本条3.3表示该水平分隔以上处所不浸水的概率的缩减因数v求得。
Translation: For compartments or groups of compartments below a horizontal subdivision, the value of s should be obtained by multiplying the value determined in paragraph 1.1 by the reduction factor v, which represents the probability that spaces above the horizontal subdivision will not be flooded as specified in paragraph 3.3.

Query_Text_cn: 3.2如果由于水平分隔以上处所同时浸水能使指数A增加一个正值，则该舱室或舱组的s值应由按本条3.1所得的值增加一个因同时浸水按本条1.1得到的s值乘以因数（1-v）求得的值。
Translation: 3.2 If simultaneous flooding above the horizontal subdivision causes an increase in index A by a positive value, the s-value for that compartment or group of compartments shall be increased by the value obtained by multiplying the s-value resulting from simultaneous flooding as determined in paragraph 1.1 by the factor (1-v), in addition to the value obtained in accordance with paragraph 3.1.

Query_Text_cn: 取其较小者。
Translation: Take the lesser of the two.

Query_Text_cn: 1应向船长提供必要的可靠资料，以使船长能在各种营运情况下通过迅速而简便的方法得到有关船舶稳性的准确指导。
Translation: Necessary and reliable information should be provided to the captain to enable him to obtain accurate guidance on the ship's stability in various operational situations through quick and simple methods.

Query_Text_cn: 3破损后维持稳性所必需的所有其他数据和辅助措施。
Translation: All other necessary data and auxiliary measures required to maintain stability after three damages.

Query_Text_cn: 参见MCS/Circ.651通函《对SOLAS公约第II-1章B-1部分规则的解释》。
Translation: Refer to MSC/Circ.651, "Interpretation of the provisions of Part B-1 of Chapter II-1 of the SOLAS Convention."

Query_Text_cn: ②视何者导致较严重的后果而定。
Translation: ②It depends on which causes more serious consequences.

Query_Text_cn: 2为了指导高级船员，在驾驶室内应有固定显示的或随时可用的控制图，该图应清晰标明各层甲板及货舱的水密舱室的限界，限界上的开口及其关闭装置和控制位置，以及扶正由于浸水产生的横倾的装置。
Translation: 2. To guide senior crew members, a permanently displayed or readily available control diagram should be provided in the wheelhouse. This diagram must clearly indicate the boundaries of watertight compartments on each deck and in the cargo holds, the openings on these boundaries and their closing devices and control locations, as well as the devices used to correct heel caused by flooding.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还应给船上高级船员提供包含上述资料的小册子。
Translation: In addition, a booklet containing the above information should also be provided to senior crew members on board.

Query_Text_cn: 3为了提供本条1.1所指的资料，如果所用的极限GM（或KG）值从有关分舱指数的计算中求得，则此极限GM应在最深分舱载重线和部分载重线之间呈线性变化。
Translation: 3. In order to provide the information referred to in Article 1.1, if the limiting GM (or KG) value is obtained from the calculation of the relevant subdivision index, this limiting GM shall vary linearly between the deepest subdivision load line and the partial load line.

Query_Text_cn: ②在此情况下，如部分载重线吃水的最小GM值由分舱指数的计算求得，则此GM值应假定为在低于部分载重线的各较小吃水时的GM值，除非应用完整稳性的要求。
Translation: ②In this case, if the minimum GM value at partial load line drafts is determined by the calculation of the subdivision index, this GM value should be assumed as the GM value at all lesser drafts below the partial load line, unless the requirements for intact stability are applied.

Query_Text_cn: 1为适应船舶设计和船舶正常作业，水密分隔上的开口数量应保持最少。
Translation: To accommodate ship design and ensure normal operations, the number of openings on watertight divisions should be kept to a minimum.

Query_Text_cn: 凡是为了出入、管路、通风、电缆等需要而穿过水密舱壁和内部甲板时，须设有保持水密完整性的装置。
Translation: Any penetrations through watertight bulkheads and internal decks for access, piping, ventilation, cables, or other purposes must be equipped with devices that maintain watertight integrity.

Query_Text_cn: 如果表明任何累进浸水能易于控制并且不损害船舶安全，则主管机关可以允许放宽对干舷甲板以上的开口的水密性要求。
Translation: If it can be demonstrated that any progressive flooding can be easily controlled and does not compromise the safety of the ship, the competent authority may permit a relaxation of the watertightness requirements for openings above the freeboard deck.

Query_Text_cn: 2为确保在海上使用的内部开口的水密完整性而设置的门须是滑动水密门，该门能从驾驶室遥控关闭，也能从舱壁的每一边就地操纵。
Translation: Doors installed to ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings used at sea must be sliding watertight doors, which can be remotely closed from the wheelhouse and locally operated from either side of the bulkhead.

Query_Text_cn: 在控制位置应装设显示门是开启或关闭的指示器，并且在门关闭时发出声响报警。
Translation: An indicator showing whether the door is open or closed should be installed at the control position, and an audible alarm should be triggered when the door is closed.

Query_Text_cn: 在主动力失灵时，动力、控制和指示器应能工作。
Translation: In the event of main power failure, the power supply, control, and indicators should remain operational.

Query_Text_cn: 特别应注意减少控制系统失灵的影响。
Translation: Special attention should be paid to minimizing the impact of control system failures.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个动力操纵的滑动水密门应有一个独立的手动机械操纵装置。
Translation: Each power-operated sliding watertight door shall be provided with an independent manual mechanical operating device.

Query_Text_cn: 该装置应能从门的任一边用手开启和关闭该门。
Translation: The device should be capable of opening and closing the door manually from either side.

Query_Text_cn: 3用以保证内部开口的水密完整性且通常在航行时关闭的出入门和舱盖，应在该处和驾驶室装设显示这些门或舱盖是开启还是关闭的设施。
Translation: To ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings, access doors and hatches that are normally kept closed during navigation should be equipped with indicators at their locations and in the wheelhouse to show whether these doors or hatches are open or closed.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个此类门或舱盖必须附贴一个通告牌，其大意是不能让它开着。
Translation: Each such door or hatch must have a notice posted on it, indicating that it must not be left open.

Query_Text_cn: 这类门或舱盖的使用应经值班驾驶员批准。
Translation: The use of such doors or hatches shall be approved by the duty officer.

Query_Text_cn: 4可以装设结构良好的水密门或坡道用作大型货物处所的内部分隔，条件是主管机关确信此种门或坡道是必要的。
Translation: 4. Well-constructed watertight doors or ramps may be installed as internal divisions for large cargo spaces, provided that the competent authority is satisfied that such doors or ramps are necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 这些门或坡道可以是绞链的，滚动的或滑动的门或坡道，但不应是遥控操纵的。
Translation: These doors or ramps may be hinged, rolling, or sliding, but should not be remotely operated.

Query_Text_cn: ②此类门或坡道应在开航前关妥，并应在航行中保持关闭；此类门或坡道在港内开启的时间和船舶离港前关闭的时间应记入航海日志中。
Translation: Such doors or ramps shall be properly closed before departure and kept closed during navigation; the time when such doors or ramps are opened in port and the time when they are closed before the vessel leaves port shall be recorded in the ship's logbook.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在航程中需要通过任何此类门或坡道，则应设有适当装置以防未经授权的开启。
Translation: If any such doors or ramps need to be passed during the voyage, appropriate devices should be installed to prevent unauthorized opening.

Query_Text_cn: 5为保证内部开口的水密完整性，在海上保持永久关闭的其他关闭装置，应有一个通告牌贴于其上，其大意是必须保持关闭。
Translation: To ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings, any other closing device that is to remain permanently closed at sea shall have a notice posted on it indicating that it must be kept closed.

Query_Text_cn: 用螺栓紧固盖子的人孔不必设此通告牌。
Translation: Manholes with bolted covers do not require this notice sign.

Query_Text_cn: 参见MSC/Circ.919通函《破损控制图指南》。
Translation: Refer to MSC/Circ.919, "Guidelines for Damage Control Plans."

Query_Text_cn: ②参见MSC/Circ.651通函《对SOLAS公约第II-1章B-1部分规则的解释》。
Translation: See MSC/Circ.651, "Interpretation of the Provisions of Part B-1 of SOLAS Chapter II-1."

Query_Text_cn: 1所有通向在破损分析中假定为完整的且位于最终水线以下的舱室的外部开口，应要求水密。
Translation: All external openings leading to compartments assumed to be intact and located below the final waterline in damage analysis shall be required to be watertight.

Query_Text_cn: 2根据本条1要求水密的外部开口应有足够的强度，除货舱盖外，在驾驶室应设有指示器。
Translation: 2. According to the requirements of paragraph 1 of this article, watertight external openings must have sufficient strength. Except for cargo hatch covers, indicators should be installed in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 3在限制垂向破损范围的甲板以下的船壳外板上的开口，在海上应保持永久关闭。
Translation: Openings in the shell plating below the deck limiting the vertical extent of damage shall be kept permanently closed at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在航程中需要通过任何这类开口，则应设有适当装置以防未经受授权的开启。
Translation: If it is necessary to pass through any such openings during the voyage, appropriate devices shall be provided to prevent unauthorized access.

Query_Text_cn: 4尽管有本条3的要求，如为了船舶的操纵需要并且不损害船舶的安全，主管机关仍可授权船长根据需要打开某些特殊的门。
Translation: 4. Notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 3 of this article, the competent authority may authorize the master to open certain special doors as necessary for the operation of the ship, provided that it does not compromise the safety of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 5为保证外部开口的水密完整性，在海上保持永久关闭的其他关闭装置，应有一个通告牌贴于其上，其大意是必须保持关闭。
Translation: To ensure the watertight integrity of external openings, all other closing appliances that are to remain permanently closed at sea shall have a notice posted on them indicating that they must be kept closed.

Query_Text_cn: 1机器、锅炉和其他受压容器、有关的管系和附件，其设计和构造应适合于它们的用途；并在充分考虑到运动部件、热表面和其他危险的情况下，其安装和保护应使其对船上人员伤害的危险性降至最低程度。
Translation: The design and construction of machinery, boilers, and other pressure vessels, as well as associated piping systems and fittings, shall be suitable for their intended purposes; and, with full consideration given to moving parts, hot surfaces, and other hazards, their installation and protection shall minimize the risk of injury to personnel on board to the greatest extent possible.

Query_Text_cn: 其设计应考虑到结构所用的材料、设备用途以及可能遇到的工作条件和船上环境条件。
Translation: Its design should take into account the materials used for the structure, the intended use of the equipment, as well as the possible operating conditions and onboard environmental conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关应特别注意单个重要推进部件的可靠性；而且可以要求设有一个独立推进动力源，足以使船舶保持一个可航行速度，特别是在非常规布置的情况下。
Translation: The competent authorities should pay special attention to the reliability of individual critical propulsion components and may require the installation of an independent propulsion power source sufficient to maintain a navigable speed, especially in cases of unconventional arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 3应设有措施，在任一重要辅机不能工作时，使推进机械的正常运转能够维持或恢复。
Translation: 3. Measures shall be in place to ensure that the normal operation of the propulsion machinery can be maintained or restored in the event of failure of any essential auxiliary.

Query_Text_cn: 10主推进装置（包括可调螺距螺旋桨）的液压、气动或电气的控制装置。
Translation: Hydraulic, pneumatic, or electric control systems for main propulsion units (including controllable pitch propellers).

Query_Text_cn: 但是，当主管机关对整体安全性作考虑后，可以接受将正常运行的推进能力作部分降低。
Translation: However, when the competent authority considers overall safety, it may accept a partial reduction in propulsion capability during normal operation.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见MSC/Circ.834通函《机舱的设置、设计和布置指南》。
Translation: Refer to MSC/Circ.834 "Guidelines for the Arrangement, Design and Installation of Machinery Spaces."

Query_Text_cn: ②参见MSC/Circ.647通函《关于最大限度减少可燃液体系统泄漏的指南》，该通函经MSC/Circ.851通函《关于机舱燃油系统的指南》补充。
Translation: Refer to MSC/Circ.647, "Guidelines to Minimize Leakages from Combustible Liquid Systems," as supplemented by MSC/Circ.851, "Guidelines for Engine Room Fuel Oil Systems."

Query_Text_cn: 4应设有措施保证在没有外来帮助的情况下能使机器从瘫船状态运转起来。
Translation: Measures shall be in place to ensure that the machinery can be brought back into operation from a dead ship condition without external assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 5所有锅炉、机器的所有部件，所有蒸汽、液压、气动和其他系统，以及有关的承受内部压力的附件，在首次投入使用前，应经受包括压力试验在内的相应试验。
Translation: All components of boilers and machinery, all steam, hydraulic, pneumatic, and other systems, as well as related accessories subjected to internal pressure, shall undergo appropriate tests, including pressure tests, before being put into service for the first time.

Query_Text_cn: 6主推进装置和船舶推进与安全必需的所有辅机，均应设计成安装于船上后，在船舶正浮时以及向任一舷横倾至15°和向任一舷横摇至22.5°，并同时首或尾纵摇7.5°时能正常工作。
Translation: All six main propulsion units, as well as all auxiliary machinery essential for ship propulsion and safety, shall be designed to operate normally after installation on board when the vessel is upright, as well as when it is heeled up to 15° to either side, rolling up to 22.5° to either side, and simultaneously pitching either fore or aft up to 7.5°.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到船舶的类型、尺度和营运条件，主管机关可允许偏离这些角度。
Translation: Taking into account the type, size, and operating conditions of the ship, the competent authority may permit deviations from these angles.

Query_Text_cn: 7应有便于对主推进装置和辅机，包括锅炉和受压容器，进行清洁、检查和维修保养的措施。
Translation: 7. Measures should be in place to facilitate the cleaning, inspection, and maintenance of the main propulsion system and auxiliary machinery, including boilers and pressure vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 8应特别注意推进装置系统的设计、构造和安装，以使在正常运转范围内机器的任何振动模态不会引起其过度的应力。
Translation: Special attention should be paid to the design, construction, and installation of the propulsion system to ensure that no vibration mode within the normal operating range causes excessive stress on the machinery.

Query_Text_cn: 9管系中的非金属膨胀接头如安装于贯穿船侧的管系中，且贯穿位置和非金属膨胀接头均位于最深载重线以下，则应作为按第I/10(a)条规定检验的一部分进行检查，并在必要时或按制造商建议的间隔期予以更换。
Translation: If non-metallic expansion joints in piping systems are installed in piping that penetrates the ship's side, and both the penetration point and the non-metallic expansion joint are located below the deepest load line, they shall be inspected as part of the examination required by Regulation I/10(a), and replaced as necessary or at intervals recommended by the manufacturer.

Query_Text_cn: 10操作和保养须知以及保证船舶机器和设备安全操作的图纸文件应用高级船员和船员明白的语言文字书写，以使其在执行自已的职责时能够看懂这些资料。
Translation: The instructions for operation and maintenance, as well as the drawings and documents ensuring the safe operation of the ship's machinery and equipment, shall be written in a language easily understood by senior officers and crew members, so that they can comprehend these materials when performing their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 11用于燃油舱、沉淀柜及润滑油舱的透气管的安装和布置应使透气管在破损时不会直接导致海水或雨水溅入。
Translation: The installation and arrangement of vent pipes for fuel tanks, settling tanks, and lubricating oil tanks shall ensure that, in the event of damage, seawater or rainwater will not directly splash into the tanks.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘新建船舶应对推进及主系统必需的每一种燃油配备两个燃油柜或等效布置，其容量必须至少能供船舶推进装置在最大持续功率下，以及发电机装置在海上正常负荷下工作8h。
Translation: Each newly built ship shall be equipped with two fuel tanks or an equivalent arrangement for each type of fuel required for propulsion and main systems. The capacity of these tanks must be sufficient to supply the ship's propulsion system operating at maximum continuous power, as well as the generator set operating under normal sea load, for at least 8 hours.

Query_Text_cn: ①本节规定只适用于1998年7月1日或以后建造的船舶。
Translation: This section applies only to ships constructed on or after July 1, 1998.

Query_Text_cn: 1当机器存在超速的危险时，应有措施以保证不超过安全速度。
Translation: When there is a risk of the machine overspeeding, measures shall be taken to ensure that the safe speed is not exceeded.

Query_Text_cn: 2当主机或辅机（包括受压容器或这类机器的任何部件）经受内部压力并可能受到危险的超压时，应有措施切实防止这种过度的压力。
Translation: When the main or auxiliary machinery (including pressure vessels or any components of such machines) is subjected to internal pressure and may be exposed to hazardous overpressure, effective measures must be taken to prevent such excessive pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 3对船舶推进、船舶安全或船上人员安全必要的机器，其动力传递用的所有齿轮装置和每根轴与每个联轴器的设计和构造应能承受一切运行情况下可能产生的最大工作应力，并应适当考虑到驱动它们的或由它们作为组成部分的机器的型式。
Translation: 3. All gearing arrangements used for power transmission and every shaft and coupling, which are essential to ship propulsion, ship safety, or the safety of personnel on board, shall be designed and constructed to withstand the maximum working stresses that may occur under all operating conditions, with due regard given to the type of machinery by which they are driven or of which they form a part.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见SOLAS公约第II-2/4.2条“燃油、润滑油和其他易燃油类的布置”。
Translation: Refer to SOLAS Convention Regulation II-2/4.2 "Arrangement of fuel oil, lubricating oil and other flammable oils."

Query_Text_cn: 4缸径为200mm或曲柄箱容积为0.6m3及以上的内燃机，应设有适当型式和足够释压面积的曲柄箱防爆安全阀。
Translation: Internal combustion engines with four cylinders and a bore of 200 mm or more, or with a crankcase volume of 0.6 m³ or above, shall be equipped with crankcase explosion relief valves of appropriate type and sufficient relief area.

Query_Text_cn: 安全阀的布置或提供的措施，应保证阀排出的气体对人员伤害的可能性降至最低程度。
Translation: The arrangement of safety valves or the measures provided should ensure that the likelihood of harm to personnel from discharged gases is minimized.

Query_Text_cn: 5主涡轮推进机械和（如适用时）主内燃推进机械及辅机，应设有发生诸如滑油供应故障等可能导致机器的迅速破坏、严重损伤或爆炸的故障时能自动停车的装置。
Translation: Main turbine propulsion machinery and, where applicable, main internal combustion propulsion machinery and auxiliary machinery shall be equipped with devices capable of automatically shutting down the machinery in the event of failures—such as lubricating oil supply failure—that could lead to rapid destruction, serious damage, or explosion of the machinery.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关可允许采用自动停车装置的越控装置。
Translation: The competent authority may permit the use of automatic parking devices as override mechanisms.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶应具有足够的后退动力，以保证在所有正常情况下均能控制船舶。
Translation: The vessel shall have sufficient astern power to ensure that it can be controlled under all normal circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 2对机器在足够的时间内使推进器换向，并在合理的距离内使船舶从最大营运前进航速到停止的能力应进行验证并记录。
Translation: The ability of two machines to reverse the thrusters within sufficient time and to bring the vessel from its maximum operational forward speed to a stop within a reasonable distance shall be verified and documented.

Query_Text_cn: 3对航行试验记录的停船时间、船首航向和距离，连同多螺旋桨船舶在一个或几个螺旋桨不工作的情况下所进行的航行和操纵以测定其能力的试验结果应备于船上供船长或指定的人员随时可用。
Translation: Records of stopping time, heading, and distance from navigation trials, together with the results of trials conducted to determine the maneuvering capabilities of multi-propeller vessels when one or more propellers are not in operation, shall be kept on board and made readily available to the master or designated personnel at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 4如船舶设有操纵或停船的补充措施，则应按本条2和3的要求，对这些措施的有效性进行验证并记录。
Translation: 4. If supplementary measures for maneuvering or stopping are provided on the ship, their effectiveness shall be verified and recorded in accordance with the requirements of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 1除另有明文规定外，每艘船舶应配备使主管机关满意的主操舵装置和辅助操舵装置。
Translation: Except as otherwise expressly provided, every ship shall be equipped with a main steering gear and an auxiliary steering gear satisfactory to the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 主操舵装置和辅助操舵装置的布置应使两者中之一在发生故障时，不会导致另一装置不能工作。
Translation: The arrangement of the main steering gear and the auxiliary steering gear shall ensure that a failure in one does not render the other inoperative.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1所有操舵装置的部件和舵杆应为主管机关满意的坚固和可靠的构造。
Translation: 2.1 All components of the steering gear and the rudder stock shall be of robust and reliable construction to the satisfaction of the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 对于非双套的必要部件的适用性应特别注意。
Translation: Special attention should be paid to the applicability of essential components that are not dual-equipped.

Query_Text_cn: 任何这类必要部件，如合适时，应采用耐磨轴承，如球轴承、滚子轴承或者能持久润滑或设有润滑装置的套筒轴承。
Translation: Any such necessary components, where appropriate, should use wear-resistant bearings, such as ball bearings, roller bearings, or sleeve bearings that are either permanently lubricated or equipped with lubrication devices.

Query_Text_cn: 2.2对于承受内部液压的管系和其他操舵装置的部件，确定其尺寸计算所用的设计压力应至少为本条3.2所指运行状况下可能出现的最大工作压力的1.25倍，同时应考虑在该系统低压一侧可能存在的压力。
Translation: 2.2 For piping systems and other steering gear components subjected to internal hydraulic pressure, the design pressure used for determining their dimensions shall be at least 1.25 times the maximum working pressure that may occur under the operating conditions specified in 3.2 of this section. At the same time, consideration shall be given to the pressure that may exist on the low-pressure side of the system.

Query_Text_cn: 根据主管机关的意见，管系和部件的设计应采用疲劳衡准，同时考虑动力负荷所产生的脉动压力。
Translation: According to the competent authorities, the design of piping systems and components should adopt fatigue criteria, while also taking into account the pulsating pressure caused by dynamic loads.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《关于操纵资料在船上存放和显示的建议》(A.601(15)决议)、《船舶操纵性标准》(MSC.137(76)决议)和《船舶操纵性标准的解释性说明》(MSC/Circ.1053通函)。
Translation: ① Refer to the "Recommendation on the Provision and Display of Manoeuvring Information on Board Ships" (Resolution A.601(15)), the "Standards for Ship Manoeuvrability" (Resolution MSC.137(76)), and the "Explanatory Notes to the Standards for Ship Manoeuvrability" (MSC/Circ.1053).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.415(XI)决议《关于改进的客货船操舵装置标准》和A.416(XI)决议《关于现有液货船操舵装置的检查》。
Translation: See Resolution A.415(XI) "Improved Steering Gear Standards for Passenger and Cargo Ships" and Resolution A.416(XI) "Inspection of Steering Gears on Existing Tankers."

Query_Text_cn: 2.3凡在液压系统中能被隔断的和由于动力源或外力作用能产生压力的任何部件，应设置安全阀。
Translation: Any component in the hydraulic system that can be isolated and is capable of generating pressure due to the power source or external forces shall be equipped with a safety valve.

Query_Text_cn: 安全阀的调定应不超过设计压力。
Translation: The safety valve should be set no higher than the design pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 安全阀应有足够尺寸并布置成能够避免过度升高的压力超过设计压力。
Translation: The safety valve should be adequately sized and arranged to prevent excessive pressure from exceeding the design pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 4设计成在最大后退航速时不致损坏；但是这个设计要求不需要用最大后退航速和最大舵角的试航来验证。
Translation: 4. It is designed to prevent damage at maximum reverse speed; however, this design requirement does not need to be verified through sea trials at both maximum reverse speed and maximum rudder angle.

Query_Text_cn: 3动力操纵，以必要时满足本条4.2的要求，以及在任何情况下主管机关要求舵柄处舵杆直径超过230mm时（不包括冰区加强）的要求。
Translation: 3. Power steering shall meet the requirements of Section 4.2 when necessary, as well as the requirements in any case where the competent authority requires the diameter of the rudder stock at the helm to exceed 230 mm (excluding reinforcement for ice areas).

Query_Text_cn: 2能从驾驶室某一位置投入工作。
Translation: 2. It can be put into operation from a specific position in the cab.

Query_Text_cn: 操舵装置的任何一台动力设备失电时，应在驾驶室里发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: In the event of a power failure in any steering gear power unit, both audible and visual alarms shall be activated in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 3主操舵装置布置成当其管系或1台动力设备发生单项故障时，此故障能被隔离，使操舵能力能够保持或迅速恢复。
Translation: The three main steering gear units are arranged so that, in the event of a single failure in their piping system or one power unit, the fault can be isolated, allowing steering capability to be maintained or quickly restored.

Query_Text_cn: 6.2直至1986年9月1日止，主管机关可以接受设置经证实具有可靠性记录但不符合本条6.1.3对液压系统要求的操舵装置。
Translation: 6.2 Until September 1, 1986, the competent authority may accept steering gear installations with a proven record of reliability but not meeting the requirements for hydraulic systems specified in 6.1.3 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 6.3非液压型式的操舵装置应达到等效的标准，并使主管机关满意。
Translation: 6.3 Non-hydraulic steering systems shall meet equivalent standards and satisfy the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 但不必设置两套操舵手轮或操舵手柄。
Translation: However, it is not necessary to install two sets of steering wheels or steering handles.

Query_Text_cn: 3对于位于舵机舱的辅助操舵装置，如系动力操纵，也应能在驾驶室进行操作，并应独立于主操舵装置的控制系统。
Translation: For auxiliary steering gear located in the steering gear compartment, if it is power-operated, it must also be operable from the wheelhouse and be independent of the control system of the main steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 5应仅对操舵装置控制供电线路设有短路保护。
Translation: Short-circuit protection should only be provided for the power supply circuit controlling the steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 9本条和第30条要求的电力线路和操舵装置系统以及相关的部件、电缆和管子应在它们的整个长度范围内尽可能地分离。
Translation: The power supply lines and steering gear systems, as well as the associated components, cables, and pipes required by this article and Article 30, shall be separated as far as practicable throughout their entire length.

Query_Text_cn: 10驾驶室与舵机舱之间应设有通信设施。
Translation: Communication facilities should be provided between the wheelhouse and the steering gear compartment.

Query_Text_cn: 1当主操舵装置系动力操纵时，在驾驶室显示。
Translation: 1. When the main steering gear is power-operated, it shall be indicated in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 2能在舵机舱内辨认出来。
Translation: 2 can be identified in the steering gear compartment.

Query_Text_cn: 2每个液体贮存器设低位警报器，以便确切和尽早地指示液体泄漏。
Translation: Each liquid storage tank is equipped with a low-level alarm to provide accurate and early indication of liquid leakage.

Query_Text_cn: 3当主操舵装置要求动力操纵时，设置一个固定储存柜，其容量足以至少为一个动力执行系统(包括贮存器)进行再充液。
Translation: When the main steering gear requires power operation, a fixed storage tank shall be provided with sufficient capacity to allow at least one power actuating system (including the reservoir) to be refilled.

Query_Text_cn: 储存柜应用管系固定联结以使能从舵机舱内容易地再次为液压系统充液，并应设有液位指示器。
Translation: The storage cabinet shall be equipped with fixed piping connections to allow easy refilling of the hydraulic system from within the steering gear compartment, and a liquid level indicator shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 2有适当的布置以保证有到达操舵装置和控制器的工作通道。
Translation: 2. Appropriate arrangements shall be made to ensure that there is a working passage to the steering gear and controllers.

Query_Text_cn: 这些布置应包括扶手栏杆和格子板或其他防滑地板以保证液体泄漏时有适宜的工作条件。
Translation: These arrangements should include handrails and grating or other non-slip flooring to ensure suitable working conditions in the event of liquid leakage.

Query_Text_cn: 14如果要求舵柄处舵杆直径超过230mm（不包括冰区加强），应设有由应急电源或位于舵机舱内的独立动力源在45s内自动供电的替代动力源，其容量至少满足供应符合本条4.2要求的操舵装置动力设备及其有关的控制系统和舵角指示器。
Translation: If the diameter of the rudder stock at the tiller exceeds 230 mm (excluding ice strengthening), an alternative power source must be provided, which is automatically supplied within 45 seconds by an emergency power supply or an independent power source located in the steering gear compartment. Its capacity must be sufficient to supply the steering gear power equipment, its associated control systems, and rudder angle indicators in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 4.2 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 此独立动力源应只用于上述目的。
Translation: This independent power source should be used solely for the aforementioned purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘10,000总吨及以上的船舶，替代动力源应具有至少连续运转30min的能力，在任何其他船舶上则至少为10min。
Translation: For each vessel of 10,000 gross tonnage and above, the alternative power source must be capable of operating continuously for at least 30 minutes, while for any other vessel, it must be capable of operating for at least 10 minutes.

Query_Text_cn: 1510,000总吨及以上的每艘油船、化学品船或气体运输船和70,000总吨及以上的每艘其他船舶，主操舵装置应由符合本条6规定的两台或两台以上相同的动力设备组成。
Translation: For each oil tanker, chemical tanker, or gas carrier of 150,000 gross tonnage and above, and for each other ship of 70,000 gross tonnage and above, the main steering gear shall consist of two or more identical power units complying with the provisions of paragraph 6 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.2至少两个相同的动力执行系统，在正常运转中同时工作时，应能满足本条3.2的要求。
Translation: At least two identical power actuation systems, when operating simultaneously under normal conditions, shall be able to meet the requirements specified in Section 3.2 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 当需要符合此要求时，液压动力执行系统应设有交叉联结。
Translation: When compliance with this requirement is necessary, the hydraulic power actuation system should be equipped with cross-linkage.

Query_Text_cn: 一个系统中液体的流失应能发现，有缺陷的系统应能自动隔离，以使另一个或几个执行系统能保持全面运转。
Translation: Any loss of liquid in a system should be detectable, and any defective system should be able to automatically isolate itself so that one or more other operating systems can continue to function fully.

Query_Text_cn: 3非液压型式的操舵装置应能达到等效标准。
Translation: Non-hydraulic steering systems shall be able to meet equivalent standards.

Query_Text_cn: 2如果操舵装置只包括单个舵执行器，则应特别注意在设计中对所使用的材料、密封装置的安装、试验检查和有效维护的要求进行包括疲劳分析和断裂力学分析（如适用）在内的应力分析。
Translation: If the steering gear consists of only a single rudder actuator, special attention should be paid in the design to the requirements for the materials used, installation of sealing devices, testing and inspection, and effective maintenance, including stress analysis such as fatigue analysis and fracture mechanics analysis where applicable.

Query_Text_cn: 在考虑上述情况时，主管机关应采用包括本组织通过的《10,000总吨及以上但小于100,000载重吨的油船、化学品船和气体运输船非双套舵执行器验收指南》的各项规定。
Translation: In considering the above circumstances, the competent authority shall apply all provisions, including those set out in the "Guidelines for Acceptance of Non-Dual Rudder Actuators for Oil Tankers, Chemical Tankers, and Gas Carriers of 10,000 Gross Tonnage and Above but Less Than 100,000 Deadweight Tonnage," adopted by this organization.

Query_Text_cn: 18对于10,000总吨及以上但小于70,000载重吨的油船、化学品船或气体运输船，至1986年9月1日止，主管机关可接受具有可靠性记录但不符合本条16中对液压系统要求的单项故障衡准的操舵装置系统。
Translation: 18 For oil tankers, chemical tankers, or gas carriers of 10,000 gross tonnage and above but less than 70,000 deadweight tons, until September 1, 1986, the competent authority may accept steering gear systems with a record of reliability but not meeting the single failure criterion for hydraulic systems specified in paragraph 16 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 2应设有两个独立操舵装置控制系统，每个系统均能从驾驶室操作。
Translation: Two independent steering gear control systems should be provided, each capable of being operated from the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 4每个操舵装置控制系统，如系电动者，应由操舵装置电力线路设独立电路供电，或从向操舵装置电力线路供电的电路板上邻近该电力线路处的一点直接供电。
Translation: Each steering gear control system, if electrically operated, shall be supplied by an independent circuit from the steering gear power supply line, or directly from a point on the switchboard adjacent to the power supply line to the steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 20除本条19的要求外，1984年9月1日以前建造的40,000总吨及以上的每艘油船、化学品船或气体运输船，其操舵装置应在不迟于1988年9月1日布置成当管系或其中1台动力设备发生单项故障时，能够保持操舵能力，或舵的运动能加以限制，以使操舵能力迅速重新获得。
Translation: 20. In addition to the requirements of paragraph 19 of this regulation, every oil tanker, chemical tanker, or gas carrier of 40,000 gross tonnage and above constructed before 1 September 1984 shall, not later than 1 September 1988, be provided with steering gear arrangements such that, in the event of a single failure in the piping system or in any one of the power units, steering capability can be maintained or the movement of the rudder can be limited so that steering capability can be promptly regained.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织通过的A.467(XII)决议。
Translation: Resolution A.467(XII) adopted by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 3如各液压动力系统是交叉联结的，则应作适当布置以保证一个系统中液体的流失能被发现，有缺陷的系统能自动地或从驾驶室加以隔离，以使其他系统能保持全面运转。
Translation: If the hydraulic power systems are interconnected, appropriate arrangements should be made to ensure that any loss of fluid in one system can be detected, and that the defective system can be automatically or manually isolated from the cockpit, so that the other systems can continue to operate fully.

Query_Text_cn: 1对于电动和电动液压操舵装置，应在驾驶室和适当的主机控制位置装设指示其电动机正在运转的设备。
Translation: For electric and electro-hydraulic steering gear, devices indicating that the electric motor is running shall be installed in the wheelhouse and at appropriate main engine control positions.

Query_Text_cn: 2由1台或几台动力设备组成的每一电动或电动液压操舵装置至少应由两个自主配电板直接供电的专用电路来供电；但是，其中之一可以由应急配电板供电。
Translation: Each electric or electro-hydraulic steering gear unit, consisting of one or more power units, shall be supplied by at least two dedicated power circuits directly from the main switchboard; however, one of these circuits may be supplied by the emergency switchboard.

Query_Text_cn: 与电动或电动液压主操舵装置相联系的电动或电动液压辅助操舵装置可与向此主操舵装置供电的电路之一连接。
Translation: The electric or electro-hydraulic auxiliary steering gear associated with the electric or electro-hydraulic main steering gear may be connected to one of the circuits supplying power to the main steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 向电动或电动液压操舵装置供电的电路应有足够容量，以便能同时向与它连接且可能需要同时工作的所有电动机供电。
Translation: The circuit supplying power to electric or electro-hydraulic steering devices shall have sufficient capacity to simultaneously supply all motors connected to it that may need to operate at the same time.

Query_Text_cn: 3这类电路和电动机应设有短路保护和过载报警装置。
Translation: Such circuits and motors should be equipped with short-circuit protection and overload alarm devices.

Query_Text_cn: 包括起动电流在内的过电流保护装置（如有时），应不小于所保护电路或电动机全负荷电流的两倍，并应布置成能允许适当的起动电流通过。
Translation: Overcurrent protection devices, including those for starting current where applicable, shall not be rated at less than twice the full-load current of the protected circuit or motor, and shall be arranged to permit the passage of an appropriate starting current.

Query_Text_cn: 如采用三相供电，应设有能指示任一相所发生故障的报警装置。
Translation: If three-phase power supply is used, an alarm device capable of indicating a fault in any phase shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 本节所要求的警报应为听觉和视觉报警，并应位于正常控制主机的主机处所或控制室内明显位置上，并应符合第51条适用的要求。
Translation: The alarms required in this section shall be both audible and visual, and shall be installed in prominent locations within the main control station or control room of the normal control host. They shall also comply with the applicable requirements of Article 51.

Query_Text_cn: 4在小于1,600总吨的船上，按第29.4.3条要求为动力操作的辅助操舵装置，如不是电动的或是由原来用作其他用途的电动机来驱动的，则主操舵装置可由来自主配电板的一个电路供电。
Translation: On ships of less than 1,600 gross tonnage, where the power-operated auxiliary steering gear required by paragraph 29.4.3 is not electrically driven or is driven by an electric motor primarily used for other purposes, the main steering gear may be supplied by a single circuit from the main switchboard.

Query_Text_cn: 当这类原来用作其他用途的电动机作为这种辅助舵装置的动力时，如主管机关对其保护装置表示满意，并认为其满足适用于辅助操舵装置的第29.5.1条和29.5.2条以及第29.7.3条的要求时，可免除本条3的要求。
Translation: When electric motors originally used for other purposes are employed as the power source for such auxiliary steering gear, the requirements of paragraph 3 of this regulation may be waived, provided that the competent authority is satisfied with their protective devices and considers them to meet the requirements applicable to auxiliary steering gear as specified in paragraphs 29.5.1 and 29.5.2, as well as paragraph 29.7.3.

Query_Text_cn: 1对船舶推进和安全所必需的主机和辅机应设有有效的操作和控制装置。
Translation: Effective operating and control devices shall be provided for the main and auxiliary engines necessary for ship propulsion and safety.

Query_Text_cn: 2对每一独立的螺旋桨，应由一个控制装置进行遥控，该控制装置的设计和制造应使其在运行时无需对机器的操作细节予以特别注意。
Translation: Each individual propeller shall be remotely controlled by a control device, which shall be designed and manufactured in such a way that no special attention to the operational details of the machinery is required during operation.

Query_Text_cn: 5推进机械在同一个时间内仅能由一处进行遥控；在这些处所可允许有互相连接的控制位置。
Translation: The propulsion machinery can only be remotely controlled from one location at a time; interconnected control stations may be permitted at these locations.

Query_Text_cn: 1除另有明文规定者外，本章应适用于1998年7月1日或以后安放龙骨或处于类似建造阶段的船舶。
Translation: Unless otherwise expressly provided, this chapter shall apply to ships the keels of which are laid or which are at a similar stage of construction on or after July 1, 1998.

Query_Text_cn: 2该船业已开始的装配量至少为50t，或为全部结构材料估算重量的1%，取较小者。
Translation: The assembly volume already commenced for the vessel shall be at least 50 tons, or 1% of the estimated total structural material weight, whichever is less.

Query_Text_cn: 3无论何时建造的货船，一经改装为客船后，从开始改装之日应视作客船。
Translation: Regardless of when a cargo ship was built, once it has been converted into a passenger ship, it shall be regarded as a passenger ship from the date the conversion begins.

Query_Text_cn: 2确保当此类船舶更换救生设备或装置，或当此类船舶进行涉及到更换或增设其现有救生设备或装置的重大修理、改装或改建时，这些救生设备和装置在合理可行的情况下满足本章要求。
Translation: 2. Ensure that when such ships replace lifesaving appliances or equipment, or when they undergo major repairs, alterations, or conversions involving the replacement or addition of existing lifesaving appliances or equipment, these appliances and equipment comply with the requirements of this chapter wherever reasonably practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果更换的只是除气胀式救生筏外的救生艇筏而不更换其降落设备，或是相反，则救生艇筏或降落设备可与被更换者是相同类型的。
Translation: However, if only the lifeboats or rafts other than inflatable liferafts are replaced without replacing their launching appliances, or vice versa, the lifeboats, rafts, or launching appliances may be of the same type as those being replaced.

Query_Text_cn: 1主管机关如考虑到航程的遮蔽性及其条件认为实施本章的某些要求为不合理或不必要时，对在航程中距最近陆地不超过20nmile的个别船舶或某些类型的船舶，可免除这些要求。
Translation: If the competent authority, taking into account the sheltered nature and conditions of the voyage, considers the application of certain requirements of this chapter to be unreasonable or unnecessary, it may exempt individual ships or certain types of ships, which during their voyage do not proceed more than 20 nautical miles from the nearest land, from these requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 2《1973年特种业务客船舱室要求议定书》所附的规则。
Translation: The regulations annexed to the Protocol of 1973 concerning Special Trade Passenger Ships.

Query_Text_cn: 1抗暴露服系指设计成供救助艇艇员和海上撤离系统人员使用的保护服。
Translation: An anti-exposure suit refers to protective clothing designed for use by lifeboat crew members and personnel of marine evacuation systems.

Query_Text_cn: 2持证人员系指持有主管机关按照现行的《国际海员培训、发证和值班标准公约》要求，授权签发的或承认有效的精通救生艇筏业务证书的人员；或持有非该公约缔约国的主管机关为公约证书同一目的而签发或承认的证书的人员。
Translation: "Certified personnel" refers to individuals who hold a certificate of proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats issued or recognized as valid by the competent authority in accordance with the current requirements of the International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers (STCW); or individuals who hold a certificate issued or recognized by the competent authority of a non-Party to the Convention for the same purpose as the Convention certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 3探测系指幸存者或救生艇筏位置的测定。
Translation: Detection refers to determining the location of survivors or lifeboats and rafts.

Query_Text_cn: 4登乘梯系指设置在救生艇筏登乘站以供安全登入降落下水后的救生艇筏的梯子。
Translation: 4. An embarkation ladder refers to a ladder installed at the lifeboat/life raft embarkation station to ensure safe boarding of lifeboats or life rafts after they have been lowered into the water.

Query_Text_cn: 5自由漂浮下水系指救生艇筏从下沉中的船舶自动脱开并立即可用的降落方法。
Translation: The five free-floating launching methods refer to the ways in which lifeboats and rafts automatically detach from a sinking vessel and become immediately usable.

Query_Text_cn: 6自由降落下水系指载足全部乘员和属具的救生艇筏在船上脱开并在没有任何制约装置的情况下，任其下降到海面的降落方法。
Translation: The six-degree free-fall launching system refers to a method by which a fully loaded lifeboat or life raft, carrying all crew members and equipment, is released from the ship and allowed to descend freely into the sea without any restraining devices.

Query_Text_cn: 7救生服系指减少在冷水中穿着该服人员体热损失的保护服。
Translation: A immersion suit refers to a protective garment designed to reduce the loss of body heat for individuals wearing it in cold water.

Query_Text_cn: 8气胀式设备系指依靠非刚性的充气室作浮力，而且在准备使用前通常保持不充气状态的设备。
Translation: An inflatable device refers to equipment that relies on non-rigid air chambers for buoyancy and is typically kept uninflated prior to use.

Query_Text_cn: 9充气式设备系指依靠非刚性的充气室作浮力，而且一直保持充气备用状态的设备。
Translation: Inflatable equipment refers to devices that rely on non-rigid inflatable chambers for buoyancy and remain continuously inflated and ready for use.

Query_Text_cn: 10国际救生设备（LSA）规则（本章内称“规则”）系指本组织海上安全委员会MSC.48(66)决议通过的，可由本组织修正的《国际救生设备（LSA）规则》，但这种修正案的通过、生效和实施应按本公约第VIII条有关适用于除第I章外的附则的修正程序的规定进行。
Translation: 10. The International Life-Saving Appliance (LSA) Code (referred to as "the Code" in this chapter) means the International Life-Saving Appliance (LSA) Code adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization by resolution MSC.48(66), as may be amended by the Organization, provided that the adoption, entry into force, and implementation of such amendments shall be in accordance with the procedures specified in Article VIII of this Convention concerning the amendment of the annexes other than Chapter I.

Query_Text_cn: 11降落设备或装置系指将救生艇筏或救助艇从其存放位置安全地转移到水上的设施。
Translation: 11. Launching appliances or devices refer to equipment used to safely transfer lifeboats, life rafts, or rescue boats from their stowed positions to the water.

Query_Text_cn: 12长度系指量自龙骨上面的最小型深85%处水线总长的96%，或沿该水线从首柱前缘量至舵杆中心线的长度，取较大者。
Translation: The length between perpendiculars refers to either 96% of the total length measured at the waterline located at 85% of the least molded depth above the keel, or the length measured along this waterline from the forward edge of the stem to the centerline of the rudder stock, whichever is greater.

Query_Text_cn: 对设计为具有倾斜龙骨的船舶，其计量长度的水线应与设计水线平行。
Translation: For ships designed with an inclined keel, the waterline used for measuring length shall be parallel to the design waterline.

Query_Text_cn: 13最轻载航行状态系指船舶处于平浮、无货，备品和燃料有10%剩余量的装载状态；对客船而言，船舶处于载足全额乘客和船员及其行李的装载状态。
Translation: The lightest sailing condition refers to the state in which the vessel is afloat and level, carrying no cargo, with 10% of stores and fuel remaining; for passenger ships, it refers to the condition where the vessel is fully loaded with the maximum number of passengers, crew, and their luggage.

Query_Text_cn: 14海上撤离系统系指将人员从船舶的登乘甲板迅速转移到漂浮的救生艇筏上的设备。
Translation: The marine evacuation system refers to equipment designed to rapidly transfer personnel from the embarkation deck of a vessel to floating lifeboats or rafts.

Query_Text_cn: 1型深系指从龙骨上面量到在船舷处的干舷甲板横梁上面的垂直距离。
Translation: Type 1 depth refers to the vertical distance measured from the top of the keel to the top of the deck beam at the freeboard deck at the ship's side.

Query_Text_cn: 对木质船舶和混合结构船舶，此垂直距离从龙骨槽口的下缘量起。
Translation: For wooden vessels and vessels with mixed structures, this vertical distance is measured from the lower edge of the keel slot.

Query_Text_cn: 如船舶中横剖面的下部具有凹形，或如装有厚龙骨翼板，此垂直距离从船底平坦部分向内延伸线与龙骨侧面相交之点量起。
Translation: If the lower part of the transverse section of the vessel is concave, or if it is fitted with thick keel wing plates, this vertical distance is measured from the point where the inward extension of the flat portion of the bottom intersects with the side of the keel.

Query_Text_cn: 2具有圆弧形舷边的船舶，型深应量至甲板型线和船舶外板型线相交之点，这些线的延伸是把该舷边看作是设计为角形的。
Translation: For vessels with rounded gunwales, the moulded depth should be measured to the point where the deck line and the outer shell line intersect, with the extensions of these lines treating the gunwale as if it were designed to be angular.

Query_Text_cn: 3凡干舷甲板为阶梯形并且其升高部分延伸到超过决定型深的点时，型深应量至甲板较低部分与升高部分平行的延伸线。
Translation: 3. When the freeboard deck is stepped and the raised part extends beyond the point at which the moulded depth is to be determined, the moulded depth shall be measured to a line extending parallel to the lower part of the deck at the side.

Query_Text_cn: 16新颖救生设备或装置系指具有本章或规则之规定未全部包括的新型特征，但达到等效的或更高的安全标准的救生设备或装置。
Translation: Novel life-saving appliances or arrangements refer to those with new features not fully covered by the provisions of this chapter or regulations, but which provide an equivalent or higher standard of safety.

Query_Text_cn: 17正稳性系指艇筏在移去一横倾力矩后回复到其初始位置的能力。
Translation: Initial stability refers to the ability of a boat or raft to return to its original position after the removal of a heeling moment.

Query_Text_cn: 18救助艇的回收时间系指该艇被提升至某一位置，而使艇上人员可从该处登上大船甲板所需的时间。
Translation: The recovery time of the 18 rescue boat refers to the time required to lift the boat to a position where personnel on board can board the main ship's deck from that location.

Query_Text_cn: 回收时间包括在救助艇上做的回收准备工作所需的时间，诸如抛投和系住首缆，连接救助艇与降落设备，以及提升救助艇的时间。
Translation: Recovery time includes the time required for preparatory work on the rescue boat, such as deploying and securing the head line, connecting the rescue boat to the lowering equipment, and hoisting the rescue boat.

Query_Text_cn: 回收时间不包括把降落设备降低至回收救助艇的位置所需要的时间。
Translation: The recovery time does not include the time required to lower the landing device to the position of the recovery rescue boat.

Query_Text_cn: 19救助艇系指为救助遇险人员及集结救生艇筏而设计的艇。
Translation: A rescue boat refers to a boat designed for rescuing persons in distress and for assembling lifeboats and life rafts.

Query_Text_cn: 20拯救系指安全寻回幸存者。
Translation: Rescue refers to the safe retrieval of survivors.

Query_Text_cn: 21客滚船系指具有第II-2/3条定义的滚装装货处所或特种处所的客船。
Translation: A ro-ro passenger ship refers to a passenger ship that has ro-ro cargo spaces or special category spaces as defined in Regulation II-2/3.

Query_Text_cn: 22短程国际航行系指在航行中，船舶距离能够安全安置乘客和船员的港口或地点不超过200nmile的国际航行。
Translation: 22. Short international voyages refer to international voyages during which the ship is never more than 200 nautical miles from a port or place where passengers and crew can be safely accommodated.

Query_Text_cn: 启航国最后停靠港至最终目的港之间距离与返航航程均应不超过600nmile。
Translation: The distance between the last port of call in the country of departure and the final destination port, as well as the return voyage, shall not exceed 600 nautical miles.

Query_Text_cn: 最终目的港系指船舶开始返航回到启航国前的计划航次中的最后停靠港。
