Translation: Refer to this Organization’s Resolution A.694(17) “Recommendations on General Requirements for Shipborne Radio Equipment Forming Part of the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) and for Electronic Navigational Aids,” as well as the general requirements for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) of all electrical and electronic equipment on ships in Resolution A.813(19), and to Maritime Safety Committee Circular MSC/Circ.862 “Clarification of Certain Requirements in IMO Performance Standards for GMDSS Equipment.”

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.702(17)决议中关于A3和A4海区的全球海上遇险和安全系统的无线电维修指南。
Translation: Refer to the radio maintenance guidelines for the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System in sea areas A3 and A4 as outlined in Resolution A.702(17).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见STCW规则第IV章第B-IV/2节。
Translation: See STCW Regulation Chapter IV, Section B-IV/2.

Query_Text_cn: 2客船上，至少应指派一名按本条1要求的有资格的人员，在遇险时只执行无线电通信责任。
Translation: On passenger ships, at least one qualified person as required by paragraph 1 of this article shall be designated to perform solely radio communication duties in the event of distress.

Query_Text_cn: 应备有使主管机关满意并符合无线电规则要求的无线电记录，该记录应记载对于海上人命安全显然具有重要性的与无线电通信业务有关的所有遇险事故。
Translation: A radio log satisfactory to the competent authority and in compliance with the requirements of the Radio Regulations shall be maintained, recording all distress incidents related to radio communication operations that are clearly of significance to the safety of life at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 适用本章的船舶，其船上备有的能在遇险报警时自动报告船位的所有双向通信设备，均应自动从内部或外部导航接收装置（如设有）获得该信息。
Translation: All two-way communication devices on ships subject to this chapter, which are capable of automatically reporting the ship's position in the event of distress alerts, shall automatically obtain such information from internal or external navigation receivers, if provided.

Query_Text_cn: 如果未安装这种接收装置，则船舶在航行中的位置以及船位确定的时间应按不超过4小时的间隔期手动更新，以便随时可由该设备发送。
Translation: If such receiving equipment is not installed, the vessel's position and the time at which the position was determined shall be manually updated at intervals not exceeding four hours while underway, so that the information can be transmitted by the device at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 2对1997年2月1日以前建造的且仅航行于A2、A3和A4海区的船舶，在实际可行时，只要这些船舶在其通常驾驶的位置在VHF16频道上保持连续守听值班，主管机关可免除第7.1.1.1条和7.1.2条的要求。
Translation: For ships constructed before February 1, 1997 and operating solely in sea areas A2, A3, and A4, the competent authority may exempt them from the requirements of paragraphs 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2, provided that, where practicable, these ships maintain a continuous watch on VHF Channel 16 at their normal operating position.

Query_Text_cn: 2专门航行于北美洲五大湖以及与其连接的东至加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔的圣拉姆伯特船闸下游出口处为止的水域及支流的船舶。
Translation: 2. Vessels exclusively navigating the waters and tributaries of the North American Great Lakes and their connecting waters, up to and including the downstream exit of the St. Lambert Lock at Montreal, Quebec, Canada.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，仍鼓励军舰、海军辅助船或由缔约国政府拥有或经营的仅用于政府非商业性目的的其他船舶在合理和可行的范围内，与本章保持一致。
Translation: However, warships, naval auxiliary vessels, or other ships owned or operated by the government of a contracting party and used only for non-commercial government purposes are still encouraged, to the extent reasonable and practicable, to act in a manner consistent with this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关可决定本章对仅在按国际法规定的基准线以内（向岸一侧）水域营运的船舶适用范围。
Translation: 2. The competent authority may determine the scope of application of this chapter to ships operating solely within waters landward of the baselines established in accordance with international law.

Query_Text_cn: 3就本章而言，顶推船舶和被顶推船舶的刚性连接混合单元，当其设计成专用的整体拖船和驳船组合体时，应视为单一船舶。
Translation: For the purposes of this chapter, rigidly connected pushers and pushed vessels forming a composite unit, when specifically designed as an integrated tug and barge combination, shall be regarded as a single vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 3渔船。
Translation: Three fishing vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 3该船业已开始的装配量至少为50t，或为全部结构材料估算重量的1%，取较小者。
Translation: 3. The assembly of the vessel has commenced with at least 50 tons, or 1% of the estimated total structural material weight, whichever is less.

Query_Text_cn: 2海图或航海出版物系指专用的图或书，或支持这种图或书的经特殊编辑的数据库，由政府主管当局，经授权的水文局或其他相关的政府机构正式颁布，用于满足航海要求①。
Translation: Nautical charts or publications refer to specialized charts or books, or specially edited databases supporting such charts or books, officially issued by the competent government authorities, authorized hydrographic offices, or other relevant government agencies to meet navigational requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 3所有船舶系指所有船或艇，而不论其类型和用途。
Translation: 3. All vessels refer to all ships or boats, regardless of their type and purpose.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见国际水文组织关于沿岸国根据第9条提供海图的权利和责任的相应决议和建议。
Translation: Refer to the relevant resolutions and recommendations of the International Hydrographic Organization regarding the rights and responsibilities of coastal States to provide charts in accordance with Article 9.

Query_Text_cn: 1主管机关对无机械推进装置的船舶可准予全面免除第15、17、18、19（19.2.1.7除外）、20、22、24、25、26、27和28条的要求。
Translation: The competent authority may grant a full exemption from the requirements of Articles 15, 17, 18, 19 (except 19.2.1.7), 20, 22, 24, 25, 26, 27, and 28 for vessels without mechanical propulsion.

Query_Text_cn: 2如个别船舶所从事的航行，其距岸的最大距离、航程的长短和性质、大体上无航行危险以及影响安全的其他情况使完全实施本章的规定成为不合理或不必要时，主管机关可对任何这种船舶准予部分或有条件的免除或等效，但主管机关必须事先考虑到这种免除和等效对所有其他船舶的安全可能产生的影响。
Translation: If, for certain ships engaged in specific voyages, the maximum distance from shore, the length and nature of the voyage, the absence of significant navigational hazards, or other circumstances affecting safety render the full application of the provisions of this chapter unreasonable or unnecessary, the competent authority may grant partial or conditional exemptions or equivalencies to any such ship. However, the competent authority must first consider the potential impact of such exemptions or equivalencies on the safety of all other ships.

Query_Text_cn: 3各主管机关应在每年的1月1日以后尽快向本组织提交一份报告，该报告应汇总上一日历年度内按本条2之规定准予的所有新的免除和等效并说明准予这种免除和等效的理由。
Translation: Each competent authority shall, as soon as possible after January 1 of each year, submit to the Organization a report summarizing all new exemptions and equivalencies granted under paragraph 2 of this Article during the preceding calendar year, and stating the reasons for granting such exemptions and equivalencies.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织应将这些内容分发给其他缔约国政府，以供参考。
Translation: The organization should distribute this information to the governments of other contracting parties for their reference.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应采取所有必要的步骤，确保其从任何可靠的来源获悉危险的情报时，迅速通知有关各方并传送到其他相关的国家政府①。
Translation: The governments of all contracting parties shall take all necessary steps to ensure that, upon receiving information about dangers from any reliable source, they promptly notify the relevant parties and transmit it to other concerned national governments.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，鼓励海上船舶收集气象资料，并用最适宜于助航目的方式安排这些资料的审查、传送和交换②。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes the obligation to encourage ships at sea to collect meteorological data and to arrange for the examination, transmission, and exchange of such data in the manner best suited to the purposes of navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关应鼓励使用高度精确的气象仪器，并应于接到校核此种仪器的请求时给予便利。
Translation: The competent authorities should encourage the use of highly accurate meteorological instruments and provide assistance upon receiving requests for the calibration of such instruments.

Query_Text_cn: 国家相应的气象服务机构可作出安排，免费向船舶提供这种校核。
Translation: The relevant national meteorological service agencies may make arrangements to provide such verification to ships free of charge.

Query_Text_cn: 1使用陆地和空间无线电通信服务机构的相应岸基设备以文字、并尽实际可能以图象格式发出信息，警告船舶注意强风，风暴和热带气旋。
Translation: 1. Use the relevant shore-based equipment of land and space radio communication service organizations to transmit information in written form, and, where practicable, in graphic form, to warn ships of strong winds, storms, and tropical cyclones.

Query_Text_cn: 2每日至少2次通过相应的陆地和空间无线电通信服务③发出适用于航运的气象信息，其中包括天气、波浪和冰的数据、分析、警报和预报。
Translation: At least twice daily, meteorological information applicable to shipping—including data, analyses, warnings, and forecasts on weather, waves, and ice—shall be transmitted via appropriate terrestrial and space-based radiocommunication services.

Query_Text_cn: 这些信息应以文字、并尽实际可能以图象格式发送，其中包括通过传真或以数字形式发送的气象分析和预测图象，供船上数据处理系统重新编制。
Translation: This information should be transmitted in written form and, whenever possible, in graphical format, including meteorological analysis and forecast charts sent by fax or in digital form, for reprocessing by onboard data processing systems.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.706(17)决议通过的经修正的《IMO/IHO全球航行警报服务导则》。
Translation: Refer to the revised "IMO/IHO World-Wide Navigational Warning Service Guidance" adopted by this Organization by Resolution A.706(17).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.528(13)决议通过的《关于气象航线划定的建议案》。
Translation: See the "Recommendation on the Designation of Meteorological Routes" adopted by this organization in Resolution A.528(13).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见第IV/7.1.4和IV/7.1.5条。
Translation: See Sections IV/7.1.4 and IV/7.1.5.

Query_Text_cn: 3编制并发行供海上顺利开展气象工作所可能需要的出版物（如可行时），并安排发布及提供每日天气图供出航船舶参考。
Translation: 3. Prepare and issue, as appropriate, publications necessary for the smooth conduct of meteorological work at sea, and arrange for the dissemination and provision of daily weather charts for reference by vessels setting sail.

Query_Text_cn: 4安排选定的船舶装设经过校验的船用气象仪器（例如气压计、气压记录仪、湿度计及测量海水温度的适宜仪器），以供气象服务之用，并使其在主要标准时进行气象观测且记录和发送观测结果（如环境许可，每日至少4次），作为海面天气形势分析之用，并鼓励其他船舶用变通方式进行观测且记录和发送观测结果，特别是在航船稀少的区域。
Translation: Arrange for selected vessels to be equipped with calibrated marine meteorological instruments (such as barometers, barographs, hygrometers, and suitable instruments for measuring sea water temperature) for meteorological services, and ensure that meteorological observations are conducted, recorded, and transmitted at principal standard times (at least four times daily, if conditions permit) for the purpose of analyzing sea surface weather patterns. Other vessels are also encouraged to conduct, record, and transmit observations by alternative means, especially in areas where ship traffic is sparse.

Query_Text_cn: 5鼓励船公司尽可能多地将其船舶投入到气象观测和记录工作中；观测结果使用船舶陆地或空间无线电通信设备发送，以使各国气象服务机构受益。
Translation: Shipping companies are encouraged to deploy as many of their vessels as possible for meteorological observation and recording; the observation results should be transmitted using ship-based terrestrial or space radio communication equipment to benefit meteorological services in all countries.

Query_Text_cn: 6这些气象观测结果免费向有关船舶发送。
Translation: These meteorological observation results are provided free of charge to relevant vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 7当在热带气旋或疑似热带气旋附近时，应鼓励船舶尽可能增加其观测和发送观测结果的次数，但应牢记船上驾驶员在风暴情况下需先行处理的航行任务。
Translation: When in the vicinity of a tropical cyclone or a suspected tropical cyclone, ships should be encouraged to increase the frequency of their observations and the transmission of observation results as much as possible. However, it should be kept in mind that, under storm conditions, navigational duties take precedence for the officers on board.

Query_Text_cn: 8使用陆地和空间无线电通信服务机构的相应岸基设备，安排接收来自船舶和向船舶发送气象信息。
Translation: 8. Utilize appropriate shore-based equipment of land and space radio communication service organizations to arrange for the reception of meteorological information from ships and the transmission of such information to ships.

Query_Text_cn: 9鼓励船长在遇到风速50kn或以上（蒲福风级10级）时，通知附近船舶及海岸电台。
Translation: 9. Captains are encouraged to notify nearby vessels and coastal radio stations when encountering wind speeds of 50 knots or above (Beaufort scale force 10).

Query_Text_cn: 10努力使上述国际气象服务获得统一程序，并尽可能地符合世界气象组织提出的技术规则和建议。
Translation: 10. Efforts shall be made to ensure that the above-mentioned international meteorological services adopt standardized procedures and, as far as possible, comply with the technical regulations and recommendations put forward by the World Meteorological Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府可以将执行本公约过程中可能产生的任何气象问题提交世界气象组织研究和征求意见。
Translation: The governments of the contracting parties may submit any meteorological issues that may arise in the implementation of this Convention to the World Meteorological Organization for study and consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 3应以发送格式提交本条所规定的信息，并按《无线电规则》规定的优先顺序发送，在“向所有电台”发送气象信息、预报和警报时，所有船舶电台都必须遵守《无线电规则》的规定。
Translation: 3. The information specified in this Article shall be transmitted in the prescribed format and in accordance with the priority order established by the Radio Regulations. When meteorological information, forecasts, and warnings are transmitted "to all stations," all ship stations must comply with the provisions of the Radio Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 4供船舶使用的预报、警报、天气形势和其他气象资料，应按有关缔约国政府间的共同协定，特别是按世界气象组织系统为针对全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）范围内的公海编制和传播气象预报和警报所规定的要求，由具备最佳位置为不同沿海和公海区域服务的国家气象服务机构进行发布和传送。
Translation: Meteorological forecasts, warnings, weather conditions, and other meteorological information provided for ships shall be issued and transmitted by national meteorological services best positioned to serve different coastal and high seas areas, in accordance with relevant intergovernmental agreements among Contracting Governments, particularly the requirements established by the World Meteorological Organization system for the preparation and dissemination of meteorological forecasts and warnings for the high seas within the scope of the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS).

Query_Text_cn: 1冰区巡逻有助于在北大西洋内的海上人命安全、航行安全和航行效率以及海洋环境保护。
Translation: Patrolling the ice zone contributes to maritime safety of life, navigation safety and efficiency, as well as marine environmental protection in the North Atlantic.

Query_Text_cn: 在冰季期间穿越由冰区巡逻警戒的冰山区的船舶，应要求使用冰区巡逻所提供的服务。
Translation: During the ice season, vessels crossing ice areas patrolled and monitored by the ice patrol should use the services provided by the ice patrol upon request.

Query_Text_cn: 2各缔约国政府承担义务，继续担任北大西洋冰区巡逻和冰情的研究与观测服务。
Translation: The governments of the two contracting parties undertake the obligation to continue providing patrol services in the North Atlantic ice region, as well as research and observation services related to ice conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 在整个冰季期间，即每年的2月15日至7月1日，在纽芬兰大浅滩附近冰山区的东南、南及西南界限应予警戒，以便将该危险区的范围通知过往船舶，研究浮冰的一般情况以及对巡逻船舶和飞机活动区内的船舶和船员提供所需的帮助。
Translation: Throughout the entire ice season, from February 15 to July 1 each year, the southeastern, southern, and southwestern boundaries of the ice area near the Grand Banks of Newfoundland should be closely monitored in order to inform passing vessels of the extent of this danger zone, to study the general conditions of drifting ice, and to provide necessary assistance to ships and crews within the patrol vessels' and aircrafts' areas of operation.

Query_Text_cn: 在一年其余时间内也应适当保持对冰情的研究与观测。
Translation: Appropriate research and monitoring of ice conditions should also be maintained throughout the rest of the year.

Query_Text_cn: 3用于供冰区巡逻服务及研究与观测冰情的船舶和飞机，可担任分配的其他任务，但这些其他任务不得妨碍本服务工作的原有目的或增加其费用。
Translation: 3. Ships and aircraft used for patrol services in ice-covered areas, as well as for research and observation of ice conditions, may be assigned other tasks, provided that such tasks do not interfere with the original purpose of these services or increase their costs.

Query_Text_cn: 4美利坚合众国政府同意继续全面管理冰区巡逻服务及冰情的研究与观测，包括传播由此得到的信息。
Translation: 4. The Government of the United States of America agrees to continue comprehensive management of ice patrol services and research and observation of ice conditions, including the dissemination of information obtained therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: 5在本章的附录《北大西洋冰区巡逻管理、运作和费用规则》中阐明了适用于冰区巡逻之管理、运作和费用的各项条件，该附录是本章一个组成部分。
Translation: The conditions applicable to the management, operation, and expenses of ice patrols are set forth in the Appendix to this chapter, "Regulations for the Management, Operation, and Expenses of the North Atlantic Ice Patrol," which forms an integral part of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 6无论何时，美利坚合众国政府和/或加拿大政府如欲中止提供这些服务，即可以这样做，并且各缔约国政府应根据其共同利益解决继续这些服务的问题。
Translation: 6. Whenever the Government of the United States of America and/or the Government of Canada wishes to discontinue the provision of these services, it may do so, and the governments of the contracting parties shall resolve the issue of the continuation of these services based on their mutual interests.

Query_Text_cn: 美利坚合众国和/或加拿大政府对于在中止提供这些服务之前受益于这些服务且获准悬挂缔约国国旗的船舶和在缔约国政府已延用本条要求的领土内注册的船舶，应提前18个月向所有有关缔约国政府发出中止服务的书面通知。
Translation: The Government of the United States of America and/or Canada shall give written notice at least 18 months in advance to all relevant Contracting Governments before discontinuing the provision of such services to ships that have benefited from these services and are authorized to fly the flag of a Contracting Party, as well as to ships registered in territories where the government of a Contracting Party has applied the requirements of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，确保为其负责区域内的遇险通信和相互协调并为营救其海岸附近的海上遇险者作出必要的安排。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes the obligation to ensure the provision of distress communications and coordination within its area of responsibility, and to make the necessary arrangements for the rescue of persons in distress at sea near its coasts.

Query_Text_cn: 这些安排，考虑到海上交通的密度和航行障碍物的密度，应包括视为实际可行和必要的搜救设施的建立、运转和维护，并应尽可能提供足够的寻找和营救遇险人员的设备①。
Translation: These arrangements, taking into account the density of maritime traffic and navigational hazards, should include the establishment, operation, and maintenance of search and rescue facilities deemed practicable and necessary, and should, as far as possible, provide adequate equipment for locating and rescuing persons in distress.

Query_Text_cn: 2各缔约国政府承担义务，向本组织提供其现有搜救设施的资料以及对其中内容所作的更改方案（如有）。
Translation: The governments of the two contracting parties undertake the obligation to provide the Organization with information on their existing search and rescue facilities, as well as any proposed changes to such information, if applicable.

Query_Text_cn: 3适用第I章的客船，应备有在紧急情况下与相应的搜寻和救助机构合作的计划。
Translation: Passenger ships to which Chapter I applies shall have a plan for cooperation with the appropriate search and rescue services in emergency situations.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划应由船舶、第IX/1条所定义的公司以及搜救机构共同制定。
Translation: The plan should be developed jointly by the ship, the company as defined in Regulation IX/1, and the search and rescue organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划应包括要进行定期演习以证明该计划有效性的规定。
Translation: The plan should include provisions for conducting regular drills to demonstrate its effectiveness.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划应根据本组织制定的指南而编制。
Translation: The plan should be developed in accordance with the guidelines established by the organization.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《1979年国际海上搜寻救助（SAR）公约》和本组织通过的下列决议：《搜救飞机的自导能力》（A.225(VII)决议）、《雷达应答器用于搜寻和救助》（A.530(13)决议）、《搜救自导能力》（A.616(15)决议）和《国际航空海上搜寻和救助手册（IAMSAR）》（A.894(21)决议）。
Translation: Refer to the International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue (SAR), 1979, and the following resolutions adopted by this Organization: "Self-locating Capability of Search and Rescue Aircraft" (Resolution A.225(VII)), "Radar Transponders for Search and Rescue" (Resolution A.530(13)), "Self-locating Capability for Search and Rescue" (Resolution A.616(15)), and the "International Aeronautical and Maritime Search and Rescue Manual (IAMSAR)" (Resolution A.894(21)).

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府承担义务作好安排，使从事搜救工作的搜救设施在与遇险船舶或遇险人员通信时使用救生信号。
Translation: The governments of the contracting parties undertake the obligation to make arrangements to ensure that search and rescue facilities engaged in rescue operations use distress signals when communicating with ships or persons in distress.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，安排水文资料的收集和编制，并且出版、传播以及不断更新为安全航行所必需的所有航海资料。
Translation: 1. Each contracting government undertakes the obligation to arrange for the collection and compilation of hydrographic data, as well as the publication, dissemination, and continual updating of all nautical information necessary for safe navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 4提供数据管理安排以支持这些服务。
Translation: 4. Provide data management arrangements to support these services.

Query_Text_cn: 3各缔约国政府承担义务，确保尽最大可能统一海图和航海出版物，并且无论何时都要考虑到有关的国际决议和建议①。
Translation: The governments of the contracting parties undertake the obligation to ensure, to the greatest extent possible, the uniformity of nautical charts and publications, and shall at all times take into account relevant international resolutions and recommendations.

Query_Text_cn: 4各缔约国政府承担义务以最大程度协调其活动，确保在全球范围内尽可能及时、可靠并明确地提供水文和航行资料。
Translation: The governments of the four contracting parties undertake the obligation to coordinate their activities to the greatest extent possible, ensuring that hydrological and navigational information is provided globally in a timely, reliable, and clear manner to the fullest possible extent.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶航线划定系统有利于海上人命安全、航行安全及效率和/或海洋环境保护。
Translation: A ship routeing system is beneficial to the safety of life at sea, navigational safety and efficiency, and/or the protection of the marine environment.

Query_Text_cn: 如采纳和实施本组织制定的指南和衡准②，建议所有船舶，某些类型船舶或载运某些货物的船舶使用船舶航线划定系统，这也可以作为强制性要求。
Translation: If the adoption and implementation of the guidelines and criteria developed by the Organization are accepted, it is recommended that all ships, certain types of ships, or ships carrying certain cargoes use ship routeing systems, which may also be established as mandatory requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 2本组织是公认的为船舶航线划定系统制定国际性指南、衡准和规则的唯一国际机构。
Translation: The Organization is universally recognized as the sole international body responsible for developing international guidelines, standards, and regulations for ship routeing systems.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应将通过船舶航线划定系统的提案送交本组织。
Translation: The governments of the contracting parties shall submit proposals for the establishment of ship routeing systems to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织将核对有关已通过的所有船舶航线划定系统的全部资料并分发各缔约国政府。
Translation: The organization will verify all information related to approved ship routing systems and distribute it to the governments of all contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见国际水文组织通过的相应决议和建议。
Translation: Refer to the relevant resolutions and recommendations adopted by the International Hydrographic Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.572(14)决议通过的经修订的《船舶航线划定的一般规定》。
Translation: Refer to the revised "General Provisions on Ship Routeing," adopted by this organization under Resolution A.572(14).

Query_Text_cn: 3发起建立船舶航线划定系统是各有关国家政府的责任。
Translation: It is the responsibility of the governments of the relevant countries to initiate the establishment of a ship routing system.

Query_Text_cn: 为使本组织通过此系统，在建立这类系统时应考虑到本组织制订的指南及衡准。
Translation: In order for the organization to adopt this system, the guidelines and standards established by the organization should be taken into consideration when developing such systems.

Query_Text_cn: 4船舶航线划定系统应提交本组织通过。
Translation: The delineation of ship routing systems shall be submitted for approval by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，对于一国或多国政府实施的船舶航线划定系统不准备提交本组织通过或未经本组织通过，则鼓励其尽可能考虑本组织制订的指南及衡准①。
Translation: However, if a ship routing system established by the government(s) of one or more countries is not intended to be submitted to or approved by this Organization, it is nevertheless encouraged that, as far as possible, the guidelines and criteria developed by this Organization be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 5如果两国或两国以上政府共同关注某一特定区域，应在他们之间达成协议的基础上制定联合提案明确说明他们对该区域船舶航线划定系统的表述和使用。
Translation: If two or more governments share a common interest in a particular area, a joint proposal should be developed on the basis of an agreement between them, clearly specifying their description and use of the ship routing system for that area.

Query_Text_cn: 收到此提案并开始考虑其是否通过之前，本组织应确保把该提案的详细内容分发给共同关注此地区的政府，包括在此船舶航线划定系统附近的国家。
Translation: Before receiving and considering whether to approve this proposal, the organization should ensure that the detailed contents of the proposal are distributed to governments with a shared interest in the region, including countries located near the vessel routing system.

Query_Text_cn: 6缔约国政府应遵守本组织通过的关于船舶航线划定系统的措施。
Translation: The governments of the six contracting states shall comply with the measures adopted by this organization regarding the designation of ship routing systems.

Query_Text_cn: 他们应公布安全有效地使用船舶航线划定系统所必需的资料。
Translation: They should publish the information necessary for the safe and effective use of ship routing systems.

Query_Text_cn: 有关的一国或多国政府可监督这些系统的运行。
Translation: The operation of these systems may be supervised by the government of one or more countries.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应在其权力范围内全力确保适当使用本组织通过的船舶航线划定系统。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall, within its jurisdiction, make every effort to ensure the proper use of the ship routing systems adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 7船舶应按其船型或运载货物的要求，使用本组织通过的强制性船舶航线划定系统，并符合现行的有关规定，除非有不使用船舶航线划定系统的令人信服的理由。
Translation: Ships shall use the mandatory ship routing systems adopted by this Organization in accordance with their type or cargo requirements and comply with the relevant current regulations, unless there are compelling reasons for not using the ship routing systems.

Query_Text_cn: 所有这些理由应记录于船舶日志内。
Translation: All these reasons should be recorded in the ship's log.

Query_Text_cn: 8强制性的船舶航线划定系统应由各有关缔约国政府按照本组织制定的指南和衡准①审核。
Translation: 8. Mandatory ship routing systems shall be reviewed by the governments of the relevant Contracting Governments in accordance with the guidelines and criteria developed by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 9所有已通过的船舶航线划定系统和为实施这些系统所采取的行动应符合国际法，包括1982年联合国海洋法公约的有关规定。
Translation: All approved ship routing systems and actions taken to implement these systems shall comply with international law, including the relevant provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea of 1982.

Query_Text_cn: 10本条及其相关指南和衡准的任何内容均不侵害各国政府根据国际法或关于国际航行海峡及群岛海道的法律体系所具有的权利和义务。
Translation: Nothing in this article, its related guidelines, or criteria shall prejudice the rights and obligations of governments under international law or the legal regime concerning international straits and archipelagic sea lanes.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶报告系统有利于海上人命安全、航行安全及效率和/或海洋环境保护。
Translation: 1. Ship reporting systems are beneficial to the safety of life at sea, the safety and efficiency of navigation, and/or the protection of the marine environment.

Query_Text_cn: 船舶报告系统在按照本组织根据本条的要求制定的指南和衡准③予以通过并实施后，应按每个所通过的系统的规定适用于所有船舶或某些类型船舶或载运某些货物的船舶。
Translation: After the ship reporting system has been adopted and implemented in accordance with the guidelines and criteria developed by the Organization pursuant to this article, it shall apply, as specified for each approved system, to all ships, or to certain types of ships, or to ships carrying certain cargoes.

Query_Text_cn: 2本组织是公认的为船舶报告系统制定国际性指南、衡准和规则的唯一国际机构。
Translation: The organization is internationally recognized as the sole authority for developing guidelines, standards, and regulations for ship reporting systems.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应将采用船舶报告系统的提案送交本组织。
Translation: Governments of the Contracting Parties shall submit proposals for the adoption of ship reporting systems to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织将核对有关已通过的所有船舶报告系统的全部资料并分发各缔约国政府。
Translation: The organization will verify all information related to approved ship reporting systems and distribute it to the governments of all contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.572(14)决议通过的经修订的《船舶航线划定的一般规定》。
Translation: Refer to the revised "General Provisions on Ships' Routeing" adopted by this Organization by Resolution A.572(14).

Query_Text_cn: ②本条不涉及各国政府为搜救目的而建立且适用经修正的1979年搜救公约第5章的船舶报告系统。
Translation: This article does not apply to ship reporting systems established by governments for search and rescue purposes and governed by Chapter V of the 1979 Search and Rescue Convention as amended.

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.43(64)决议通过并以MSC.111(73)决议修正的指南和衡准。
Translation: Refer to the guidelines and criteria adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of this organization through Resolution MSC.43(64) and amended by Resolution MSC.111(73).

Query_Text_cn: 并参见本组织以A.851(20)决议通过的《船舶报告系统总则和船舶报告要求，包括涉及危险品、有害物质和/或海洋污染物事故报告指南》。
Translation: And with reference to the “General Principles for Ship Reporting Systems and Ship Reporting Requirements, including Guidelines for Reporting Incidents Involving Dangerous Goods, Harmful Substances and/or Marine Pollutants” adopted by this Organization by resolution A.851(20).

Query_Text_cn: 3发起建立船舶报告系统是各有关政府的责任。
Translation: It is the responsibility of the relevant governments to initiate the establishment of a ship reporting system.

Query_Text_cn: 在建立此类系统时，应考虑到本组织制定的指南和衡准①中的规定。
Translation: When establishing such systems, the provisions set out in the guidelines and benchmarks formulated by the organization should be taken into consideration.

Query_Text_cn: 4未提交本组织通过的船舶报告系统不需遵守本条要求。
Translation: Ships that have not submitted the ship reporting system adopted by this organization are not required to comply with the requirements of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，鼓励实施这种系统的缔约国政府尽可能遵循本组织制定的指南和衡准①。
Translation: However, the governments of the Contracting Parties that encourage the implementation of such a system should, as far as possible, follow the guidelines and standards established by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府可向本组织提交这种系统由本组织认可。
Translation: The governments of the contracting parties may submit such systems to the organization for approval.

Query_Text_cn: 5如果两国或两国以上政府共同关注某一特定区域，应在他们之间达成协议的基础上制定一个经协调的船舶报告系统的提案。
Translation: If the governments of two or more countries share a common interest in a specific area, a proposal for a coordinated ship reporting system should be developed on the basis of an agreement reached among them.

Query_Text_cn: 在着手通过船舶报告系统的提案以前，本组织应向在该系统覆盖的区域内具有共同利益的那些缔约国政府通报该提案的详细内容。
Translation: Before proceeding with a proposal for a ship reporting system, the Organization shall notify the governments of Contracting Parties with common interests in the area covered by the system of the detailed contents of the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 如果通过并建立了一个经协调的船舶报告系统，则该系统应具有统一的程序和操作。
Translation: If an integrated and coordinated vessel reporting system is established, it should feature standardized procedures and operations.

Query_Text_cn: 6在按本条的要求通过船舶报告系统后，各有关国家政府应采取所有必要的措施公布有效使用该系统所需的任何资料。
Translation: After the ship reporting system has been established in accordance with the requirements of this article, the governments of the relevant States shall take all necessary measures to publish any information required for the effective use of the system.

Query_Text_cn: 任何已通过的船舶报告系统应具有相互交流的能力以及在必要时为船舶提供资料的能力。
Translation: Any approved ship reporting system should have the capability for mutual communication and the ability to provide information to ships when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 这种系统应按照本组织根据本条的要求制定的指南和衡准2进行操作。
Translation: Such systems shall operate in accordance with the guidelines and criteria developed by the organization pursuant to the requirements of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 7船长应遵守所通过的各个船舶报告系统的要求，并按其中每一系统的规定向有关当局报告所要求的所有资料。
Translation: The master shall comply with the requirements of each ship reporting system through which the vessel passes and shall report all information required by each system to the relevant authorities as specified.

Query_Text_cn: 8所有已通过的船舶报告系统和为实施这些系统所采取的行动应符合国际法，包括联合国海洋法公约的有关规定。
Translation: All approved ship reporting systems and actions taken to implement these systems shall be in accordance with international law, including the relevant provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.

Query_Text_cn: 9本条及其相关指南和衡准的任何内容均不应侵害各国政府根据国际法或关于国际航行海峡及群岛海道的法律体系所具有的权利和义务。
Translation: Nothing in this article, its related guidelines, or criteria shall prejudice the rights and obligations of governments under international law or the legal regime governing international straits and archipelagic sea lanes.

Query_Text_cn: 10船舶按已通过的船舶报告系统的规定加入系统，应对有关船舶免收费用。
Translation: Ships that join the system in accordance with the provisions of an approved ship reporting system shall be exempt from relevant charges.

Query_Text_cn: 11本组织应确保根据本组织制定的指南和衡准，对已通过的船舶报告系统进行审核。
Translation: 11. The Organization shall ensure that approved ship reporting systems are reviewed in accordance with the guidelines and criteria established by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶交通服务（VTS）有利于海上人命安全、航行安全及效率和/或保护海洋环境、附近岸上区域、工地和海上设施免受海洋运输可能带来的不利影响。
Translation: Vessel Traffic Services (VTS) are beneficial to the safety of life at sea, the safety and efficiency of navigation, and/or the protection of the marine environment, adjacent shore areas, worksites, and offshore installations from possible adverse effects of maritime traffic.

Query_Text_cn: 2缔约国政府承担义务，在其认为因交通量和危险程度而需要船舶交通服务的场所作出建立这种服务的安排。
Translation: The governments of the two contracting parties undertake the obligation to make arrangements for the establishment of such vessel traffic services at locations where, in their judgment, the volume of traffic and the degree of risk necessitate such services.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.43(64)决议通过并以MSC.111(73)决议修正的指南和衡准。
Translation: Refer to the guidelines and criteria adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of this Organization by resolution MSC.43(64), as amended by resolution MSC.111(73).

Query_Text_cn: 3缔约国政府规划和实施船舶交通服务，应尽可能遵循守本组织制定的指南①。
Translation: 3. When planning and implementing vessel traffic services, the Governments of Contracting Parties should, as far as possible, follow the guidelines developed by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 船舶交通服务的使用，仅在沿海国家领海所属的海域内才可作为强制性要求。
Translation: The use of vessel traffic services can only be made mandatory within the territorial waters of coastal states.

Query_Text_cn: 4各缔约国政府应确保悬挂其国旗的船舶参予船舶交通服务并遵守该服务的规定。
Translation: The governments of the four contracting parties shall ensure that vessels flying their national flags participate in vessel traffic services and comply with the regulations of such services.

Query_Text_cn: 5本条或本组织通过的指南之任何内容均不侵害各国政府根据国际法或关于国际航行海峡及群岛海道的法律体系所具有的权利和义务。
Translation: Nothing in these guidelines adopted by this article or organization shall prejudice the rights and obligations of national governments under international law or the legal regime governing international straits and archipelagic sea lanes.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，在其认为可行和必要时，根据交通量和危险程度的需要，单独或与其他缔约国政府合作提供助航设备。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes the obligation, when it deems it practicable and necessary, to provide, either individually or in cooperation with other Contracting Governments, such aids to navigation as the volume of traffic and the degree of danger may require.

Query_Text_cn: 2为尽最大可能达到助航设备的一致性，缔约国政府承担义务在设置这些助航设备时，注意到国际上的建议和指南②。
Translation: 2. In order to achieve the greatest possible uniformity in navigational aids, the governments of the contracting States undertake, when installing such aids, to take into account international recommendations and guidelines.

Query_Text_cn: 3缔约国政府承担义务，安排向所有有关方面提供与助航设备有关的信息。
Translation: The governments of the three contracting parties undertake the obligation to arrange for the provision of information related to navigational aids to all relevant parties.

Query_Text_cn: 会对船上所设接收机的性能产生不利影响的定位系统发送的变化，应尽可能避免并仅在及时和适当地发布通告之后才可起作用。
Translation: Changes transmitted by positioning systems that may adversely affect the performance of receivers installed on ships should be avoided as much as possible and should only take effect after timely and appropriate notification has been issued.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，各自对本国船舶保持实行或在必要时采取措施，以确保所有船舶从海上人命安全观点出发，配备足够数量和胜任的船员③。
Translation: Each contracting government undertakes the obligation to maintain or, when necessary, to take measures to ensure that all ships under its flag are adequately manned with a sufficient number of competent crew members from the perspective of maritime safety.

Query_Text_cn: 2本公约第I章适用的每艘船舶，应备有1份由主管机关颁发的适当的最少安全配员证明或等效证明，作为符合本条1之规定所需的最少安全配员的凭证。
Translation: Every ship to which Chapter I of the two Conventions applies shall be provided with an appropriate Minimum Safe Manning Certificate or an equivalent certificate issued by the competent authority, as evidence of compliance with the minimum safe manning requirements stipulated in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 3在所有船舶上，为确保船员在安全事务上起到有效作用，应规定一种工作语言并将其记录在船舶航海日志上。
Translation: On all ships, in order to ensure that crew members play an effective role in safety matters, a working language should be designated and recorded in the ship's logbook.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约第IX/1条所定义的公司或船长（合适者）应确定适当的工作语言。
Translation: The company or the master, as defined in Regulation IX/1 of this Convention, shall determine the appropriate working language.

Query_Text_cn: 应要求每个船员能懂得这种语言，并在合适情况下使用这种语言下达指令和指示以及应答。
Translation: Each crew member is required to understand this language and to use it to give and respond to orders and instructions as appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该工作语言不是船旗国的官方语言，则所有需张贴的图纸和图表内应有该工作语言的译文。
Translation: If the working language is not the official language of the flag State, translations in the working language shall be included in all drawings and charts required to be posted.

Query_Text_cn: 4在本公约第I章适用的船舶上，英语应作为驾驶台的工作语言，用以进行驾驶台对驾驶台、驾驶台对岸的安全通信以及用于引航员和驾驶台值班人员④之间在船上的通信，除非直接参与通信的人员都讲英语以外的一种共同语言。
Translation: On ships to which Chapter I of this Convention applies, English shall be used as the working language on the bridge for bridge-to-bridge and bridge-to-shore safety communications, as well as for communications between pilots and bridge watchkeeping personnel on board, unless all persons directly involved in the communication share a common language other than English.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.857(20)决议通过的《船舶交通服务指南》。
Translation: Refer to the "Guidelines for Vessel Traffic Services" adopted by this Organization by Resolution A.857(20).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见IALA的相应建议和指南，以及SN/Circ.107通函《海上浮标系统》。
Translation: Refer to the relevant recommendations and guidelines of IALA, as well as SN/Circ.107, "Maritime Buoyage System."

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织以A.890(21)决议通过并以A.955(23)决议修正的《安全配员原则》。
Translation: Refer to the Principles of Safe Manning adopted by this Organization by resolution A.890(21), as amended by resolution A.955(23).

Query_Text_cn: ④为此可使用经修正的《IMO标准海上通信用语》（A.918(22)决议）。
Translation: For this purpose, the amended IMO Standard Marine Communication Phrases (Resolution A.918(22)) may be used.

Query_Text_cn: 3使驾驶台工作人员和引航员能够方便和连续地访问重要信息。
Translation: 3. Enable bridge personnel and pilots to conveniently and continuously access critical information.

Query_Text_cn: 7通过监视和报警系统最大限度降低人为错误的风险并在发生人为错误时可探测到，以使驾驶台工作人员和引航员及时采取相应行动。
Translation: 7. Minimize the risk of human error through monitoring and alarm systems, and ensure that any human errors can be detected so that bridge personnel and pilots can take timely and appropriate action.

Query_Text_cn: 1应具有使主管机关满意的适当安排，以确保本章所要求设备的性能得到维护。
Translation: 1. Appropriate arrangements satisfactory to the competent authority shall be made to ensure that the performance of the equipment required by this chapter is maintained.

Query_Text_cn: 2除第I/7(b)(ii)、I/8和I/9条规定者外，虽应采取一切合理措施以保持本章所要求的设备处于有效工作状态，但不应把这些设备的功能失常视为船舶不适航，或作为将船舶滞留在不易提供维修设施的港口的理由，只要船长在计划和实行一个安全航程以将船舶驶往可以进行维修的港口时注意到无法工作的设备或不可得到的信息，并作了适当的安排。
Translation: Except as provided in Regulations I/7(b)(ii), I/8, and I/9, although all reasonable steps shall be taken to maintain the equipment required by this chapter in an efficient working order, the malfunction of such equipment shall not be regarded as making the ship unseaworthy, nor shall it be considered as a reason for detaining the ship in a port where repair facilities are not readily available, provided that the master has duly taken into account the inoperative equipment or unavailable information when planning and executing a safe voyage to a port where repairs can be carried out, and has made appropriate arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 1各国主管机关应确保安装在2002年7月1日或以后建造的船舶上，位于驾驶台或邻近驾驶台的所有电气和电子设备，应结合本组织制定的建议案②，进行电磁兼容性试验。
Translation: 1. The competent authorities of each country shall ensure that all electrical and electronic equipment installed on ships constructed on or after July 1, 2002, and located on or near the bridge, undergo electromagnetic compatibility testing in accordance with the recommendations developed by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2电气和电子设备的安装应使电磁干扰不会影响航行系统和设备的正常功能。
Translation: 2. The installation of electrical and electronic equipment shall ensure that electromagnetic interference does not affect the normal functioning of navigation systems and equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 3如果便携式电气和电子设备可能影响航行系统和设备的正常功能，则其不应在驾驶台进行操作。
Translation: If portable electrical and electronic devices may affect the normal functioning of navigation systems and equipment, they should not be operated on the bridge.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《驾驶台设备和布置的人机工程学衡准指南》（MSC/Circ.982号通函）和IBS性能标准（MSC.64(67)决议，附件1）及INS性能标准（MSC.86(70)决议，附件3）。
Translation: Refer to the “Guidelines on Ergonomic Criteria for Bridge Equipment and Layout” (MSC/Circ.982), the IBS Performance Standards (MSC.64(67), Annex 1), and the INS Performance Standards (MSC.86(70), Annex 3).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.813(19)决议通过的《所有船用电气和电子设备电磁兼容性的一般要求》。
Translation: Refer to the General Requirements for Electromagnetic Compatibility of All Marine Electrical and Electronic Equipment adopted by this Organization under Resolution A.813(19).

Query_Text_cn: 1需满足本章第19条和20条要求的系统和设备应为主管机关认可的型式。
Translation: Systems and equipment required to comply with Articles 19 and 20 of this chapter shall be of types approved by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2在2002年7月1日或以后安装，用于执行第19条和20条的功能要求的系统和设备，包括相关的后备装置（如适用），其所达到的相应性能标准应不低于本组织通过的性能标准①。
Translation: 2. For systems and equipment, including relevant backup devices (where applicable), installed on or after 1 July 2002 for the purpose of fulfilling the functional requirements of Regulations 19 and 20, the relevant performance standards achieved shall be not less than those adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 《关于船舶首向发送装置（THDs）性能标准的建议案》（MSC.116(73)决议）。
Translation: Proposal on Performance Standards for Shipborne Heading Transmission Devices (THDs) (Resolution MSC.116(73)).

Query_Text_cn: 3当在2002年7月1日以前建造的船舶上替换或添加系统和设备时，这些系统和设备应在合理和可行的范围内符合本条2的要求。
Translation: When systems and equipment are replaced or added on ships constructed before July 1, 2002, such systems and equipment shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 2 of this article to the extent that is reasonable and practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 4在本组织通过相关的性能标准之前安装的系统和设备，主管机关在充分考虑了本组织通过的建议衡准后，可以对其免除完全符合这种标准的要求。
Translation: For systems and equipment installed prior to the adoption of relevant performance standards by the Organization, the competent authority may exempt them from the requirement of full compliance with such standards, having duly considered the recommendations adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，对于视为满足19.2.1.4条之海图配备要求的电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS），该系统所达到的相关性能标准应不低于本组织所通过且在其安装之日有效的性能标准，或者，对于在1999年1月1日以前安装的系统，应不低于本组织在1995年11月23日通过的性能标准①。
Translation: However, for Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems (ECDIS) considered as meeting the chart carriage requirements of Regulation 19.2.1.4, the relevant performance standards achieved by such systems shall be not less than those adopted by the Organization and in effect on the date of their installation, or, for systems installed before 1 January 1999, not less than the performance standards adopted by the Organization on 23 November 1995①.

Query_Text_cn: 5主管机关应要求制造商具有一个由适任机构审核的质量控制系统，以确保持续符合型式认可条件。
Translation: The competent authority shall require manufacturers to have a quality control system audited by a qualified body to ensure continued compliance with type approval conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 作为替代，主管机关可以在该产品安装上船之前使用最终产品验证程序，由适任机构验证其是否符合型式认可证书。
Translation: As an alternative, the competent authority may, before the product is installed on board, use the final product verification procedure to have a qualified body verify its compliance with the type approval certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 6在对具有本章未涉及之新特征的航行系统或设备认可之前，主管机关应确保这种特征对功能的支持与本章所要求者至少同样有效。
Translation: Before approving navigation systems or equipment with new features not covered in this chapter, the competent authority shall ensure that the support provided by such features for their functions is at least as effective as that required by this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 7如果除第19条和20条要求的各项设备以外，船上还配有本组织已制定性能标准的设备，则这种设备应经过认可且所达到的性能标准应尽实际可能不低于本组织通过的性能标准。
Translation: If, in addition to the equipment required by Regulations 19 and 20, the ship is also fitted with equipment for which performance standards have been established by the Organization, such equipment shall be approved and, as far as practicable, shall meet performance standards not inferior to those adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 8航行数据记录仪系统，包括所有传感器，应作年度性能试验。
Translation: The voyage data recorder system, including all sensors, shall undergo an annual performance test.

Query_Text_cn: 试验应由认可的试验或检修机构进行，以验证所记录数据的精度、持续时间和可恢复性。
Translation: The tests should be conducted by accredited testing or maintenance institutions to verify the accuracy, duration, and recoverability of the recorded data.

Query_Text_cn: 另外还应进行试验和检查，以确定所有防护外罩和辅助定位装置的适用性。
Translation: In addition, tests and inspections should be conducted to determine the suitability of all protective covers and auxiliary positioning devices.

Query_Text_cn: 船上应保留1份由试验机构颁发的载明符合日期和适用性能标准的符合证书，应有一份副本保留在船上。
Translation: A certificate of compliance issued by the testing institution, indicating the date of compliance and applicable performance standards, shall be kept on board, with a copy retained on the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1在2002年7月1日或以后建造的船舶，应配备满足本条2.1至2.9规定要求的航行系统和设备。
Translation: Ships constructed on or after 1 July 2002 shall be fitted with navigational systems and equipment that meet the requirements of paragraphs 2.1 to 2.9 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: ①《关于电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS）性能标准的建议案》（A.817(19)决议）。
Translation: ① "Recommendation on Performance Standards for Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems (ECDIS)" (Resolution A.817(19)).

Query_Text_cn: 3不迟于本条2.4.2和2.4.3规定的日期，配备本条2.4要求的系统。
Translation: Equip the systems required under Clause 2.4 no later than the dates specified in Clauses 2.4.2 and 2.4.3.

Query_Text_cn: 91部电话，或其他装置，用与向应急操舵位置（如设有）传递首向信息。
Translation: 91. Telephones or other devices used to transmit heading information to the emergency steering position, if provided.

Query_Text_cn: ①合适的对开纸质航海图可作为ECDIS的后备装置。
Translation: Appropriate paper nautical charts of the corresponding scale can serve as a backup for ECDIS.

Query_Text_cn: 可接受ECDIS的其他后备装置（见经修正的A.817(19)决议的附录6）。
Translation: Other acceptable back-up arrangements for ECDIS (see Appendix 6 of the revised Resolution A.817(19)).

Query_Text_cn: 21套白昼信号灯，或其他装置，用于在白天和夜晚通过灯光进行联络，使用电源，但非唯一依靠船上电源供电。
Translation: 21 sets of daytime signal lamps, or other devices, used for communication via light signals during both day and night, powered by electricity but not solely dependent on the ship's power supply.

Query_Text_cn: 51台经过适当校正的首向传送装置，或其他装置，用于传送首向信息以输入到本条2.3.2、2.3.3和2.4所述的设备中。
Translation: 51 properly calibrated primary directional transmitters, or other devices, used to transmit primary directional information for input into the equipment described in items 2.3.2, 2.3.3, and 2.4 of this section.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见第I/8条。
Translation: See Article I/8.

Query_Text_cn: ②第一次安全设备检验系指安全设备的第一次年度检验、第一次定期检验或第一次换证检验，以在2004年7月1日以后先到期者为准，此外，对于在建船舶，系指初次检验。
Translation: ②The first safety equipment inspection refers to the first annual inspection, the first periodic inspection, or the first certificate renewal inspection of safety equipment, whichever occurs first after July 1, 2004. In addition, for ships under construction, it refers to the initial inspection.

Query_Text_cn: 7AIS的操作应考虑到本组织通过的指南21。
Translation: The operation of 7AIS should take into account the guidelines 21 adopted by the organization.

Query_Text_cn: 配备AIS的船舶应使AIS始终保持运行状态，但国际协定、规则或标准规定要保护航行信息的情况除外。
Translation: Ships equipped with AIS should keep the AIS in continuous operation at all times, except in cases where international agreements, regulations, or standards require the protection of navigational information.

Query_Text_cn: 31台电罗经方位复视器，或其他装置，通过使用上述.1所述的电罗经或其他装置，在水平360o弧度范围内量取方位。
Translation: 31 sets of gyrocompass bearing repeaters, or other devices, measure bearings within a 360° horizontal arc by utilizing the gyrocompass or other devices mentioned in section.1 above.

Query_Text_cn: 51台自动跟踪仪，或其他装置，用于自动标绘其他目标的距离和方位，以确定碰撞危险。
Translation: 51 automatic tracking devices, or other equipment, used to automatically plot the range and bearing of other targets to determine the risk of collision.

Query_Text_cn: 1本章适用于因其对船舶或船上人员的特别危害而需在本规则所适用的一切船舶上，及小于500总吨的货船上采取特别预防措施的货物的装运（散装液体、散装气体和其他章内已作出装运规定的除外）。
Translation: This chapter applies to the carriage of cargoes that, due to their particular hazards to ships or persons on board, require special precautions to be taken on all ships to which these regulations apply, as well as on cargo ships of less than 500 gross tonnage, except for bulk liquids, bulk gases, and other cargoes for which provisions for carriage have already been made in other chapters.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，对小于500总吨的货船，如果主管机关认为因航行的遮蔽性和条件，应用本章A部分或B部分的任何具体要求是不合理或不必要的，则可采取能够确保这些船舶所需安全的其他有效措施。
Translation: However, for cargo ships of less than 500 gross tonnage, if the competent authority considers that, due to the sheltered nature and conditions of their navigation, the application of any specific requirements of Part A or Part B of this chapter is unreasonable or unnecessary, other effective measures may be taken to ensure the required safety of these ships.

Query_Text_cn: 2作为本章A部分和B部分规定的补充，每一缔约国政府应保证提供有关货物及其堆装和系固的适当资料，特别说明安全装运此类货物所必需的预防措施。
Translation: 2. In addition to the provisions of Parts A and B of this chapter, each Contracting Government shall ensure the provision of appropriate information regarding the goods and their stowage and securing, with particular reference to the precautions necessary for the safe carriage of such goods.

Query_Text_cn: 1发货人应在装货前及早向船长或其代表提供关于该货物的适当资料，以便能实施为此种货物的适当堆装和安全装运可能是必需的预防措施。
Translation: The shipper shall, prior to loading and in a timely manner, provide the master or his representative with appropriate information regarding the cargo, so that any necessary precautions for the proper stowage and safe carriage of such cargo can be taken.

Query_Text_cn: 此类资料②应在货物装船前以书面形式③和适当的运输单证予以确认。
Translation: Such documents② should be confirmed in writing③ together with appropriate shipping documents before the goods are loaded.

Query_Text_cn: 1对于杂货和以货物单元运输的货物，应有货物的一般说明、货物或货物单元的毛重和货物的任何有关特性。
Translation: For general cargo and cargo transported in units, there should be a general description of the cargo, the gross weight of the cargo or cargo unit, and any relevant characteristics of the cargo.

Query_Text_cn: 就本条而言，应提供本组织以A.714(17)决议通过并可能经修正的《货物堆装和系固安全操作规则》第1.9节所要求的货物资料。
Translation: For the purposes of this paragraph, cargo information required by section 1.9 of the Code of Safe Practice for Cargo Stowage and Securing, adopted by the Organization by resolution A.714(17) and as may be amended, shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于散装货物，应有关于货物积载因数、平舱方法、移动的可能性（包括稳定角,如适用）以及任何其他有关特性的资料。
Translation: 2. For bulk cargoes, information should be provided regarding the stowage factor, trimming methods, the possibility of shifting (including the angle of repose, where applicable), and any other relevant characteristics.

Query_Text_cn: 3本组织以A.434(XI)决议通过的经修正的《固体散装货物安全操作规则(BC规则)》。
Translation: 3. The organization adopted the amended Code of Safe Practice for Solid Bulk Cargoes (BC Code) by resolution A.434(XI).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见MSC/Circ.663通函《货物资料表》。
Translation: See MSC/Circ.663, "Cargo Information Sheet."

Query_Text_cn: ③本条所指的单证并不排除作为书面文件的一种辅助手段而使用电子数据处理（EDP）和电子数据交换（EDI）的传输技术。
Translation: The documents referred to in this Article do not preclude the use of electronic data processing (EDP) and electronic data interchange (EDI) transmission technologies as an auxiliary means to written documents.

Query_Text_cn: 3对于未按第VII/1.1条所定义的IMDG规则的规定分类，但具有可能造成潜在危害的化学性质的散装货物，除上述各项要求的资料外，还应有关于其化学性质的资料。
Translation: For bulk cargoes that are not classified according to the provisions of the IMDG Code as defined in paragraph VII/1.1, but possess chemical properties that may present potential hazards, information regarding their chemical properties shall also be provided in addition to the above-mentioned required information.

Query_Text_cn: 3在货物单元装船前，发货人应确保这类货物单元的毛重与运输单证中表明的毛重是一致的。
Translation: Before loading the cargo unit onto the vessel, the shipper shall ensure that the gross weight of such cargo unit is consistent with the gross weight indicated in the transport documents.

Query_Text_cn: 1在运输可能释放有毒或易燃气体或可能在货物处所中造成氧气耗尽的散装货物时，应备有测量空气中这类气体或氧气浓度的适当仪器，及其详细的使用说明书。
Translation: When transporting bulk cargoes that may release toxic or flammable gases or may cause oxygen depletion in cargo spaces, appropriate instruments for measuring the concentration of such gases or oxygen in the air, along with detailed instructions for their use, shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 这种仪器应使主管机关满意。
Translation: Such instruments shall be subject to the satisfaction of the competent authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关应采取措施，确保船员在上述仪器使用方面受到培训。
Translation: The competent authorities shall take measures to ensure that crew members receive training in the use of the aforementioned equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 在船上使用杀虫剂，尤其是为熏舱而使用杀虫剂时，应采取适当预防措施。
Translation: When using insecticides on board, especially for fumigating cabins, appropriate precautions should be taken.

Query_Text_cn: 1在甲板上和甲板下装运的货物、货物单元②和货物运输单元③，其装载、堆装和系固应尽可能防止在整个航程中对船舶和船上人员造成损害或危险，以及防止货物落水灭失。
Translation: Cargo, cargo units, and cargo transport units loaded both on and under deck shall be stowed, stacked, and secured in such a manner as to prevent, as far as practicable, any damage or danger to the ship and persons on board throughout the voyage, as well as to prevent the loss of cargo overboard.

Query_Text_cn: 2货物、货物单元和货物运输单元，其在单元中的包装和系固，应能防止在整个航程中对船舶和船上人员造成损害或危险。
Translation: 2. Cargo, cargo units, and cargo transport units, as well as their packaging and securing within the units, shall be arranged to prevent any damage or danger to the ship and personnel on board throughout the entire voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 3在重型货物或异常外形尺寸货物的装载和运输过程中，应采取适当的预防措施，确保不发生船舶结构性损坏，并在整个航程中保持足够的稳性。
Translation: During the loading and transportation of heavy cargo or cargo with abnormal dimensions, appropriate precautionary measures should be taken to ensure that no structural damage occurs to the vessel and that adequate stability is maintained throughout the entire voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 4在滚装船上货物单元和货物运输单元的装载和运输过程中，应采取适当的预防措施，特别是注意这种船上和货物单元和货物运输单元上的系固装置，以及系固点和捆索的强度。
Translation: During the loading and transportation of cargo units and cargo transport units on ro-ro ships, appropriate precautionary measures shall be taken, with particular attention to the securing devices on board the ship and on the cargo units and cargo transport units, as well as the strength of securing points and lashings.

Query_Text_cn: 5货运集装箱的装载应不超过经修正的《国际集装箱安全公约》（CSC）规定的安全核准牌上注明的最大总重量。
Translation: The loading of five cargo containers shall not exceed the maximum gross weight indicated on the safety approval plate in accordance with the amended International Convention for Safe Containers (CSC).

Query_Text_cn: 6在整个航程中，除散装固体和液体货物以外的所有货物、货物单元和货物运输单元，应按照主管机关认可的《货物系固手册》进行装载、堆装和系固。
Translation: During the entire voyage, all cargo, cargo units, and cargo transport units, except for bulk solid and liquid cargoes, shall be loaded, stacked, and secured in accordance with the Cargo Securing Manual approved by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 对于具有第II-2/3.41条定义的滚装处所的船舶，应在离开泊位之前按照《货物系固手册》完成所有这些货物、货物单元和货物运输单元的系固。
Translation: For ships with ro-ro spaces as defined in Regulation II-2/3.41, all such cargo, cargo units, and cargo transport units shall be secured in accordance with the Cargo Securing Manual before leaving the berth.

Query_Text_cn: 《货物系固手册》的编制标准应至少与本组织制定的相关指南④相当。
Translation: The standards for the preparation of the Cargo Securing Manual should be at least equivalent to the relevant guidelines developed by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见经修正的IMO《关于在船上安全使用杀虫剂的建议案》。
Translation: Refer to the amended IMO "Recommendations on the Safe Use of Pesticides in Ships."

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.714(17)决议通过的经修正的《货物堆装和系固安全操作规则》。
Translation: Refer to the revised "Code of Safe Practice for Cargo Stowage and Securing" adopted by this organization under Resolution A.714(17).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织以MSC.122(75)决议通过的《国际海运危险货物（IMDG）规则》。
Translation: Refer to the International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code adopted by this organization through Resolution MSC.122(75).

Query_Text_cn: ④参见《货物系固手册编制指南》（MSC/Circ.745通函）。
Translation: Refer to the "Guidelines for the Preparation of the Cargo Securing Manual" (MSC/Circ.745).

Query_Text_cn: 1在散装货物装船前，船长应得到关于船舶稳性和标准装载条件下货物分布的综合资料。
Translation: Before loading bulk cargo, the master shall be provided with comprehensive information regarding the vessel's stability and the distribution of cargo under standard loading conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 提供此种资料的方法，应使主管机关满意。
Translation: The method of providing such information shall satisfy the competent authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 2对浓缩物或可液化的其他货物，只有当其实际含水量小于其可运含水极限时才能被接受装船。
Translation: Concentrates or other cargoes that may liquefy shall only be accepted for shipment when their actual moisture content is less than their transportable moisture limit.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果作出了使主管机关满意的安全布置，确保在货物移动时有足够的稳性而且船舶具有充分的结构完整性，则即使其含水量超过了上述极限，仍可接受此种浓缩物和其他货物装船。
Translation: However, if safety arrangements satisfactory to the competent authority are made to ensure adequate stability during cargo operations and the vessel maintains sufficient structural integrity, such concentrates and other cargoes may still be accepted for loading even if their moisture content exceeds the aforementioned limits.

Query_Text_cn: 3对于未按第VII/1.1条所定义的IMDG规则的规定分类，但具有可能造成潜在危害的化学性质的散装货物，在装船之前应对其安全运输采取特别预防措施。
Translation: For bulk cargoes that are not classified according to the provisions of the IMDG Code as defined in paragraph VII/1.1, but possess chemical properties that may present potential hazards, special precautions shall be taken for their safe transport prior to loading.

Query_Text_cn: 1就本条而言，码头代表系指船舶装卸货物的码头或其他设施使用方指定的人员，其负责这个码头或设施对该特定船舶进行作业。
Translation: For the purposes of this Article, "terminal representative" refers to the person designated by the user of the terminal or other facility for loading or unloading cargo from the vessel, who is responsible for the operation of the terminal or facility with respect to the specific vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 2为能使船长防止船体结构中产生过大应力，应给船舶配备一本手册，并应采用为负责货物作业的高级船员所熟悉的语言编写。
Translation: 2. In order to enable the master to prevent excessive stress in the ship's structure, a manual shall be provided on board and shall be written in a language with which the senior officers responsible for cargo operations are familiar.

Query_Text_cn: 如该种语言不是英文，则船上也应配备一本用英文写成的手册。
Translation: If the manual is not written in English, an English version should also be provided on board.

Query_Text_cn: 2本组织以A.562(14)决议通过的《关于船长24m及以上客船和货船完整稳性的突风和横摇衡准(气象衡准)的建议案》。
Translation: The organization adopted Resolution A.562(14), which contains the Recommendation on Weather Criteria for Intact Stability of Passenger and Cargo Ships of 24 meters in length and above, including criteria for sudden squalls and rolling.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.862(20)决议通过的《散货船安全装卸操作规则(BLU规则)》。
Translation: Refer to the "Code of Practice for the Safe Loading and Unloading of Bulk Carriers (BLU Code)" adopted by this organization under Resolution A.862(20).

Query_Text_cn: 7如要求强度计算，在装卸货物及航行期间船体上的最大许用载荷和力矩。
Translation: If strength calculations are required, the maximum allowable load and moment on the hull during cargo handling and navigation must be specified.

Query_Text_cn: 3固体散装货物在装货或卸货之前，船长和码头代表应商定一项计划①，该计划应确保在装卸货物期间不超过船上的许用应力和力矩，同时还应包括装卸货物的次序、数量及速率,此时应考虑到装卸货物的速度、船上添注口的数量及减压载或加压载的能力。
Translation: Before loading or unloading solid bulk cargoes, the master and the terminal representative shall agree on a plan to ensure that the permissible stresses and moments on the ship are not exceeded during cargo operations. The plan shall also include the sequence, quantity, and rate of loading or unloading, taking into account the speed of cargo handling, the number of shipboard filling points, and the vessel’s capacity for deballasting or ballasting.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划及其后的任何修改，应提交给港口国的有关当局。
Translation: The plan and any subsequent amendments shall be submitted to the relevant authorities of the port State.

Query_Text_cn: 4散装货物应在整个货物处所范围内装载并按需要合理平舱，以尽量减少货物移动的危险，并确保在整个航行期间保持足够的稳性。
Translation: Bulk cargoes should be loaded throughout the cargo space and, as necessary, properly trimmed to minimize the risk of cargo shifting and to ensure adequate stability is maintained throughout the voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 5在甲板间舱装载散装货物时，如果装载资料表明船底结构在舱口开启时的应力会达到不可接受的程度，则这些甲板间的舱口应关闭。
Translation: When loading bulk cargo in tween-deck holds, if loading data indicates that the stress on the ship's bottom structure will reach an unacceptable level when the hatch covers are open, the tween-deck hatch covers shall be kept closed.

Query_Text_cn: 应将货物合理平舱，并应延伸到两舷，或用具有足够强度的附加纵向隔壁加以固定。
Translation: Cargo should be properly leveled and extended to both sides of the vessel, or secured with additional longitudinal bulkheads of sufficient strength.

Query_Text_cn: 应注意甲板间舱的安全承载能力，以确保甲板结构不过载。
Translation: Attention should be paid to the safe load-bearing capacity of the tween deck compartments to ensure that the deck structure is not overloaded.

Query_Text_cn: 6船长和码头代表应确保装卸货物作业按照商定的计划进行。
Translation: The ship's captain and the dock representative shall ensure that cargo loading and unloading operations are carried out in accordance with the agreed plan.

Query_Text_cn: 7如果在装卸货物期间，本条2所述的对船舶的任一限制已经超出或者如果装卸继续进行下去可能导致超出，则船长有权中止装卸作业并有责任将此通知给批准这个计划的港口国有关当局。
Translation: If, during the loading or unloading of cargo, any of the limitations on the ship described in paragraph 2 of this Article have already been exceeded, or if continuing the loading or unloading may result in such exceedance, the master shall have the right to suspend the cargo operations and shall be responsible for notifying the relevant authorities of the port State that approved the plan.

Query_Text_cn: 船长和码头代表应确保采取纠正措施。
Translation: The captain and the dock representative should ensure that corrective actions are taken.

Query_Text_cn: 当卸货时，船长和码头代表应确保卸货方法不损坏船体结构。
Translation: During unloading, the master and the dock representative shall ensure that the unloading methods do not damage the ship's structure.

Query_Text_cn: 8船长应确保船上人员连续不断地监视货物装卸作业。
Translation: The captain shall ensure that the cargo loading and unloading operations are continuously monitored by personnel on board.

Query_Text_cn: 如有可能，在装卸货物期间应定期校核吃水以确认提供的吨位数。
Translation: If possible, the draft should be checked periodically during cargo loading and discharging to confirm the tonnage provided.

Query_Text_cn: 每次测得的吃水和吨位数应记入货物日志。
Translation: The draft and tonnage measured each time shall be recorded in the cargo log.

Query_Text_cn: 如发现与商定的计划有显著的偏差，则应调整货物装卸或压载作业，或两者，以确保偏差被纠正。
Translation: If significant deviations from the agreed plan are identified, cargo handling or ballasting operations, or both, should be adjusted to ensure that the deviations are corrected.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.862(20)决议通过的《散货船安全装卸操作规则(BLU规则)》。
Translation: Refer to the Code of Practice for the Safe Loading and Unloading of Bulk Carriers (BLU Code) adopted by this Organization by resolution A.862(20).

Query_Text_cn: 1国际谷物规则系指由本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.23(59)决议通过并可能经本组织修正的《国际散装谷物安全装运规则》，但这类修正案应按本公约第VIII条有关除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: 1. The International Grain Code refers to the "International Code for the Safe Carriage of Grain in Bulk," adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization by Resolution MSC.23(59) and as may be amended by the Organization. However, such amendments shall be adopted, enter into force, and be implemented in accordance with the procedures for amending the Annex, other than Chapter I, as set out in Article VIII of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2谷物一词包括小麦、玉蜀黍（苞米）、燕麦、稞麦、大麦、大米、豆类、种子以及由其加工而成并在自然状态下具有类似特征的制品。
Translation: The term "grain" includes wheat, maize (corn), oats, buckwheat, barley, rice, legumes, seeds, as well as products processed from these and possessing similar characteristics in their natural state.

Query_Text_cn: 1除本规则任何其他适用的要求外，装运谷物的货船还应符合《国际谷物规则》的要求，并持有1份按该规则要求的批准文件。
Translation: In addition to any other applicable requirements under these regulations, ships carrying grain must comply with the provisions of the International Grain Code and possess an approved document as required by the Code.

Query_Text_cn: 就本条而言，该规则的要求应强制性执行。
Translation: For the purposes of this article, the requirements of this rule shall be enforced mandatorily.

Query_Text_cn: 2没有这种批准文件的船舶，在船长使主管机关或代表主管机关的装货港的缔约国政府确信该船所提出的装载情况符合《国际谷物规则》的要求之前，不应装载谷物。
Translation: Ships without such a certificate shall not load grain until the master has satisfied the competent authority or the government of the contracting party at the port of loading, or its representative, that the proposed loading arrangements comply with the requirements of the International Grain Code.

Query_Text_cn: 本章适用于所有核能船舶，但军用船舶除外。
Translation: This chapter applies to all nuclear-powered ships, except for military vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约的其他各章中的规则均适用于核能船舶，但经本章修订者除外。
Translation: The provisions of the other chapters of this Convention shall apply to nuclear ships, except as modified by this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，核能船舶均应符合本公约的任何规则，不应被免除。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall nuclear-powered ships be exempted from any of the provisions of this Convention; they shall comply with all its regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 核反应堆装置的设计、构造以及检查和装配的标准均应经主管机关认可和满意，并应考虑因辐射而使检验所受到的限制。
Translation: The standards for the design, construction, inspection, and assembly of nuclear reactor installations shall be approved and satisfied by the competent authorities, and shall take into account the limitations imposed on inspection by radiation.

Query_Text_cn: 设计核反应堆装置时，应考虑船舶在正常和异常两种航行情况下的特殊工作条件。
Translation: When designing nuclear reactor installations, special operating conditions of ships under both normal and abnormal navigation scenarios should be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关应采取措施，确保在海上或港内不使船员、乘客或公众，或水道或食物或水源受到不当的辐射或其他的核能危害。
Translation: The competent authorities shall take measures to ensure that crew members, passengers, the public, waterways, food, or water sources are not subjected to undue radiation or other nuclear hazards at sea or in ports.

Query_Text_cn: (a)应编写安全鉴定书，以评定核动力装置的性能和船舶的安全，从而确保在海上或港内不使船员、乘客或公众，或水道或食物或水源受到不当的辐射或其他的核能危害。
Translation: (a) A safety assessment report shall be prepared to evaluate the performance of the nuclear power plant and the safety of the vessel, so as to ensure that neither the crew, passengers, nor the public, nor waterways, food, or water sources are subjected to undue radiation or other nuclear hazards while at sea or in port.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关对鉴定书满意时，应予以认可，该鉴定书应始终保持更新。
Translation: When the competent authority is satisfied with the appraisal report, it should grant approval, and the appraisal report must be kept up to date at all times.

Query_Text_cn: (b)应提前足够的时间将安全鉴定书送交核能船舶拟驶往的缔约国政府，以供其评定该核能船舶的安全性。
Translation: (b)The safety certificate shall be submitted to the government of the Contracting Party to which the nuclear-powered ship intends to sail in sufficient time in advance for the purpose of assessing the safety of the nuclear-powered ship.

Query_Text_cn: 应制订关于核动力装置的所有操作事项且着重于安全的操作手册，作为操作人员在工作时的参考和指导。
Translation: An operations manual focusing on safety should be developed for all procedures related to nuclear power installations, serving as a reference and guide for operators during their work.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关对操作手册满意时，应予以认可。
Translation: When the competent authority is satisfied with the operations manual, it shall grant approval.

Query_Text_cn: 应有一份操作手册保存在船上，且应始终保持更新。
Translation: An operating manual should be kept on board the vessel and should be continuously updated.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《核能商船安全规则》（A.491(XII)决议），该规则补充了本章的要求。
Translation: Refer to the “Code of Safety for Nuclear Merchant Ships” (Resolution A.491(XII)), which supplements the requirements of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 对核能船舶的检验应包括第I/7条或第I/8、9和10条中的适用要求，但对于因辐射而受到限制的检验除外。
Translation: The inspection of nuclear-powered ships shall include the applicable requirements of Regulation I/7 or I/8, 9, and 10, except for inspections that are restricted due to radiation.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，检验还应包括安全鉴定书的任何特殊要求。
Translation: In addition, the inspection should also include any special requirements specified in the safety certification.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然有第I/8条和10条的规定，但在所有情况下，对核能船舶的检验应不少于每年1次。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of Regulations I/8 and 10, in all cases, the inspection of nuclear ships shall be carried out at least once a year.

Query_Text_cn: (a)第I/12(a)条及第I/14条的规定不适用于核能船舶。
Translation: The provisions of Article I/12(a) and Article I/14 shall not apply to nuclear ships.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对经检查和检验后符合第II-1章、第II-2章、第III章、第IV章和第VIII章的要求及本规则其他有关要求的核能客船，应签发核能客船安全证书。
Translation: (b) A Nuclear Passenger Ship Safety Certificate shall be issued to nuclear passenger ships that, after inspection and examination, are found to comply with the requirements of Chapters II-1, II-2, III, IV, and VIII, as well as other relevant provisions of these regulations.

Query_Text_cn: (c)对经检查和检验后满足第I/10条所规定的货船检验要求并符合第II-1章、第II-2章、第III章、第IV章和第VIII章的要求以及本规则其他有关要求的核能货船，应签发核能货船安全证书。
Translation: (c) Nuclear-powered cargo ships that, upon inspection and examination, meet the cargo ship survey requirements specified in Regulation I/10 and comply with the requirements of Chapters II-1, II-2, III, IV, and VIII, as well as other relevant provisions of these regulations, shall be issued a Nuclear Cargo Ship Safety Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (d)在核能客船安全证书和核能货船安全证书中应阐明：“此船为核能船舶，此船符合公约第VIII章的所有要求，并与所认可的此船安全鉴定书相一致”。
Translation: (d) The Nuclear Passenger Ship Safety Certificate and the Nuclear Cargo Ship Safety Certificate shall state: "This ship is a nuclear-powered vessel. It complies with all the requirements of Chapter VIII of the Convention and is consistent with the approved Safety Assessment for this ship."

Query_Text_cn: (e)核能客船安全证书和核能货船安全证书的有效期限均不应超过12个月。
Translation: (e) The validity period of the Nuclear Passenger Ship Safety Certificate and the Nuclear Cargo Ship Safety Certificate shall not exceed 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: (f)核能客船安全证书和核能货船安全证书应由主管机关或由其正式授权的个人或机构签发。
Translation: (f) The Nuclear Passenger Ship Safety Certificate and the Nuclear Cargo Ship Safety Certificate shall be issued by the competent authority or by persons or institutions formally authorized by it.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有情况下，主管机关应对该证书负全部责任。
Translation: In all cases, the competent authority shall bear full responsibility for the certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 除按第I/19条所规定的控制外，核能船舶在进入各缔约国港口之前以及在港时均应受到特殊控制，其目的是为证实船上已具备有效的核能船舶安全证书，并证实在海上或港内，该船对船员、乘客或公众，或对水道或食物或水源没有不当的辐射或其他的核能危害。
Translation: In addition to the controls stipulated in Regulation I/19, nuclear-powered ships shall be subject to special controls both prior to entering the ports of Contracting States and while in port. The purpose of these controls is to verify that the ship possesses a valid Nuclear Ship Safety Certificate and to confirm that, whether at sea or in port, the ship does not pose undue radiation or other nuclear hazards to crew, passengers, the public, waterways, food, or water sources.

Query_Text_cn: 当核能船舶发生任何可能导致危害周围环境的事故时，该船船长应立即报告主管机关。
Translation: In the event of any accident involving a nuclear-powered vessel that may pose a threat to the surrounding environment, the ship's master shall immediately report to the competent authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 船长还应立即报告该船在损坏情况下可能处于的水域或驶往的水域所属国家政府的主管当局。
Translation: The captain shall also immediately report to the competent authorities of the government of the country in whose waters the vessel may be located or to whose waters it may be proceeding while in a damaged condition.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见IMO/IAEA《关于核能商船使用港口的安全建议》。
Translation: Refer to the IMO/IAEA "Safety Recommendations for the Use of Ports by Nuclear Merchant Ships."

Query_Text_cn: 11994年高速船规则（1994HSC规则）系指由本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.36(63)决议通过的《国际高速船安全规则》。该规则可能由本组织修正，但这类修正案应按照本公约第VIII条有关的除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The 1994 High-Speed Craft Code (1994 HSC Code) refers to the International Code of Safety for High-Speed Craft adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of this Organization through Resolution MSC.36(63). The Code may be amended by this Organization, but such amendments shall be adopted, enter into force, and be implemented in accordance with the procedures for amending the Annex, except Chapter I, as specified in Article VIII of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 22000年高速船规则（2000HSC规则）系指由本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.97(73)决议通过的《2000年国际高速船安全规则》。该规则可能由本组织修正，但这类修正案应按照本公约第VIII条有关的除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The 2000 High-Speed Craft Code (2000 HSC Code) refers to the International Code of Safety for High-Speed Craft, 2000, adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of this Organization by resolution MSC.97(73). The Code may be amended by the Organization, but such amendments shall be adopted, brought into force, and implemented in accordance with the procedures for amending the Annex, other than Chapter I, as set out in Article VIII of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 式中：▽=相应于设计水线的排水量，m3。不包括在非排水状态下船体由地效应产生的气动升力完全支承在水面以上的船舶。
Translation: In the formula: ▽ refers to the displacement corresponding to the design waterline, in cubic meters (m³). It does not include vessels that are fully supported above the water surface by aerodynamic lift generated by ground effect when the hull is in a non-displacement state.

Query_Text_cn: 4建造的船系指安放龙骨或处于类似建造阶段的船。
Translation: Ships under construction refer to those with the keel laid or at a similar stage of construction.

Query_Text_cn: 2该船业已开始的装配量至少为50t，或为全部结构材料估算重量的3%，取较小者。
Translation: The assembly volume already commenced for the vessel shall be at least 50 tons, or 3% of the estimated total structural material weight, whichever is less.

Query_Text_cn: 2在其营运的航线上，满载时以其营运航速航行至避难地不超过8h的500总吨及以上的货船。
Translation: 2. Cargo ships of 500 gross tonnage and above, operating on their routes, which, when fully loaded and sailing at their operating speed, can reach a place of refuge within no more than 8 hours.

Query_Text_cn: 2任何船，不论其建造日期，当进行修理、改装、改建以及与之有关的舾装时，应至少继续符合原适用于该船的要求。
Translation: Any ship, regardless of its construction date, shall, during repairs, alterations, modifications, and related outfitting, continue to comply at least with the requirements originally applicable to that ship.

Query_Text_cn: 在2002年7月1日以前建造的高速船，一般应符合对该日期或以后建造的船的要求，且至少能达到在对其修理、改装、改建或舾装之前的同等程度。
Translation: High-speed craft constructed before July 1, 2002, should generally comply with the requirements applicable to craft constructed on or after that date and, at a minimum, should be brought to at least the same standard as existed prior to any repair, alteration, modification, or outfitting.

Query_Text_cn: 对于重大的修理、改装、改建以及与之有关的舾装，在主管机关认为合理和可行的范围内，均应满足对2002年7月1日或以后建造的高速船的要求。
Translation: For major repairs, alterations, conversions, and related outfitting, the requirements applicable to high-speed craft constructed on or after July 1, 2002 shall be met to the extent that the competent authority deems reasonable and practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 1在1996年1月1日或以后，但在2002年7月1日以前建造的高速船，如完全符合1994年高速船规则的要求，并按该规则的规定业已检验和发证，则其应视为符合第I章至第IV章及第V/18、19和20条的要求。
Translation: High-speed craft constructed on or after 1 January 1996 but before 1 July 2002, which fully comply with the requirements of the 1994 High-Speed Craft Code and have been surveyed and certified in accordance with the provisions of that Code, shall be regarded as complying with the requirements of Chapters I to IV and Regulations V/18, 19, and 20.

Query_Text_cn: 2在2002年7月1日或以后建造的高速船，如完全符合2000年高速船规则的要求，并按该规则的规定业已检验和发证，则其应视为符合第I章至第IV章及第V/18、19和20条的要求。
Translation: High-speed craft constructed on or after 1 July 2002, which fully comply with the requirements of the 2000 High-Speed Craft Code and have been surveyed and certified in accordance with the provisions of that Code, shall be deemed to comply with the requirements of Chapters I to IV and Regulations V/18, 19 and 20.

Query_Text_cn: 2按照《高速船规则》签发的证书和许可证，应与按照第I章规定签发的证书具有同样的效力和获得同样的承认。
Translation: Certificates and permits issued in accordance with the High-Speed Craft Code shall have the same validity and receive the same recognition as certificates issued under the provisions of Chapter I.

Query_Text_cn: 1散货船系指第IX/1.6条所定义的散货船。
Translation: 1. "Bulk carrier" refers to a bulk carrier as defined in Regulation IX/1.6.

Query_Text_cn: 2单舷侧结构散货船系指货舱边界为舷侧壳板的散货船。
Translation: A single-side bulk carrier refers to a bulk carrier whose cargo hold boundary is the side shell plating.

Query_Text_cn: 3散货船的船长系指现行《国际载重线公约》所定义的长度。
Translation: The length of bulk carriers refers to the length as defined by the current International Load Line Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 4固体散货系指除液体或气体外，粉状、颗粒状或任何较大块物质构成的货物，其一般是均匀的，可直接装进装货处所而不需用任何形式的容器盛装。
Translation: Solid bulk cargo refers to goods composed of powder, granules, or any larger pieces, excluding liquids or gases. Generally, such cargo is uniform and can be loaded directly into the cargo hold without the need for any form of container.

Query_Text_cn: 5散货船舱壁和双层底强度标准系指1974年国际海上人命安全公约缔约国政府大会于1997年11月27日通过的决议4《对最前两个货舱之间垂向槽形水密舱壁构件尺寸和最前部货舱许可装载的评估标准》，该标准可能经本组织修正，但这类修正案应按照本公约第VIII条有关的除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The strength standards for bulk carrier cargo hold bulkheads and double bottoms refer to Resolution 4, "Assessment Standards for the Dimensions of Vertical Corrugated Watertight Bulkhead Components Between the First Two Cargo Holds and the Permissible Loading of the Foremost Cargo Hold," adopted by the Conference of Contracting Governments to the 1974 International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea on November 27, 1997. These standards may be amended by the Organization, but such amendments shall be adopted, enter into force, and be implemented in accordance with the procedures for amending the Annex, except Chapter I, as specified in Article VIII of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 6建造的船舶与第II-1/1.1.3.1条的含义相同。
Translation: "Ships constructed" has the same meaning as in Regulation II-1/1.1.3.1.

Query_Text_cn: 散货船除符合其他各章的适用要求外，还应符合本章的要求。
Translation: In addition to complying with the applicable requirements of other chapters, bulk carriers shall also comply with the requirements of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 3对1999年7月1日船龄小于15年的散货船，船龄达到15年后的第一次定期检验日期,但不迟于船龄达到17年之日。
Translation: For bulk carriers less than 15 years old as of July 1, 1999, the date of the first periodical survey after the vessel reaches 15 years of age, but no later than the date the vessel reaches 17 years of age.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织海上安全委员会MSC.79(70)和MSC.89(71)决议通过的《对SOLAS公约第XII章关于散货船的附加安全措施规定的解释》。
