Translation: Refer to the Interpretations of the Provisions of Chapter XII of the SOLAS Convention on Additional Safety Measures for Bulk Carriers, adopted by this Organization’s Maritime Safety Committee through Resolutions MSC.79(70) and MSC.89(71).

Query_Text_cn: 1船长150m及以上，设计用于载运密度为1,000kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物，于1999年7月1日或以后建造的单舷侧结构散货船，当装载至夏季载重线时，应在所有装载状态下能承受任一货舱进水，并能按本条3的规定在令人满意的平衡状态下保持漂浮。
Translation: Bulk carriers of single-side skin construction, with a length of 150 meters or above, designed to carry solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,000 kg/m³ or above, and constructed on or after 1 July 1999, when loaded to the summer load line, shall be capable of withstanding flooding of any one cargo hold in all loading conditions and shall remain afloat in a satisfactory condition of equilibrium in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 3 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 2船长150m及以上，用于载运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物，于1999年7月1日以前建造的单舷侧结构散货船，当装载至夏季载重线时，应在所有装载状态下能承受最前部货舱进水，并能按本条3的规定在令人满意的平衡状态下保持漂浮。
Translation: Bulk carriers of 150m in length and above, constructed before 1 July 1999, with single-side skin construction and intended for the carriage of solid bulk cargoes having a density of 1,780 kg/m³ and above, when loaded to the summer load line, shall be capable of withstanding flooding of the foremost cargo hold in all loading conditions and remain afloat in a satisfactory condition of equilibrium in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 3 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 应按第3条规定的实施计划符合本要求。
Translation: The implementation plan should comply with the requirements set forth in Article 3.

Query_Text_cn: 3按本条6的规定，进水后的平衡状态应满足经A.514(13)决议修正的A.320(IX)决议的附件《等效于1966年国际载重线公约第27条的规则》所规定的平衡状态。
Translation: 3. In accordance with paragraph 6 of this Article, the post-flooding equilibrium condition shall comply with the requirements for equilibrium specified in the Annex to Resolution A.320(IX), as amended by Resolution A.514(13), "Regulations Equivalent to Regulation 27 of the International Convention on Load Lines, 1966."

Query_Text_cn: 假定的进水只需考虑货舱处所进水。
Translation: Only assumed flooding in the cargo hold needs to be considered.

Query_Text_cn: 除非进水货舱容积中被货物占据部分的渗透率按该特定货物予以假定，并且该货舱剩余的空余容积的渗透率假定为0.95,否则载货舱的渗透率应假定为0.9，而空货舱的渗透率应假定为0.95。
Translation: Unless the permeability of the portion of the flooded cargo hold occupied by cargo is assumed according to that specific cargo, and the permeability of the remaining empty volume in the hold is assumed to be 0.95, the permeability of loaded cargo holds should be assumed to be 0.9, while that of empty cargo holds should be assumed to be 0.95.

Query_Text_cn: 41999年7月1日以前建造并按1966年4月5日通过的《1966年国际载重线公约》第27(7)条已核定为减小干舷的散货船，可视为符合本条2的要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers constructed before 1 July 1999 and assigned reduced freeboards in accordance with Regulation 27(7) of the International Load Line Convention, 1966, as adopted on 5 April 1966, may be considered as complying with the requirements of paragraph 2 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 5按经A.514(13)决议修正的A.320(IX)决议通过的《等效于1966年国际载重线公约第27条的规则》(8)的规定已核定为减小干舷的散货船，可视为符合本条1或2的相应要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers certified as reduced freeboard ships in accordance with the provisions of the "Regulations Equivalent to Article 27 of the 1966 International Load Line Convention," adopted by Resolution A.320(IX) as amended by Resolution A.514(13), may be considered as meeting the corresponding requirements of paragraphs 1 or 2 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 6按《1966年国际载重线公约1988年议定书》附则B第27(8)条的规定已核定为减小干舷的散货船，进水后的平衡状态应满足该议定书的有关规定。
Translation: Bulk carriers that have been certified for reduced freeboard in accordance with Regulation 27(8) of Annex B to the 1988 Protocol of the 1966 International Load Line Convention must meet the relevant requirements of the Protocol regarding the equilibrium condition after flooding.

Query_Text_cn: 船长150m及以上，设计用于载运密度为1,000kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物的单舷侧结构散货船,应在所有装载压载状态下有足够强度承受任一货舱进水，并计及舱内进水所产生的动力影响，同时考虑到本组织通过的建议案。
Translation: Bulk carriers of 150 meters in length and above, designed for the carriage of solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,000 kg/m³ and above, and constructed with single-side skin structures, shall have sufficient strength in all loading and ballast conditions to withstand flooding of any one cargo hold, taking into account the dynamic effects of water ingress, and with due consideration to the recommendations adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见1997年SOLAS公约缔约国大会通过的决议3《关于符合SOLAS公约第XII/5条的建议案》。
Translation: Refer to Resolution 3 adopted by the 1997 Conference of Contracting Governments to the SOLAS Convention, "Recommendations on Compliance with Regulation XII/5 of the SOLAS Convention."

Query_Text_cn: 1船长150m及以上，载运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物的单舷侧结构散货船应按第3条规定的实施计划符合本条要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers of single-side skin construction with a length of 150 meters or above, carrying solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,780 kg/m³ or above, shall comply with the requirements of this article in accordance with the implementation schedule specified in Article 3.

Query_Text_cn: 2最前两个货舱间的水密横舱壁及最前部货舱的双层底应符合散货船舱壁和双层底强度标准，有足够强度承受最前部货舱进水，并计及舱内进水所产生的动力影响。
Translation: The watertight transverse bulkhead between the two foremost cargo holds and the double bottom of the foremost cargo hold shall comply with the strength standards for bulk carrier bulkheads and double bottoms, possessing sufficient strength to withstand flooding in the foremost cargo hold and taking into account the dynamic effects caused by water ingress within the hold.

Query_Text_cn: 就本条而言,散货船舱壁和双层底强度标准应视作强制性标准。
Translation: For the purposes of this article, the strength standards for bulk carrier hatch covers and double bottoms shall be regarded as mandatory standards.

Query_Text_cn: 2最大载重量的限制。
Translation: 2. Limitation on maximum load capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 4对为满足本条2的要求而采用以上3.1和3.2的一种或两种限制的散货船，当装载密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散货时，均应符合这些限制条件。
Translation: For bulk carriers to which one or both of the restrictions specified in 3.1 and 3.2 above are applied in order to meet the requirements of paragraph 2 of this article, such restrictions shall be complied with when carrying solid bulk cargoes with a stowage factor of 1,780 kg/m³ or higher.

Query_Text_cn: 2所有货舱按第XI/2条要求的加强检验程序中的定期检验要求通过了同样范围的检验。
Translation: All cargo holds have undergone the same scope of inspection in accordance with the periodical survey requirements of the enhanced survey program specified in Regulation XI/2.

Query_Text_cn: 1第VI/7.2条要求的小册子应由主管机关或其代表签署以表明其符合本章第4、5、6和7条的适用要求。
Translation: The booklet required by Regulation VI/7.2 shall be signed by the competent authority or its representative to indicate its compliance with the applicable requirements of Regulations 4, 5, 6, and 7 of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 2按第6条的要求对载运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物的任何限制应在本条1所述的小册子上作出标识和记录。
Translation: Any restrictions on the carriage of solid bulk cargoes with a stowage density of 1,780 kg/m³ or above, as required by Regulation 6, shall be indicated and recorded in the booklet referred to in paragraph 1 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 3适用本条2的散货船应在船中部左、右舷侧外板上勘划一个实心的永久性等边三角形标志，其边长为500mm，顶点在甲板线以下300mm处，并漆成与船体有反差的颜色。
Translation: Bulk carriers to which paragraph 2 of this article applies shall mark a solid, permanent equilateral triangle on the outer plating of both port and starboard sides amidships, with each side measuring 500 mm. The apex of the triangle shall be located 300 mm below the deck line, and the triangle shall be painted in a color contrasting with the hull.

Query_Text_cn: 3提供特定货舱进水状况的详细资料。
Translation: 3. Provide detailed information on the specific flooding conditions of the designated cargo hold.

Query_Text_cn: 该资料应附有按《国际安全管理（ISM）规则》第8节规定制定的有关撤离部署的详细须知，并作为船员培训和演习的基础。
Translation: This document should be accompanied by detailed instructions on evacuation arrangements developed in accordance with Section 8 of the International Safety Management (ISM) Code, and should serve as the basis for crew training and drills.

Query_Text_cn: 1散货船装货之前，发货人除按第VI/2条要求提交货物资料外，还应申报货物密度。
Translation: Before loading bulk cargo onto a bulk carrier, in addition to submitting cargo information as required by Article VI/2, the shipper shall also declare the cargo density.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于适用第6条的散货船，除非这些散货船符合本章有关装运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散货的所有要求，申报的密度在1,250kg/m3至1,780kg/m3范围内的任何货物应由经授权的试验机构验证其密度。
Translation: For bulk carriers to which Regulation 6 applies, unless such bulk carriers comply with all the requirements of this chapter applicable to the carriage of solid bulk cargoes with a stowage density of 1,780 kg/m³ or above, the density of any cargo declared to be within the range of 1,250 kg/m³ to 1,780 kg/m³ shall be verified by an authorized testing institution.

Query_Text_cn: 1船长150m及以上的散货船均应配备装载仪，该装载仪应能结合本组织所通过的建议案②，提供主船体梁的剪力和弯矩资料。
Translation: Bulk carriers with a length of 150 meters or above shall be equipped with a loading instrument capable of providing information on the shear force and bending moment of the main hull girder, in accordance with the recommendations adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 21999年7月1日以前建造的船长150m及以上的散货船，应不迟于1999年7月1日以后的第一次中间检验或定期检验之日符合本条1的要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers of 150 meters in length and above constructed before July 1, 1999 shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 1 of this article not later than the date of the first intermediate or periodical survey after July 1, 1999.

Query_Text_cn: ①在验证固体散货密度时,可参见海安会MSC/Circ.908通函《测量散货密度的统一方法》。
Translation: When verifying the density of solid bulk cargoes, reference can be made to IMO MSC/Circ.908, "Unified Method for Measuring the Density of Bulk Cargoes."

Query_Text_cn: ②参见1997年SOLAS公约缔约国大会通过的决议5《关于装载仪的建议案》。
Translation: See Resolution 5 "Recommendation on Loading Instruments" adopted by the Conference of Contracting Governments to the SOLAS Convention in 1997.

Query_Text_cn: 1在每一货舱内，当水位达到高出任何货舱内底0.5m时应发出听觉和视觉报警，并在水位高度达到不小于货舱深度15%但不超过2m时也应发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: 1. In each cargo hold, an audible and visual alarm shall be activated when the water level rises 0.5 meters above the bottom of any cargo hold, and an audible and visual alarm shall also be activated when the water level reaches a height not less than 15% of the cargo hold depth but not exceeding 2 meters.

Query_Text_cn: 对于第9.2条适用的散货船，只需安装后一个报警的探测器。
Translation: For bulk carriers subject to Clause 9.2, only one detector with an alarm needs to be installed at the aft.

Query_Text_cn: 水位探测器应安装在货舱的尾端。
Translation: The water level detector should be installed at the aft end of the cargo hold.

Query_Text_cn: 对于用做水压载的货舱，可以安装一个报警越控装置。
Translation: An alarm override device can be installed in cargo holds used for water ballast.

Query_Text_cn: 2对第II-1/11条所要求的防撞舱壁前方的任一压载舱，当舱内的液面达到不超过舱容的10%时应发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: For any ballast tank located forward of the collision bulkhead as required by Regulation II-1/11, an audible and visual alarm shall be activated when the liquid level in the tank reaches no more than 10% of the tank capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 3在除锚链舱以外的任何干燥处所或空舱内，延伸至首货舱前方的任何部位，在水位高出甲板0.1m时应发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: 3. In any dry compartment or empty hold other than the chain locker, at any location extending forward of the forepeak cargo hold, an audible and visual alarm shall be triggered when the water level rises 0.1 meters above the deck.

Query_Text_cn: 当围蔽处所内的容量不超过船舶最大排水量的0.1%时，不必安装此类报警器。
Translation: When the capacity within the enclosed space does not exceed 0.1% of the vessel's maximum displacement, such alarms are not required to be installed.

Query_Text_cn: 2在上述1中规定的听觉和视觉报警器应设于驾驶室。
Translation: The auditory and visual alarms specified in Item 1 above shall be installed in the driver's cab.

Query_Text_cn: 32004年7月1日以前建造的散货船，应在不迟于2004年7月1日后船舶进行的年度检验、中间检验或换证检验时符合本条要求，取早者。
Translation: Bulk carriers constructed before July 1, 2004 shall comply with the requirements of this article at the time of the first annual survey, intermediate survey, or renewal survey conducted after July 1, 2004, whichever occurs earlier.

Query_Text_cn: 1散货船上，用于排放和泵吸位于防撞舱壁前方的压载舱的压载水，和任何部位延伸至首货舱前的干燥处所的舱底水的设备，应能从一个可进入的围蔽处所内将其运行，该围蔽处所应能从驾驶室或主机控制站进入而无需穿过露天干舷甲板或上层建筑甲板。
Translation: On bulk carriers, the equipment used for discharging and pumping ballast water from ballast tanks located forward of the collision bulkhead, as well as for handling bilge water from any dry space extending forward of the foremost cargo hold, shall be operable from an accessible enclosed space. This enclosed space shall be accessible from the wheelhouse or the main engine control station without the need to traverse exposed weather deck or superstructure deck.

Query_Text_cn: 如果用于这些舱或舱底水的管路穿过防撞舱壁，作为第II-1/11.4条规定的阀的控制的替代措施，只要此类阀门控制器的位置符合本条的规定，也可接受通过遥控启动阀门操作的装置。
Translation: If the piping for these compartments or bilge water passes through the collision bulkhead, as an alternative to the control of the valve specified in Regulation II-1/11.4, a device for remote operation of the valve may also be accepted, provided that the location of such valve controls complies with the provisions of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 22004年7月1日以前建造的散货船，应在不迟于2004年7月1日后船舶进行第一次中间检验或换证检验时，但无论如何不得迟于2007年7月1日符合本条要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers constructed before July 1, 2004 shall comply with the requirements of this article no later than the first intermediate or renewal survey of the ship after July 1, 2004, but in any case not later than July 1, 2007.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织海上安全委员会MSC.145(77)决议通过的《散货船水位探测器性能标准》。
Translation: Refer to the Performance Standards for Water Level Detectors on Bulk Carriers adopted by this Organization under MSC.145(77) of the Maritime Safety Committee.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见海安会通函MSC/Circ.1069《对SOLAS公约第XII/13条的解释》。
Translation: Refer to MSC/Circ.1069, "Interpretation of SOLAS Regulation XII/13," issued by the Maritime Safety Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 1现行生效的1974年国际海上人命安全公约（1974年SOLAS公约）是由国际海事组织（IMO）于1974年11月1日召开的国际海上人命安全公约会议通过的，并于1980年5月25日生效。
Translation: The currently effective International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, 1974 (SOLAS 1974), was adopted at the International Conference on Safety of Life at Sea convened by the International Maritime Organization (IMO) on November 1, 1974, and entered into force on May 25, 1980.

Query_Text_cn: 2国际检验与发证协调系统会议1988年11月11日通过的议定书（1988年SOLAS议定书），于2000年2月3日生效，并在1988年SOLAS议定书缔约国之间替代并废除1978年SOLAS议定书。
Translation: The Protocol of November 11, 1988, to the International Convention on the Coordination of Inspection and Certification Systems (the 1988 SOLAS Protocol) entered into force on February 3, 2000, and replaced and abrogated the 1978 SOLAS Protocol among the contracting parties to the 1988 SOLAS Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 27以1974年国际海上人命安全公约缔约国政府会议决议1通过的2002年12月修正案，于2004年7月1日生效。
Translation: The amendment adopted on December 27, 2002, by Resolution 1 of the Conference of Contracting Governments to the 1974 International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea entered into force on July 1, 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 28以MSC.142(77)决议通过的2003年6月修正案。
Translation: The June 2003 amendments adopted by Resolution MSC.142(77).

Query_Text_cn: 29以MSC.151(78)决议（第II-1/3-6条）、MSC.152(78)决议（第III章和第IV章及附则的附录）和MSC.153(78)决议（第V章）通过的2004年5月修正案。
Translation: The May 2004 amendments adopted by resolutions MSC.151(78) (regulation II-1/3-6), MSC.152(78) (Chapters III and IV and the appendix to the annex), and MSC.153(78) (Chapter V).

Query_Text_cn: 海上安全委员会在通过这些修正案时决定，这些修正案应分别于2005年7月1日、2006年1月1日和2006年1月1日视为已被接受，除非在这些日期以前，三分之一以上的SOLAS公约缔约国政府，或商船合计吨数不少于世界商船总吨数50%的缔约国政府通知其反对这些修正案。
Translation: When adopting these amendments, the Maritime Safety Committee decided that they shall be deemed to have been accepted on 1 July 2005, 1 January 2006, and 1 January 2006, respectively, unless, prior to those dates, one third or more of the Contracting Governments to the SOLAS Convention, or Contracting Governments the combined merchant fleets of which constitute not less than 50% of the gross tonnage of the world's merchant fleet, notify their objection to the amendments.

Query_Text_cn: 这些修正案如被接受，将分别于2006年1月1日、2006年7月1日和2006年7月1日生效。
Translation: If adopted, these amendments will take effect on January 1, 2006, July 1, 2006, and July 1, 2006, respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 其生效条件于2003年7月1日达到，该修正案于2004年1月1日生效。
Translation: The conditions for its entry into force were met on July 1, 2003, and the amendment entered into force on January 1, 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 1988年SOLAS议定书还经MSC.154(78)决议通过的2004年5月修正案作了修正。
Translation: The 1988 SOLAS Protocol was further amended by the May 2004 amendments adopted by resolution MSC.154(78).

Query_Text_cn: 海上安全委员会在通过该修正案时决定，该修正案将于2006年1月1日应视为已被接受，除非在此日期以前，三分之一以上的1988年SOLAS议定书缔约国政府，或商船合计吨数不少于世界商船总吨数50%的缔约国政府通知其反对该修正案。
Translation: When adopting the amendment, the Maritime Safety Committee decided that the amendment shall be deemed accepted on 1 January 2006, unless, prior to that date, the governments of one-third or more of the Parties to the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, or the governments of Parties whose combined merchant shipping tonnage constitutes not less than 50% of the world’s total merchant shipping tonnage, notify their objection to the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 这些修正案如被接受，将于2006年7月1日生效。
Translation: If accepted, these amendments will take effect on July 1, 2006.

Query_Text_cn: 4本出版物包括了1974年SOLAS公约、1988年SOLAS议定书以及其后直到并包括2002年12月修正案的全部修正案的综合文本。
Translation: The four publications comprise the consolidated texts of the 1974 SOLAS Convention, the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, and all subsequent amendments up to and including the amendments adopted in December 2002.

Query_Text_cn: IMO秘书处编辑了合成文本，其用意是便于参照2004年7月1日起适用的SOLAS公约要求。
Translation: The IMO Secretariat has compiled a consolidated text for ease of reference to the requirements of the SOLAS Convention applicable from July 1, 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 2第2部分，包括关于全球统一执行检验和发证协调系统（HSSC）的A.883(21)决议、船上应具备的证书和文件①清单、前述的SOLAS公约缔约国会议通过的决议清单以及SOLAS公约第II-1章第12-2条。
Translation: Part 2 includes Resolution A.883(21) on the Global Harmonization of Survey and Certification (HSSC), a list of certificates and documents required to be carried on board, the list of resolutions adopted by the aforementioned Conference of Contracting Governments to the SOLAS Convention, and Regulation 12-2 of Chapter II-1 of the SOLAS Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 证书清单包括了规定的所有证书和文件的用途简述，以便有助于岸上工作人员、官员和船长评估证书和文件，这些对港口国控制和船舶在港内的顺利作业都是必需的。
Translation: The certificate list includes a brief description of the purpose of all required certificates and documents, in order to assist shore personnel, officials, and the master in assessing the certificates and documents. These are essential for port state control and the smooth operation of the vessel in port.

Query_Text_cn: 6总体而言，本综合文本所包含的作业方面要求适用于所有船舶，而有关船舶构造和设备的要求只适用于各个条款所规定的日期或其后建造的船舶。
Translation: Overall, the operational requirements contained in this consolidated text apply to all ships, while the requirements concerning ship construction and equipment apply only to ships constructed on or after the dates specified in the respective provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 为确定适用于2001年以前建造船舶的构造和设备要求，应查阅以前的1974年SOLAS公约、1988年SOLAS议定书以及本公约修正案。
Translation: To determine the construction and equipment requirements applicable to ships built before 2001, reference should be made to the earlier versions of the 1974 SOLAS Convention, the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, and the amendments to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，对现有客船的特殊要求未包含在1981年修正案的第II-2章中，也没有包含在本综合文本之中，而是只包含在原始的1974年SOLAS公约第II-2章的F部分之中。
Translation: For example, special requirements for existing passenger ships are not included in Chapter II-2 of the 1981 Amendments, nor are they incorporated in this consolidated text, but are only contained in Part F of Chapter II-2 of the original 1974 SOLAS Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 而经1978年SOLAS议定书修改的1974年SOLAS公约其他各章的有关规定无类似符号表示，因为在本公约第I章中的有关规定已被1988年SOLAS议定书缔约国之间所替代并废除的同时，这些规定业已被其后通过的SOLAS公约修正案所替代。
Translation: The relevant provisions of other chapters of the 1974 SOLAS Convention, as amended by the 1978 SOLAS Protocol, are not indicated by similar symbols, because when the relevant provisions in Chapter I of this Convention were replaced and abrogated among the Contracting Parties to the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, these provisions had already been superseded by subsequent amendments to the SOLAS Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 8总体而言，本出版物收入了1974年SOLAS公约和1988年SOLAS议定书的文本，并包括了在其正式文本中所给出的修改和修正案内容。
Translation: Overall, this publication contains the texts of the 1974 SOLAS Convention and the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, including the amendments and corrections as set out in their official texts.

Query_Text_cn: 4已按A.351(IX)决议采用国际单位制（SI）的公制值。
Translation: 4. The metric values in the International System of Units (SI) have been adopted in accordance with Resolution A.351(IX).

Query_Text_cn: 9本综合文本中的脚注（正如海上安全委员会（MSC）所说明的，其并不构成公约的一部分，之所以引入，只是为了便于参照）提出与某一特定条文有关的规则、指南和建议案供参照，并已由秘书处在出版时加以更新。
Translation: The footnotes in the consolidated text of the nine volumes (as clarified by the Maritime Safety Committee (MSC), they do not form part of the Convention and are included solely for reference purposes) provide rules, guidelines, and recommendations related to specific provisions for reference, and have been updated by the Secretariat at the time of publication.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还根据规则、指南和建议案及其他MSC决定的有关文本，插入一些解释性脚注。
Translation: In addition, some explanatory footnotes have been inserted based on the relevant texts of rules, guidelines, draft recommendations, and other MSC decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有情况下，读者都必须使用所指文本的最新版本，并记住：这些文本可能已被自经修正的本公约综合文本出版以后的更新材料所修改或废除。
Translation: In all cases, readers must use the latest version of the referenced text and bear in mind that these texts may have been amended or repealed by updated materials published after the consolidated text of this Convention was issued.

Query_Text_cn: 按照第七十六条的规定，应依本附件以下各条成立一个二百海里以外大陆架界限委员会。
Translation: In accordance with Article 76, a Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf beyond 200 nautical miles shall be established pursuant to the following articles of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本委员会应由二十一名委员组成，委员应是地质学、地球物理学或水文学方面的专家，由本公约缔约国从其国民中选出，选举时应妥为顾及确保公平地区代表制的必要，委员应以个人身分任职。
Translation: The Committee shall be composed of twenty-one members who are experts in the fields of geology, geophysics, or hydrology. The members shall be elected by the States Parties to this Convention from among their nationals, with due regard to the necessity of ensuring equitable regional representation during the election. Members shall serve in their personal capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 2.初次选举应尽快举行，无论如何应在本公约生效之日后十八个月内举行。
Translation: 2. The first election shall be held as soon as possible and, in any case, within eighteen months after the entry into force of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 联合国秘书长应在每次选举之日前至少三个月发信给各缔约国，邀请它们在进行适当的区域协商后于三个月内提出候选人。
Translation: The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall, at least three months before the date of each election, address a letter to the States Parties, inviting them, after appropriate regional consultations, to submit their nominations of candidates within three months.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长应依字母次序编制所有候选人的名单，并将名单提交所有缔约国。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall compile a list of all candidates in alphabetical order and submit the list to all States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会委员的选举应由秘书长在联合国总部召开缔约国会议举行。
Translation: The election of the members of the committee shall be held at a meeting of the States Parties convened by the Secretary-General at the United Nations Headquarters.

Query_Text_cn: 在该次会议上，缔约国的三分之二应构成法定人数，获得出席并参加表决的缔约国代表三分之二多数票的候选人应当选为委员会委员。
Translation: At the meeting, a quorum shall consist of two-thirds of the States Parties. Candidates who receive a two-thirds majority of the votes cast by the representatives of the States Parties present and voting shall be elected as members of the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 从每一地理区域应至少选出三名委员。
Translation: At least three members should be selected from each geographical region.

Query_Text_cn: 连选可连任。
Translation: Re-election is permitted for consecutive terms.

Query_Text_cn: 5.提出委员会委员候选人的缔约国应承担该委员在执行委员会职务期间的费用。
Translation: The State Party nominating a candidate for the committee shall bear the expenses incurred by that member in the performance of committee duties.

Query_Text_cn: 有关沿海国应承担为提供本附件第三条第1款(b)项所指的咨询意见而引起的费用。
Translation: Regarding the costs incurred by the coastal State in providing the advisory opinions referred to in Article 3, paragraph 1(b) of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会秘书处应由联合国秘书长提供。
Translation: The Secretariat of the Committee shall be provided by the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: (b)经有关沿海国请求，在编制(a)项所述资料时，提供科学和技术咨询意见。
Translation: (b) Upon the request of the relevant coastal State, provide scientific and technical advisory opinions in the preparation of the materials referred to in item (a).

Query_Text_cn: 2.委员会可在认为必要和有用的范围内与联合国教科文组织的政府间海洋学委员会、国际水文学组织及其他主管国际组织合作，以求交换可能有助于委员会执行职务的科学和技术情报。
Translation: 2. The Committee may, to the extent it deems necessary and useful, cooperate with the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO, the International Hydrological Organization, and other competent international organizations, in order to exchange scientific and technical information that may assist the Committee in carrying out its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 拟按照第七十六条划定其二百海里以外大陆架外部界限的沿海国，应将这种界限的详情连同支持这种界限的科学和技术资料，尽早提交委员会，而且无论如何应于本公约对该国生效后十年内提出。
Translation: A coastal State intending to establish the outer limits of its continental shelf beyond 200 nautical miles in accordance with Article 76 shall submit the particulars of such limits, along with supporting scientific and technical data, to the Commission as soon as possible, and in any case, within ten years of the entry into force of this Convention for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 沿海国应同时提出曾向其提供科学和技术咨询意见的委员会内任何委员的姓名。
Translation: The coastal State shall also provide the names of any members of the commission who have previously provided it with scientific and technical advice.

Query_Text_cn: 除委员会另有决定外，委员会应由七名委员组成的小组委员会执行职务，小组委员会委员应以平衡方式予以任命，同时考虑到沿海国提出的每一划界案的具体因素。
Translation: Unless otherwise decided by the Commission, the Commission shall perform its functions through sub-commissions composed of seven members. The members of each sub-commission shall be appointed in a balanced manner, taking into account the specific circumstances of each submission made by the coastal State.

Query_Text_cn: 为已提出划界案的沿海国国民的委员会委员，或曾提供关于划界的科学和技术咨询意见以协助该国的委员会委员，不得成为处理该案的小组委员会委员，但应有权以委员身分参与委员会处理该案的程序。
Translation: A member of the Commission who is a national of a coastal State that has submitted a delimitation proposal, or who has provided scientific and technical advice regarding the delimitation to assist that State's member of the Commission, shall not serve as a member of the sub-commission handling the case, but shall have the right to participate in the Commission's proceedings on the case in their capacity as a member.

Query_Text_cn: 向委员会提出划界案的沿海国可派代表参与有关的程序，但无表决权。
Translation: A coastal State submitting a delimitation proposal to the Commission may send representatives to participate in the relevant proceedings, but without the right to vote.

Query_Text_cn: 1.小组委员会应将其建议提交委员会。
Translation: The subcommittee shall submit its recommendations to the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 2.小组委员会的建议应由委员会以出席并参加表决的委员三分之二多数核准。
Translation: 2. Recommendations of the subcommittee shall be approved by a two-thirds majority of the committee members present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会的建议应以书面递交提出划界案的沿海国和联合国秘书长。
Translation: 3. The Committee's recommendations shall be submitted in writing to the coastal State that has presented the delimitation proposal and to the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 沿海国应依第七十六条第8款的规定并按照适当国家程序划定大陆架的外部界限。
Translation: Coastal States shall establish the outer limits of the continental shelf in accordance with paragraph 8 of Article 76 and in accordance with appropriate national procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 在沿海国不同意委员会建议的情形下，沿海国应于合理期间内向委员会提出订正的或新的划界案。
Translation: If the coastal State does not agree with the Commission's recommendations, it shall submit a revised or new delimitation proposal to the Commission within a reasonable period of time.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会的行动不应妨害海岸相向或相邻国家间划定界限的事项。
Translation: The actions of the Commission shall not prejudice matters relating to the delimitation of boundaries between States with opposite or adjacent coasts.

Query_Text_cn: 矿物按照本公约回收时，其所有权即转移。
Translation: The ownership of minerals shall be transferred upon their recovery in accordance with this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 1.(a)管理局应鼓励在“区域”内探矿。
Translation: 1.(a)The Authority shall encourage exploration within the "Area".

Query_Text_cn: (b)探矿只有在管理局收到一项令人满意的书面承诺以后才可进行，申请探矿者应在其中承诺遵守本公约和管理局关于在第一四三和第一四四条所指的训练方案方面进行合作以及保护海洋环境的规则、规章和程序，并接受管理局对其是否加以遵守进行查核。
Translation: (b) Prospecting may only be conducted after the Authority has received a satisfactory written undertaking from the applicant, in which the applicant commits to comply with this Convention and the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority regarding cooperation in training programs referred to in Articles 143 and 144, as well as the protection of the marine environment, and accepts the Authority’s verification of such compliance.

Query_Text_cn: 申请探矿者在提出承诺的同时，应将准备进行探矿的一个或多个区域的大约面积通知管理局。
Translation: When submitting their commitment, applicants for exploration should also notify the administration of the approximate area of one or more regions where they intend to conduct exploration.

Query_Text_cn: (c)一个以上的探矿者可在同一个或几个区域内同时进行探矿。
Translation: (c) More than one prospector may conduct exploration simultaneously in the same area or in several areas.

Query_Text_cn: 2.探矿不应使探矿者取得对资源的任何权利。
Translation: 2. Exploration should not grant explorers any rights to the resources.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，探矿者可回收合理数量的矿物供试验之用。
Translation: However, prospectors may recover a reasonable quantity of minerals for testing purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 1.企业部、缔约国和第一五三条第2款(b)项所指的其他实体，可向管理局申请核准其关于“区域”内活动的工作计划。
Translation: 1. Enterprises, States Parties, and other entities referred to in Article 153, paragraph 2(b), may apply to the Authority for approval of their plans of work for activities in the "Area."

Query_Text_cn: 2.企业部可对“区域”的任何部分提出申请，但其他方面对保留区域的申请，应受本附件第九条各项附加条件的限制。
Translation: 2. The Enterprise Department may submit applications for any part of the "region," but applications for reserved areas by other parties shall be subject to the additional conditions set forth in Article 9 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 3.勘探和开发应只在第一五三条第3款所指的，并经管理局按照本公约以及管理局的有关规则、规章和程序核准的工作计划中所列明的区域内进行。
Translation: 3. Exploration and development shall only be conducted within the areas specified in the approved work plans referred to in paragraph 3 of Article 153 and approved by the Authority in accordance with this Convention and the relevant rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: (c)按照管理局的规则、规章和程序，授予经营者在工作计划所包括的区域内勘探和开发指明类别的资源的专属权利。
Translation: (c) Grant the operator exclusive rights to explore and develop specified categories of resources within the areas covered by the work plan, in accordance with the Authority's rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 如果申请者申请核准只包括勘探阶段和开发阶段的工作计划，核准的工作计划应只就该阶段给予这种专属权利。
Translation: If the applicant's application for approval includes only the work plan for the exploration stage and the development stage, the approved work plan shall grant such exclusive rights only for that stage.

Query_Text_cn: 5.经管理局核准后，每项工作计划，除企业部提出者外，应采取由管理局和一个或几个申请者订立合同的形式。
Translation: 5. After approval by the Administration Bureau, each work plan, except those proposed by the Enterprise Department, shall be implemented in the form of a contract concluded between the Administration Bureau and one or several applicants.

Query_Text_cn: 1.企业部以外的申请者如具备第一五三条第2款(b)项所指明的国籍或控制和担保，且如遵守管理局规则、规章和程序所载列的程序并符合其中规定的资格标准，即应取得资格。
Translation: Applicants other than corporate entities who possess the nationality or control and guarantee specified in Article 153, Paragraph 2(b), and who comply with the procedures set forth in the Authority's rules, regulations, and procedures and meet the eligibility criteria therein, shall be qualified.

Query_Text_cn: 2.除第6款所规定者外，上述资格标准应包括申请者的财政和技术能力及其履行以前同管理局订立的任何合同的情形。
Translation: 2. Except as provided in paragraph 6, the above qualification criteria shall include the applicant's financial and technical capabilities, as well as their performance under any previous contracts entered into with the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 3.每一申请者应由其国籍所属的缔约国担保，除非申请者具有一个以上的国籍，例如几个国家的实体组成的合伙团体或财团，在这种情形下，所有涉及的缔约国都应担保申请；或者除非申请者是由另一个缔约国或其国民有效控制，在这种情形下，两个缔约国都应担保申请。
Translation: 3. Each applicant shall be sponsored by the Contracting State of which he is a national, unless the applicant possesses more than one nationality, such as in the case of a partnership or consortium composed of entities from several countries, in which case all the Contracting States concerned shall sponsor the application; or unless the applicant is effectively controlled by another Contracting State or its nationals, in which case both Contracting States shall sponsor the application.

Query_Text_cn: 实施担保规定的标准和程序应载入管理局的规则、规章和程序。
Translation: The standards and procedures for implementing guarantee provisions should be incorporated into the rules, regulations, and procedures of the authority.

Query_Text_cn: 4.担保国应按照第一三九条，负责在其法律制度范围内，确保所担保的承包者应依据合同条款及其在本公约下的义务进行“区域”内活动。
Translation: 4. The guaranteeing State shall, in accordance with Article 139, be responsible within its legal system for ensuring that the contractor it guarantees conducts activities within the "area" in accordance with the terms of the contract and its obligations under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但如该担保国已制定法律和规章并采取行政措施，而这些法律和规章及行政措施在其法律制度范围内可以合理地认为足以使在其管辖下的人遵守时，则该国对其所担保的承包者因不履行义务而造成的损害，应无赔偿责任。
Translation: However, if the guarantor country has enacted laws and regulations and taken administrative measures that can reasonably be considered, within its legal system, sufficient to ensure compliance by persons under its jurisdiction, then the country shall not be liable for compensation for damages caused by the contractor it guarantees due to non-performance of obligations.

Query_Text_cn: 5.缔约国为申请者时，审查其资格的程序，应顾及申请者是国家的特性。
Translation: 5. When a Contracting Party is an applicant, the procedure for examining its qualifications shall take into account the fact that the applicant is a State.

Query_Text_cn: (d)遵守本附件第五条所载有关技术转让的规定。
Translation: (d) Comply with the provisions on technology transfer set forth in Article 5 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 1.每一申请者在提出工作计划时，应向管理局提交关于进行“区域”内活动所使用的装备和方法的一般性说明，以及关于这种技术的特征的其他非专有的有关情报和可以从何处取得这种技术的情报。
Translation: Each applicant, when submitting a work plan, shall provide the Authority with a general description of the equipment and methods to be used for activities within the "area," as well as other non-proprietary information regarding the characteristics of such technology and information on where such technology can be obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 2.经营者每当作出重大的技术改变或革新时，均应将对依据第1款提出的说明和情报所作的修改通知管理局。
Translation: 2. Whenever an operator makes significant technological changes or innovations, they shall notify the authority of any modifications made to the statements and information submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: (a)经管理局一旦提出要求，即以公平合理的商业条款和条件向企业部提供他根据合同进行“区域”内活动时所使用而且该承包者在法律上有权转让的技术。
Translation: (a)Upon request by the Authority, the Contractor shall provide to the Enterprise, on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions, the technology used by the Contractor in carrying out activities within the "Area" under the Contract, provided that the Contractor is legally entitled to transfer such technology.

Query_Text_cn: 这应以承包者与企业部商定并在补充合同的特别协议中订明的特许方式或其他适当安排来履行。
Translation: This shall be carried out in accordance with the concession method or other appropriate arrangements as agreed upon between the Contractor and the Enterprise Department and specified in the special provisions of the supplementary contract.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对于根据合同进行“区域”内活动所使用，但通常不能在公开市场上获得，而且为(a)项所不包括的任何技术，从技术所有人取得书面保证，经管理局一旦提出要求，技术所有人将以特许方式或其他适当安排，并以公平合理的商业条款和条件，在向承包者提供这种技术的同样程度上向企业部提供这种技术。
Translation: (b) For any technology used in activities within the "Area" under the contract that is not generally available on the open market and is not included in item (a), a written assurance shall be obtained from the technology owner that, upon request by the Authority, the technology owner will, by way of license or other appropriate arrangements and on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions, provide such technology to the Enterprise Department to the same extent as it is provided to the Contractor.

Query_Text_cn: (c)经企业部提出要求，而承包者又不致因此承担巨大费用时，对承包者根据合同进行“区域”内活动所使用而在法律上无权转让，并且通常不能在公开市场上获得的任何技术，通过一项可以执行的合同，从技术所有人取得转让给企业部的法律权利。
Translation: (c) Upon request by the Enterprise Department, and provided that the contractor does not incur substantial costs as a result, the contractor shall, through an enforceable contract, obtain from the owner of any technology—used by the contractor in activities within the "region" under the contract, which cannot be legally transferred and is generally unavailable on the open market—the legal right to transfer such technology to the Enterprise Department.

Query_Text_cn: 在承包者与技术所有人之间具有实质性公司关系的情形下，应参酌这种关系的密切程度和控制或影响的程度来判断是否已采取一切可行的措施。
Translation: In cases where there is a substantive corporate relationship between the contractor and the technology owner, the determination of whether all feasible measures have been taken should be based on the closeness of this relationship and the degree of control or influence.

Query_Text_cn: (e)为了按照本附件第九条申请合同的发展中国家或发展中国家集团的利益，采取(a)、(b)、(c)和(d)项所规定的相同措施，但此项措施应以对承包者所提出的按照本附件第八条已予保留的一部分区域的开发为限，而且该发展中国家或发展中国家集团所申请的根据合同进行的活动须不涉及对第三国或第三国国民的技术转让。
Translation: (e) In order to claim the benefits for developing countries or groups of developing countries under Article 9 of this Annex, the same measures as specified in subparagraphs (a), (b), (c), and (d) may be taken. However, such measures shall be limited to the development of those parts of the area that have been reserved pursuant to Article 8 of this Annex as proposed by the contractor, and the activities applied for by the developing country or group of developing countries under the contract shall not involve the transfer of technology to any third country or nationals of any third country.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本项的义务应只在尚未经企业部要求提供技术或尚未由特定承包者向企业部转让的情形下，才对该承包者适用。
Translation: The obligations under this section shall apply to the contractor only in cases where the technology has not yet been requested by the Enterprise Department or has not yet been transferred to the Enterprise Department by the specific contractor.

Query_Text_cn: 4.关于第3款所要求的承诺的争端，象合同其他规定一样，均应按照第十一部分提交强制解决程序，遇有违反这种承诺的情形，则可按照本附件第十八条命令暂停或终止合同或课以罚款。
Translation: 4. Disputes regarding the commitments required under Paragraph 3 shall, like other provisions of the contract, be submitted to the mandatory resolution procedures set forth in Part Eleven. In the event of a breach of such commitments, suspension or termination of the contract or the imposition of fines may be ordered in accordance with Article 18 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 关于承包者所作提议是否在公平合理的商业条款和条件的范围内的争端，可由任何一方按照联合国国际贸易法委员会的仲裁规则或管理局的规则、规章和程序可能有所规定的其他仲裁规则，提交有拘束力的商业仲裁。
Translation: Any dispute regarding whether the Contractor's proposal falls within the scope of fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions may be submitted by either party to binding commercial arbitration in accordance with the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules or any other arbitration rules that may be stipulated by the Authority's rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 如果裁决认为承包者所作提议不在公平合理的商业条款和条件的范围以内，则在管理局按照本附件第十八条采取任何行动以前，应给予承包者四十五天的时间以修改其提议，使其合乎上述范围。
Translation: If the ruling determines that the contractor's proposal does not fall within the scope of fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions, the contractor shall be granted forty-five days to amend its proposal to comply with the aforementioned scope before the Authority takes any action pursuant to Article 18 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如果企业部未能以公平合理的商业条款和条件取得适当的技术，使其能及时开始回收和加工“区域”的矿物，理事会或大会可召集由从事“区域”内活动的缔约国、担保实体从事“区域”内活动的缔约国、以及可以取得这种技术的其他缔约国组成的一个集团。
Translation: 5. If the Enterprise fails to obtain appropriate technology on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions, enabling it to commence the timely recovery and processing of minerals from the "Area," the Council or the Assembly may convene a group composed of States Parties engaged in activities in the "Area," States Parties whose sponsored entities are engaged in activities in the "Area," and other States Parties capable of providing such technology.

Query_Text_cn: 这个集团应共同协商，并应采取有效措施，以保证这种技术以公平合理的商业条款和条件向企业部提供。
Translation: The group shall consult jointly and take effective measures to ensure that such technology is made available to the Ministry of Enterprises on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个这种缔约国都应在其自己的法律制度范围内，为此目的采取一切可行的措施。
Translation: Each such State Party shall, within the scope of its own legal system, take all feasible measures for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 6.在同企业部进行联合企业的情形下，技术转让将按照联合企业协议的条款进行。
Translation: 6. In the case of forming a joint venture with the relevant enterprise department, technology transfer shall be carried out in accordance with the terms of the joint venture agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 7.第3款所要求的承诺应列入进行“区域”内活动的每一个合同，至企业部开始商业生产后十年为止，在这段期间内可援引这些承诺。
Translation: The commitments required under paragraph 3 shall be incorporated into every contract for activities conducted within the "region" and shall remain enforceable for ten years after the commencement of commercial production by the enterprise.

Query_Text_cn: 8.为本条的目的，“技术”是指专用设备和技术知识，包括为装配、维护和操作一个可行的系统所必要的手册、设计、操作指示、训练及技术咨询和支援，以及在非专属性的基础上为该目的使用以上各个项目的法律权利。
Translation: 8. For the purposes of this Article, "technology" refers to specialized equipment and technical know-how, including manuals, designs, operating instructions, training, and technical consultation and support necessary for the assembly, maintenance, and operation of a functional system, as well as the legal rights to use any of the above items for such purposes on a non-exclusive basis.

Query_Text_cn: 1.管理局应于本公约生效后六个月，以及其后每逢第四个月，对提议的工作计划进行审查。
Translation: The Authority shall review the proposed work plan six months after the entry into force of this Convention and every four months thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: (a)申请者是否遵守按照本附件第四条规定的申请程序，并已向管理局提供该条所规定的任何这种承诺和保证。
Translation: (a) Whether the applicant has complied with the application procedures stipulated in Article 4 of this Annex and has provided the Authority with any undertakings and guarantees as required by that Article.

Query_Text_cn: (b)申请者是否具备本附件第四条所规定的必要资格。
Translation: (b) Whether the applicant possesses the necessary qualifications stipulated in Article 4 of this annex.

Query_Text_cn: 3.所有提议的工作计划，应按其收到的顺序予以处理。
Translation: All proposed work plans should be processed in the order in which they are received.

Query_Text_cn: 提议的工作计划应符合并遵守本公约的有关条款以及管理局各项规则、规章和程序，其中包括关于作业条件、财政贡献和有关技术转让承诺的那些规则、规章和程序。
Translation: The proposed work plan shall conform to and comply with the relevant provisions of this Convention, as well as the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority, including those relating to operational conditions, financial contributions, and commitments concerning technology transfer.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵在非保留区域进行勘探和开发多金属结核的工作计划，而这些区域合并计算构成海底区域中未予保留或未依据第一六二条第2款(X)项不准开发的部分的总面积的百分之二。
Translation: (2) The work plan for the exploration and development of polymetallic nodules in non-reserved areas, and these areas, when combined, shall constitute two percent of the total area of the seabed that has not been reserved or prohibited from development pursuant to Article 162, paragraph 2(x).

Query_Text_cn: 4.为了第3款(c)项所指标准的目的，一个合伙团体或财团所提议的工作计划应在按照本附件第四条第3款规定提出担保的各缔约国间按比例计算。
Translation: 4. For the purposes of the criteria referred to in paragraph 3(c), the proposed work program of a consortium or syndicate shall be calculated proportionally among the Contracting Parties providing guarantees in accordance with paragraph 3 of Article 4 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 如果管理局确定第3款(c)项所述工作计划的核准不致使一个缔约国或由其担保的实体垄断“区域”内活动的进行，或者排除其他缔约国进行“区域”内活动，管理局可核准这种计划。
Translation: If the Authority determines that the approval of a work plan referred to in paragraph 3(c) would not result in a monopoly by any Contracting Party or entity sponsored by it over activities in the "Area," nor preclude other Contracting Parties from carrying out activities in the "Area," the Authority may approve such a plan.

Query_Text_cn: 5.虽有第3款(a)项，在第一五一条第3款所规定的过渡期间结束后，管理局可以通过规则、规章和程序制订其他符合本公约规定的程序和准则，以便在须对提议区域的申请者作出选择的情形下，决定哪些工作计划应予核准。
Translation: 5. Notwithstanding subparagraph (a) of paragraph 3, after the expiration of the transitional period specified in paragraph 3 of Article 151, the Authority may, through rules, regulations, and procedures, establish other procedures and criteria consistent with the provisions of this Convention to determine, in cases where a choice must be made among applicants for proposed areas, which work plans should be approved.

Query_Text_cn: 这些程序和准则应确保在公平和无歧视的基础上核准工作计划。
Translation: These procedures and guidelines should ensure that work plans are approved on a fair and non-discriminatory basis.

Query_Text_cn: 如果核准所有这些申请不会超出第一五一条规定的生产限制或违背管理局按照该条参与的商品协定或安排下的义务，则管理局应发给所申请的许可。
Translation: If the approval of all these applications would not exceed the production limits stipulated in Article 151 or violate the obligations of the Authority under any commodity agreement or arrangement in which it participates pursuant to that Article, the Authority shall issue the requested licenses.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果由于第一五一条第2至7款所规定的生产限制，或由于管理局按照第一五一条第1款的规定参与的商品协定或安排下的义务而必须在生产许可的申请者中作出选择时，管理局应以其规则、规章和程序中所订客观而无歧视的标准进行选择。
Translation: 2. If, due to the production restrictions stipulated in paragraphs 2 to 7 of Article 151, or due to obligations under commodity agreements or arrangements in which the Authority participates pursuant to paragraph 1 of Article 151, it becomes necessary to select among applicants for production permits, the Authority shall make such selections based on objective and non-discriminatory criteria established in its rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: (c)在探矿和勘探方面已投入最多资源和尽最大努力者。
Translation: (c) The party that has invested the most resources and made the greatest efforts in exploration and prospecting.

Query_Text_cn: 4.未在任何期间内被选定的申请者，在随后各段期间应有优先，直到其取得生产许可为止。
Translation: 4. Applicants who have not been selected during any period shall be given priority in subsequent periods until they obtain a production license.

Query_Text_cn: 5.申请者的选择应考虑到有必要使所有缔约国，不论其社会经济制度或地理位置如何，都有更多的机会参加“区域”内活动，以避免对任何国家或制度有所歧视，并防止垄断这种活动。
Translation: 5. The selection of applicants should take into account the necessity of providing all contracting parties, regardless of their socioeconomic systems or geographical locations, with greater opportunities to participate in activities within the "region," so as to avoid discrimination against any country or system and to prevent monopolization of such activities.

Query_Text_cn: 6.当开发的保留区域少于非保留区域时，对保留区域生产许可的申请应有优先。
Translation: 6. When the reserved area is smaller than the non-reserved area, applications for production permits in the reserved area shall be given priority.

Query_Text_cn: 7.本条所述的各项决定，应于每一段期间结束后尽快作出。
Translation: Decisions referred to in this Article shall be made as soon as possible after the end of each period.

Query_Text_cn: 每项申请，除了企业部或任何其他实体就保留区域所提出者外，应包括一个总区域，它不一定是一个单一连续的区域，但须足够大并有足够的估计商业价值，可供从事两起采矿作业。
Translation: Each application, except those submitted by the Enterprise or any other entity for reserved areas, shall include a total area, which need not be a single continuous area but must be sufficiently large and of sufficient estimated commercial value to support at least two mining operations.

Query_Text_cn: 申请者应指明座标，将区域分成估计商业价值相等的两个部分，并且提交他所取得的关于这两个部分的所有资料。
Translation: Applicants should specify the coordinates, divide the area into two parts of approximately equal commercial value, and submit all information obtained regarding these two parts.

Query_Text_cn: 在不妨害本附件第十七条所规定管理局的权力的情形下，提交的有关多金属结核的资料应涉及制图、试验、结核的丰度及其金属含量。
Translation: Without prejudice to the authority of the Authority as stipulated in Article 17 of this Annex, the submitted data concerning polymetallic nodules shall cover mapping, testing, nodule abundance, and their metal content.

Query_Text_cn: 在收到这些资料后的四十五天以内，管理局应指定哪一个部分专保留给管理局通过企业部或以与发展中国家协作的方式进行活动。
Translation: Within forty-five days after receiving these materials, the Authority shall designate which portion is reserved exclusively for activities conducted by the Authority through the Enterprise or in cooperation with developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 如果管理局请一名独立专家来评断本条所要求的一切资料是否都已提交管理局，则作出这种指定的期间可以再延四十五天。
Translation: If the authority appoints an independent expert to assess whether all the information required under this article has been submitted to the authority, the period for making such an appointment may be extended by an additional forty-five days.

Query_Text_cn: 一旦非保留区域的工作计划获得核准并经签订合同，指定的区域即应成为保留区域。
Translation: Once the work plan for a non-reserved area is approved and a contract is signed, the designated area shall become a reserved area.

Query_Text_cn: 1.对每一个保留区域企业部应有机会决定是否有意在其内进行“区域”内活动。
Translation: 1. Each business unit in every reserved area should have the opportunity to decide whether it intends to carry out activities within the "region."

Query_Text_cn: 这项决定可在任何时间作出，除非管理局接到按照第4款发出的通知。在这种情形下，企业部应在合理时间内作出决定。
Translation: This decision may be made at any time unless the Authority receives a notice issued in accordance with paragraph 4. In such cases, the Department of Enterprise shall make a decision within a reasonable period.

Query_Text_cn: 企业部可决定同有兴趣的国家或实体成立联合企业来开发这种区域。
Translation: The Enterprise Department may decide to establish joint ventures with interested countries or entities to develop such areas.

Query_Text_cn: 2.企业部可按照附件四第十二条订立关于执行其部分活动的合同，并可同任何按照第一五三条第2款(b)项有资格进行“区域”内活动的实体为进行这种活动成立联合企业。
Translation: 2. The Enterprise may, in accordance with Article 12 of Annex IV, enter into contracts for the execution of certain of its activities, and may establish joint ventures with any entity qualified under Article 153, paragraph 2(b), to carry out activities within the "Area."

Query_Text_cn: 企业部在考虑成立这种联合企业时，应提供发展中国家缔约国及其国民有效参加的机会。
Translation: When considering the establishment of such joint ventures, the enterprise shall provide effective opportunities for the participation of developing country Parties and their nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 3.管理局可在其规则、规章和程序内规定这种合同和联合企业的实质性和程序性要求和条件。
Translation: 3. The Authority may stipulate substantive and procedural requirements and conditions for such contracts and joint ventures within its rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 4.任何发展中国家缔约国，或该国所担保并受该国或受具有申请资格的另一发展中国家缔约国有效控制的任何自然人或法人，或上述各类的任何组合，可通知管理局愿意按照本附件第六条就某一保留区域提出工作计划。
Translation: 4. Any developing country State Party, or any natural or juridical person sponsored by and effectively controlled by such State or by another developing country State Party eligible to apply, or any combination of the foregoing, may notify the Authority of its willingness to submit a plan of work for a reserved area in accordance with Article 6 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 如果企业部按照第1款决定无意在该区域内进行活动，则应对该工作计划给予考虑。
Translation: If the enterprise department decides, in accordance with Paragraph 1, that it does not intend to carry out activities in the area, it shall give due consideration to the work plan.

Query_Text_cn: 按本附件第三条第4款(c)项的规定取得核准只进行勘探的工作计划的经营者，就同一区域和资源在各申请者中应有取得开发工作计划的优惠和优先。
Translation: An operator who has obtained approval for an exploration work plan in accordance with Article 3, Paragraph 4(c) of this Annex shall, among all applicants, have preferential and priority rights to obtain approval for a development work plan for the same area and resources.

Query_Text_cn: 但如经营者的工作成绩不令人满意时，这种优惠或优先可予撤销。
Translation: However, if the performance of the operator is unsatisfactory, such preferential treatment or priority may be revoked.

Query_Text_cn: 1.合同可规定承包者同由企业部代表的管理局之间采用联合企业或分享产品的形式，或任何其他形式的联合安排，这些联合安排在修改、终止、暂停方面享有与管理局订立的合同相同的保障。
Translation: 1. The contract may stipulate that the contractor and the management bureau, represented by the enterprise department, adopt joint ventures, product sharing arrangements, or any other form of joint arrangement. These joint arrangements shall enjoy the same protections regarding modification, termination, and suspension as contracts entered into with the management bureau.

Query_Text_cn: 2.与企业部成立这种联合安排的承包者，可取得本附件第十三条中规定的财政鼓励。
Translation: 2. Contractors who establish such joint arrangements with the Enterprise Department may be eligible for the financial incentives specified in Article 13 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 3.同企业部组成的联合企业的合伙者，应按照其在联合企业中的份额负责缴付本附件第十三条所规定的款项，但须受该条规定的财政鼓励的限制。
Translation: 3. Partners in joint ventures formed with the Enterprise Department shall be responsible for paying the amounts specified in Article 13 of this Annex in proportion to their shares in the joint venture, but subject to the limitations of the financial incentives provided in that Article.

Query_Text_cn: 1.企业部依据第一五三条第2款(a)项进行的“区域”内活动，应遵守第十一部分，管理局的规则、规章和程序及其有关的决定。
Translation: 1. Activities conducted by the Enterprise under Article 153, paragraph 2(a), within the "Area" shall be subject to Part XI, the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority, and its relevant decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.企业部提出的任何工作计划应随附证明其财政及技术能力的证据。
Translation: Any work plan proposed by the Enterprise Department shall be accompanied by evidence demonstrating its financial and technical capabilities.

Query_Text_cn: (f)保证不致因依据第14款，按照本附件第十九条予以审查的合同条款或有关联合企业的本附件第十一条的规定向承包者提供财政鼓励，造成津贴承包者使其比陆上采矿者处于人为的竞争优势的结果。
Translation: (f) Ensure that, as a result of providing financial incentives to the contractor pursuant to Article 19 of this Annex for contract terms subject to review under paragraph 14, or pursuant to the provisions of Article 11 of this Annex regarding joint ventures, no subsidy is granted to the contractor that would place it at an artificial competitive advantage over onshore miners.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为支付处理关于核准合同形式的勘探和开发工作计划的申请的行政开支，应征收规费，并应规定每份申请的规费为五十万美元。
Translation: 2. To cover the administrative expenses for processing applications regarding the approval of exploration and development work plans in contract form, a fee shall be levied, and the fee for each application shall be set at USD 500,000.

Query_Text_cn: 该规费应不时由理事会加以审查，以确保其足以支付处理这种申请的行政开支。
Translation: The fee shall be reviewed by the Council from time to time to ensure that it is sufficient to cover the administrative expenses incurred in processing such applications.

Query_Text_cn: 如果管理局处理申请的行政开支少于规费数额，管理局应将余额退还给申请者。
Translation: If the administrative expenses incurred by the Authority in processing the application are less than the amount of the prescribed fee, the Authority shall refund the balance to the applicant.

Query_Text_cn: 3.承包者应自合同生效之日起，缴纳固定年费一百万美元。
Translation: 3. The contractor shall pay a fixed annual fee of one million US dollars from the effective date of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: 如果因为按照第一五一条发出生产许可有所稽延而推迟经核准的商业生产的开始日期，则在这段推迟期间内应免缴固定年费。
Translation: If the commencement date of approved commercial production is delayed due to a postponement in the issuance of a production license pursuant to Article 151, the fixed annual fee shall be exempted during the period of such delay.

Query_Text_cn: 自商业生产开始之日起，承包者应缴付第4款所指的财政贡献或固定年费，以较大的数额为准。
Translation: From the commencement date of commercial production, the contractor shall pay the financial contribution or fixed annual fee referred to in Clause 4, whichever is greater.

Query_Text_cn: (b)同时缴付生产费和一份收益净额。
Translation: (b) Pay the production costs and a share of the net proceeds simultaneously.

Query_Text_cn: (b)上述市价应为按照第7和第8款的规定，在有关会计年度自合同包括的区域回收的多金属结核生产的加工金属数量和这些金属平均价格的乘积数。
Translation: (b) The aforementioned market price shall be the product of the quantity of processed metals produced from polymetallic nodules recovered within the contract area during the relevant accounting year, as stipulated in paragraphs 7 and 8, and the average prices of those metals.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在(d)项所规定的商业生产第二期的任何一个会计年度内，按百分之四缴付生产费的结果会使(m)项所规定的投资利得降低到百分之十五以下，则该会计年度的生产费应为百分之二而非百分之四。
Translation: If, in any fiscal year of the second phase of commercial production as stipulated in item (d), payment of production costs at the rate of 4% would result in the investment return specified in item (m) falling below 15%, then the production cost for that fiscal year shall be 2% instead of 4%.

Query_Text_cn: (b)上述市价应为按照第7和第8款的规定，在有关会计年度自合同包括的区域回收的多金属结核生产的加工金属数量和这些金属平均价格的乘积数。
Translation: (b) The above-mentioned market price shall be the product of the quantity of processed metals produced from polymetallic nodules recovered from the contract area during the relevant financial year, as stipulated in paragraphs 7 and 8, and the average prices of these metals.

Query_Text_cn: (c)⑴管理局在收益净额中的份额应自承包者因开采合同包括的区域资源所得到的那一部分收益净额中拨付，这笔款额以下称为开发合同区域收益净额。
Translation: (c)(1) The Authority's share of net proceeds shall be allocated from that portion of the net proceeds derived by the contractor from the exploitation of resources in the area covered by the contract, which amount shall hereinafter be referred to as the net proceeds from the contract area.

Query_Text_cn: 在承担发展费用的第一个会计年度，未收回的发展费用应等于发展费用减去该年的现金赢余。
Translation: In the first accounting year in which development expenses are incurred, the unrecovered development expenses should equal the development expenses minus the cash surplus for that year.

Query_Text_cn: 在以后的每一人会计年度，未收回的发展费用应等于前一会计年度未收回的发展费用加上发展费用以年利十分计算的利息，加上本会计年度所承担的发展费用，减去承包者本会计年度的现金赢余。
Translation: In each subsequent fiscal year, the unrecovered development costs should equal the unrecovered development costs from the previous fiscal year plus the interest calculated at an annual rate of ten percent on the development costs, plus the development costs incurred in the current fiscal year, minus the contractor's cash surplus for the current fiscal year.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵商业生产的第二期，应从商业生产的第一期终了后下一个会计年度开始，并应继续至合同结束时为止。
Translation: The second phase of commercial production shall commence at the beginning of the accounting year following the conclusion of the first phase of commercial production and shall continue until the termination of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: (e)“开发合同区域收益净额”是指承包者收益净额乘以在承包者发展费用中其采矿部门发展费用所占比率的乘积数。
Translation: (e) "Net proceeds from the development contract area" refers to the product of the contractor's net proceeds and the proportion of mining sector development expenses within the contractor's total development expenses.

Query_Text_cn: 如果承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核、主要生产三种加工金属，即钴、铜和镍，则开发合同区域收益净额不应少于承包者收益净额的百分之二十五。
Translation: If the contractor is engaged in the extraction and transportation of polymetallic nodules and primarily produces three processed metals—cobalt, copper, and nickel—the net proceeds from the contract area shall not be less than twenty-five percent of the contractor's net proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: 在(n)项规定的限制下，在所有其他情形，包括承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核、主要生产四种加工金属，即钴、铜、锰和镍的情形下，管理局可在其规则、规章和程序中规定适当的最低限额，这种限额与每一种情形的关系，应与百分之二十五的最低限额与三种金属和情形的关系相同。
Translation: Subject to the limitations set forth in (n), in all other cases—including situations where the contractor is engaged in the extraction or transportation of polymetallic nodules, or primarily produces the four processed metals, namely cobalt, copper, manganese, and nickel—the Authority may, in its rules, regulations, and procedures, establish appropriate minimum limits. The relationship between such limits and each specific case shall be the same as that between the 25 percent minimum limit and the three metals and cases.

Query_Text_cn: (f)“承包者收益净额”是指承包者收益毛额减去其业务费用再减去按照(j)项收回的发展费用。
Translation: (f) "Net contractor proceeds" refers to the gross contractor proceeds minus its operating expenses and further minus the development costs recovered in accordance with item (j).

Query_Text_cn: (g)⑴如果承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核、生产加工金属，则“承包者收益毛额”是指出售加工金属的收入毛额，以及按照管理局财务规则、规章和程序任何其他可以合理地归因于根据合同进行业务所得的款项。
Translation: (g)(1) If the contractor engages in the extraction, transportation of polymetallic nodules, or the production and processing of metals, "gross proceeds of the contractor" refers to the gross proceeds from the sale of processed metals, as well as any other amounts that can reasonably be attributed to operations conducted under the contract in accordance with the Authority's financial rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵除(g)项(l)目和(n)项⑶目所列举者外，在所有其他情形下，“承包者收益毛额”是指出售自合同包括的区域回收物的金属结核生产的半加工金属所得收入毛额，以及按照管理局财务规则、规章和程序任何其他可以合理地归因于根据合同进行业务所得的款项。
Translation: (2) Except for the cases listed in item (g), subparagraph (l), and subparagraph (3) of item (n), in all other circumstances, "contractor's gross proceeds" refers to the gross income derived from the sale of semi-processed metals produced from metal nodules recovered from the contract area, as well as any other amounts that can reasonably be attributed to operations conducted under the contract in accordance with the Authority's financial rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵在商业生产开始后，为执行工作计划而需要承担的与以上⑴目所载相类似的开支，但可计入业务费用的开支除外。
Translation: (2) After the commencement of commercial production, expenses similar to those listed in item (1) above that are incurred for the implementation of work plans, except for those expenses that can be accounted for as operating costs.

Query_Text_cn: (i)处理7资本资产所得的收益，以及合同所规定的业务不再需要而又未予出售的那些资本资产的市场价值，应从有关的会计年度的承包者发展费用中扣除。
Translation: (i) The income derived from the disposal of capital assets, as well as the market value of those capital assets specified in the contract but no longer required for the business and not sold, shall be deducted from the contractor's development expenses for the relevant accounting year.

Query_Text_cn: 这些扣除的数额超过承包者发展费用时，超过部分应计入承包者收益毛额。
Translation: When the deducted amounts exceed the contractor's development expenses, the excess portion shall be included in the contractor's gross income.

Query_Text_cn: (j)(h)项⑴目和(n)项⑷目所指的在商业生产开始之前承担的承包者发展费用，应从商业生产开始之日起，平均分为十期收回，每年一期。
Translation: The contractor's development costs incurred prior to the commencement of commercial production, as referred to in subparagraph (1) of item (j)(h) and subparagraph (4) of item (n), shall be recovered in ten equal installments starting from the date of commencement of commercial production, with one installment per year.

Query_Text_cn: (h)项⑵目和(n)项⑷目所指的在商业生产开始以后承担的承包者发展费用，应平均分为十期或不到十期收回，每年一期，以确保在合同结束前全部收回。
Translation: The contractor's development expenses incurred after the commencement of commercial production, as referred to in item (h)(2) and item (n)(4), shall be amortized over ten periods or fewer, with one period per year, to ensure full recovery before the termination of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: (k)“承包者业务费用”是指在商业生产开始后，为合同所规定的业务，而依照一般公认的会计原则所承担的经营合同包括的区域的生产能力及其有关活动的一切开支，其中除其他外包括：固定年费或生产费(以较大的数额为准)、工资、薪给、员工福利、材料、服务、运输、加工和销售费用、利息、公用事业费、保全海洋环境、具体与合同业务有关的间接费用和行政费用等项开支，以及其中规定的从其前或其后的年度转帐的任何业务亏损净额。
Translation: (k) "Contractor's business expenses" refer to all expenditures incurred for the operations specified in the contract within the area covered by the operating contract, after the commencement of commercial production, in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. These expenses include, among others: fixed annual fees or production fees (whichever is greater), wages, salaries, employee benefits, materials, services, transportation, processing and sales expenses, interest, utility fees, expenses for marine environmental protection, indirect costs and administrative expenses specifically related to the contract operations, as well as any net business losses stipulated to be transferred from previous or subsequent fiscal years.

Query_Text_cn: 业务亏损净额可以连续两年转入下一年度的帐目，但在合同的最后两年除外，这两年可转入其前两年的帐目。
Translation: The net operating loss can be carried forward to the following year's accounts for two consecutive years, except for the last two years of the contract, during which the loss may be carried back to the accounts of the preceding two years.

Query_Text_cn: (l)如果承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核并生产加工金属和半加工金属，则“采矿部门发展费用”是指依照一般公认的会计原则和管理局的财务规则、规章和程序，承包者发展费用中与开采合同包括的区域的资源直接有关的部分，其中除其他外包括：申请费、固定年费以及在可适用的情形下在合同包括的区域进行探矿和勘探的费用和一部分研究与发展费用。
Translation: (l) If the contractor is engaged in the extraction and transportation of polymetallic nodules and the production and processing of metals and semi-processed metals, "mining sector development costs" refers to the portion of the contractor's development costs that are directly related to the resources within the area covered by the mining contract, in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles and the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority. This includes, among other things, application fees, fixed annual fees, and, where applicable, the costs of exploration and prospecting within the contract area, as well as a portion of research and development expenses.

Query_Text_cn: (m)任何会计年度的“投资利得”是指该年度的开发合同区域收益净额与采矿部门发展费用的比率。
Translation: (m) "Investment gain" for any fiscal year refers to the ratio of the net revenue from the contract area during that year to the development expenses of the mining sector.

Query_Text_cn: 为计算这一比率的目的，采矿部门发展费用应包括采矿部门购买新装备或替换装备的开支减去被替换的装备的原价。
Translation: For the purpose of calculating this ratio, mining sector development expenditures should include the costs incurred by the mining sector for purchasing new equipment or replacing existing equipment, minus the original cost of the equipment being replaced.

Query_Text_cn: ⑴“开发合同区域收益净额”是指承包者的全部收益净额。
Translation: "Net revenue from the development contract area" refers to the total net revenue of the contractor.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵“承包者收益净额”的定义与(f)项相同。
Translation: The definition of "net proceeds to the contractor" is the same as in item (f).

Query_Text_cn: ⑶“承包者收益毛额”是指出售多金属结核的收入毛额，以及按照管理局财务规则、规章和程序任何其他可以合理地归因于根据合同进行业务所得的款项。
Translation: (3) "Contractor's gross proceeds" refers to the gross income from the sale of polymetallic nodules, as well as any other amounts that can reasonably be attributed to operations conducted under the contract in accordance with the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: ⑷“承包者发展费用”是指如(h)项⑴目所述在商业生产开始前所承担的以及如(h)项⑵目所述在商业生产开始后所承担的按照一般公认的会计原则与开采合同包括的区域资源直接有关的一切开支。
Translation: (4) "Contractor's development costs" refer to all expenditures directly related to the resources within the area covered by the mining contract, incurred in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, both prior to the commencement of commercial production as described in item (h)(1) and after the commencement of commercial production as described in item (h)(2).

Query_Text_cn: ⑸“承包者业务费用”是指如(k)项所述的按照一般公认的会计原则与开采合同包括的区域资源直接有关的承包者业务费用。
Translation: "Contractor's operating costs" refer to the contractor's operating expenses that are directly related to the resources within the contract area as specified in item (k), in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.

Query_Text_cn: ⑹任何会计年度的“投资利得”是指该年度的承包者收益净额与承包者发展费用的比率。
Translation: (6) "Investment gain" for any accounting year refers to the ratio of the contractor's net income to the contractor's development expenses for that year.

Query_Text_cn: 为计算这一比率的目的，承包者发展费用应包括购买新装备或替装备的开支减去被替换的装备的原价。
Translation: For the purpose of calculating this ratio, contractor development expenses should include the expenditure for purchasing new equipment or replacement equipment, minus the original cost of the equipment being replaced.

Query_Text_cn: (o)关于(h)、(k)(l)和(n)项所指的承包者所付的有关利息的费用，应在一切情形下，只有在管理局按照本附件第四条第1款，并顾及当时的商业惯例，认为债务资产净值比率和利率是合理的限度内，才容许列为费用。
Translation: The costs related to interest paid by the contractor as referred to in items (h), (k), (l), and (n) shall, in all cases, only be allowed as expenses if the Authority, in accordance with paragraph 1 of Article 4 of this Annex and taking into account prevailing commercial practices, considers that the debt-to-asset net value ratio and the interest rate are within reasonable limits.

Query_Text_cn: (p)本款所指费用不应解释为包括缴付国家对承包者业务所征收的公司所得税或类似课税的款项。
Translation: The expenses referred to in this paragraph shall not be construed as including payments of corporate income tax or similar taxes imposed by the state on the contractor's business.

Query_Text_cn: 7.(a)第5和第6款所指的“加工金属”是指国际中心市场上通常买卖的最基本形式的金属。
Translation: 7.(a) The term "processed metals" referred to in paragraphs 5 and 6 means metals in their most basic forms that are commonly bought and sold on international central markets.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，管理局应在财务规则、规章和程序中列明有关的国际中心市场。
Translation: To this end, the Authority shall specify the relevant international central markets in its financial rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: (b)如果管理局无法以其他方式确定第5款(b)项和第6款(b)项所指自合同包括在区域回收的多金属结核生产的加工金属的数量，此项数量应依照管理局的规则、规章和程序并按照一般公认的会计原则，根据结核的金属含量、加工回收效率和其他有关因素予以确定。
Translation: (b) If the Authority is unable to determine by other means the quantity of processed metals produced from polymetallic nodules recovered from the Area under a contract as referred to in paragraphs 5(b) and 6(b), such quantity shall be determined in accordance with the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority and in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, based on the metal content of the nodules, processing recovery efficiency, and other relevant factors.

Query_Text_cn: 8.如果一个国际中心市场为加工金属、多金属结核和产自这种结核的半加工金属提供一个有代表性的定价机构，即应使用这个市场的平均价格。
Translation: 8. If an international central market serves as a representative pricing institution for processed metals, polymetallic nodules, and semi-processed metals derived from such nodules, the average price of this market should be used.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有其他情形下，管理局应在同承包者协商后，按照第9款为上述产品定出一个公平的价格。
Translation: In all other cases, the Authority shall, after consultation with the contractor, determine a fair price for the aforementioned products in accordance with Clause 9.

Query_Text_cn: 9.(a)本条所指的一切费用、开支、收益和收入，以及对价格和价值的一切决定，均应为自由市场或正当交易的结果。
Translation: 9.(a) All expenses, costs, profits, and income referred to in this Article, as well as all determinations of price and value, shall be the result of a free market or bona fide transactions.

Query_Text_cn: (b)为了保证本款的规定得到遵守和执行，管理局应遵循联合国跨国公司委员会、发展中和发达国家间税务条约专家组以及其他国际组织对于正当交易所制定的原则和所作的解释，并应在其规则、规章和程序中，具体规定划一的和国际上接受的会计规则和程序，以及为了遵照这些规则、规章和程序查核帐目的目的，由承包者选择管理局认可的领有执照的独立会计师的方法。
Translation: (b) To ensure compliance with and enforcement of the provisions of this paragraph, the Authority shall follow the principles and interpretations established by the United Nations Commission on Transnational Corporations, the Group of Experts on Tax Treaties between Developing and Developed Countries, and other international organizations regarding fair transactions. The Authority shall specify in its rules, regulations, and procedures uniform and internationally accepted accounting rules and procedures, as well as methods for auditing accounts, whereby contractors may select licensed independent accountants approved by the Authority for the purpose of verifying compliance with these rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 10.承包者应按照管理局的财务规则、规章和程序，向会计师提供为决定本条是否得到遵守所必要的财务资料。
Translation: 10. The Contractor shall, in accordance with the Authority's financial rules, regulations, and procedures, provide the auditor with the financial information necessary to determine whether this Article has been complied with.

Query_Text_cn: 大约在十五年前，有一天我在友人古斯塔夫·哈隆教授的书房里，和他共同研读主要是道家思想的古书《管子》。这次，他建议很快翻过我们正在读的那一章的某些材料，因为其中似乎只包括一些关于动物的荒诞无稽的传说。可是我却仔细地研究了它。
Translation: About fifteen years ago, one day I was in the study of my friend, Professor Gustav Haloun, reading together the ancient text "Guanzi," which is primarily rooted in Daoist thought. On that occasion, he suggested that we quickly skim over certain passages in the chapter we were reading, as they seemed to contain nothing but absurd legends about animals. However, I studied them carefully.

Query_Text_cn: 结果发现，其中有一段文字谈到某些海洋动物受到月亮周期的影响，它们的大小随着月亮的盈亏而增大或缩小。
Translation: It was found that a passage discussed how certain marine animals are influenced by the lunar cycle, with their size increasing or decreasing according to the waxing and waning of the moon.

Query_Text_cn: 我大为惊奇，因为我记得亚里士多德曾说过完全相同的话。
Translation: I was greatly surprised, for I remembered that Aristotle had said exactly the same thing.

Query_Text_cn: 亚里士多德的叙述中所指的是海。我们现在已经证实了他的观察。
Translation: What Aristotle referred to in his account is the sea. We have now confirmed his observation.

Query_Text_cn: 后一种看法的可能性是难以令人信服的。
Translation: The likelihood of the latter view is difficult to find convincing.

Query_Text_cn: 还有一次，在我写这些段文字之前的几个星期，我参加了皇家医学会的一次会议，会上有另一位老朋友查尔斯·辛格博士谈到盖伦和古代解剖学的关系。
Translation: A few weeks before I wrote these paragraphs, I attended a meeting of the Royal Society of Medicine, where another old friend, Dr. Charles Singer, spoke about Galen and the relationship between ancient anatomy and him.

Query_Text_cn: 他强调说，盖伦本人从来没有解剖过人体，他的老师们也没有解剖过，可是亚历山大时代的人确实进行过解剖，这开始于公元前3世纪上半叶的希罗菲卢斯和埃拉西斯特拉图斯。
Translation: He emphasized that Galen himself had never dissected a human body, nor had his teachers, but people in the Alexandrian era did conduct dissections, beginning with Herophilus and Erasistratus in the first half of the third century BC.

Query_Text_cn: 早期菡督教的神父们大都把解剖当作一件骇人听闻的事情，他们自己从来不接触解剖。我感到这个事实是很奇特的，因为在中国也可以看到古代解剖学出现过类似的兴起和衰落。中国古代解剖学起源相当早，始于扁鹊，王莽时代（公元9年）已有进行解剖的确据，并持续到稍晚的三国时期（公元240年前后）。此后，也象在欧洲一样，解剖学便绝迹了，直到中世纪晚期才再度出现。
Translation: In the early days, most priests of the Han Du religion regarded dissection as something horrifying and never engaged in it themselves. I find this fact quite peculiar, as similar rises and declines in ancient anatomy can also be observed in China. Ancient Chinese anatomy originated rather early, beginning with Bian Que, and there is concrete evidence of dissections during the reign of Wang Mang (9 AD), which continued until the later Three Kingdoms period (around 240 AD). After that, as in Europe, anatomy disappeared entirely and did not reemerge until the late Middle Ages.

Query_Text_cn: 宋朝的解剖学者，大约比蒙迪诺·德·卢齐早一个世纪，可是没有发展下去。
Translation: Anatomists of the Song Dynasty emerged about a century earlier than Mondino de Luzzi, but their work did not continue to develop.

Query_Text_cn: 我举这些事例——还可以举出其他许多同样惊人的类似事例——目的是想指出，在讨论中国思想史和各门科学史之前，有必要谈谈在不同的历史时期内东亚和西欧之间思想传播的可靠性。
Translation: I cite these examples—and many other similarly astonishing cases could be mentioned—for the purpose of pointing out that, before discussing the history of Chinese thought and the histories of various sciences, it is necessary to first address the reliability of intellectual transmission between East Asia and Western Europe during different historical periods.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，作为必要的准备，简要地讨论一下诸如通过贸易路线和翻译人员可能产生相互影响的各种条件等整个问题，显然是适宜的。
Translation: Therefore, as a necessary preparation, it is clearly appropriate to briefly discuss the overall issue, including various conditions such as the possible mutual influences arising from trade routes and interpreters.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管有大量的文献讨论到中国和欧洲之间的交往（下面即将简要地概述这些文献），可是我们还是没有足够的事实来作出总结，而且愈是深入追溯历史细节，情形当然便变得愈加复杂。
Translation: Although there is a substantial body of literature discussing the interactions between China and Europe—which will be briefly reviewed below—we still lack sufficient factual evidence to draw definitive conclusions. Moreover, the deeper we delve into historical details, the more complex the situation inevitably becomes.

Query_Text_cn: 已经编写出来的文献中，有许多东西只不过是猜想而已。
Translation: Much of what has been written in the literature is merely conjecture.

Query_Text_cn: 在关于文字那一节中，我们提到过18世纪时的“体系”，当时人们根据早先的认识，了解到中国文字是象形性质的，因而认为中国人是“古代埃及人的移民”。
Translation: In the section on writing, we mentioned the "system" of the 18th century, when people, based on earlier understandings, believed that Chinese characters were pictographic in nature and thus concluded that the Chinese were "immigrants from ancient Egypt."

Query_Text_cn: 到19世纪，有些人在讨论中曾固执地坚持这一观点，可是现在象特里恩·德·拉库佩里或鲍尔的理论早已被驳倒了，因此主张中国文明主要是独立发展的人们，再也用不着与他们争辩了。
Translation: By the 19th century, some people still stubbornly adhered to this view in discussions. However, theories such as those of Terrien de Lacouperie or Bauer have long since been refuted. Therefore, those who advocate that Chinese civilization developed primarily independently no longer need to argue with them.

Query_Text_cn: 可是，认为在中国人的思想和实践中，有一大部分特殊的发展来源于西方，这种成见是很难消除的。
Translation: However, the prejudice that a significant portion of the unique development in Chinese thought and practice originates from the West is difficult to dispel.

Query_Text_cn: 让我们举几个例子。
Translation: Let us give a few examples.

Query_Text_cn: 马伯乐起先认为，《山海经》中所叙述的中国古代地理学是受到公元前5世纪外来（印度和伊朗）潮流的刺激，并且大部分中国天文学也是由于西方的启发。
Translation: Ma Boluo initially believed that the ancient Chinese geography described in the Classic of Mountains and Seas was stimulated by foreign influences (from India and Iran) in the 5th century BC, and that most Chinese astronomy was also inspired by the West.

Query_Text_cn: 他认为二十八宿、岁星纪年、圭表和漏壶是在大流士时代传入的；而在亚历山大时代的第二次潮流中，又传入了几何学、十二循环法、星表体系等等。
Translation: He believes that the twenty-eight lunar mansions, the Jupiter year-counting system, the gnomon and the water clock were introduced during the era of Darius; while in the second wave during the era of Alexander, geometry, the duodecimal cycle, the star catalog system, and so on were introduced.

Query_Text_cn: 我们将要看到，所有这些说法都是根据不足的，并且，马伯乐在他自己后来关于中国天文学的优秀专著中，也放弃了这些观点，不再谈交流和刺激的问题了。
Translation: As we will see, all these assertions are based on insufficient evidence, and Needham himself abandoned these views in his later excellent works on Chinese astronomy, no longer discussing issues of exchange or stimulation.

Query_Text_cn: 中国的“宿”和印度的“纳沙特拉”（意为月站）的关系，至今还是一个难题，人们尚无法决定其孰先孰后。
Translation: The relationship between China's "xiu" and India's "nakshatra" (meaning lunar mansion) remains a complex issue to this day, and it is still unclear which came first.

Query_Text_cn: 它们都可能来源于巴比伦。
Translation: They may all have originated from Babylon.

Query_Text_cn: 另有一些作者则任意地假设中国科学中的几乎每种有价值的东西都来自西方。例如，瓦卡曾不加思索地得出结论说，汉代的记里鼓车来自亚历山大里亚的赫伦（著称于公元60年）。可是在中国文献中最早提到记里鼓车，是和燕太子丹（公元前240—前226年）及韩延寿（公元前140—前70年之间）的名字连在一起的。
Translation: Some authors arbitrarily assume that almost everything of value in Chinese science originated from the West. For example, without much consideration, Waka concluded that the odometer cart of the Han dynasty came from Heron of Alexandria (renowned around 60 AD). However, the earliest mention of the odometer cart in Chinese literature is associated with the names of Prince Dan of Yan (240–226 BC) and Han Yanshou (between 140–70 BC).

Query_Text_cn: 汉代早期的这些记载并没有把记里鼓车当作很新鲜的事物；人们即使对当时所记述的记里鼓车究竟是什么车子还有点怀疑，那末，在汉代后期便有了关于记里鼓车的确切描述，这些记述出现得如此之快，以致很难认为它是从亚历山大里亚城传入的。瓦卡还认为，《周髀算经》中的几何学也来自西方，中国早期对∏值的计算也是从西方得到启发，而1300年朱世杰的二项式系数表则是从欧麦尔·海亚姆来的等等。
Translation: These early Han Dynasty records did not regard the Ji Li Drum Cart as a novel invention; even if people had some doubts about what exactly the Ji Li Drum Cart described at that time was, by the late Han Dynasty there were already precise descriptions of it. These accounts appeared so quickly that it is difficult to believe the technology was transmitted from Alexandria.
