Translation: TP53 protein was immunostained using the DO7 antibody (Novocastra Laboratories) at a dilution of 1:500, while MK167 protein (Ki-67) was immunostained using the MM-1 antibody (Novocastra Laboratories) at a dilution of 1:1000.

Query_Text_cn: 当肿瘤细胞核染色区域>20％时便认为MK167和TP53蛋白染色阳性。
Translation: When the stained area of the tumor cell nuclei is greater than 20%, MK167 and TP53 protein expression is considered positive.

Query_Text_cn: 简而言之，微矩阵切片脱蜡，在92℃的0.1M盐酸Tris液(pH，7.3)内孵育10分钟，然后室温冷却20分钟。
Translation: In brief, microarray slices are dewaxed and incubated in 0.1M Tris-HCl solution (pH 7.3) at 92°C for 10 minutes, followed by cooling at room temperature for 20 minutes.

Query_Text_cn: 在切片上加100L消化酶进行消化(Dogest-AllIII溶液，ZymedInc，SanFrancisco，Calif)。
Translation: Digest the slices with 100 µL of digestive enzyme (Dogest-All III solution, Zymed Inc, San Francisco, Calif).

Query_Text_cn: 脱水后，在切片上加入地高辛标记的ERBB2DNA探针(ZymedInc)。
Translation: After dehydration, add digoxigenin-labeled ERBB2 DNA probe (Zymed Inc.) to the sections.

Query_Text_cn: 切片在热平皿上进行变性，37℃杂交过夜。
Translation: The sections were denatured on a hot plate and hybridized overnight at 37°C.

Query_Text_cn: 用小鼠抗地高辛(1：300稀释；RocheBiochemicals，Mannheim，Germany)、抗小鼠过氧化物酶聚合体(ImmunovisionInc)和联苯二胺染色原进行依次孵育，以检测制备好的地高辛标记ERBB2探针。
Translation: The prepared digoxigenin-labeled ERBB2 probe was sequentially incubated with mouse anti-digoxigenin antibody (1:300 dilution; Roche Biochemicals, Mannheim, Germany), anti-mouse peroxidase polymer (Immunovision Inc), and diaminobenzidine chromogen for detection.

Query_Text_cn: 组织切片用苏木精轻微反向染色并包埋。
Translation: The tissue sections were lightly counterstained with hematoxylin and embedded.

Query_Text_cn: 每批杂交时均包括阳性和阴性对照标本(原位杂交荧光显色时肿瘤有无ERBB2扩增)。
Translation: Each batch of hybridization includes positive and negative control specimens (to determine the presence or absence of ERBB2 amplification in tumors during in situ hybridization with fluorescent detection).

Query_Text_cn: 采用40倍物镜对切片进行分析。
Translation: The slides were analyzed using a 40x objective lens.

Query_Text_cn: 当50％以上的肿瘤细胞细胞核有≥6个信号或当看到大量基因复制团块时便确定出现扩增。
Translation: Amplification is confirmed when more than 50% of tumor cell nuclei display six or more signals, or when numerous gene replication clusters are observed.

Query_Text_cn: 应用X2检验分析频率量表。
Translation: The frequency scale was analyzed using the Chi-square test.

Query_Text_cn: 按照Kaplan-Meier法计算寿命表。
Translation: Calculate the life table using the Kaplan-Meier method.

Query_Text_cn: 根据从诊断到其他区域出现转移的时间或从诊断到死于乳腺癌的时间计算远期无病生存时间。
Translation: Long-term disease-free survival time is calculated based on the interval from diagnosis to the occurrence of metastasis in other regions or from diagnosis to death from breast cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 用log-rank检验对时间一事件分布情况进行比较，我们预期它随时间的变化呈随机分布。
Translation: The log-rank test is used to compare the distribution of time-to-event data, and we expect it to be randomly distributed over time.

Query_Text_cn: 采用肿瘤检测法(乳腺X线筛查，0；其他方法，1)、肿瘤分级(分化良好，0；中度分化或分化不良，1)、雌孕激素受体情况(阳性或临界，0；阴性，1)、ERBB2蛋白免疫染色(阴性，0；阳性，1)、ERBB2扩增情况(无扩增，0；扩增，1)、组织学类型(小叶型或特殊类型，0；导管型，1)、确诊年龄(对年龄进行分组是为了阐述年龄引发的非线性患病危险)进行多变量生存分析。
Translation: Multivariate survival analysis was conducted using tumor detection method (mammography screening, 0; other methods, 1), tumor grade (well differentiated, 0; moderately or poorly differentiated, 1), estrogen and progesterone receptor status (positive or borderline, 0; negative, 1), ERBB2 protein immunostaining (negative, 0; positive, 1), ERBB2 amplification status (no amplification, 0; amplification, 1), histological type (lobular or special type, 0; ductal type, 1), and age at diagnosis (age was grouped to illustrate the nonlinear risk of disease associated with age).

Query_Text_cn: 肿瘤大小(cm)和腋窝淋巴结转移数目作为连续变量纳入多变量模型。
Translation: Tumor size (cm) and the number of axillary lymph node metastases were included in the multivariate model as continuous variables.

Query_Text_cn: 应用反向Cox逐级比例风险回归建立最终的多变量模型船，以P值等于0.05作为协变量入选标准。
Translation: The final multivariable model was established using backward stepwise Cox proportional hazards regression, with a p-value of 0.05 as the criterion for covariate inclusion.

Query_Text_cn: 所有P值均为双侧。
Translation: All P values are two-sided.

Query_Text_cn: 我们采用了Statview统计软件(5.0版，SASInstituteInc，Cary，NC)。
Translation: We used the Statview statistical software (version 5.0, SAS Institute Inc., Cary, NC).

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查出的乳腺癌最常见于50~59岁和60~69岁年龄组患者。
Translation: Breast cancers detected through mammographic screening are most commonly found in patients aged 50–59 and 60–69.

Query_Text_cn: 在50~69岁队列中，379名妇女(41％)经乳腺X线筛查诊断出患有乳腺癌，其中50~59岁组占53％，60~69岁组占26％。
Translation: Among the cohort aged 50 to 69, 379 women (41%) were diagnosed with breast cancer through mammography screening, with the 50–59 age group accounting for 53% and the 60–69 age group accounting for 26%.

Query_Text_cn: 这些直径≤10mm的肿瘤通常较少出现腋窝淋巴结转移(21％比35％；P小于0.001，表1)。
Translation: These tumors with a diameter of ≤10 mm are less likely to present axillary lymph node metastasis (21% vs. 35%; P<0.001, Table 1).

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤往往具有某些特殊组织学类型(13％比9％；P=0.04)，较少表达MK167抗原(17％比25％；P=0.04)。
Translation: Tumors detected by mammographic screening often exhibit certain specific histological types (13% vs. 9%; P=0.04) and express MK167 antigen less frequently (17% vs. 25%; P=0.04).

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤中31％组织学分化良好(1级)，而其他方法检出的1级肿瘤仅占16％(P小于0.001)。
Translation: Among tumors detected by mammographic screening, 31% are well-differentiated (grade 1) histologically, whereas only 16% of grade 1 tumors are identified by other methods (P<0.001).

Query_Text_cn: 总的来说，若仅对50~69岁队列进行比较，则上述差异相似(表1)。乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤患者多处于该年龄组(86％)。
Translation: Overall, if we compare only the 50–69 age cohort, the differences mentioned above are similar (Table 1). The majority of tumors detected by mammographic screening were in this age group (86%).

Query_Text_cn: 第一轮筛查出的女性乳腺癌患者与第二轮或较晚筛查出的女性乳腺癌患者预后相似(P=0.96)。
Translation: The prognosis of female breast cancer patients detected in the first round of screening was similar to that of those detected in the second or later rounds (P=0.96).

Query_Text_cn: 为此，在进行深入分析时，我们将所有筛查出的女性乳腺癌患者的预后与其他方法检出的女性乳腺癌患者的预后进行了比较。
Translation: To this end, in our in-depth analysis, we compared the prognosis of all female breast cancer patients identified through screening with those identified by other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 在大小各异的肿瘤中(≤10mm、11~20mm、21~30mm、>30mm，附图)，乳腺X线筛查出的女性乳腺癌患者均比其他方法检出的女性乳腺癌患者具有更好的远期无病生存情况。
Translation: Among tumors of varying sizes (≤10mm, 11–20mm, 21–30mm, >30mm, see attached figure), female breast cancer patients detected by mammographic screening had better long-term disease-free survival compared to those detected by other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 总的来说，筛查出肿瘤直径为11~30mm的妇女其预后与其他方法检出的直径≤10mm的肿瘤患者相同(表2)。
Translation: Overall, women with tumors measuring 11–30 mm detected through screening have the same prognosis as patients with tumors ≤10 mm detected by other methods (Table 2).

Query_Text_cn: 对单发大肿瘤组进行比较时也发现类似的预后差异(队列年龄为50~69岁，淋巴结阴性)。
Translation: Similar prognostic differences were also observed when comparing the group with single large tumors (cohort age 50-69 years, lymph node negative).

Query_Text_cn: 对于肿瘤≥30mm的患者而言，乳腺X线筛查与其他方法在预后方面无明显差异，但其中可供分析的筛查组乳腺癌患者很少(n=25)。
Translation: For patients with tumors ≥30 mm, there is no significant difference in prognosis between mammographic screening and other methods; however, the number of breast cancer patients in the screening group available for analysis is very small (n=25).

Query_Text_cn: 在筛查组淋巴结阳的90例女性患者中，仅19例(21％)有远期复发。
Translation: Among the 90 female patients with lymph node-positive findings in the screening group, only 19 cases (21%) experienced long-term recurrence.

Query_Text_cn: 由于筛查组50~59岁年龄队列(53％)所占比例比其他年龄组(40~49岁，1l％；60~69岁，26％；70~79岁，3％)高，所以确诊年龄应视为一种混淆因素。
Translation: Since the proportion of the 50-59 age cohort in the screening group (53%) is higher than that of other age groups (40-49, 11%; 60-69, 26%; 70-79, 3%), the age at diagnosis should be considered a confounding factor.

Query_Text_cn: 不管确诊年龄如何，乳腺X线筛查组患者的生存情况均优于其他方法检出的肿瘤患者。
Translation: Regardless of the age at diagnosis, patients in the mammography screening group had better survival outcomes than those whose tumors were detected by other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管筛查组和其他方法组患者预后存在巨大差异，但是各年龄队列之间远期无病生存率的差异很小(表3)。
Translation: Despite the significant differences in prognosis between the screening group and other method groups, the long-term disease-free survival rates among different age cohorts show minimal variation (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 值得注意的是，尽管50~59岁队列多通过乳腺X线筛查出肿瘤，但是该年龄段借助其他方法发现肿瘤的患者10年远期无病生存率(73％)却与非筛查组其他年龄队列大体相同(40~49岁，72％；60~69岁，69％；I>70岁，67％)。
Translation: It is noteworthy that although most tumors in the 50–59 age group are detected through mammography screening, the 10-year distant disease-free survival rate (73%) for patients in this age group whose tumors were discovered by other methods is roughly similar to that of the non-screened groups in other age cohorts (40–49 years, 72%; 60–69 years, 69%; >70 years, 67%).

Query_Text_cn: 由于筛查组肿瘤患者的年龄分布与其他方法组不同，由于筛查出的肿瘤分化好、孕激素受体表达多、MK167蛋白染色显示细胞增殖率较低，因此，我们进行了一个多变量分析以明确筛查发现肿瘤是否为其独立预后因素。
Translation: Due to the differences in age distribution of tumor patients in the screening group compared to other groups, and because tumors detected through screening tend to be well-differentiated, have higher progesterone receptor expression, and show lower cell proliferation rates as indicated by MK167 protein staining, we conducted a multivariate analysis to determine whether screen-detected tumors are an independent prognostic factor.

Query_Text_cn: 肿瘤直径每增加1cm，则远期转移的HR增加1.20(95％，CI，1.10～1.31)。
Translation: For each 1 cm increase in tumor diameter, the hazard ratio (HR) for distant metastasis increases by 1.20 (95% CI, 1.10–1.31).

Query_Text_cn: 在选择乳腺癌特异性生存率(HR，2.11；95％，CI，1.16~3.85)或总生存率(HR，1.63；95％，CI，1.02～2.60)而不是远期无病生存率作为终点时，其他方法发现乳腺癌仍是一个独立的不良预后变量。
Translation: When breast cancer-specific survival (HR, 2.11; 95% CI, 1.16–3.85) or overall survival (HR, 1.63; 95% CI, 1.02–2.60) was chosen as the endpoint instead of long-term disease-free survival, other methods also found that breast cancer remained an independent adverse prognostic factor.

Query_Text_cn: 同样，若仅根据医院病历记录筛查发现肿瘤但在芬兰国家乳腺X线肿瘤筛查登记处未登记(占筛查发现病例的30％)，并将这些妇女从分析中去除，则肿瘤检出方式仍然是不良预后变量。
Translation: Similarly, if tumors detected through hospital medical records but not registered in the Finnish National Mammography Screening Registry (accounting for 30% of screen-detected cases) are excluded from the analysis, the mode of tumor detection remains an adverse prognostic factor.

Query_Text_cn: 在模型中，通过乳腺X线筛查发现肿瘤的HR变化很小(2.09；95％CI，1.13～3.85)。
Translation: In the model, the change in hazard ratio (HR) for tumors detected through mammographic screening was minimal (2.09; 95% CI, 1.13–3.85).

Query_Text_cn: 在肿瘤淋巴结阴性的患者中(确诊年龄为50～69岁，未接受辅助治疗，n=430)，乳腺X线筛查仍独立于肿瘤大小和肿瘤组织学分级而与预后较好相关。
Translation: In patients with node-negative tumors (diagnosed at ages 50–69, not receiving adjuvant therapy, n=430), mammographic screening remains independently associated with better prognosis, regardless of tumor size and histological grade.

Query_Text_cn: 与其他方法确诊的乳腺癌患者相比，乳腺X线筛查检出的肿瘤患者预后一般更好，这可能是由于筛查发现的肿瘤平均体积较小或其生物学特性较好。
Translation: Compared with breast cancer patients diagnosed by other methods, those whose tumors are detected through mammographic screening generally have a better prognosis, which may be attributed to the smaller average tumor size or more favorable biological characteristics of screen-detected tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 与其他研究一致，本队列乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤比其他方法发现的肿瘤体积小。
Translation: Consistent with other studies, tumors detected by mammographic screening in this cohort were smaller in volume than those identified by other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 筛查出的肿瘤较少出现腋窝淋巴结转移，分化较好，常表现为某些特殊组织学类型，MK167抗原免疫染色分析显示细胞增殖率较低，ERBB2扩增常为阴性而孕激素受体常为阳性。
Translation: Tumors detected through screening are less likely to exhibit axillary lymph node metastasis, are better differentiated, and often present with certain special histological types. Immunohistochemical analysis of MK167 antigen indicates a lower cell proliferation rate, ERBB2 amplification is usually negative, while progesterone receptor expression is often positive.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这些特点并不能完全解释为何乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤预后普遍较好，原因是在多变量分析中肿瘤检测方法是一个独立的预后变量。
Translation: However, these characteristics cannot fully explain why tumors detected by mammographic screening generally have a better prognosis, as the method of tumor detection remains an independent prognostic variable in multivariate analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 在本队列中，筛查出的肿瘤多见于50～59岁和60～69岁年龄组患者，这是因为大城市很少组织50岁以下和70岁以上的妇女进行筛查。
Translation: In this cohort, most of the detected tumors were found in patients aged 50–59 and 60–69 years, primarily because large cities rarely organize screening for women under 50 or over 70 years old.

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查组患者的年龄分布差异也不大可能解释为何其预后较好，因为与各年龄组其他妇女相比，前者生存率更高。
Translation: The age distribution differences among patients in the mammography screening group are unlikely to explain their better prognosis, as their survival rates are higher compared to other women in each age group.

Query_Text_cn: 包括年龄在内的多变量分析显示，乳腺X线筛查诊断肿瘤是一个独立的预后变量。
Translation: Multivariate analysis, including age, showed that tumor diagnosis by mammographic screening is an independent prognostic factor.

Query_Text_cn: 这种良好预后不能归因于实施的治疗，因为筛查组妇女比其他方法组妇女接受系统治疗的机会少。
Translation: This favorable prognosis cannot be attributed to the treatments administered, as women in the screening group had fewer opportunities to receive systemic therapy compared to those in other groups.

Query_Text_cn: 在原发肿瘤大小相同的情况下，其他方法组妇女较筛查组妇女远期无病生存率高。
Translation: Given the same size of the primary tumor, women in the other method groups had a higher long-term disease-free survival rate than those in the screening group.

Query_Text_cn: 由于本研究样量本相对较大，因此我们可以对肿瘤直径进行相对较窄的分层后加以评价。
Translation: Due to the relatively large sample size in this study, we are able to evaluate tumor diameter after stratifying it into relatively narrow categories.

Query_Text_cn: 这一点很重要，因为筛查出的肿瘤通常比其他肿瘤体积小得多，此时若对较宽的肿瘤大小层面进行比较就会发生偏倚。
Translation: This is important because tumors detected through screening are usually much smaller in size than other tumors, and comparing tumors across a broader size range at this stage would introduce bias.

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现，既往没有研究在大小相近的肿瘤中比较筛查和其他方法对预后的影响。但是，本研究结果与2项小规模研究一致。这2项研究根据肿瘤淋巴结转移情况对筛查发现的肿瘤与其他肿瘤进行了比较。
Translation: We found that no previous studies have compared the impact of screening and other methods on prognosis in tumors of similar size. However, the results of this study are consistent with two small-scale studies. These two studies compared tumors detected by screening with other tumors based on lymph node metastasis status.

Query_Text_cn: 这两项研究得出结论认为：在校正肿瘤大小后，乳腺X线筛查出的女性肿瘤患者较其他妇女预后更好。
Translation: Both studies concluded that, after adjusting for tumor size, women whose tumors were detected by mammographic screening had a better prognosis than other women.

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现肿瘤检出方法对患者预后的影响相当大。
Translation: We found that the method of tumor detection has a significant impact on patient prognosis.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，经乳腺X线筛查出的直径为11～30mm的女性肿瘤患者其生存率与其他方法检出的直径≤10mm的女性患者大致相同。
Translation: For example, the survival rate of female tumor patients with diameters of 11–30 mm detected by mammography screening is roughly the same as that of female patients with diameters ≤10 mm detected by other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 对大小相近的肿瘤进行比较可减少研究时间偏倚对预后比较的影响。
Translation: Comparing tumors of similar size can reduce the impact of research time bias on prognostic comparisons.

Query_Text_cn: 对这项全国范围的研究而言，选择性偏倚不可能产生主要影响。
Translation: For this nationwide study, selection bias is unlikely to have a major impact.

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤可能具有不同于其他肿瘤的生物学特点，因此，时间偏倚(生长缓慢的肿瘤通过筛查发现)可能是其预后一般较好的重要因素。
Translation: Tumors detected by mammographic screening may have biological characteristics different from those of other tumors; therefore, time bias (the detection of slow-growing tumors through screening) may be an important factor contributing to their generally better prognosis.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，除了组织学分级，我们研究的各种肿瘤生物学因素无一与肿瘤检测方法强相关。
Translation: However, apart from histological grading, none of the various tumor biological factors we studied were strongly associated with the tumor detection method.

Query_Text_cn: 在以组织学分级和某些肿瘤生物学因素为协变量的多变量生存分析中，肿瘤检测法是一个独立的预后变量。
Translation: In multivariate survival analysis using histological grading and certain tumor biological factors as covariates, the tumor detection method is an independent prognostic variable.

Query_Text_cn: 与其他方法检出的肿瘤相比，筛查发现的肿瘤患者较少出现乳房肿痛、胸部压迫感、乳头溢液等症状、体征。
Translation: Compared with tumors detected by other methods, patients with tumors identified through screening are less likely to present with symptoms and signs such as breast pain, chest tightness, or nipple discharge.

Query_Text_cn: 这些症状可能与肿瘤浸润相关，如神经或神经周围镜下浸润(引起疼痛)、水肿(有压迫感)、血管浸润、导管堵塞或浸润(乳头溢液、疼痛、压迫感)。
Translation: These symptoms may be associated with tumor infiltration, such as perineural or neural infiltration (causing pain), edema (a sense of pressure), vascular infiltration, or ductal obstruction or infiltration (nipple discharge, pain, or a sense of pressure).

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究未对这些因素进行观察，这在定程度上可以解释为何其他方法组肿瘤患者预后较差。
Translation: Our study did not observe these factors, which to some extent may explain why patients in other treatment groups had poorer prognoses.

Query_Text_cn: 导致肿瘤血管生成、转移的其他因素也可能很重要，有待进一步研究。
Translation: Other factors that contribute to tumor angiogenesis and metastasis may also be significant and warrant further investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 一些通过乳腺X线筛查发现的肿瘤可能生长缓慢；惰性肿瘤可能在妇女一生中都不会显露出来。
Translation: Some tumors detected through mammographic screening may grow slowly; indolent tumors may never manifest during a woman's lifetime.

Query_Text_cn: 某些尸检研究发现，在普通人群中有相当比例的女性患有隐性乳腺肿瘤。
Translation: Some autopsy studies have found that a considerable proportion of women in the general population have occult breast tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 这些研究显示，4.3％～18％的女性患有隐性原位癌。在一组法医尸检研究中，浸润性乳腺癌占1.8％。
Translation: These studies indicate that 4.3% to 18% of women have occult carcinoma in situ. In a group of forensic autopsy studies, invasive breast cancer accounted for 1.8%.

Query_Text_cn: 有人在一组拒绝手术的早期乳腺癌患者中观察了未经治疗的乳腺癌患者的生物学行为。
Translation: The biological behavior of untreated breast cancer was observed in a group of early-stage breast cancer patients who refused surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 许多未接受治疗的妇女存活时间比预期长(从出现症状到死亡的平均生存期为30～40.5个月)弱，一些患I、Ⅱ、Ⅲ期乳腺癌但拒绝治疗的妇女存活了5年弘。
Translation: Many untreated women survived longer than expected (the average survival time from symptom onset to death was 30 to 40.5 months), and some women with stage I, II, or III breast cancer who refused treatment survived for as long as five years.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，患者自身发现的肿瘤大多具有侵袭性，并且通常在随诊l0年内出现远期转移，在随诊l5年后发生转移者极为罕见。
Translation: However, most tumors detected by patients themselves are aggressive and typically develop distant metastases within 10 years of follow-up, while metastasis occurring after 15 years of follow-up is extremely rare.

Query_Text_cn: 本文所述的肿瘤检出方式以现有的医院病历记录资料为基础。
Translation: The tumor detection method described in this article is based on existing hospital medical records.

Query_Text_cn: 我们还研究了芬兰国家乳腺X线登记处采用的肿瘤检出方式。
Translation: We also studied the tumor detection methods used by the Finnish National Breast X-ray Registry.

Query_Text_cn: 通过筛查发现的女性肿瘤患者(以医院病历记录资料为据)中有70％在筛查登记处有备案。
Translation: Among female tumor patients identified through screening (based on hospital medical records), 70% were registered at the screening registry.

Query_Text_cn: 其余30％在登记处无备案的妇女也可能是通过筛查发现肿瘤的。
Translation: The remaining 30% of women who were not registered with the registry may also have had tumors detected through screening.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，由于登记资料不完全，这一点无法证实。
Translation: However, this cannot be confirmed due to incomplete registration data.

Query_Text_cn: 仅以医院记录为依据，从队列中去除通过乳腺X线筛查发现的女性肿瘤患者，对多变量模型中与筛查相关的远期复发的HR几乎没有影响。
Translation: Excluding female tumor patients detected through mammography screening from the cohort based solely on hospital records had almost no impact on the hazard ratio (HR) for long-term recurrence associated with screening in the multivariable model.

Query_Text_cn: 因为肿瘤筛查轮次对预后无明显影响(P=0.96)，加之有些妇女没有筛查轮次的资料，所以我们在进一步分析中将各轮筛查发现的女性肿瘤患者合并。
Translation: Since the number of tumor screening rounds had no significant impact on prognosis (P=0.96), and some women lacked information on their screening rounds, we combined female tumor patients detected in different screening rounds for further analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 其他方法组由患者自身发现肿瘤、未参加筛查但发现肿瘤以及在乳腺X线筛查问期发现肿瘤的妇女组成。
Translation: The other methods group consists of women who discovered tumors themselves, those who were not screened but found tumors, and those who had tumors detected during the interval between mammography screenings.

Query_Text_cn: 有意思的是，在这些肿瘤患者中，50~59岁组与其他组生存率几乎相同，但是由于对50~59岁组进行了更深入的筛查，使该年龄组自我发现肿瘤的相对比例比其他年龄组低。
Translation: Interestingly, among these cancer patients, the survival rate of the 50-59 age group is almost the same as that of the other groups. However, due to more intensive screening in the 50-59 age group, the relative proportion of self-detected tumors in this age group is lower than in other age groups.

Query_Text_cn: 其他一些研究也发现，在乳腺X线筛查问期发现的女性肿瘤患者与其他方法发现的女性肿瘤患者预后大致相同，我们的结果与上述研究一致。
Translation: Other studies have also found that the prognosis of female tumor patients detected during mammography screening is generally similar to that of patients detected by other methods, and our results are consistent with these findings.

Query_Text_cn: 绝经前妇女和应用激素替代治疗的妇女似乎更易在乳腺X线筛查问期发现肿瘤，这可能是由于她们的乳腺实质更为致密，而乳腺X线的技术含量和放射科医生的技能可能也很重要。
Translation: Premenopausal women and women undergoing hormone replacement therapy appear to be more likely to have tumors detected during interval breast X-ray screening, possibly because their breast parenchyma is denser. The technical quality of mammography and the skills of radiologists may also play an important role.

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查问期发现的肿瘤的假阴性率为10％30％，但是回顾性地将乳X线筛查问期发现的肿瘤分为真正的间期肿瘤和漏诊的肿瘤是非常必要的，但在常规临床实践却很少进行。
Translation: The false-negative rate for tumors detected during the interval between mammographic screenings is 10%–30%. However, it is essential to retrospectively classify these interval-detected tumors as either true interval cancers or missed cancers, although this is rarely done in routine clinical practice.

Query_Text_cn: 因为上述原因，加之全国范围研究的诸多管理问题，我们未尝试将其他方面发现的肿瘤进一步分类。
Translation: For the reasons mentioned above, coupled with numerous management issues identified in nationwide studies, we did not attempt to further classify tumors found in other areas.

Query_Text_cn: 任何乳腺X线筛查发现的女性肿瘤队列均有可能包含一些有症状的患者，因为有些妇女可能在等待筛查通知而不是主动就医。
Translation: Any cohort of female tumors detected through mammographic screening may include some symptomatic patients, as some women may wait for screening notifications rather than actively seek medical attention.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，筛查队列有利的生存差异可能比我们所观察到的更大，因为筛查队列中包含了一些有肿瘤症状的妇女。
Translation: Therefore, the favorable survival difference in the screening cohort may be greater than what we have observed, as the screening cohort included some women with tumor symptoms.

Query_Text_cn: 另一方面，其他方法组可能包括了拒绝筛查、与参加筛查的妇女相比预后可能不佳的妇女柏。
Translation: On the other hand, the other method groups may include women who refuse screening and those whose prognosis may be worse compared to women who participate in screening.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，在芬兰拒绝参加乳腺X线筛查的妇女所占比例很小。
Translation: However, the proportion of women in Finland who refuse to participate in mammography screening is very small.

Query_Text_cn: 在40~49岁、60~69岁和I>70岁组，参加筛查者的比例主要由提供乳腺X线筛查的市政府决定。
Translation: In the 40–49, 60–69, and ≥70 age groups, the proportion of participants undergoing screening was mainly determined by the municipal governments that provided mammography screening.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的结论是，乳腺X线筛查发现的女性肿瘤患者比肿瘤直径大致相同的其他妇女预后更好。
Translation: Our conclusion is that female tumor patients detected through mammographic screening have a better prognosis than other women with tumors of approximately the same diameter.

Query_Text_cn: 通过乳腺X线筛查发现肿瘤是有益的是独立于腋窝淋巴结数目、原发肿瘤大小、确诊年龄和组织学分级的预后变量。
Translation: Detection of tumors through mammographic screening is a prognostic factor that is beneficial independently of the number of axillary lymph nodes, primary tumor size, age at diagnosis, and histological grade.

Query_Text_cn: 组织病理学和肿瘤生物学因素均不能解释筛查发现肿瘤对远期复发危险的影响。
Translation: Neither histopathological nor tumor biological factors can account for the impact of screen-detected tumors on long-term recurrence risk.

Query_Text_cn: 我们需要进步研究肿瘤浸润和转移形成的相关因素。
Translation: We need to further investigate the factors related to tumor infiltration and metastasis formation.

Query_Text_cn: 对通过乳腺X线筛查检出的女性肿瘤患者，必须将肿瘤检测法纳入风险评估，否则就有可能高估其发生远期转移的危险。
Translation: For female tumor patients detected through mammographic screening, it is essential to incorporate tumor detection methods into risk assessment; otherwise, there is a risk of overestimating their likelihood of long-term metastasis.

Query_Text_cn: 背景：了解结直肠肿瘤的危险因素能够为无症状个体制定降低发病风险策略提供信息。
Translation: Understanding the risk factors for colorectal tumors can provide information for developing strategies to reduce the incidence among asymptomatic individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 目前评价无症状个体罹患进展期结直肠肿瘤危险因素的研究、对比有无息肉个体危险因素的研究或在多变量分析中纳入最有意义危险因素的研究甚少。
Translation: Currently, there are few studies evaluating risk factors for advanced colorectal tumors in asymptomatic individuals, few studies comparing risk factors between individuals with and without polyps, or studies that include the most significant risk factors in multivariate analyses.

Query_Text_cn: 目的：在一个完成全结肠镜检的无症状患者队列中确定与进展期结直肠肿瘤相关的危险因素。
Translation: Objective: To identify risk factors associated with advanced colorectal neoplasms in a cohort of asymptomatic patients who have undergone complete colonoscopy.

Query_Text_cn: 设计、地点和参试者：1994年2月至1997年1月，于3121例无症状患者中进行前瞻性横断面研究。患者来自13个退伍军人医疗中心，年龄50～75岁。
Translation: Design, Setting, and Participants: A prospective cross-sectional study was conducted from February 1994 to January 1997 among 3,121 asymptomatic patients aged 50 to 75 years from 13 Veterans Affairs medical centers.

Query_Text_cn: 所有入组患者都接受了结肠镜检以确定进展期肿瘤的发生。进展期肿瘤定义为直径≥10mm的腺瘤，绒毛状腺瘤(至少25％的绒毛成分)，伴重度非典型增生的腺瘤，或者浸润癌。
Translation: All enrolled patients underwent colonoscopy to identify the occurrence of advanced tumors. Advanced tumors were defined as adenomas with a diameter ≥10 mm, villous adenomas (with at least 25% villous component), adenomas with severe dysplasia, or invasive carcinoma.

Query_Text_cn: 检测的变量包括罹患结直肠癌一级亲属病史，既往胆囊切除史，血清胆固醇水平，体力活动水平，吸烟情况，饮酒情况和饮食因素。
Translation: The variables examined include a family history of colorectal cancer in first-degree relatives, previous cholecystectomy, serum cholesterol levels, physical activity levels, smoking status, alcohol consumption, and dietary factors.

Query_Text_cn: 主要观察指标：对每个变量均进行年龄校正分析，以便与没有息肉的患者比较，计算其发生进展期肿瘤的优势比(ORs)和95％可信区间(CLs)。
Translation: Primary observation indicators: Age-adjusted analyses were conducted for each variable to compare with patients without polyps, and odds ratios (ORs) and 95% confidence limits (CLs) for the development of advanced tumors were calculated.

Query_Text_cn: 我们建立了一个多变量logistic回归模型以便对有关危险因素做出鉴定。
Translation: We established a multivariable logistic regression model to identify relevant risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 二级分析检查增生性息肉的危险因素，与无息肉以及有进展期肿瘤的患者比较。
Translation: Secondary analyses examined risk factors for hyperplastic polyps, comparing them with patients without polyps and those with advanced neoplasia.

Query_Text_cn: 结果：329例入组患者有进展期肿瘤，1441例没有息肉。
Translation: Results: Among the enrolled patients, 329 had advanced tumors, and 1,441 had no polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 在多变量分析中，我们发现一级亲属结直肠癌病史(OR，1.66；95％CI，1.16～2.35)、目前吸烟(OR，1.85；95％CI，1.33～2.58)以及目前中至大量饮酒(OR，1.02；95％CI，1.01～1.03)与之呈正相关关系。
Translation: In multivariate analysis, we found that a family history of colorectal cancer in first-degree relatives (OR, 1.66; 95% CI, 1.16–2.35), current smoking (OR, 1.85; 95% CI, 1.33–2.58), and current moderate to heavy alcohol consumption (OR, 1.02; 95% CI, 1.01–1.03) were positively associated with it.

Intake of cereal fiber (OR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91–0.99), vitamin D (OR, 1.66; 95% CI, 1.16–2.35), and the use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (OR, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.48–0.91) were negatively correlated.

Query_Text_cn: 在单变量分析中，存在负相关的因素包括谷物纤维摄入大于4.2g/d，维生素D的摄入大于645IU/d以及每日应用非甾体抗炎药。
Translation: In the univariate analysis, negatively correlated factors included cereal fiber intake greater than 4.2 g/d, vitamin D intake greater than 645 IU/d, and daily use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.

Query_Text_cn: 临界因素包括体力活动，每日服用多种维生素，钙的摄入以及红肉脂肪获取量。
Translation: Critical factors include physical activity, daily intake of multivitamins, calcium consumption, and the amount of fat obtained from red meat.

Query_Text_cn: 没有相关性的因素包括体重指数、既往胆囊切除和血清胆固醇水平。
Translation: Irrelevant factors include body mass index, previous cholecystectomy, and serum cholesterol levels.

Query_Text_cn: 结肠镜检发现391例最严重的病变为增生性息肉。
Translation: Colonoscopy revealed that the most severe lesion in 391 cases was hyperplastic polyp.

Query_Text_cn: 除既往和目前吸烟与发生增生性息肉的危险增高相关外，其他危险变量结果与没有息肉的患者类似。
Translation: Except for the increased risk of developing hyperplastic polyps associated with past and current smoking, the results for other risk variables were similar to those in patients without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 结论：我们的研究数据证实了进展期结肠肿瘤的一些重要的危险因素，并为降低危险策略提供了一定依据。
Translation: Conclusion: Our research data confirm several important risk factors for advanced colorectal tumors and provide a certain basis for risk reduction strategies.

Query_Text_cn: 尚需进一步的研究以确定改变生活方式是否可以降低结肠癌的危险。
Translation: Further research is needed to determine whether lifestyle changes can reduce the risk of colorectal cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 在北美，结直肠癌位居癌症死亡的第二位。
Translation: In North America, colorectal cancer ranks as the second leading cause of cancer-related deaths.

Query_Text_cn: 有证据表明，对50岁以上的无症状人群进行普查可以降低结直肠癌的死亡率。结肠腺瘤切除可减少结直肠癌的发生率。
Translation: There is evidence that screening asymptomatic individuals over the age of 50 can reduce mortality from colorectal cancer. Removal of colonic adenomas can decrease the incidence of colorectal cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 明确导致息肉恶变的重要危险因素可以为危险分层以及降低危险策略的制定提供准确的信息。
Translation: Identifying key risk factors that contribute to the malignant transformation of polyps can provide accurate information for risk stratification and the development of risk reduction strategies.

Query_Text_cn: 许多结直肠息肉的潜在危险因素以前已有研究。
Translation: Many potential risk factors for colorectal polyps have been studied previously.

Query_Text_cn: 但是在无症状个体评估进展期结直肠癌危险因素的研究，在伴或不伴息肉个体比较危险因素的研究，或者在多变量分析中纳入最有意义危险因素的研究甚少。
Translation: However, there are few studies assessing risk factors for advanced colorectal cancer in asymptomatic individuals, comparing risk factors between individuals with and without polyps, or including the most significant risk factors in multivariate analyses.

Query_Text_cn: 我们在接受结肠镜筛检的无症状个体进行了横断面研究以确定进展期结肠癌的危险因素。
Translation: We conducted a cross-sectional study among asymptomatic individuals undergoing colonoscopy screening to identify risk factors for advanced colorectal cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 该研究的独特之处在于：(1)纳入结肠镜检查结肠无息肉的个体作为对照组，与有进展期肿瘤的患者比较；(2)样本量足以满足在多变量分析中对最重要的变量进行分析。
Translation: The uniqueness of this study lies in: (1) including individuals without polyps on colonoscopy as the control group and comparing them with patients who have advanced tumors; (2) having a sufficient sample size to allow for the analysis of the most important variables in multivariate analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 根据以往研究发现的联系以及生物学推理，还选择了一些可疑的危险因素。
Translation: Some suspected risk factors were also selected based on associations identified in previous studies and biological reasoning.

Query_Text_cn: 我们研究的潜在危险因素包括：结直肠癌家族史、饮食、吸烟、饮酒、体重指数、非甾体抗炎药的应用、血清胆固醇水平、胆囊切除、体力活动。
Translation: The potential risk factors we studied include: family history of colorectal cancer, diet, smoking, alcohol consumption, body mass index, use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, serum cholesterol levels, cholecystectomy, and physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 我们对最坏结肠病灶为一或多个增生性息肉的患者进行了二级分析。
Translation: We conducted a secondary analysis on patients whose worst colonic lesions were one or more hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 增生性息肉属良性病变，而且临床常见。
Translation: Hyperplastic polyps are benign lesions and are commonly seen in clinical practice.

Query_Text_cn: 目前的指南建议增生性息肉的治疗与无息肉患者类似。
Translation: Current guidelines recommend that the treatment of hyperplastic polyps should be similar to that of patients without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 先前并无研究评估增生性息肉患者的危险因素，因此无法确定他们是否与无息肉患者类似。
Translation: Previously, no studies have evaluated the risk factors in patients with hyperplastic polyps, making it impossible to determine whether they are similar to those without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 与无息肉患者和进展期肿瘤患者比较，我们的研究为确定增生性息肉患者的危险因素提供了一个机会。
Translation: Compared with patients without polyps and those with advanced tumors, our study provides an opportunity to identify risk factors for patients with hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 患者于1994年2月至1997年1月收集自13个退伍军人医疗中心，年龄50～75岁，没有下消化道症状。
Translation: The patients were collected from 13 Veterans Medical Centers between February 1994 and January 1997, aged 50 to 75 years, with no lower gastrointestinal symptoms.

Query_Text_cn: 研究计划得到了一个中心人权委员会以及各参试中心机构审查委员会的批准，所有参试者均提供了书面的知情同意。
Translation: The research protocol was approved by a central human rights committee as well as the institutional review boards of all participating centers, and written informed consent was obtained from all participants.

Query_Text_cn: 患者需完成一项临床调查以确定其入组资格。
Translation: The patient is required to complete a clinical assessment to determine eligibility for enrollment.

Query_Text_cn: 如果患者报告有下消化道疾病症状，则将其排除。这些症状包括直肠出血(此前6个月内≥1次)、大便习惯明显改变、下腹部疼痛需进行临床评估。
Translation: If patients report symptoms of lower gastrointestinal diseases, they will be excluded. These symptoms include rectal bleeding (≥1 episode in the past 6 months), significant changes in bowel habits, or lower abdominal pain requiring clinical evaluation.

Query_Text_cn: 其他的排除条件包括参加其他研究，有结肠疾病史(如结肠炎、息肉或癌)，既往结肠手术，10年内曾行结肠检查(如乙状结肠镜、结肠镜、钡灌肠)，存在可增加结肠镜检危险或不能从结肠镜筛查(癌症或任何终末期疾病)获益的医学问题，安装有人工心脏瓣膜，接受抗凝治疗，以及其他非医学问题(精神疾病，缺少运输工具，无家可归或缺少家庭支持以及过量饮酒)，或是在接受结肠镜检时需要特殊的预防措施(如预防性抗生素)。
Translation: Other exclusion criteria include participation in other studies, a history of colonic diseases (such as colitis, polyps, or cancer), previous colon surgery, colon examinations within the past 10 years (such as sigmoidoscopy, colonoscopy, or barium enema), medical conditions that may increase the risk of colonoscopy or prevent individuals from benefiting from colonoscopic screening (cancer or any terminal illness), presence of artificial heart valves, receipt of anticoagulant therapy, as well as other non-medical issues (mental illness, lack of transportation, homelessness or lack of family support, and excessive alcohol consumption), or the need for special preventive measures during colonoscopy (such as prophylactic antibiotics).

Query_Text_cn: 可能怀孕的女性亦予排除。
Translation: Women who may be pregnant are also excluded.

Query_Text_cn: 2346例患者拒绝临床调查。
Translation: 2,346 patients declined to participate in the clinical survey.

Query_Text_cn: 最常见的排除原因为10年内曾行结肠检查(n=6486)、结肠疾病史(n=2221)、严重的医学问题(n=1052)和接受抗凝治疗(n=712)。
Translation: The most common reasons for exclusion were a history of colon examination within the past 10 years (n=6,486), a history of colon disease (n=2,221), serious medical issues (n=1,052), and receiving anticoagulant therapy (n=712).

Query_Text_cn: 符合入组标准的患者中，1463例患者(31.4％)拒绝参加，3196例符合条件的患者入组。
Translation: Among eligible patients, 1,463 (31.4%) declined to participate, and 3,196 eligible patients were enrolled.

Query_Text_cn: 完成结肠镜检查的患者纳入分析(n=3121)。
Translation: Patients who completed colonoscopy were included in the analysis (n=3121).

Query_Text_cn: 对于关键危险因素，我们确定的样本量有足够的把握度(>90％)检出具有临床重要意义的双倍危险。
Translation: For key risk factors, the sample size we determined provides sufficient power (>90%) to detect a clinically significant doubling of risk.

Query_Text_cn: 我们分析研究了329例进展期肿瘤患者和1441例无息肉患者(n=1770)。
Translation: We analyzed and studied 329 patients with advanced tumors and 1,441 patients without polyps (n=1,770).

Query_Text_cn: 结肠镜检和组织学评估步骤此前已有描述。
Translation: The procedures for colonoscopy and histological assessment have been previously described.

Query_Text_cn: 进展期结肠肿瘤的定义为≥10mm的腺瘤，绒毛状腺瘤(至少25％的绒毛)，腺瘤伴重度非典型增生，或浸润癌。
Translation: Advanced colonic tumors are defined as adenomas measuring ≥10 mm, villous adenomas (with at least 25% villous component), adenomas with severe dysplasia, or invasive carcinoma.

Query_Text_cn: 病理学证实粘膜内癌或原位癌的患者被分人重度非典型增生组。
Translation: Patients pathologically confirmed with intramucosal carcinoma or carcinoma in situ were classified into the severe dysplasia group.

Query_Text_cn: 癌症的定义为恶性细胞浸润超过粘膜肌层。
Translation: Cancer is defined as malignant cells infiltrating beyond the muscularis mucosae.

Query_Text_cn: 患者的分类根据组织学最高为进展期病灶进行。
Translation: Patient classification is based on the histologically most advanced lesion.

Query_Text_cn: 二级队列患者最严重的结肠病灶为增生性息肉，对他们进行研究分析以确定其危险因素是否不同于息肉患者或进展期肿瘤患者。
Translation: The most severe colonic lesion in patients in the secondary queue is hyperplastic polyp. These patients were studied and analyzed to determine whether their risk factors differ from those of polyp patients or those with advanced tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 如果患者未填项目超过70个或者报告之总能量摄人值过高或过低，都将其排除。
Translation: If a patient leaves more than 70 items unanswered or if the total reported energy intake is excessively high or low, the patient will be excluded.

Query_Text_cn: 根据调查表，每例患者应测定以下项目：总能量摄人；总脂肪；从牛肉、猪肉或羊肉获得的脂肪；总饮食纤维；谷类纤维、水果纤维及蔬菜纤维；钙摄人总量；叶酸摄人总量；维生素D；以及每日多种维生素的应用。
Translation: According to the survey form, the following items should be measured for each patient: total energy intake; total fat; fat obtained from beef, pork, or lamb; total dietary fiber; cereal fiber, fruit fiber, and vegetable fiber; total calcium intake; total folic acid intake; vitamin D; and the use of daily multivitamins.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动指数来自Framingham研究报告。
Translation: The physical activity index is derived from the Framingham Study report.

Query_Text_cn: 研究给患者提供了在家中、工作以及娱乐活动中有关很轻体力活动、轻体力活动、中度体力活动和重体力活动的标准，记录患者每类活动花费的时问从而获得一个24小时评分。
Translation: The study provided patients with standards for very light physical activity, light physical activity, moderate physical activity, and vigorous physical activity at home, work, and during recreational activities. Patients recorded the time spent on each type of activity, resulting in a 24-hour score.

Query_Text_cn: 第二种评估方法是计算代谢当量，这是一种切实有效的评估特定中至重体力活动能量消耗的方法，表达为每周代谢当量。
Translation: The second assessment method is to calculate metabolic equivalents, which is a practical and effective way to evaluate the energy expenditure of specific moderate to vigorous physical activities, expressed as weekly metabolic equivalents.

Query_Text_cn: 两种评分系统反映了体力活动的不同方面。
Translation: The two scoring systems reflect different aspects of physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 就体力活动指数而言，一个每日从事数小时轻微活动的个体其评分可能与每日进行短时间激烈活动的个体相似。
Translation: In terms of the physical activity index, an individual who engages in several hours of light activity each day may have a score similar to that of someone who participates in short periods of vigorous activity daily.

Query_Text_cn: 与之相对，代谢当量评分则可鉴别从事中和重体力活动的个体；从事数小时轻微体力活动的个体其评分要低于短时间重体力活动的个体。
Translation: In contrast, the metabolic equivalent score can distinguish individuals engaged in moderate and heavy physical activities; those who perform several hours of light physical activity have lower scores than those who engage in short periods of intense physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 询问患者目前吸烟情况、每日吸烟量及吸烟年限。
Translation: Inquire about the patient's current smoking status, daily cigarette consumption, and the number of years they have been smoking.

Query_Text_cn: 对于既往吸烟者，确定其戒烟年份、吸烟年限以及每日吸烟量。
Translation: For former smokers, determine the year they quit smoking, the duration of their smoking history, and their daily cigarette consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 既往和目前饮酒通过每周饮酒次数计算，定义为葡萄酒(每杯4盎司)、啤酒(每罐或每瓶12盎司)或白酒(每口1盎司)，以上均相当于每次饮用11g酒精。
Translation: Past and current alcohol consumption was calculated based on the number of drinking occasions per week, defined as wine (4 ounces per glass), beer (12 ounces per can or bottle), or spirits (1 ounce per shot), each equivalent to 11 grams of alcohol per occasion.

Query_Text_cn: 阿斯匹林或其他非甾体抗炎药的使用通过询问卷确定，包括各种已知的非甾体抗炎药。
Translation: The use of aspirin or other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs was determined through questionnaires, including various known nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.

Query_Text_cn: 因为新药投入使用，研究期问问卷清单亦需不断升级修订。
Translation: With the introduction of new drugs, the questionnaire list used during the research period must also be continuously updated and revised.

Query_Text_cn: 患者需填写使用的具体药物、每日剂量、使用时间(年为单位)。
Translation: Patients are required to provide the specific medications used, daily dosage, and duration of use (in years).

Query_Text_cn: 根据目前使用情况(从不使用比偶尔使用或每日使用)和使用时间对资料进行分析。
Translation: Analyze the data based on current usage patterns (ranging from never used to occasional or daily use) and duration of use.

Query_Text_cn: 既往胆囊切除病史以及手术时间亦予确定。
Translation: The history of previous cholecystectomy and the timing of the surgery were also confirmed.

Query_Text_cn: 血清胆固醇用空腹血标本测量。
Translation: Serum cholesterol is measured using fasting blood samples.

Query_Text_cn: 研究数据库的管理和所有统计学分析均采用SAS软件，6.12版(SASInstituteInc，Carry，NC)。
Translation: All database management and statistical analyses were performed using SAS software, version 6.12 (SAS Institute Inc., Cary, NC).

Query_Text_cn: 描述性统计学分析包括分类数据率和比例的计算，以及连续数据均值和SEs的计算。
Translation: Descriptive statistical analysis includes the calculation of rates and proportions for categorical data, as well as the calculation of means and standard errors (SEs) for continuous data.

Query_Text_cn: 采用标准的logistic回归法将相对危险计算为优势比和95％可信区间。
Translation: Relative risk was calculated as odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals using standard logistic regression methods.

Query_Text_cn: 在分析饮食和其他连续变量时，参试者按最低至最高5分位分组，以最低5分位作为参照组。
Translation: When analyzing diet and other continuous variables, participants were grouped into quintiles from lowest to highest, with the lowest quintile serving as the reference group.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食变量首先校正年龄，然后是年龄加总能量摄人和病史因素(家族史、体重指数、吸烟、饮酒、体力活动指数和非甾体抗炎药的使用)。
Translation: Dietary variables were first adjusted for age, followed by adjustment for age plus total energy intake and medical history factors (family history, body mass index, smoking, alcohol consumption, physical activity index, and use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs).

Query_Text_cn: 非饮食危险因素校正年龄。
Translation: Age adjusted for non-dietary risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 研究的基本目的是，在一个多变量模型中评估有关危险因素的相对重要性。
Translation: The fundamental purpose of the study is to assess the relative importance of risk factors within a multivariate model.

Query_Text_cn: 这些因素可分成几类，其中包括多个测量指标。
Translation: These factors can be categorized into several groups, each comprising multiple measurement indicators.

Query_Text_cn: 多变量模型的建立要求变量选择以避免冗余和过度专一问题。
Translation: The construction of multivariate models requires careful variable selection to avoid redundancy and excessive specificity.

Query_Text_cn: 如果结果不明确，则采用一种逐步回归统计过程在各类因素间选择最具统计学关联的变量。
Translation: If the results are inconclusive, a stepwise regression statistical process will be used to select the variables with the strongest statistical association among various factors.

Query_Text_cn: 多变量模型包括以下变量：家族史(≥1个一级亲属患结直肠癌比没有组)；体重指数(连续变量，按5单位增量)；体力活动指数(连续变量，按5单位增量)；吸烟(目前吸烟比从不吸烟或既往吸烟)；饮酒(连续变量，以每周饮酒数为单位)；非甾体抗炎药的使用(用过一种比从未使用)；牛肉、猪肉、羊肉作为主餐(连续变量，作为总能量摄人百分数)，代表饮食因素之脂肪摄入水平；谷物纤维(连续变量，按1g增量)作为纤维变量；维生素D(连续变量，按100IU增量)。
Translation: The multivariable model includes the following variables: family history (having ≥1 first-degree relative with colorectal cancer versus none); body mass index (continuous variable, per 5-unit increment); physical activity index (continuous variable, per 5-unit increment); smoking status (current smoker versus never or former smoker); alcohol consumption (continuous variable, measured as drinks per week); use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (ever used versus never used); beef, pork, or lamb as a main dish (continuous variable, expressed as a percentage of total energy intake), representing dietary fat intake; cereal fiber (continuous variable, per 1 g increment) as the fiber variable; and vitamin D (continuous variable, per 100 IU increment).

Query_Text_cn: 对于所有分析均以P小于0.05作为具有统计显著性的标准。
Translation: For all analyses, a p-value of less than 0.05 was considered statistically significant.

Query_Text_cn: 总共3121例患者接受了直到盲肠的全结肠镜检。
Translation: A total of 3,121 patients underwent a complete colonoscopy up to the cecum.

Query_Text_cn: 男性患者占该队列的96.8％，所以该结果不适用于女性。
Translation: Male patients accounted for 96.8% of this cohort; therefore, the results are not applicable to females.

Query_Text_cn: 根据发现之最坏的结肠组织学病灶对患者进行分类。
Translation: Patients were classified according to the most severe histological lesion found in the colon.

Query_Text_cn: 1441例患者无结肠息肉，118例(3.8％)患者有非腺瘤病灶，391例(12.5％)有增生性息肉，842例(27.0％)有1或1个以上直径小于1厘米的管状腺瘤。
Translation: 1,441 patients had no colonic polyps, 118 patients (3.8%) had non-adenomatous lesions, 391 patients (12.5%) had hyperplastic polyps, and 842 patients (27.0%) had one or more tubular adenomas less than 1 cm in diameter.

Query_Text_cn: 作为分析的内容，329(10.5％)例患者至少有一个进展期肿瘤。
Translation: As part of the analysis, 329 patients (10.5%) had at least one advanced-stage tumor.

Query_Text_cn: 将这些患者与1441例无结肠息肉生长的患者进行比较。
Translation: These patients were compared with 1,441 patients without colonic polyp growth.

Query_Text_cn: 所有患者均获得完整的病史信息。
Translation: Complete medical history information was obtained for all patients.

Query_Text_cn: 312例进展期肿瘤患者(94.8％)和1359例没有肿瘤的患者(94.3％)获得完整的饮食信息。
Translation: Complete dietary information was obtained for 312 patients with advanced tumors (94.8%) and 1,359 patients without tumors (94.3%).

Query_Text_cn: 进展期肿瘤患者的年龄大于无肿瘤患者(65.1岁比62.7岁；P小于0.001)。
Translation: The age of patients with advanced tumors was higher than that of patients without tumors (65.1 years vs. 62.7 years; P<0.001).

Query_Text_cn: 所有的优势比均校正了年龄。
Translation: All advantage ratios have been adjusted for age.

Query_Text_cn: 我们总结了病史危险因素的年龄校正分析结果。
Translation: We have summarized the age-adjusted analysis results of medical history risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 一级亲属至少有1人患结直肠癌的患者罹患进展期肿瘤的危险增加(OR，1.68；95％CI，1.21～2.31)，若有2位一级亲属患结直肠癌其危险性更高。
Translation: Patients with at least one first-degree relative diagnosed with colorectal cancer have an increased risk of developing advanced tumors (OR, 1.68; 95% CI, 1.21–2.31), and the risk is even higher if two first-degree relatives are affected.

Query_Text_cn: 白人与黑人和西班牙裔患者比较，罹患进展期肿瘤的危险并无显著差异。
Translation: There was no significant difference in the risk of developing advanced-stage tumors between white patients and Black or Hispanic patients.

Query_Text_cn: 体重指数与罹患进展期肿瘤的危险并无相关性。
Translation: There is no association between body mass index and the risk of developing advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动指数大于36与罹患进展期肿瘤危险降低相关(OR，0.67；95％CI，0.49～0.93)。
Translation: A physical activity index greater than 36 is associated with a reduced risk of developing advanced-stage tumors (OR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.49–0.93).

Query_Text_cn: 每周代谢当量与罹患风险无相关性。
Translation: There is no correlation between weekly metabolic equivalents and the risk of incidence.

Query_Text_cn: 罹患进展期肿瘤的患者与无瘤患者血清胆固醇水平或胆囊切除率无差异。
Translation: There is no difference in serum cholesterol levels or cholecystectomy rates between patients with advanced tumors and those without tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 目前吸烟与危险增加明显相关(OR，2.12；95％CI，1.49～3.01)。
Translation: Currently, smoking is significantly associated with an increased risk (OR 2.12; 95% CI, 1.49–3.01).

Query_Text_cn: 吸烟超过25包一年的目前吸烟者以及戒烟前吸烟超过49包年的过去吸烟者危险也增加。
Translation: Current smokers with a smoking history of more than 25 pack-years, as well as former smokers who had smoked more than 49 pack-years before quitting, also face increased risk.

Query_Text_cn: 如果患者每日平均饮酒超过一杯，那么目前酒精消费也与危险增加相关(OR，2.12；96％CI，1.44～3.14)。
Translation: If the patient consumes more than one drink per day on average, current alcohol consumption is also associated with an increased risk (OR, 2.12; 96% CI, 1.44–3.14).

Query_Text_cn: 偶尔使用或每日使用非甾体抗炎药与罹患进展期肿瘤的危险减少相关。
Translation: Occasional or daily use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs is associated with a reduced risk of developing advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 以非甾体抗炎药的使用时间作为一个连续变量进行分析，进展期肿瘤的年龄校正优势比与使用时间的增加明显相关(OR，使用10年者为0.83；95％CI，0.73～0.95)。
Translation: When the duration of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) use was analyzed as a continuous variable, the age-adjusted odds ratio for advanced tumors was significantly associated with increased duration of use (OR for 10 years of use, 0.83; 95% CI, 0.73–0.95).

Query_Text_cn: 饮食变量通过年龄、总能量摄人和病史危险因素加以校正。
Translation: Dietary variables were adjusted for age, total energy intake, and risk factors related to medical history.

Query_Text_cn: 总动物脂肪摄取与进展期肿瘤呈不显著的弱相关关系。
Translation: Total animal fat intake is weakly and insignificantly correlated with advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 红肉脂肪摄取量在最高5分位者与危险明显相关。
Translation: Red meat fat intake in the highest quintile is significantly associated with risk.

Query_Text_cn: 以牛肉、猪肉或羊肉作为主食每周进食≥5次的患者与未消费这类食物的患者相比，罹患进展期肿瘤的相对危险增加(OR，2.73；95％CI，1.05～3.63)。
Translation: Patients who consumed beef, pork, or lamb as a staple food five or more times per week had an increased relative risk of developing advanced-stage tumors compared to those who did not consume these foods (OR, 2.73; 95% CI, 1.05–3.63).

Query_Text_cn: 在摄人的所有纤维成分中，只有谷物纤维与进展期肿瘤危险降低相关。
Translation: Among all types of dietary fiber intake, only cereal fiber is associated with a reduced risk of advanced tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 总钙摄人量、总叶酸摄人量和维生素D摄人量在最高5分位的患者，与摄人量在最低5分位的患者比较，罹患进展期肿瘤的相对危险显著降低。
Translation: Patients in the highest quintile of total calcium intake, total folate intake, and vitamin D intake had a significantly reduced relative risk of developing advanced tumors compared to those in the lowest quintile of intake.

Query_Text_cn: 日常多种维生素的消耗也与危险降低明显相关(OR，0.75；95％CI，0.56～0.99)。
Translation: The regular consumption of multivitamins was also significantly associated with a reduced risk (OR, 0.75; 95% CI, 0.56–0.99).

Query_Text_cn: 除目前吸烟和既往吸烟外，两组不存在其他具有明显区别的危险变量。
Translation: Apart from current and former smoking, there were no other significantly different risk variables between the two groups.

Query_Text_cn: 与无息肉的对照组相比，既往(OR，1.65；95％CI，1.23～2.23)和目前吸烟者(OR，2.71；95％CI，1.93～3.81)发生增生性息肉的危险明显增加。
Translation: Compared with the control group without polyps, both former smokers (OR, 1.65; 95% CI, 1.23–2.23) and current smokers (OR, 2.71; 95% CI, 1.93–3.81) had a significantly increased risk of developing hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 每日应用非甾体抗炎药与发生增生性息肉的优势比降低有关(OR，0.75；95％CI，0.56～0.99)。
Translation: Daily use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs is associated with a reduced odds ratio for the development of proliferative polyps (OR, 0.75; 95% CI, 0.56–0.99).

Query_Text_cn: 将增生性息肉患者的危险变量与进展期肿瘤患者比较，其结果与无息肉患者基本相同。
Translation: When comparing the risk variables of patients with hyperplastic polyps to those with advanced tumors, the results are essentially the same as those observed in patients without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 年龄增加患进展期肿瘤的危险亦增加，而维生素D和多种维生素的摄入增加则与危险降低相关。
Translation: The risk of developing advanced-stage tumors increases with age, while higher intake of vitamin D and multivitamins is associated with a reduced risk.

Query_Text_cn: 其余关系无统计学显著性。
Translation: The remaining relationships are not statistically significant.

Query_Text_cn: 研究建立了包括每个病史因素和每个饮食组一个因素的多变量模型。
Translation: The study established a multivariate model that included one factor for each medical history variable and one factor for each dietary group.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食变量是通过组内逐步回归法进行选择的。
Translation: Dietary variables were selected using stepwise regression within groups.

Query_Text_cn: 分析将谷物纤维维生素D以及以牛、羊、猪肉为主的饮食(根据总能量摄入百分比)确定为模型的最佳侯选变量。
Translation: Analysis identified cereal fiber, vitamin D, and a diet primarily based on beef, mutton, and pork (according to the percentage of total energy intake) as the best candidate variables for the model.

Query_Text_cn: 在多变量分析中，与进展期肿瘤危险增加明显相关的因素包括家族史、目前吸烟、中到大量饮酒。
Translation: In multivariate analysis, factors significantly associated with an increased risk of advanced-stage tumors include family history, current smoking, and moderate to heavy alcohol consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 与进展期肿瘤危险降低明显相关的因素包括非甾体抗炎药的应用、谷物纤维的摄入和维生素D。
Translation: Factors significantly associated with a reduced risk of advanced tumors include the use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, intake of cereal fiber, and vitamin D.

Query_Text_cn: 在多变量分析中，维生素D的摄入较总钙和总叶酸的摄入更为重要。
Translation: In multivariate analysis, vitamin D intake is more important than total calcium and total folate intake.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动水平较高与危险降低存在临界的无统计学显著性的相关性。
Translation: A higher level of physical activity is associated with a borderline, non-statistically significant reduction in risk.

Query_Text_cn: 这项研究首次在无症状的接受全结肠检查的个体对进展期结肠肿瘤的诸多危险因素进行了横断面研究。
Translation: This study is the first cross-sectional investigation of multiple risk factors for advanced colorectal tumors in asymptomatic individuals undergoing total colon examination.

Query_Text_cn: 我们选择进展期结肠癌作为研究的终点是为了在最有可能发生结肠癌的患者明确相关的危险因素其目标是建立相应的预防策略。
Translation: We chose advanced colon cancer as the endpoint of our study in order to identify relevant risk factors in patients most likely to develop colon cancer, with the aim of establishing corresponding prevention strategies.

Query_Text_cn: 由于很多进展期肿瘤患者在其终生并不发生结肠癌，因此该研究终点受到一定的限制。
Translation: Since many patients with advanced-stage tumors do not develop colorectal cancer during their lifetime, the study endpoint is subject to certain limitations.

Query_Text_cn: 有几种危险因素以往并无相关资料。
Translation: There are several risk factors for which no previous data exists.

Query_Text_cn: 以前的研究发现体重指数、血清胆固醇水平以及既往胆囊切除与结直肠肿瘤仅有很弱的相关性。
Translation: Previous studies have found that body mass index, serum cholesterol levels, and prior cholecystectomy are only weakly correlated with colorectal tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 在本研究，这些变量与进展期结肠肿瘤并无显著关联，但是亦不能排除中度相关性。
Translation: In this study, these variables were not significantly associated with advanced-stage colon tumors; however, a moderate correlation cannot be ruled out.

Query_Text_cn: 本文两种评估体力活动的方法所获结果相互矛盾。
Translation: The results obtained from the two methods used to assess physical activity in this study are contradictory.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动指数记分较高的患者，或者为较长时间轻微体力活动或者为短时间剧烈活动，罹患进展期结肠肿瘤的年龄校正危险较低。
Translation: Patients with higher physical activity index scores, whether due to prolonged periods of light activity or short bursts of vigorous activity, have a lower age-adjusted risk of developing advanced-stage colon tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 不同代谢当量记分5分位患者罹患进展期结肠肿瘤的危险并无差异。
Translation: There is no difference in the risk of developing advanced colorectal tumors among patients in the five quintiles of metabolic equivalent scores.

Query_Text_cn: 这表明，个体有可能从长期轻微体力活动获益，就像从短时间剧烈体力活动获益一样。
Translation: This suggests that individuals may benefit from prolonged periods of light physical activity just as they do from short bouts of vigorous physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 在多变量分析中，体力活动仅有临界的没有统计学显著性的获益。
Translation: In multivariate analysis, physical activity showed only marginal, non-statistically significant benefits.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食脂肪和纤维素食物与进展期肿瘤的关系并不肯定。
Translation: The relationship between dietary fats and fiber-rich foods and advanced-stage tumors is not definitive.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的分析发现，与总脂肪摄入相关的发生进展期结肠肿瘤的危险并无显著增加，与从红肉脂肪摄取相关的危险增高则呈临界性，没有统计学显著性。
Translation: Our analysis found that there was no significant increase in the risk of developing advanced colorectal tumors associated with total fat intake, while the risk associated with fat intake from red meat showed a borderline increase but was not statistically significant.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然我们未发现脂肪摄入与进展期结肠肿瘤显著相关，但是我们也不能排除脂肪摄入可以促进有先兆的腺瘤恶变从而导致结肠癌发病率增高的可能性。
Translation: Although we did not find a significant association between fat intake and advanced colorectal tumors, we cannot rule out the possibility that fat intake may promote the malignant transformation of precancerous adenomas, thereby increasing the incidence of colorectal cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 现有资料显示在单因素分析模型中，谷物纤维摄入在最高5分位的患者发生进展期结肠肿瘤的危险较低，而且在校正后的多变量模型中这种关系仍然存在。
Translation: Available data indicate that, in the univariate analysis model, patients in the highest quintile of cereal fiber intake have a lower risk of developing advanced colorectal neoplasia, and this association remains significant in the adjusted multivariate model.

Query_Text_cn: 之前的干预研究在3~4年的研究期间未能证明纤维饮食的保护作用。
Translation: Previous intervention studies failed to demonstrate the protective effect of a fiber-rich diet during the 3 to 4-year study period.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，这些研究采用(大或小)腺瘤作为研究终点，评价的是短期干预的效果。
Translation: However, these studies used (large or small) adenomas as study endpoints, evaluating only the short-term effects of the interventions.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究结果与这些研究结论并不矛盾。
Translation: Our research findings are not inconsistent with these study conclusions.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的资料表明，大量长期摄入谷物纤维可阻止进展期肿瘤的发展。
Translation: Our data indicate that a high long-term intake of cereal fiber can inhibit the progression of advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 维生素D是一种重要的保护因素。
Translation: Vitamin D is an important protective factor.

Query_Text_cn: 以往已有几项研究显示，在体外实验，维生素D，特别是其活性形式(1,25-羟基维生素D)对结肠粘膜细胞有抗增殖作用，几项临床研究也证实其有益效应。
Translation: Previous studies have shown that, in vitro, vitamin D—particularly its active form (1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D)—exerts antiproliferative effects on colonic mucosal cells, and several clinical studies have also confirmed its beneficial effects.

Query_Text_cn: 之前已有一些研究发现补充钙对预防腺瘤发生具有临界性益处。
Translation: Previous studies have found that calcium supplementation has a marginal benefit in preventing the occurrence of adenomas.

Query_Text_cn: 在我们的多变量分析中，左右钙摄取的饮食维生素D是一种有益的因素。
Translation: In our multivariate analysis, dietary vitamin D, which influences calcium intake, is a beneficial factor.

Query_Text_cn: 我们未测量日光浴的作用。日光浴能影响25-羟基维生素D水平。
Translation: We did not measure the effects of sunbathing. Sunbathing can affect 25-hydroxyvitamin D levels.

Query_Text_cn: 这些数据提示，维生素D可能是一种重要的保护因素。应进一步研究确定饮食和日光浴的相对作用。
Translation: These data suggest that vitamin D may be an important protective factor. Further research is needed to determine the relative roles of diet and sun exposure.

Query_Text_cn: 总叶酸摄入量与多种维生素摄人的影响在分析中难于分开；在单变量分析中两者都有一定保护作用。
Translation: It is difficult to separate the effects of total folate intake from those of multivitamin intake in the analysis; in univariate analysis, both show a certain protective effect.

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现1或多个一级亲属结直肠癌病史与进展期肿瘤显著相关，这一点在许多其他研究也得到证实。
Translation: We found that a history of colorectal cancer in one or more first-degree relatives was significantly associated with advanced-stage tumors, a finding that has also been confirmed in many other studies.

Query_Text_cn: 我们对家族成员在60岁之前或之后诊断癌症的参试者发生进展期肿瘤的危险进行了比较，结果未见显著差异。
Translation: We compared the risk of advanced tumors among participants whose family members were diagnosed with cancer before or after the age of 60, and found no significant difference.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，我们的结果对下述建议提供了支持：所有一级亲属有结直肠癌的患者应作为高危人群，并为之提供结肠镜筛查。
Translation: Therefore, our results support the following recommendation: all first-degree relatives of patients with colorectal cancer should be considered a high-risk population and offered colonoscopic screening.

Query_Text_cn: 与以前的研究一致，目前吸烟以及每周饮酒7杯以上与危险增加强烈相关。
Translation: Consistent with previous studies, current smoking and consuming more than seven alcoholic drinks per week are strongly associated with an increased risk.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管其机制尚不明确，但这些数据为提倡戒烟以及减少饮酒提供了进一步的理由。
Translation: Although the mechanism remains unclear, these data provide further justification for advocating smoking cessation and reducing alcohol consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 与不使用非甾体抗炎药的患者相比，常规应用非甾体抗炎药的患者发生进展期肿瘤的危险较低，此点亦与以往许多研究相符。
Translation: Compared with patients who do not use nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), those who routinely use NSAIDs have a lower risk of developing advanced-stage tumors, which is consistent with the findings of many previous studies.

Query_Text_cn: 药物使用时间与危险降低明显相关。
Translation: The duration of medication use is significantly associated with a reduction in risk.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究提出COX-2抑制药物的应用问题。研究显示，这种药物可以减缓家族性息肉病患者腺瘤的进展。
Translation: This study raises concerns regarding the use of COX-2 inhibitors. Research indicates that these drugs can slow the progression of adenomas in patients with familial polyposis.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究超过80％的受试者已经使用阿斯匹林作为预防心血管疾病的药物，或使用其他非甾体抗炎药治疗关节炎和疼痛。
Translation: In this study, more than 80% of the subjects had already used aspirin as a preventive medication for cardiovascular diseases or had used other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs to treat arthritis and pain.

Query_Text_cn: 并且可能还有潜在的危害。
Translation: And there may also be potential risks.

Query_Text_cn: 这些药物有引发消化道溃疡、胃肠道出血及其他副作用的危险，必须权衡其利弊。
Translation: These medications carry the risk of causing gastrointestinal ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, and other side effects, so their benefits and risks must be carefully weighed.

Query_Text_cn: 所以对单独应用阿斯匹林或其他非甾体抗炎药预防结肠肿瘤仍需进一步研究。
Translation: Therefore, further research is needed on the use of aspirin or other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs alone for the prevention of colorectal tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 在二级分析研究中，我们对最重病变为1或多个增生性息肉患者的危险因素进行了研究。
Translation: In the secondary analysis, we investigated the risk factors for patients whose most severe lesion was one or more proliferative polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 多数指南均将增生性息肉看作一种良性病变，并有几项大规模筛查研究发现远端增生性息肉并不是近端肿瘤的危险因素。
Translation: Most guidelines regard hyperplastic polyps as a benign lesion, and several large-scale screening studies have found that distal hyperplastic polyps are not a risk factor for proximal neoplasia.

Query_Text_cn: 我们假设如果增生性息肉是偶发的，且无肿瘤增殖成分，那么增生性息肉患者应该与无息肉患者非常相似。
Translation: We assume that if hyperplastic polyps are incidental and lack neoplastic proliferative components, patients with hyperplastic polyps should be very similar to those without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 以前并无研究评价增生性息肉是否存在可资鉴别危险的变量。
Translation: Previously, no studies have evaluated whether there are identifiable risk variables for distinguishing hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究表明单纯增生性息肉患者的结果与无息肉对照组近似。
Translation: Our study indicates that the outcomes of patients with simple hyperplastic polyps are similar to those of the control group without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 只有既往或目前吸烟者是具有重要意义的危险因素。
Translation: Only current or former smokers are significant risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 有趣的是，吸烟是仅有的既与增生性息肉又与进展期肿瘤相关的危险因素。
Translation: Interestingly, smoking is the only risk factor associated with both proliferative polyps and advanced tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 吸烟可以促进DNA过甲基化，进展期腺瘤的进展则可能取决于甲基四氢叶酸还原酶表型。
Translation: Smoking can promote DNA hypermethylation, and the progression of advanced adenomas may depend on the methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase phenotype.

Query_Text_cn: 当我们将进展期肿瘤队列与增生性息肉组患者比较时，结果发现维生素D和多种维生素摄人量较高与进展期肿瘤危险降低相关。
Translation: When comparing the advanced neoplasia cohort with patients in the group with hyperplastic polyps, we found that higher intake of vitamin D and multivitamins was associated with a reduced risk of advanced neoplasia.

Query_Text_cn: 其他差异无统计学显著性。
Translation: No other differences were statistically significant.

Query_Text_cn: 因为这属于二级分析结论，所以我们的研究结论不足以检出这种差异。
Translation: Because this falls under secondary analysis conclusions, our research findings are insufficient to detect such differences.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，进展期肿瘤组患者也可能同时罹患增生性息肉，因此两组可能有一定重叠。
Translation: In addition, patients in the advanced-stage tumor group may also have hyperplastic polyps, so there may be some overlap between the two groups.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究也有几个重要的局限性。
Translation: Our study also has several important limitations.

Query_Text_cn: 首先，这是一项横断面研究。
Translation: First of all, this is a cross-sectional study.

Query_Text_cn: 研究设置的某些危险因素可能与进展期肿瘤的发生并无相关性，但却可能为其他继发病灶危险因素。
Translation: Some risk factors identified in the study may not be associated with the occurrence of advanced-stage tumors, but they could serve as risk factors for other secondary lesions.

Query_Text_cn: 研究设计了对这组人群的随访。
Translation: A follow-up study was designed for this group of people.

Query_Text_cn: 研究的重点在于进展期肿瘤高危人群的危险因素。
Translation: The focus of the research is on the risk factors for high-risk populations with advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 在这组人群，癌症的进展并非不可避免，并且其他因素也可能促进进展期肿瘤向癌症的转化。
Translation: In this group, cancer progression is not inevitable, and other factors may also contribute to the transformation of advanced-stage tumors into cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 第二，某些研究结果可能会遭受记忆偏差因素的影响。
Translation: Second, some research findings may be affected by recall bias.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食频率调查在很多研究均是有效的，但是该调查并未测量饮食习惯在研究期间是否发生变化。
Translation: Dietary frequency surveys are effective in many studies; however, they do not measure whether dietary habits change during the study period.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究有38.7％的患者报告过去l0年饮食结构发生了重大变化。
Translation: In this study, 38.7% of patients reported significant changes in their dietary patterns over the past 10 years.

Query_Text_cn: 在进展期肿瘤患者和非进展期肿瘤患者，饮食结构的变化率近似。
Translation: The rate of change in dietary structure is similar between patients with progressive tumors and those with non-progressive tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，我们不能排除继往饮食习惯影响目前进展期肿瘤危险的可能性。
Translation: Therefore, we cannot rule out the possibility that previous dietary habits may influence the current risk of advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 第三，我们的结果只适用于男性人群；对女性的危险因素还需进一步研究。
Translation: Third, our results are only applicable to the male population; further research is needed to identify risk factors for females.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，退伍军人亦可能不同于美国其他男性人群。
Translation: In addition, veterans may also differ from other male populations in the United States.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，我们也认识到混淆变量分析的复杂性。
Translation: Finally, we also recognize the complexity of confounding variable analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，这项研究的一个显著特点就是包括了所有的重要病史和饮食危险因素。
Translation: Therefore, a notable feature of this study is the inclusion of all major medical histories and dietary risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究的一项重要举措是所有无症状患者均进行了完全的结肠镜检查，以确定有危险的人群，这减少了错误分类的可能性。
Translation: An important measure in this study was that all asymptomatic patients underwent a complete colonoscopy to identify individuals at risk, which reduced the likelihood of misclassification.

Query_Text_cn: 研究有足够的把握度对诸多潜在混淆危险变量进行检测。
Translation: The study is sufficiently confident in detecting numerous potential confounding variables.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究是首次确定维生素D为保护因素的研究之一。
Translation: This study is one of the first to identify vitamin D as a protective factor.

Query_Text_cn: 因为维生素D和钙是混合分析的，所以只有研究样本量足够大才能检测两种物质各自的相对受益。
Translation: Because vitamin D and calcium are analyzed together, only a sufficiently large sample size can detect the relative benefits of each substance individually.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究能够检测肥胖和体力活动的相对危险和受益。
Translation: Our research is able to assess the relative risks and benefits of obesity and physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的结论是肥胖本身并不是个有意义的危险因素，而常规体力锻炼则具有保护作用。
Translation: Our conclusion is that obesity itself is not a significant risk factor, whereas regular physical exercise has a protective effect.

Query_Text_cn: 以往曾有许多研究提及高脂饮食或高纤维饮食的危险和受益。
Translation: Many previous studies have discussed the risks and benefits of high-fat or high-fiber diets.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的资料显示，大量谷物纤维具有保护作用，而从肉类纤维大量摄取脂肪则可增加进展期肿瘤的危险。
Translation: Our data indicate that a high intake of cereal fiber has a protective effect, whereas consuming large amounts of fat from meat fiber may increase the risk of advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 吸烟和饮酒的危险性现在已有一项大型多变量分析证实。
Translation: The risks of smoking and drinking have now been confirmed by a large-scale multivariate analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 此前曾有许多研究分析了这些变量，但未考虑其他危险因素。
Translation: Many previous studies have analyzed these variables but have not taken other risk factors into account.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，我们发现最重病变为增生性息肉的患者其结果与无息肉的对照非常类似。
Translation: Finally, we found that the outcomes of patients with the most severe lesions being hyperplastic polyps were very similar to those of the polyp-free controls.

Query_Text_cn: 对于增生性息肉，过去或目前吸烟是仅有的具有显著意义的危险因素。
Translation: For hyperplastic polyps, past or current smoking is the only significant risk factor.

Query_Text_cn: 这些新的信息与临床应将增生性息肉当作无意义结肠病灶对待的建议相符。
Translation: This new information aligns with clinical recommendations to treat hyperplastic polyps as insignificant colonic lesions.

Query_Text_cn: 总之，这些结果表明，有几种危险因素与进展期结肠肿瘤的发生正相关。包括：结直肠癌家族史、目前吸烟以及目前中到大量饮酒。
Translation: In summary, these results indicate that several risk factors are positively associated with the occurrence of advanced colorectal tumors, including a family history of colorectal cancer, current smoking, and current moderate to heavy alcohol consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 存在负相关的因素包括非甾体抗炎药的使用，高水平谷物纤维和维生素D的摄取。
Translation: Negatively correlated factors include the use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, high intake of cereal fiber, and vitamin D.

Query_Text_cn: 临界的、无统计学显著性的保护因素包括：适当的体力活动、总钙摄取量以及总叶酸摄取量和多种维生素摄取。
Translation: Marginally protective factors without statistical significance included adequate physical activity, total calcium intake, total folate intake, and multivitamin intake.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究并不是为证明调整危险因素可改变结肠肿瘤危险而设计的。
Translation: Our study was not designed to demonstrate that modifying risk factors can alter the risk of colorectal tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管如此，我们仍谨慎建议，将戒烟、减少饮酒、日常体力锻炼作为健康维持措施的一部分。
Translation: Nevertheless, we still cautiously recommend including smoking cessation, reducing alcohol consumption, and regular physical exercise as part of health maintenance measures.

Query_Text_cn: 服用维生素D加钙或者规律食用奶制品是对患者有益的方案。
Translation: Taking vitamin D with calcium or regularly consuming dairy products is a beneficial approach for patients.

Query_Text_cn: 每日服用多种维生素是否有益仍不确定，还需要进一步研究证实，但是它与危险很低相关。
Translation: It remains uncertain whether taking multiple vitamins daily is beneficial, and further research is needed to confirm this; however, it is associated with very low risk.

Query_Text_cn: 与结直肠癌家族史的明显相关性，对目前提出的有关开展结肠镜筛查的建议提供了支持。
Translation: The clear correlation with a family history of colorectal cancer provides support for the current recommendations regarding the implementation of colonoscopy screening.

Query_Text_cn: 必需仔细权衡非甾体抗炎药的潜在保护作用及其危险。
Translation: The potential protective effects and risks of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs must be carefully weighed.

Query_Text_cn: 仍需进一步的研究以便确定基线结肠镜检查是否可以预测进展期肿瘤的发生或复发。
Translation: Further research is needed to determine whether baseline colonoscopy can predict the occurrence or recurrence of advanced tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食：饮食因素评估用半定量食物频率调查表进行，以往研究已证实其可靠性。
Translation: Diet: Dietary factors were assessed using a semi-quantitative food frequency questionnaire, the reliability of which has been confirmed by previous studies.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动：用两种方法评定日常体力活动以及偶尔发生的大运动量体力活动。
Translation: Physical activity: Assess daily physical activity and occasional high-intensity physical activity using two methods.

Query_Text_cn: 饮酒、吸烟和非甾体抗炎药：确定患者既往及目前吸烟情况。
Translation: Alcohol consumption, smoking, and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs: Determine the patient's past and current smoking status.

Query_Text_cn: 其他因素：体重指数计算为体重(kg)/身高(m2)。
Translation: Other factors: Body mass index is calculated as weight (kg)/height (m²).

Query_Text_cn: 背景一些大型观察性研究、小型前瞻性研究以及随机临床试验的事后分析已经表明，他汀类药物时慢性心力衰竭患者有益。
Translation: Background: Some large observational studies, small prospective studies, and post hoc analyses of randomized clinical trials have indicated that statins are beneficial for patients with chronic heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，以前的研究在方法学上说服力较弱。
Translation: However, previous studies have been methodologically less convincing.

Query_Text_cn: 作者对瑞舒伐他汀在心力衰竭患者中的有效性与安全性进行了观察。
Translation: The author conducted an observation on the efficacy and safety of rosuvastatin in patients with heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 方法在意失利的326个心脏中心和31个内科中心进行了一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验。
Translation: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial was conducted at 326 cardiology centers and 31 internal medicine centers that were concerned about the loss.

Query_Text_cn: 在不限定患者病因以及左室射血分数的情况下，纳入年龄≥18岁、纽约心脏协会(NYHA)心功能分级为Ⅱ~Ⅳ级的慢性心力衰竭患者作为研究对象，利用隐蔽设计的计算机控制电话随机分组系统将患者随机分组，分别给予瑞舒伐他汀10mg/d(n=2285)或安慰剂(n=2289)治疗。
Translation: Regardless of the etiology of the patients and left ventricular ejection fraction, chronic heart failure patients aged ≥18 years with New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional class II–IV were enrolled as study subjects. Using a concealed, computer-controlled telephone randomization system, patients were randomly assigned to receive either rosuvastatin 10 mg/day (n=2285) or placebo (n=2289) treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 试验中对患者进行了中位期为3.9年(IQR3.0~4.4)的随访。
Translation: Patients were followed up for a median period of 3.9 years (IQR 3.0–4.4) during the trial.

Query_Text_cn: 主要终点包括至死亡发生的时间以及至死亡或因心血管原因住院的时间。
Translation: The primary endpoints include time to death and time to death or hospitalization due to cardiovascular causes.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究已在ClinicaITrials.gov注册，编码为NCT00336336。
Translation: This study has been registered on ClinicalTrials.gov with the identifier NCT00336336.
All-cause mortality was 29% (657 cases) in the rosuvastatin group and 28% (644 cases) in the placebo group (adjusted HR 1.00, 95.5% CI 0.898–1.122, p=0.943).

Query_Text_cn: 瑞舒伐他汀组中1305例(57%)患者发生死亡或因心血管原因住院，安慰剂组中则为1283例(56%)（校正HR1.01，99%CI0.908~1.112，p=0.903）。
Translation: In the rosuvastatin group, 1,305 patients (57%) experienced death or hospitalization due to cardiovascular causes, compared to 1,283 patients (56%) in the placebo group (adjusted HR 1.01, 99% CI 0.908–1.112, p=0.903).

Query_Text_cn: 胃肠道反应是两组共同的最常见不良反应［瑞舒伐他汀组34例(1%)vs安慰剂组44例(2%)］。
Translation: Gastrointestinal reactions were the most common adverse events in both groups [rosuvastatin group: 34 cases (1%) vs placebo group: 44 cases (2%)].

Query_Text_cn: 结论瑞舒伐他汀10mg/d的治疗对任何原因所致慢性心力衰竭患者的临床结果无影响，在这些患者中该药物治疗安全性良好。
Translation: Conclusion: Treatment with rosuvastatin 10 mg/day has no impact on clinical outcomes in patients with chronic heart failure of any cause, and the drug demonstrates good safety in these patients.

Query_Text_cn: 基金意大利SocietaProdottiAntibiotici(SPA)公司、辉瑞制药公司、意大利SigmaTau公司和阿斯利康制药公司。
Translation: The fund includes Italy's Societa Prodotti Antibiotici (SPA), Pfizer Pharmaceuticals, Italy's Sigma-Tau, and AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals.

Query_Text_cn: 对于动脉粥样硬化血栓形成的一级和二级预防，羟甲基二酰辅酶A(HMG-CoA)还原酶抑制剂（即他汀类药物）是过去数十年里被研发并运用于临床实践的最成功药物之一。
Translation: For the primary and secondary prevention of atherothrombosis, 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase inhibitors, commonly known as statins, are among the most successful drugs developed and applied in clinical practice over the past several decades.

Query_Text_cn: 除具有降脂作用外，他汀类药物还被认为有多重效应，其中包括：抗炎、抗肥大、抗纤维化与抗氧化作用；改善内皮功能障碍；抑制神经激素活化；预防心律失常。
Translation: In addition to their lipid-lowering effects, statins are believed to have multiple actions, including anti-inflammatory, anti-hypertrophic, anti-fibrotic, and antioxidant effects; improvement of endothelial dysfunction; inhibition of neurohormonal activation; and prevention of arrhythmias.

Query_Text_cn: 这些效应中多数都能针对心力衰竭复杂病理生理机制的重要部分起效。
Translation: Most of these effects can target key aspects of the complex pathophysiological mechanisms of heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 大型观察性研究、一些对比试验药物与他汀类药物的随机临床试验的事后分析以及小型前瞻性试验已经表明，他汀类药物对心力衰竭患者有益。
Translation: Large observational studies, post-hoc analyses of randomized clinical trials comparing other drugs with statins, and small prospective trials have demonstrated that statins are beneficial for patients with heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，针对他汀类药物观察性试验和随机临床试验的两项荟萃分析证实，应用他汀类药物可使缺血性或非缺血性原因所致心力衰竭患者的心血管死亡率降低。
Translation: In addition, two meta-analyses of observational studies and randomized clinical trials on statins have confirmed that the use of statins can reduce cardiovascular mortality in patients with heart failure caused by either ischemic or non-ischemic etiologies.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，由于以前的研究在方法学上说服力较弱，所以还需要对他汀类药物在心力衰竭患者中的有效性与安全性进行特定观察的随机对照试验。
Translation: However, due to the methodological limitations of previous studies, randomized controlled trials with specific observation are still needed to assess the efficacy and safety of statins in patients with heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 意大利心肌梗死生存研究组(GISSI)决定在不限定病因和左室收缩功能的有症状性心力衰竭患者中进行一项研究，旨在检验使用瑞舒伐他汀的安全性和有效性。
Translation: The Italian Myocardial Infarction Survival Study Group (GISSI) decided to conduct a study in symptomatic heart failure patients without restrictions on etiology or left ventricular systolic function, aiming to evaluate the safety and efficacy of rosuvastatin.

Query_Text_cn: 本试验为一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的多中心研究，有意大利的326个心脏中心和31个内科中心参与（图1）。
Translation: This trial is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter study involving 326 cardiology centers and 31 internal medicine centers in Italy (Figure 1).

Query_Text_cn: GISSI-HF试验的设计已在其他文献中有详细描述，包括随机化分组、监测以及随访过程。
Translation: The design of the GISSI-HF trial has been described in detail in other publications, including randomization, monitoring, and follow-up procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 入选患者为年龄≥18岁的有症状性心力衰竭患者，包括男性和女性，其心功能分级为NYHAⅡ~Ⅳ级，均依照欧洲心脏病学会(ESC)指南进行治疗。
Translation: The selected patients were symptomatic heart failure patients aged 18 years or older, including both males and females, with cardiac function classified as NYHA class II to IV. All patients were treated according to the guidelines of the European Society of Cardiology (ESC).

Query_Text_cn: 患者的左室射血分数(LVEF)在纳入研究前3个月内检测。
Translation: The patient's left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) was measured within three months prior to enrollment in the study.

Query_Text_cn: LVEF>40%的患者必须在之前1年有至少一次因充血性心力衰竭住院的经历才符合纳入标准。
Translation: Patients with an LVEF >40% must have had at least one hospitalization for congestive heart failure in the previous year to meet the inclusion criteria.

Query_Text_cn: 妊娠或哺乳期女性，或者没有采取充分避孕措施的生育期女性。
Translation: Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women of childbearing age who have not taken adequate contraceptive measures.

Query_Text_cn: 所有患者在被纳入前均签署参与研究的书面知情同意书。
Translation: All patients signed a written informed consent form before being enrolled in the study.

Query_Text_cn: 本试验由参与研究机构的当地伦理委员会授权进行。
Translation: This trial was authorized by the local ethics committees of the participating research institutions.

Query_Text_cn: 成立独立的数据安全性监督委员会，对被纳入试验患者的安全及试验进度进行监督。
Translation: An independent Data Safety Monitoring Committee shall be established to oversee the safety of enrolled trial participants and monitor the progress of the trial.

Query_Text_cn: 2002年8月6日至2005年2月28日期间，患者被随机分配服用瑞舒伐他汀(10mg)或与之匹配的安慰剂1片/d。
Translation: Between August 6, 2002 and February 28, 2005, patients were randomly assigned to receive either rosuvastatin (10 mg) or a matching placebo, one tablet per day.

Query_Text_cn: 具体治疗措施分配对所有患者及研究组成员均设盲。
