Translation: The allocation of specific treatment measures was blinded for all patients and members of the study group.

Query_Text_cn: 采用隐蔽设计的计算机控制电话随机分组系统，将合格入选的患者随机分配入不同治疗组（按地点进行分层）。
Translation: A computer-controlled telephone randomization system with concealed design was used to randomly assign eligible patients to different treatment groups, stratified by location.

Query_Text_cn: 计划在随机分组后的1、3、6及12个月时进行临床观察，此后每6个月进行一次直至试验结束。
Translation: Clinical observations are scheduled at 1, 3, 6, and 12 months after randomization, and then every 6 months thereafter until the end of the trial.

Query_Text_cn: 每次的观察包括心血管系统体格检查、生命体征测量、12导联心电图、依从性检查、严重不良事件评估以及血液检验。
Translation: Each observation includes a physical examination of the cardiovascular system, measurement of vital signs, a 12-lead electrocardiogram, compliance check, assessment of serious adverse events, and blood tests.

Query_Text_cn: 在进行这些观察的同时，每6个月提供一次研究治疗。
Translation: While conducting these observations, study treatment will be administered every six months.

Query_Text_cn: 向患者积极推荐已证实对慢性心力衰竭有明确疗效的治疗（如，血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂、β受体阻断剂、利尿药、洋地黄、螺内酯）。
Translation: Actively recommend to patients treatments that have been proven effective for chronic heart failure (such as angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors, beta-blockers, diuretics, digitalis, and spironolactone).

Query_Text_cn: 本研究设计中包括两项联合主要终点：至死亡发生的时间以及至死亡或因心血管原因住院的时间。
Translation: The study design includes two co-primary endpoints: time to death and time to death or hospitalization due to cardiovascular causes.

Query_Text_cn: 次要结果包括：心血管死亡、因任何原因住院或心血管原因死亡、心脏性猝死、因任何原因住院、因心血管原因住院、因心力衰竭住院、心肌梗死以及卒中。
Translation: Secondary outcomes included: cardiovascular death; hospitalization for any cause or cardiovascular death; sudden cardiac death; hospitalization for any cause; hospitalization for cardiovascular causes; hospitalization for heart failure; myocardial infarction; and stroke.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究中记录的所有事件均由一个特设委员会基于预设的定义和程序采用盲法认定。
Translation: All events recorded in this study were adjudicated in a blinded manner by a dedicated committee based on predefined definitions and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 按照年龄（大于或小于中位年龄）、左室功能（LVEF>40%与≤40%)、心力衰竭原因（缺血性与非缺血性）、心功能（NYHAⅡ级Ⅲ~Ⅳ级）、糖尿病（患有或未患）及基线总胆固醇水平（高于或低于中位值）分为不同亚组，在各亚组中评估瑞舒伐他汀对全因死亡或因心血管原因住院的联合终点的影响。
Translation: Patients were divided into different subgroups according to age (greater than or less than the median age), left ventricular function (LVEF >40% or ≤40%), cause of heart failure (ischemic or non-ischemic), cardiac function (NYHA class II or class III–IV), diabetes status (with or without diabetes), and baseline total cholesterol level (higher or lower than the median value). The effect of rosuvastatin on the composite endpoint of all-cause mortality or hospitalization for cardiovascular reasons was assessed within each subgroup.

Query_Text_cn: 本试验统计学分析采用0.05的整体显著性水平，根据两项主要终点进行校正；对第1个主要终点（至死亡发生的时间）以双侧0.045的显著性水平进行检验，第2个主要终点（至死亡或因心血管原因住院的时间）以0.01的显著性水平进行检验。
Translation: The statistical analysis of this trial was conducted at an overall significance level of 0.05, adjusted for the two primary endpoints. The first primary endpoint (time to death) was tested at a two-sided significance level of 0.045, while the second primary endpoint (time to death or hospitalization due to cardiovascular causes) was tested at a significance level of 0.01.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到两项主要终点之间的关系，对净α变化（消耗）保留记录。
Translation: Given the relationship between the two primary endpoints, records of net alpha changes (consumption) are retained.

Query_Text_cn: 基于第1个主要终点（至死亡发生的时间），进行样本大小的计算。
Translation: Sample size calculation was performed based on the first primary endpoint (time to death).

Query_Text_cn: 计算得出：在检验效能为90%且预计安慰剂组3年死亡率为25%的情况下，要检出瑞舒伐他汀组有15%的减少所需事件数为1252例。
Translation: It was calculated that, with a statistical power of 90% and an expected 3-year mortality rate of 25% in the placebo group, 1,252 events are required to detect a 15% reduction in the rosuvastatin group.

Query_Text_cn: 除了对两项主要终点进行的符合试验方案数据分析外，其他所有分析均针对意向治疗人群进行；符合试验方案分析仅针对无重大试验违规并在至少80%的观察时间接受研究分配治疗的患者进行。
Translation: Except for the protocol-compliant data analyses conducted for the two primary endpoints, all other analyses were performed on the intention-to-treat population; the protocol-compliant analysis was limited to patients without major protocol violations who received the assigned study treatment for at least 80% of the observation period.

Query_Text_cn: 为了评估治疗效果，利用校正了随机分组问不均衡变量(P小于0.1)的拟合Cox比例风险模型进行主要分析。
Translation: To evaluate the treatment effect, the primary analysis was conducted using a fitted Cox proportional hazards model that adjusted for variables with random group imbalance (P<0.1).

Query_Text_cn: 对第1个和第2个联合主要终点分别计算95.5%CI和99%CI。
Translation: Calculate the 95.5% CI and 99% CI for the first and second co-primary endpoints, respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 通过对数图［-log（存活）］和时间依赖性协变量检验，校验随机治疗的假定比例风险。
Translation: The proportional hazards assumption for randomized treatment was validated using log-minus-log survival plots and tests of time-dependent covariates.

Query_Text_cn: 将Kaplan-Meier生存曲线图与对数秩检验的结果一同表述。
Translation: Present the Kaplan-Meier survival curves together with the results of the log-rank test.

Query_Text_cn: 由于在将患者随机分入瑞舒伐他汀组或安慰剂组的同时还随机分配了n-3多不饱和脂肪酸(PUFA)或与之匹配的安慰剂治疗，所以通过拟合一个包含n-3PUFA、瑞舒伐他汀及两者相互作用的Cox比例风险模型，探讨接受了两种治疗的患者中是否存在疗效变化。
Translation: Since patients were randomly assigned to either the rosuvastatin group or the placebo group, as well as to n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) or a matched placebo treatment, a Cox proportional hazards model including n-3 PUFA, rosuvastatin, and their interaction was fitted to investigate whether there was a variation in efficacy among patients who received both treatments.

Query_Text_cn: 为了评估瑞舒伐他汀对次要终点的效应（校正分析）及其在各预先设定亚组中的效应，以Cox比例风险模型计算HR(95%CI)。
Translation: To assess the effect of rosuvastatin on secondary endpoints (adjusted analysis) and its effect in each predefined subgroup, hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using Cox proportional hazards models.

Query_Text_cn: 利用校正相应基线数值的重复测量方差分析，评估本研究中随机分组之间实验室检查的差异（1年和3年）。
Translation: The differences in laboratory tests between randomized groups in this study (at 1 year and 3 years) were assessed using repeated measures analysis of variance, with adjustment for corresponding baseline values.

Query_Text_cn: 当实验室参数不能满足正态假设时，对其进行对数转换。
Translation: When laboratory parameters do not meet the assumption of normality, logarithmic transformation is applied.

Query_Text_cn: 高敏C反应蛋白(hsCRP)水平因呈现显著偏态分布而采用了对数转换。
Translation: Due to the significant skewed distribution of high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) levels, a logarithmic transformation was applied.

Query_Text_cn: 对基线数值进行校正后，利用方差分析评估基线至3个月时的变化。
Translation: After adjusting for baseline values, changes from baseline to month 3 were assessed using analysis of variance.

Query_Text_cn: 所有分析均采用SAS软件（8.2版）进行。
Translation: All analyses were conducted using SAS software (version 8.2).

Query_Text_cn: GISSI-HF研究组协调整个研究，管理并分析数据，同时接受设计GISSI-HF研究的指导委员会的监督。
Translation: The GISSI-HF research group coordinated the entire study, managed and analyzed the data, and operated under the supervision of the steering committee responsible for designing the GISSI-HF study.

Query_Text_cn: 资助者不参与试验设计、实施、数据收集、分析、数据解释或研究报告撰写。
Translation: The sponsors did not participate in the design, implementation, data collection, analysis, interpretation of the data, or writing of the research report.

Query_Text_cn: 通讯作者有权使用试验中的所有数据。
Translation: The corresponding author has the right to use all data from the experiment.

Query_Text_cn: 数据的储存和分析均在GISSI-HF协调中心（佛罗伦萨和米兰）进行。
Translation: Data storage and analysis were both conducted at the GISSI-HF Coordinating Center in Florence and Milan.

Query_Text_cn: 指导委员会与写作委员会的全部成员都有权使用数据库资料，并最终负责决定论文的提交发表。
Translation: All members of the Steering Committee and the Writing Committee are entitled to access the database and are ultimately responsible for deciding on the submission and publication of the paper.

Query_Text_cn: 4631例患者被随机分组（图1）。
Translation: A total of 4,631 patients were randomly assigned to groups (Figure 1).

Query_Text_cn: 由于未完成充分的知情同意手续和不能确保数据质量，在随机分组后、开盲前剔除了来自一个地点的57例患者的资料。
Translation: Due to incomplete informed consent procedures and the inability to ensure data quality, data from 57 patients at one site were excluded after randomization but before unblinding.

Query_Text_cn: 其余4574例患者中，2285例被分配接受瑞舒伐他汀治疗，另2289例则接受安慰剂治疗。
Translation: Of the remaining 4,574 patients, 2,285 were assigned to receive rosuvastatin treatment, while the other 2,289 received placebo treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 随访于2008年3月31日结束。
Translation: The follow-up concluded on March 31, 2008.

Query_Text_cn: 中位随访时间为3.9年(IQR3.0~4.4)。
Translation: The median follow-up duration was 3.9 years (IQR 3.0–4.4).

Query_Text_cn: 表1中显示了所有患者的基线特征，包括详细的既往药物治疗情况。
Translation: Table 1 presents the baseline characteristics of all patients, including detailed information on prior medication treatments.

Query_Text_cn: 患者的平均年龄为68岁(s=11)。有2014例(44%)年龄>70岁。
Translation: The mean age of the patients was 68 years (s=11). There were 2,014 cases (44%) aged over 70 years.
1,032 patients (23%) were female.

Query_Text_cn: 1828例(40%)患者的心力衰竭原因为缺血性，1576例(35%)为原发性扩张性心肌病，823例(18%)为高血压。
Translation: The cause of heart failure was ischemic in 1,828 patients (40%), primary dilated cardiomyopathy in 1,576 patients (35%), and hypertension in 823 patients (18%).

Query_Text_cn: 关于患者接受的基本治疗，4276例(94%)患者使用了肾素-血管紧张素系统阻断剂，2853例(62%)使用了一种β受体阻断剂，1835例(40%)使用了螺内酯（表1）。
Translation: Regarding the basic treatments received by patients, 4,276 patients (94%) used renin-angiotensin system inhibitors, 2,853 patients (62%) used a beta-blocker, and 1,835 patients (40%) used spironolactone (Table 1).

Query_Text_cn: 瑞舒伐他汀组中全因死亡患者有657例(29%)。安慰剂组中为644例(28%)（图2）。
Translation: There were 657 cases of all-cause mortality (29%) in the rosuvastatin group, compared to 644 cases (28%) in the placebo group (Figure 2).

Query_Text_cn: 瑞舒伐他汀组中1305例(57%)患者发生联合主要终点（全因死亡或因心血管原因住院），安慰剂组中有1283例(56%)患者出现（图2）。
Translation: In the rosuvastatin group, 1,305 patients (57%) experienced the composite primary endpoint (all-cause death or hospitalization for cardiovascular reasons), compared to 1,283 patients (56%) in the placebo group (Figure 2).

Query_Text_cn: 使用瑞舒伐他汀和n-3PUFA的患者中疗效变化被排除（对于全因死亡，相互作用P=0.76；对于联合终点，P=0.95）。
Translation: Changes in efficacy among patients using rosuvastatin and n-3 PUFA were excluded (for all-cause mortality, interaction P=0.76; for the composite endpoint, P=0.95).

Query_Text_cn: 瑞舒伐他汀组与安慰剂组患者相比，以下几项次要结果发生率相似：心血管原因死亡，首次因任何原因、心血管原因或心力衰竭住院，心血管原因死亡或因任何原因住院的联合结局（表2）。
Translation: Compared with patients in the placebo group, those in the rosuvastatin group had similar incidence rates for the following secondary outcomes: cardiovascular death; first hospitalization for any cause, cardiovascular cause, or heart failure; and the composite endpoint of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for any cause (Table 2).

Query_Text_cn: 此外还观察到，心脏性猝死、心肌梗死以及卒中的发生率无显著差异（表2）。
Translation: In addition, no significant differences were observed in the incidence of sudden cardiac death, myocardial infarction, or stroke (Table 2).

Query_Text_cn: 作者注意到，无论心血管性死亡或非心血管性死亡，两组之间各种原因死亡无显著差异（表3）。
Translation: The author notes that there is no significant difference in all-cause mortality between the two groups, whether cardiovascular or non-cardiovascular death (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 在任何预先设定的亚组中（包括缺血性vs非缺血性心力衰竭），全因死亡或因心血管原因住院的风险不受瑞舒伐他汀影响，也不存在疗效的不均一性（表4）。
Translation: In any predefined subgroup (including ischemic vs. non-ischemic heart failure), the risk of all-cause mortality or hospitalization for cardiovascular reasons was not affected by rosuvastatin, nor was there any heterogeneity of treatment effect (Table 4).

Query_Text_cn: 在仅限于1828例缺血性心力衰竭患者的事后分析中，无论主要终点或次要终点，瑞舒伐他汀组与安慰剂组并无显著差异（数据未显示）。
Translation: In a post hoc analysis limited to 1,828 patients with ischemic heart failure, there was no significant difference between the rosuvastatin group and the placebo group in either the primary or secondary endpoints (data not shown).

Query_Text_cn: 在瑞舒伐他汀组中，基线时LDL胆固醇水平为3.16mmol/L，1年后降至2.15mmol/L（-32%），3年后为2.31mmol/L（-27%）。
Translation: In the rosuvastatin group, the baseline LDL cholesterol level was 3.16 mmol/L, which decreased to 2.15 mmol/L (-32%) after one year and was 2.31 mmol/L (-27%) after three years.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，在安慰剂组中未见到显著变化，基线时浓度为3.13mmol/L，1年后为3.37mmol/L，3年后则为3.06mmol/L（时间与治疗相互作用P小于0.0001）。
Translation: However, no significant changes were observed in the placebo group, with concentrations of 3.13 mmol/L at baseline, 3.37 mmol/L after one year, and 3.06 mmol/L after three years (time-by-treatment interaction P < 0.0001).

Query_Text_cn: 与安慰剂组患者相比较，瑞舒伐他汀组患者的HDL胆固醇水平没有显著变化（时间与治疗相互作用P=0.67）。
Translation: Compared with patients in the placebo group, there was no significant change in HDL cholesterol levels among patients in the rosuvastatin group (time-by-treatment interaction P=0.67).

Query_Text_cn: 按照LDL降低程度将人群分成3层进行探索性亚组分析，以检验下述假设——在接受研究治疗后LDL胆固醇显著降低的患者中事件发生风险可能增高。
Translation: The population will be divided into three tiers based on the degree of LDL reduction for exploratory subgroup analysis to test the following hypothesis: among patients whose LDL cholesterol is significantly reduced after receiving the study treatment, the risk of event occurrence may increase.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，在这些亚组患者中没有见到疗效差异（数据未显示）。
Translation: However, no differences in efficacy were observed among these subgroups (data not shown).

Query_Text_cn: 在检测了hsCRP水平的626例患者中，瑞舒伐他汀组和安慰剂组基线时的hsCRP水平分别为2.71mg/L(IQR1.22~5.99)和2.17mg/L(IQR1.07~4.92)，用药3个月后hsCRP水平分别降低了0.45mg/L（IQR-2.29~0.53）和0.10mg/L(IQR-1.37~0.85)，两组之间存在显著差异（方差分析，P=0.0195）。
Translation: Among the 626 patients whose hsCRP levels were measured, the baseline hsCRP levels in the rosuvastatin group and the placebo group were 2.71 mg/L (IQR 1.22–5.99) and 2.17 mg/L (IQR 1.07–4.92), respectively. After 3 months of treatment, hsCRP levels decreased by 0.45 mg/L (IQR -2.29–0.53) in the rosuvastatin group and by 0.10 mg/L (IQR -1.37–0.85) in the placebo group, with a significant difference between the two groups (ANOVA, P=0.0195).

Query_Text_cn: 研究结束时，790例(35%)使用瑞舒伐他汀的患者和831例(36%)使用安慰剂的患者因各种原因未再使用研究药物(P=0.22)（表5）。
Translation: At the end of the study, 790 patients (35%) in the rosuvastatin group and 831 patients (36%) in the placebo group discontinued the study medication for various reasons (P=0.22) (Table 5).

Query_Text_cn: 在安慰剂组与瑞舒伐他汀组之间，因存在不良反应而终止治疗的情况无明显差异（表5）。
Translation: There was no significant difference between the placebo group and the rosuvastatin group in treatment discontinuation due to adverse reactions (Table 5).

Query_Text_cn: 瑞舒伐他汀组中23例患者出现了肌组织相关症状，安慰剂组中为21例，同时还记录到瑞舒伐他汀组中26例患者出现肝酶水平升高，安慰剂组则有12例患者出现。
Translation: In the rosuvastatin group, 23 patients experienced muscle-related symptoms, compared to 21 patients in the placebo group. Additionally, elevated liver enzyme levels were observed in 26 patients in the rosuvastatin group, while 12 patients in the placebo group exhibited this condition.

Query_Text_cn: 总肌酸激酶水平升至正常上限5倍以上者和10倍以上者在瑞舒伐他汀组中分别为9例和1例，而安慰剂组中为2例和1例。
Translation: In the rosuvastatin group, there were 9 cases with total creatine kinase levels exceeding 5 times the upper limit of normal and 1 case exceeding 10 times the upper limit, while in the placebo group, there were 2 cases and 1 case, respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 无1例患者因使用瑞舒伐他汀而出现横纹肌溶解。
Translation: No cases of rhabdomyolysis were reported in patients using rosuvastatin.

Query_Text_cn: 在瑞舒伐他汀组中，血清肌酐水平在基线时为94.59μmol/L（IQR79.56~109.62），1年后升至96.36μmol/L(IQR79.56~114.92)，3年后升至97.24μmol/L（IQR79.56~116.69）；安慰剂组中，基线时为95.47μmol/L(IQR79.56~114.92)，1年后升至97.24μmol/L(IQR80.44~114.92)，3年后升至（译者注：原文中未给出数值，也未能与通信作者取得联系）（IQR83.98~123.76）(时间与治疗相互作用P=0.04)。
Translation: In the rosuvastatin group, the baseline serum creatinine level was 94.59 μmol/L (IQR 79.56–109.62), which increased to 96.36 μmol/L (IQR 79.56–114.92) after 1 year and to 97.24 μmol/L (IQR 79.56–116.69) after 3 years. In the placebo group, the baseline level was 95.47 μmol/L (IQR 79.56–114.92), which increased to 97.24 μmol/L (IQR 80.44–114.92) after 1 year and to (translator’s note: the original text did not provide this value and the corresponding author could not be reached) (IQR 83.98–123.76) after 3 years (P=0.04 for time-by-treatment interaction).

Query_Text_cn: 在随访期间，瑞舒伐他汀组与安慰剂组中血清肌酐水平双倍升高的发生率相似［65例(3.0%)VS57例(2.6%)，P=0.43］。
Translation: During the follow-up period, the incidence of a doubling in serum creatinine levels was similar between the rosuvastatin group and the placebo group [65 cases (3.0%) vs. 57 cases (2.6%), P=0.43].

Query_Text_cn: 符合试验方案分析中包括了2874例完全依从的患者，均为无重大试验违规并在至少80%的观察时间接受了研究分配治疗的患者。
Translation: The per-protocol analysis included 2,874 fully compliant patients, all of whom had no major protocol violations and received the study-assigned treatment for at least 80% of the observation period.
The analysis results showed that the all-cause mortality rate was 29% (429/1461) in the rosuvastatin group and 27% (377/1413) in the placebo group (adjusted HR 1.12, 95.5% CI 0.97–1.29, P=0.16).

Query_Text_cn: 本试验在不限定年龄、缺血性与非缺血性原因以及LVEF的情况下纳入有症状心力衰竭患者，旨在观察此人群中使用常规起始剂量瑞舒伐他汀(10mg/d)的有效性与安全性。
Translation: This trial enrolled symptomatic heart failure patients regardless of age, ischemic or non-ischemic etiology, and LVEF, aiming to evaluate the efficacy and safety of routine initiation of rosuvastatin at a dose of 10 mg/day in this population.

Query_Text_cn: 无论主要终点或是次要终点均观察到瑞舒伐他汀无明显疗效，在所有预先计划的亚组分析中也未发现明显影响。
Translation: Rosuvastatin showed no significant efficacy in either the primary or secondary endpoints, and no notable effects were observed in any of the pre-specified subgroup analyses.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，许多在不同试验和临床条件下进行的观察性研究，以及对随机对照试验中心力衰竭患者的事后分析，都一致提示他汀类药物对许多临床终点（包括死亡）可产生有益作用。
Translation: However, numerous observational studies conducted under various experimental and clinical conditions, as well as post-hoc analyses of heart failure patients in randomized controlled trials, consistently suggest that statins may have beneficial effects on many clinical endpoints, including mortality.

Query_Text_cn: 有两项随机对照研究——本研究及CORONA试验——特别关注了他汀类药物对心力衰竭的影响，这两项研究报道了与上述结果相反的结果，均显示并没有获益。
Translation: There are two randomized controlled trials—this study and the CORONA trial—that specifically focused on the effects of statins on heart failure. Both studies reported results contrary to those mentioned above, showing no benefit.

Query_Text_cn: 这些发现表明，无论采用何种统计学校正方法，任何类型的观察性研究或事后分析都无法得出有关药物疗效的可靠结论。
Translation: These findings indicate that, regardless of the statistical adjustment methods used, no type of observational study or retrospective analysis can yield reliable conclusions about the efficacy of a drug.

Query_Text_cn: 在冠心病患者中对不同的他汀类药物或同一种他汀类药物的不同剂量进行直接比较，结果通常显示采用较强治疗措施的患者心力衰竭发生率较低。
Translation: Direct comparisons of different statins or different doses of the same statin in patients with coronary heart disease generally show that patients receiving more intensive therapy have a lower incidence of heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 一项针对这些研究的综述表明，应用他汀类药物在预防因心力衰竭住院方面的获益为27%。
Translation: A review of these studies indicates that the use of statins results in a 27% reduction in the risk of hospitalization due to heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 这些结果与本研究的结果并不矛盾。
Translation: These results are not inconsistent with the findings of this study.

Query_Text_cn: 一种药物可能在预防慢性心力衰竭患者的心血管事件方面无效，但却能够通过直接影响潜在心血管系统衰竭或者防止冠心病进展或不稳定，而起到预防心力衰竭发生的作用。
Translation: A drug may be ineffective in preventing cardiovascular events in patients with chronic heart failure, but it can play a role in preventing the onset of heart failure by directly affecting underlying cardiovascular system dysfunction or by preventing the progression or instability of coronary heart disease.

Query_Text_cn: 一些针对心力衰竭患者的小型随机研究已显示出他汀类药物的许多生物学和临床作用，但另一些未显现出。
Translation: Several small randomized studies targeting patients with heart failure have demonstrated many biological and clinical effects of statins, while others have not.

Query_Text_cn: 研究者们报道了他汀类药物的抗心室重构效应，该效应与其改善左室功能、减少循环炎性标记物、改善内皮功能的作用以及可能的抗心律失常作用有关。
Translation: Researchers have reported the anti-ventricular remodeling effects of statins, which are associated with their ability to improve left ventricular function, reduce circulating inflammatory markers, enhance endothelial function, and potentially exert antiarrhythmic effects.

Query_Text_cn: 研究者们还报道了许多观察终点的降低，但是这些研究中患者数量有限。不足以得出可靠结论。
Translation: Researchers have also reported reductions in many observational endpoints; however, the number of patients in these studies is limited and insufficient to draw reliable conclusions.

Query_Text_cn: 所有这些结果都强烈支持以下观点：他汀类药物在心力衰竭患者中是有效的。
Translation: All these results strongly support the view that statins are effective in patients with heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 几乎与本研究同时进行的CORONA试验，检测了使用同一剂量瑞舒伐他汀的情况，而目被已发表文献广泛引用，作为他汀类药物用于心力衰竭患者可获得对诸多研究终点（包括死亡率）产生有利影响的试验证实资料。
Translation: The CORONA trial, conducted almost concurrently with this study, examined the use of the same dosage of rosuvastatin and has been widely cited in published literature as evidence confirming that statins can have beneficial effects on various study endpoints, including mortality, in patients with heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 在CORONA试验中，主要联合终点为因心血管原因死亡、非致死性心肌梗死或卒中，虽然瑞舒伐他汀组患者因心血管原因和因心力衰竭住院数较安慰剂组患者有所减少，但是主要联合终点的发生率仅降低8%（无显著意义）。
Translation: In the CORONA trial, the primary composite endpoint was cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or stroke. Although patients in the rosuvastatin group had fewer hospitalizations due to cardiovascular causes and heart failure compared to the placebo group, the incidence of the primary composite endpoint was reduced by only 8%, which was not statistically significant.

Query_Text_cn: CORONA试验与本研究之间的主要差异在于患者的纳入：CORONA研究纳入的所有患者均为缺血性心力衰竭，而本研究中仅40%的患者为缺血性心力衰竭。
Translation: The main difference between the CORONA trial and the present study lies in patient inclusion: all patients enrolled in the CORONA study had ischemic heart failure, whereas only 40% of the patients in the present study had ischemic heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 两项研究的终点也不同，CORONA研究主要关注缺血事件，本研究的重点则在心力衰竭相关事件。
Translation: The endpoints of the two studies also differ: the CORONA study primarily focuses on ischemic events, while this study emphasizes heart failure-related events.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，CORONA研究中患者的年龄较大（平均年龄为73岁vs68岁），而且症状更为明显（NYHAⅢ~Ⅳ级者比例分别为63%vs37%）。
Translation: In addition, patients in the CORONA study were older (mean age 73 vs 68 years) and exhibited more pronounced symptoms (the proportion of patients with NYHA class III–IV was 63% vs 37%, respectively).

Query_Text_cn: 本研究的结果明确表明：对于未接受过他汀类药物治疗的任何原因所致慢性心力衰竭患者，使用瑞舒伐他汀无益。
Translation: The results of this study clearly indicate that rosuvastatin provides no benefit for patients with chronic heart failure of any cause who have not previously received statin therapy.

Query_Text_cn: CORONA试验纳入了大量的缺血性心力衰竭患者，其结果提示他汀类药物在心力衰竭患者中仍可能有预防急性缺血事件发作的作用，如针对非致死性心肌梗死及非致死性卒中联合终点的一项事后分析所示。
Translation: The CORONA trial included a large number of patients with ischemic heart failure, and its results suggest that statins may still have a role in preventing acute ischemic events in heart failure patients, as indicated by a post hoc analysis focusing on the combined endpoint of nonfatal myocardial infarction and nonfatal stroke.

Query_Text_cn: 此结果也可以解释CORONA试验中因心血管原因住院发生率降低而本研究中无相似情况。
Translation: This result may also explain why the reduction in hospitalization due to cardiovascular causes observed in the CORONA trial was not seen in our study.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究中并没有将不同LVEF值作为纳入标准。
Translation: This study did not use different LVEF values as inclusion criteria.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，仅有10%的患者LVEF值高于40%，所组成的所谓LVEF维持相对正常的心力衰竭患者亚组太小，不能就他汀类药物在此类患者中的疗效得出结论。
Translation: However, only 10% of patients had an LVEF greater than 40%, making the so-called subgroup of heart failure patients with relatively preserved LVEF too small to draw conclusions about the efficacy of statins in this population.

Query_Text_cn: 与以前的结果相比较，作者发现此亚组患者与全体患者之间无显著结果差异。
Translation: Compared with previous results, the author found no significant differences between this subgroup of patients and the overall patient population.

Query_Text_cn: 值得注意的是，尽管瑞舒伐他汀缺乏临床疗效，但是无论在CORONA或是本试验中瑞舒伐他汀都伴随强大持久的生物学效应，其中包括了血清LDL胆固醇及C反应蛋白水平的相应降低。
Translation: It is noteworthy that, despite the lack of clinical efficacy of rosuvastatin, strong and sustained biological effects were observed in both the CORONA study and the present trial, including corresponding reductions in serum LDL cholesterol and C-reactive protein levels.

Query_Text_cn: 这些效应可能不再影响缺血性心力衰竭患者的冠心病进展，有可能是因为在不利于冠心病进展的生物学环境下其作用被减弱了。
Translation: These effects may no longer influence the progression of coronary heart disease in patients with ischemic heart failure, possibly because their impact is diminished in a biological environment unfavorable to the progression of coronary heart disease.

Query_Text_cn: 心力衰竭患者中急性缺血事件发生较少，因此排除了关于药物对急性缺血事件作用的评估。
Translation: Acute ischemic events are relatively rare in patients with heart failure; therefore, the evaluation of the effects of the drug on acute ischemic events was excluded.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管瑞舒伐他汀具有抗炎活性，但是其温和作用可能意味着炎性成分在心力衰竭进展中处在病理生理边缘状态。
Translation: Although rosuvastatin possesses anti-inflammatory activity, its mild effect may suggest that the inflammatory component is at the periphery of pathophysiology in the progression of heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 检测阻断炎性细胞因子作用药物的临床试验得出的阴性结果可能支持上述假设，比如有关阻断肿瘤坏死因子α药物（依那西普）的试验。
Translation: The negative results from clinical trials of drugs that block the effects of inflammatory cytokines may support the above hypothesis, such as trials involving tumor necrosis factor-alpha inhibitors like etanercept.

Query_Text_cn: 对CORONA及GISSI-HF数据库进行进一步分析，有可能在阐明机制方面得到改善。
Translation: Further analysis of the CORONA and GISSI-HF databases may lead to improvements in elucidating the underlying mechanisms.

Query_Text_cn: 鉴于有明确数据证实所采用的试验药物剂量对于其典型药理学目标足够充分，本研究的临床结果并不支持他汀类药物的所谓多样效应具有统计学显著性，至少在广义心力衰竭范畴内是如此。他汀类药物的多效性已被广泛认可多年，有许多已发表文献对此给予支持，但其可能被高估了。
Translation: Given clear data confirming that the dosage of the investigational drug was sufficient for its typical pharmacological targets, the clinical outcomes of this study do not support the so-called pleiotropic effects of statins as being statistically significant, at least within the broad category of heart failure. The pleiotropic effects of statins have been widely acknowledged for many years, with numerous published studies supporting this view, but they may have been overestimated.

Query_Text_cn: 大约1/3的患者没有完全服从试验安排，这是本试验的不足之处。
Translation: Approximately one-third of the patients did not fully comply with the trial protocol, which is a limitation of this study.

Query_Text_cn: GISSI-HF试验对所有在意大利的心血管中心发出了邀请，大多数接受并参与了研究，这是GISSI-HF试验实效策略的一个标志，在许多长期试验中也很常见。
Translation: The GISSI-HF trial extended invitations to all cardiovascular centers in Italy, and most accepted and participated in the study. This reflects the pragmatic approach of the GISSI-HF trial, which is also common in many long-term studies.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，本研究的结果揭示了真实情况下可能发生的情况。
Translation: Therefore, the results of this study reveal what may occur in real-world situations.

Query_Text_cn: 对意向治疗原则的坚持，可确保所观察到的作用与临床实践中的作用高度一致。
Translation: Adherence to the intention-to-treat principle ensures that the observed effects are highly consistent with those seen in clinical practice.

Query_Text_cn: 符合试验方案分析的结果与意向治疗分析所获得的结果相似，证明了因依从性问题而产生的作用降低不会对整体临床结果产生大的影响。
Translation: The results of the per-protocol analysis were similar to those obtained from the intention-to-treat analysis, demonstrating that the reduction in effect due to compliance issues does not have a significant impact on the overall clinical outcomes.

Query_Text_cn: 即使其中部分药物具有一些特性，例如西立伐他汀具有一些有害特性，但是他汀类药物通常被看做一类药。
Translation: Even though some of these drugs possess certain characteristics—for example, cerivastatin has some harmful properties—statins are generally regarded as a single class of drugs.

Query_Text_cn: 当前所使用的各种他汀类药物之间唯一的显著差异是效能，该指标通常主要根据LDL降低的疗效来评估。
Translation: The only significant difference among the various statins currently in use is their potency, which is typically assessed primarily based on their efficacy in lowering LDL levels.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，由于使用了小剂量的强效药物，GISSI-HF试验的结果被认为可以外推至整个他汀类药物。
Translation: Therefore, because small doses of potent drugs were used, the results of the GISSI-HF trial are considered to be generalizable to the entire class of statins.

Query_Text_cn: 阻止羟酸合成以及后续泛醌生成因血清脂蛋白的降低导致结合及清除细菌脂多糖（强烈刺激致炎因子释放）的能力降低。
Translation: Inhibition of hydroxy acid synthesis and subsequent ubiquinone production leads to a decrease in serum lipoproteins, which in turn reduces the ability to bind and clear bacterial lipopolysaccharides (potent stimulators of pro-inflammatory factor release).

Query_Text_cn: 瑞舒伐他汀与安慰剂在有效性和安全性方面差异甚微（在基线时总胆固醇水平较低的患者亚组中），不支持这种负面效应具有临床意义。
Translation: There is little difference in efficacy and safety between rosuvastatin and placebo (in the subgroup of patients with low baseline total cholesterol levels), which does not support the clinical significance of this negative effect.

Query_Text_cn: CORONA试验纳入了更严重的心力衰竭患者，其中也显示出令人放心的相似结果。
Translation: The CORONA trial included patients with more severe heart failure and also demonstrated similarly reassuring results.

Query_Text_cn: 他汀类药物最佳剂量的观点存在分歧。
Translation: There are differing views on the optimal dosage of statins.

Query_Text_cn: 本试验中患者在纳入时或纳入前1个月内未使用他汀类药物，研究设计时主要关注的问题是安全性。
Translation: In this trial, patients had not used statins at the time of enrollment or within one month prior to enrollment, and the primary concern in the study design was safety.

Query_Text_cn: 从循环LDL胆固醇水平的相应降低来看，本研究确证了瑞舒伐他汀10mg/d的安全性。
Translation: Judging from the corresponding reduction in circulating LDL cholesterol levels, this study confirms the safety of rosuvastatin at a dose of 10 mg/day.

Query_Text_cn: 本文所报道的结果并不是对他汀类药物在所有被推荐适应证中的应用表示异议。
Translation: The results reported in this article do not challenge the use of statins in all recommended indications.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，作者认为应该阻止瑞舒伐他汀用于心力衰竭患者，甚至是阻止任何他汀类药物用于该类患者。
Translation: However, the author believes that the use of rosuvastatin in patients with heart failure should be prohibited, and even the use of any statin drugs in such patients should be prevented.

Query_Text_cn: 实际上，还有一个可能引发广泛争议的问题，当接受他汀类药物治疗的缺血患者已处于失代偿时，是应该继续应用他汀类药物还是停用。
Translation: In fact, another issue that may spark widespread controversy is whether statin therapy should be continued or discontinued in ischemic patients who have already entered a state of decompensation.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，许多资料表明，在伴有左室功能障碍或衰竭的急性缺血事件发生后早期使用他汀类药物可能有效。
Translation: For example, numerous sources indicate that early use of statins after an acute ischemic event accompanied by left ventricular dysfunction or failure may be effective.

Query_Text_cn: 当前试验结果尚不能排除这种可能性。
Translation: The current experimental results cannot rule out this possibility.

Query_Text_cn: 总的来说，GISSI-HF试验的结果可能有助于医师采取进一步的决策。
Translation: Overall, the results of the GISSI-HF trial may help physicians make further decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 首先，不要为非缺血性原因所致心力衰竭患者开具他汀类药物。
Translation: First, statins should not be prescribed to patients with heart failure caused by non-ischemic etiologies.

Query_Text_cn: 其次，在缺血性原因所致心力衰竭患者中，如果医生确信该类药物无益，或者要避免多药使用或避免减弱患者对其他已证实有益药物的依从性，则可停止使用他汀类药物。
Translation: Secondly, in patients with heart failure caused by ischemic etiologies, statin therapy may be discontinued if the physician is confident that such medication offers no benefit, or if discontinuation is necessary to avoid polypharmacy or to prevent reduced adherence to other medications that have proven benefits.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，由于在本研究人群中已证实了他汀类药物的安全性，如果医师确信该类药物在一些特殊病例中有益，则可以维持治疗。
Translation: Finally, since the safety of statins has been confirmed in the population studied, physicians may continue treatment if they are convinced that these drugs are beneficial in certain special cases.

Query_Text_cn: 背景：对于非ST段抬高急性冠脉综合征(ACS)患者而言，与单独应用普通肝素相比，依诺肝素或者血小板糖蛋白Ⅱb/Ⅲa受体拮抗剂替罗非班与普通肝素联合应用都显示出较好的疗效。
Translation: Background: For patients with non-ST-segment elevation acute coronary syndrome (ACS), both enoxaparin alone and the combination of tirofiban, a platelet glycoprotein IIb/IIIa receptor antagonist, with unfractionated heparin have demonstrated better efficacy compared to the use of unfractionated heparin alone.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，尚不清楚依诺肝素和替罗非班联合应用是否像普通肝素和替罗非班标准联合方案一样安全有效。
Translation: At present, it is unclear whether the combination of enoxaparin and tirofiban is as safe and effective as the standard regimen of unfractionated heparin and tirofiban.

Query_Text_cn: 目的：在非ST段抬高的ACS患者中评价依诺肝素和替罗非班联合疗法与普通肝素和替罗非班联合方案的疗效及安全性。
Translation: Objective: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of the combination therapy of enoxaparin and tirofiban versus the combination of unfractionated heparin and tirofiban in patients with non-ST-segment elevation acute coronary syndrome (ACS).

Query_Text_cn: 设计、地点及参试者：国际前瞻性、开标、随机、非劣势试验。在接受替罗非班和阿斯匹林治疗的非ST段抬高ACS患者中分别给予依诺肝素1mg/kg(n=2026)每12小时一次或经体重校正的静脉普通肝素(n=1961)，然后进行比较。
Translation: Design, Setting, and Participants: An international, prospective, open-label, randomized, non-inferiority trial. Patients with non-ST-segment elevation ACS receiving tirofiban and aspirin were randomly assigned to receive either enoxaparin 1 mg/kg (n=2026) every 12 hours or weight-adjusted intravenous unfractionated heparin (n=1961), and the outcomes were compared.

Query_Text_cn: 这项AtoZ试验的A阶段试验是于1999年12月至2002年5月进行的。
Translation: The Phase A trial of the AtoZ study was conducted from December 1999 to May 2002.

Query_Text_cn: 主要观察指标：意向治疗人群7天时死亡、再发心肌梗死和难治性缺血的发生情况，该意向治疗人群是根据优效性和非劣势原则确定的。
Translation: Primary observation indicators: the incidence of death, recurrent myocardial infarction, and refractory ischemia at 7 days in the intention-to-treat population. This intention-to-treat population is defined based on the principles of superiority and non-inferiority.

Query_Text_cn: 应用“心肌梗死溶栓治疗试验”(TIMI)中之出血分级系统，通过监测出血发生率判定用药安全性。
Translation: The safety of the medication was assessed by monitoring the incidence of bleeding using the bleeding classification system from the Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction (TIMI) trial.

Query_Text_cn: 结果：在治疗第7天时，随机分配至依诺肝素组的2018例患者中有169例(8.4％)发生死亡、心肌梗死或者难治性缺血，而普通肝素组的1952例患者中184例(9.4％)发生上述事件(风险比[HR]为0.88，95％可信区间[CI]为0.71～1.08)。
Translation: Results: On day 7 of treatment, 169 out of 2,018 patients randomized to the enoxaparin group (8.4%) experienced death, myocardial infarction, or refractory ischemia, compared to 184 out of 1,952 patients in the unfractionated heparin group (9.4%) (hazard ratio [HR] 0.88, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.71–1.08).

Query_Text_cn: 该结果符合预先设定的非劣势标准。
Translation: The result meets the predefined non-inferiority criteria.

Query_Text_cn: 除死亡外，所有一级和二级复合终点事件分析结果均提示，依诺肝素更为有益。死亡仅见于1％的患者(依诺肝素组23例，普通肝素组17例)。
Translation: Except for mortality, the analysis of all primary and secondary composite endpoint events indicated that enoxaparin was more beneficial. Mortality was observed in only 1% of patients (23 cases in the enoxaparin group and 17 cases in the unfractionated heparin group).

Query_Text_cn: 任何TIM1分级的出血发生率都很低(依诺肝素组为3.0％，普通肝素组为2.2％；P=0.13)。
Translation: The incidence of any TIMI grade bleeding was very low (3.0% in the enoxaparin group and 2.2% in the unfractionated heparin group; P=0.13).

Query_Text_cn: 最差情况分析(合并了两种独立的出血判定策略)表明，采用依诺肝素每治疗200例患者就会发生一次TIMI严重出血。
Translation: Worst-case analysis (combining two independent bleeding assessment strategies) indicates that one TIMI major bleeding event occurs for every 200 patients treated with enoxaparin.

Query_Text_cn: 结论：对于接受替罗非班和阿斯匹林治疗的非ST段抬高ACS患者而言，依诺肝素是除普通肝素之外的另一种适当选择。
Translation: Conclusion: For patients with non-ST-segment elevation ACS receiving tirofiban and aspirin therapy, enoxaparin is an appropriate alternative to unfractionated heparin.

Query_Text_cn: 依诺肝素可使一级终点相对减少12％，绝对减少1％，符合非劣势标准。该结果与以往未联用糖蛋白Ⅱb/Ⅲa受体拮抗剂的试验一致。
Translation: Enoxaparin resulted in a 12% relative reduction and a 1% absolute reduction in the primary endpoint, meeting the non-inferiority criteria. This result is consistent with previous trials in which glycoprotein IIb/IIIa receptor antagonists were not used in combination.

Query_Text_cn: 近年来的研究显示，有几类抗血小板及抗栓药物能安全有效地治疗非ST段抬高急性冠脉综合征(ACS)。
Translation: Recent studies have shown that several classes of antiplatelet and antithrombotic drugs can safely and effectively treat non-ST-segment elevation acute coronary syndrome (ACS).

Query_Text_cn: 美国心脏病学会、美国心脏病协会及欧洲心脏病协会的指南均建议，对于非ST段抬高ACS高危患者，应早期应用小分子血小板糖蛋白Ⅱb/Ⅲa受体拮抗剂及普通肝素，在拟行介入治疗的患者更应如此。
Translation: The guidelines of the American College of Cardiology, the American Heart Association, and the European Society of Cardiology all recommend the early use of small-molecule platelet glycoprotein IIb/IIIa receptor antagonists and unfractionated heparin in high-risk patients with non-ST-segment elevation acute coronary syndrome, especially in those who are scheduled to undergo interventional therapy.

Query_Text_cn: 这些指南还支持用低分子肝素(LMWHs)代替普通肝素治疗非ST段抬高ACS患者(准备行急诊冠脉旁路搭桥术者例外)。
Translation: These guidelines also support the use of low-molecular-weight heparins (LMWHs) instead of unfractionated heparin for the treatment of patients with non-ST-segment elevation ACS, except for those scheduled to undergo emergency coronary artery bypass grafting.

Query_Text_cn: 与普通肝素相比LMWHs更易使用，无需常规监测抗凝效果，而且较少出现血小板刺激肝素诱发的血小板减少症发生率亦较低。
Translation: Compared with unfractionated heparin, low-molecular-weight heparins (LMWHs) are easier to use, do not require routine monitoring of anticoagulant effects, and are less likely to cause heparin-induced thrombocytopenia due to reduced platelet activation.

Query_Text_cn: 已有两项大规模临床试验证实，LMWH依诺肝素用于治疗非S段抬高ACS患者具有优越性。
Translation: Two large-scale clinical trials have confirmed the superiority of LMWH enoxaparin in treating patients with non-ST-segment elevation ACS.

Query_Text_cn: LMWH的一个主要缺点在于它可增加轻度出血的发生率。
Translation: One major drawback of LMWH is that it can increase the incidence of mild bleeding.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，尚不清楚依诺肝素和糖蛋白Ⅱb/Ⅲa受体拮抗剂联合应用是否与普通肝素和糖蛋白Ⅱb/Ⅲa受体拮抗剂联合应用一样安全、有效。
Translation: At present, it is unclear whether the combined use of enoxaparin and glycoprotein IIb/IIIa receptor antagonists is as safe and effective as the combination of unfractionated heparin and glycoprotein IIb/IIIa receptor antagonists.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，我们进行了AtoZ试验的A阶段试验，以便在ACS患者中评价依诺肝素与普通肝素和糖蛋白Ⅱb/Ⅲa受体拮抗剂联合应用的疗效及安全性。
Translation: To this end, we conducted the Phase A trial of the AtoZ study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of enoxaparin compared with unfractionated heparin in combination with glycoprotein IIb/IIIa receptor antagonists in patients with ACS.

Query_Text_cn: AtoZ试验的设计方法以往已有文章详细描述。
Translation: The design methodology of the AtoZ trial has been detailed in previous publications.

Query_Text_cn: 简言之，A阶段试验旨在于接受替罗非班和阿斯匹林治疗的非ST段抬高ACS患者中比较依诺肝素与普通肝素的安全性和疗效。
Translation: In brief, the Phase A trial aims to compare the safety and efficacy of enoxaparin versus unfractionated heparin in patients with non-ST-segment elevation ACS receiving tirofiban and aspirin therapy.

Query_Text_cn: 同时，A阶段试验还为z阶段研究提供了一组经过合理治疗的非ST段抬高ACS患者队列，后者对辛伐他汀早期强化治疗的疗效及耐受性进行了评估。
Translation: At the same time, the Phase A trial also provided the Phase Z study with a cohort of non-ST-segment elevation ACS patients who had received appropriate treatment, allowing for the evaluation of the efficacy and tolerability of early intensive simvastatin therapy.

Query_Text_cn: 试验草案得到所在地学术审查委员会的批准。所有患者均签定了知情同意书。人选条件包括：非ST段抬高ACS患者，在静息时发生缺血症状后24小时内就诊，症状持续10分钟以上，伴有心电图ST段压低或抬高0.5mm以上、一过性ST段抬高1mm以上或伴有心脏标记物水平升高(心脏肌钙蛋白或者肌酸激酶为正常值高限或超过正常值；如果没有测定特异性心脏标记物，则总肌酸激酶超过正常上限的两倍)。
Translation: The trial protocol was approved by the local academic review committee. All patients provided written informed consent. Inclusion criteria were: patients with non-ST-segment elevation acute coronary syndrome (ACS) who presented within 24 hours after the onset of ischemic symptoms at rest, with symptoms lasting more than 10 minutes, accompanied by electrocardiographic ST-segment depression or elevation of more than 0.5 mm, transient ST-segment elevation of more than 1 mm, or elevated cardiac biomarkers (cardiac troponin or creatine kinase at or above the upper limit of normal; if specific cardiac biomarkers were not measured, total creatine kinase exceeding twice the upper limit of normal).

Query_Text_cn: 排除标准包括：非缺血性胸痛，休克，妨碍研究药物使用的临床情况，正在进行降脂治疗以及不符合试验条件。
Translation: Exclusion criteria include: non-ischemic chest pain, shock, clinical conditions that interfere with the use of study medication, ongoing lipid-lowering therapy, and failure to meet trial requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 重要的实验室排除标准包括总胆固醇水平高于250mg/dL(>6.48mmoL/L)以及血肌酐高于2mg/dL(176.8mmoL/L)。
Translation: Important laboratory exclusion criteria include a total cholesterol level higher than 250 mg/dL (>6.48 mmol/L) and a serum creatinine level higher than 2 mg/dL (176.8 μmol/L).

Query_Text_cn: AtoZ试验之A阶段研究为开标、随机、有效对照研究。研究在接受替罗非班和阿斯匹林的患者中对依诺肝素与普通肝素进行了比较。
Translation: The A phase of the AtoZ trial was an open-label, randomized, and controlled study. It compared enoxaparin with unfractionated heparin in patients receiving tirofiban and aspirin.

Query_Text_cn: 随机按盲法进行，使用的是一种以各研究中心为单位的简单分配方案，该方案采用密封的信封，与分配到各中心的每例患者的数字相对应。
Translation: Randomization was conducted using a blinded method, employing a simple allocation scheme based on each research center. This scheme utilized sealed envelopes, each corresponding to the number assigned to each patient enrolled at the respective center.

Query_Text_cn: 信封内包含的分配治疗方案是通过一种简单的非区组随机程序产生的。
Translation: The treatment allocation scheme contained in the envelope was generated using a simple non-block randomization procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 开标治疗包括应用依诺肝素(1mg/kg，每12小时一次)或根据体重调整的普通肝素。
Translation: Initial treatment includes the use of enoxaparin (1 mg/kg every 12 hours) or weight-adjusted unfractionated heparin.

Query_Text_cn: 根据美国心脏病学会和美国心脏病协会治疗指南选用普通肝素剂量(体重I>70kg的患者先给予4000U静脉推注，继之以900U/h静脉滴注；体重小于70kg的患者，静脉推注60U/kg[最大量不超过4000U]，继之以每小时12U/kg的速度静脉滴注)。
Translation: According to the treatment guidelines of the American College of Cardiology and the American Heart Association, the recommended dosage of unfractionated heparin is as follows: for patients weighing more than 70 kg, administer an initial intravenous bolus of 4,000 units, followed by a continuous intravenous infusion at a rate of 900 units per hour; for patients weighing less than 70 kg, administer an intravenous bolus of 60 units/kg (with a maximum dose not exceeding 4,000 units), followed by a continuous intravenous infusion at a rate of 12 units/kg per hour.

Query_Text_cn: 使用研究提供的运算方法调整普通肝素剂量，使激活部分凝血酶原时间维持于50～70秒。
Translation: Adjust the dosage of regular heparin using the calculation methods provided by the study to maintain the activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT) at 50–70 seconds.

Query_Text_cn: 要求所有人选患者均接受替罗非班和阿斯匹林治疗。
Translation: All selected patients are required to receive treatment with tirofiban and aspirin.

Query_Text_cn: AtoZ试验采用的替罗非班剂量方案综合了以往试验在ACS或者经皮冠状动脉介入治疗中证实的用量方案：首先按10mg/kg剂量在3分钟内完成静脉推注，继之以每分钟0.1mg/kg的速度维持静脉滴注，建议至少持续48小时(介入治疗后至少维持12小时)，最长可达120小时。
Translation: The tirofiban dosing regimen used in the AtoZ trial was based on protocols proven effective in previous studies involving ACS or percutaneous coronary intervention: an initial intravenous bolus of 10 mg/kg administered over 3 minutes, followed by a continuous intravenous infusion at a rate of 0.1 mg/kg per minute. It is recommended that the infusion be maintained for at least 48 hours (and for at least 12 hours after the intervention), with a maximum duration of up to 120 hours.

Query_Text_cn: 阿斯匹林的初始剂量为150～325mg/d，以后整个治疗期间剂量维持于75～325mg/d。
Translation: The initial dose of aspirin is 150–325 mg per day, and during the entire course of treatment, the dose is maintained at 75–325 mg per day.

Query_Text_cn: 早期采取介入治疗(拟于108小时内行导管手术)还是保守治疗(首先采用药物治疗，不拟行导管手术)由研究者决定。
Translation: The decision to pursue early interventional treatment (scheduled catheterization within 108 hours) or conservative treatment (initially using medication without planned catheterization) is made by the investigator.

Query_Text_cn: 研究者在人选时的治疗策略是指定的。
Translation: The treatment strategy for participants was predetermined by the researchers.

Query_Text_cn: 替罗非班在经皮冠状动脉介入手术后可停用12小时。
Translation: Tirofiban can be discontinued 12 hours after percutaneous coronary intervention.

Query_Text_cn: 随机接受依诺肝素的患者在行介入手术时允许改用普通肝素。
Translation: Patients who were randomly assigned to receive enoxaparin were permitted to switch to unfractionated heparin during interventional procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 在治疗30天时对所有患者进行终点随访，其中包括对随机选人z阶段试验的患者进行一次访视，也对不符合或拒绝进入z阶段试验的患者进行一次电话访谈。
Translation: All patients underwent endpoint follow-up at 30 days of treatment, which included an in-person visit for patients randomized to the Z-phase trial, as well as a telephone interview for those who were ineligible for or declined participation in the Z-phase trial.

Query_Text_cn: 一级复合终点包括全因死亡、新发心肌梗死(MI，即心脏标记物水平超过正常上限两倍或出现缺血症状伴标记物水平升高>50％)以及应用替罗非班7天内发生难治性缺血。
Translation: The primary composite endpoint included all-cause mortality, new-onset myocardial infarction (MI, defined as cardiac biomarker levels exceeding twice the upper limit of normal or the presence of ischemic symptoms accompanied by a >50% increase in biomarker levels), and refractory ischemia occurring within 7 days of tirofiban administration.

Query_Text_cn: 难治性缺血的标准为有反复发作的症状，有心电图改变或者心脏标记物水平升高。
Translation: The criteria for refractory ischemia are recurrent symptoms accompanied by electrocardiographic changes or elevated cardiac biomarkers.

Query_Text_cn: 全因死亡、MI、难治性缺血、紧急冠脉重建以及多发临床心肌缺血事件于第7天逐个进行综合评价。
Translation: All-cause mortality, myocardial infarction, refractory ischemia, urgent coronary revascularization, and multiple clinical myocardial ischemic events were individually assessed in a composite evaluation on day 7.

Query_Text_cn: 多发临床缺血事件定义为需要改变治疗的胸痛，但不符合难治性缺血的标准。
Translation: Recurrent clinical ischemic events are defined as chest pain requiring a change in treatment but not meeting the criteria for refractory ischemia.

Query_Text_cn: 三级终点在48小时和30天时进行评价，包括了所有一级和二级终点事件以及因ACS再人院。
Translation: Tertiary endpoints are evaluated at 48 hours and 30 days, including all primary and secondary endpoint events as well as rehospitalization due to ACS.

Query_Text_cn: 所有终点均由独立的终点事件委员会判定，但冠脉重建除外。
Translation: All endpoints were adjudicated by an independent endpoint adjudication committee, except for coronary revascularization.

Query_Text_cn: 出血事件的收集自人选开始直至替罗非班静点结束后24小时。
Translation: Bleeding events were recorded from the time of subject selection until 24 hours after the completion of tirofiban infusion.

Query_Text_cn: 首先，病例报告表要记录研究者的判定；另外，还要对出血进行独立的回顾性盲法判断，获取基线及第一天血红蛋白数值以及导管手术前后数值。
Translation: First, the case report form must record the investigator's assessment. In addition, an independent retrospective blinded evaluation of bleeding should be conducted, and baseline and Day 1 hemoglobin values, as well as values before and after catheter procedures, should be obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 第二，获取输注的浓缩红细胞的单位数。
Translation: Second, obtain the number of units of concentrated red blood cells transfused.

Query_Text_cn: 如果患者接受冠状动脉旁路搭桥术，应在手术当天检查有关出血及输血的资料。
Translation: If the patient undergoes coronary artery bypass grafting, information related to bleeding and transfusion should be reviewed on the day of the surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 在最终的出血报告中，利用最差情况分析法汇总研究者和各中心出血事件的判定结果。
Translation: In the final bleeding report, the determinations of bleeding events by investigators and each center are summarized using the worst-case analysis method.

Query_Text_cn: 采用心肌梗死溶栓治疗试验(TIMI)的标准，根据血红蛋白变化对出血事件进行分级。
Translation: According to the standards of the Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction (TIMI) trial, bleeding events are classified based on changes in hemoglobin levels.

Query_Text_cn: 严重出血指患者血红蛋白下降超5rag/dE；或者发生颅内出血或心包出血。
Translation: Severe bleeding refers to a decrease in hemoglobin of more than 5 g/dL in the patient, or the occurrence of intracranial hemorrhage or pericardial hemorrhage.

Query_Text_cn: 轻微出血指血红蛋白下降3～5mg/dL，出血部位明确；或者血红蛋白下降4～5mg/dL，出血部位不明确，有血尿、呕血及便血等。
Translation: Mild bleeding refers to a decrease in hemoglobin of 3–5 mg/dL with a clearly identified bleeding site; or a decrease in hemoglobin of 4–5 mg/dL with an unidentified bleeding site, accompanied by symptoms such as hematuria, hematemesis, or melena.

Query_Text_cn: 每输血一个单位计为血红蛋白下降1mg/dL。
Translation: Each unit of transfused blood is considered to decrease hemoglobin by 1 mg/dL.

Query_Text_cn: 由独立的资料安全监督委员会对试验的安全性进行监督。
Translation: The safety of the trial is overseen by an independent Data Safety Monitoring Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 试验期间进行两次中期分析，都未达到0’Brien-Fleming的Lan-DeMets执行规则制定的试验终止界值。
Translation: Two interim analyses were conducted during the trial, neither of which reached the trial termination threshold established by the O'Brien-Fleming Lan-DeMets implementation rule.

Query_Text_cn: 主要统计分析工作得到赞助者(Merck)的认可，由杜克临床研究院进行。
Translation: The primary statistical analyses were conducted by the Duke Clinical Research Institute and endorsed by the sponsor (Merck).

Query_Text_cn: 研究开始时根据研究资料确定把握度及非劣势范围。
Translation: At the outset of the study, the degree of confidence and the non-inferiority margin were determined based on the research data.

Query_Text_cn: 结果发现普通肝素和替罗非班组计划事件的发生率为12.9％。
Translation: The results showed that the incidence of planned events in the unfractionated heparin and tirofiban groups was 12.9%.

Query_Text_cn: 根据以往的研究推断，依诺肝素疗效可达10％。
Translation: Based on previous studies, it is inferred that the efficacy of enoxaparin can reach 10%.

Query_Text_cn: 根据最初计划5200例患者有89％的把握度符合非劣势设计(界限)要求，具体情况如下与普通肝素相比，如果依诺肝素相对疗效的单侧95％可信界限(双侧90％可信区间[CI])上限值小于1.14，即认为依诺肝素与普通肝素等效。
Translation: According to the initial plan, with 5,200 patients, there is an 89% probability of meeting the requirements of the non-inferiority design (margin). Specifically, compared with unfractionated heparin, if the upper limit of the one-sided 95% confidence boundary (two-sided 90% confidence interval [CI]) for the relative efficacy of enoxaparin is less than 1.14, enoxaparin is considered equivalent to unfractionated heparin.

Query_Text_cn: 这个范围来源于PRISM-PLU(在该研究中，与普通肝素相比，替罗非班与普通肝素联合治疗的死亡、加及难治性缺血的优势比为0.66)。
Translation: This range is derived from PRISM-PLU (in this study, the odds ratio for death, myocardial infarction, and refractory ischemia with the combination of tirofiban and unfractionated heparin compared to unfractionated heparin alone was 0.66).

Query_Text_cn: 根据95％CI上限倒数得到的非劣势范围为1.14。
Translation: The non-inferiority margin calculated based on the reciprocal of the upper limit of the 95% confidence interval is 1.14.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究样本量为4000例，进行同样的把握度计算，结果发现获得小于1.14的95％CI上限值的可能性为81％。
Translation: The sample size of this study is 4,000 cases. Using the same calculation for precision, the results show that there is an 81% probability of obtaining an upper limit of the 95% confidence interval less than 1.14.

Query_Text_cn: 研究主要对所有随机意向治疗人群进行了时间事件分析。
Translation: The study primarily conducted time-to-event analysis on all randomized intention-to-treat populations.

Query_Text_cn: 在398例随机患者中，有两个中心的6例患者(一个中心4例，另一中心例)丢失了记录资料。
Translation: Among the 398 randomized patients, records for 6 patients from two centers (4 from one center and 2 from the other) were lost.

Query_Text_cn: 另有两个人群预先指定用于支持或者推翻非劣势研究结果，其中一组人群接受治疗(n=3719；患者应用替罗非班且人选后，12小时内至少接受一次随机治疗)，另一组患者接受保守治疗(n=1506；患者在随机后108小时内未接受冠状动脉造影及经皮冠状动脉介入手术)。
Translation: Two additional groups were pre-designated to support or refute the non-inferiority study results. One group received treatment (n=3,719; patients were administered tirofiban and, after selection, received at least one randomized treatment within 12 hours), while the other group received conservative therapy (n=1,506; patients did not undergo coronary angiography or percutaneous coronary intervention within 108 hours after randomization).

Query_Text_cn: 这两个人群内部的一致性通过疗效终点估计确定而不是通过95％CI的上限值，因为后者的规定使样本数量减少。
Translation: The consistency within these two populations is determined by the estimation of efficacy endpoints rather than by the upper limit of the 95% confidence interval, as the latter requirement reduces the sample size.

Query_Text_cn: 根据Cox比例风险模型进行分析。
Translation: Analysis was conducted using the Cox proportional hazards model.

Query_Text_cn: 协变量包括治疗组、年龄、人选后7天内阿斯匹林的使用情况。
Translation: Covariates include treatment group, age, and aspirin use within 7 days after enrollment.

Query_Text_cn: 主要安全性分析是针对按照方案治疗的人群(n=3906例)而言的。根据实际接受治疗的不同，患者被分为依诺肝素组(n=1941)和普通肝素组(n=1965)。
Translation: The primary safety analysis was conducted on the population treated according to the protocol (n=3,906). Based on the actual treatment received, patients were divided into the enoxaparin group (n=1,941) and the unfractionated heparin group (n=1,965).

Query_Text_cn: 接受两种治疗的患者均按照最初随机分组进行分析。
Translation: Patients receiving both treatments were analyzed according to their initial randomization groups.

Query_Text_cn: 应用Fisher精确性检验比较TIMI出血分级和其他不良事件，包括输血和发生血小板减少症的差异。
Translation: Fisher's exact test was used to compare differences in TIMI bleeding grades and other adverse events, including transfusion and the occurrence of thrombocytopenia.

Query_Text_cn: 应用SAS软件进行统计学分析(第8版，SASInstituteInc，Cary，NC)。
Translation: Statistical analysis was performed using SAS software (8th edition, SAS Institute Inc., Cary, NC).

Query_Text_cn: 从1999年l2月至2002年月，来自41个国家340个研究中心的3987例患者入选A阶段研究截至2002年5月，尚未达到最初制定的5200例患者的入选目标，但因为该试验z阶段研究的入选工作已接近完成，因此停止继续入选患者。
Translation: From December 1999 to February 2002, 3,987 patients from 340 research centers in 41 countries were enrolled in Phase A of the study. As of May 2002, the initial enrollment target of 5,200 patients had not yet been reached. However, since enrollment for Phase Z of the trial was nearing completion, further patient enrollment was discontinued.

Query_Text_cn: 大部分患者来自欧洲和美国(2583/3987)。
Translation: The majority of patients were from Europe and the United States (2,583/3,987).

Query_Text_cn: 入选患者中大约2/3继续进入z阶段研究，其余患者在完成30天电话随访后即结束研究。
Translation: Approximately two-thirds of the enrolled patients proceeded to the Z phase of the study, while the remaining patients completed the study after a 30-day telephone follow-up.

Query_Text_cn: 99.5％的患者(依诺肝素组2018例，普通肝素组1952例)完成7天一级终点事件随访。
Translation: 99.5% of patients (2,018 in the enoxaparin group and 1,952 in the unfractionated heparin group) completed the 7-day primary endpoint follow-up.

Query_Text_cn: 两治疗组基线特征相似。
Translation: The baseline characteristics of the two treatment groups were similar.

Query_Text_cn: 2927例患者(74％)患有非ST段抬高MI。
Translation: 2,927 patients (74%) had non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI).

Query_Text_cn: 人选患者中有3190例(80％)发现肌钙蛋白和肌酸激酶-MB升高。
Translation: Among the selected patients, elevated troponin and creatine kinase-MB levels were detected in 3,190 cases (80%).

Query_Text_cn: 只有1221例患者(30.7％)在人选前既没有接受普通肝素治疗也没有接受LMWH治疗。
Translation: Only 1,221 patients (30.7%) had received neither unfractionated heparin nor LMWH treatment prior to selection.

Query_Text_cn: 在随机接受依诺肝素治疗的2021例患者中有1115例(55.2％)接受早期介入治疗，而在随机接受普通肝素治疗的1995例患者中则有1083例(55.4％)接受早期介入治疗。
Translation: Among the 2,021 patients randomly assigned to receive enoxaparin, 1,115 (55.2%) underwent early interventional therapy, while among the 1,995 patients randomly assigned to receive unfractionated heparin, 1,083 (55.4%) underwent early interventional therapy.

Query_Text_cn: 48小时内，依诺肝素组2026例患者中有861例(42.5％)、普通肝素组1961例患者中有858例(43.8％)接受了导管手术。
Translation: Within 48 hours, 861 out of 2,026 patients (42.5%) in the enoxaparin group and 858 out of 1,961 patients (43.8%) in the unfractionated heparin group underwent catheterization procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 药物应用的中位持续时间在依诺肝素组为49.1小时，普通肝素组为48.2小时。
Translation: The median duration of drug administration was 49.1 hours in the enoxaparin group and 48.2 hours in the unfractionated heparin group.

Query_Text_cn: 对于7天一级终点分析而言，共有3970例患者获得了完整资料。
Translation: For the analysis of the 7-day primary endpoint, complete data were available for a total of 3,970 patients.
The overall incidence of events was approximately 8.4% (169/2018) in the enoxaparin group and 9.4% (184/1952) in the unfractionated heparin group (hazard ratio [HR], 0.88; 95% CI, 0.71–1.08).

Query_Text_cn: 依诺肝素组绝对获益率为1％，相对获益率为2％，符合预先指定的非劣势范围。
Translation: The absolute benefit rate in the enoxaparin group was 1%, and the relative benefit rate was 2%, both within the predefined non-inferiority margin.

Query_Text_cn: 对该人群进行一级复合终点分析，其结果与HRs一致，亦显示依诺肝素较为有利。
Translation: An analysis of the primary composite endpoint in this population yielded results consistent with the hazard ratios, also indicating that enoxaparin is more favorable.
Among the treated population, the overall incidence of events was 8.6% (157/1836) in the enoxaparin group and 9.5% (178/1875) in the unfractionated heparin group (HR, 0.89; 95% CI, 0.72–1.11).

Query_Text_cn: 在接受保守治疗的人群中，总事件发生率依诺肝素组为6.7％(52/773)，普通肝素组为8.0％(58/728)(HR，0.85；95％CI，0.58～1.23)。
Translation: Among patients receiving conservative treatment, the overall event rate was 6.7% (52/773) in the enoxaparin group and 8.0% (58/728) in the unfractionated heparin group (HR, 0.85; 95% CI, 0.58–1.23).

Query_Text_cn: 同样，第7天时二级复合终点(还包括紧急血管重建和临床缺血)亦显示依诺肝素有利趋势(HR，0.89；95％CI，0.75～1.05)。
Translation: Similarly, at day 7, the secondary composite endpoint (which also includes urgent vascular reconstruction and clinical ischemia) showed a favorable trend for enoxaparin (HR, 0.89; 95% CI, 0.75–1.05).

Query_Text_cn: 除死亡外，该复合终点的所有组分都有利于依诺肝素。接受依诺肝素者的死亡率为1.1％(n=23)，接受普通肝素者的死亡率0.9％(n=17)。
Translation: Except for mortality, all components of the composite endpoint favored enoxaparin. The mortality rate was 1.1% (n=23) in the enoxaparin group and 0.9% (n=17) in the unfractionated heparin group.

Query_Text_cn: 意向治疗人群各亚组的HRs分析显示，几乎在所有的高危亚组依诺肝素对终点都是有利的，未发现组间存在显著的相互作用。
Translation: Analysis of hazard ratios (HRs) across subgroups in the intention-to-treat population showed that enoxaparin was beneficial for the endpoint in almost all high-risk subgroups, with no significant interaction observed between groups.

Query_Text_cn: 趋势分析表明，在既往没有使用抗凝治疗的情况下，依诺肝素组发生一级终点事件的危险较低(HR，0.77；95％CI，0.53～1.11；P=0.38)。
Translation: Trend analysis indicates that, in the absence of prior anticoagulant therapy, the enoxaparin group had a lower risk of primary endpoint events (HR, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.53–1.11; P=0.38).

Query_Text_cn: 本试验患者总输血率为0.9％两个随机治疗组间无显著差异。
Translation: The overall transfusion rate among patients in this trial was 0.9%, with no significant difference between the two randomized treatment groups.

Query_Text_cn: 在按照方案进行治疗的人群中，依诺肝素组19例患者(1.0％)、普通肝素组16例患者(0.8％)患者输注了浓缩红细胞。
Translation: Among the population treated according to the protocol, 19 patients (1.0%) in the enoxaparin group and 16 patients (0.8%) in the unfractionated heparin group received transfusions of concentrated red blood cells.

Query_Text_cn: 住院期间血小板计数小于90×103/μL的患者在依诺肝素组为1.2％(23/1936)，在普通肝素组为1.5％(30/1961)。
Translation: During hospitalization, the incidence of patients with platelet counts less than 90×10^3/μL was 1.2% (23/1936) in the enoxaparin group and 1.5% (30/1961) in the unfractionated heparin group.

Query_Text_cn: 依诺肝素组有例患者、普通肝素组有6例患者血小板计数小于20×103/μL。
Translation: There was 1 patient in the enoxaparin group and 6 patients in the unfractionated heparin group with a platelet count less than 20×10^3/μL.

Query_Text_cn: 按方案进行治疗的人群中，临床明显出血(TIM1分级中的重度及轻微出血)的联合发生率依诺肝素组为3.0％(59/1940)，普通肝素组为2.2％(44/1965)(P=0.13)。
Translation: Among the population treated according to the protocol, the combined incidence of clinically significant bleeding (major and minor bleeding according to TIMI classification) was 3.0% (59/1940) in the enoxaparin group and 2.2% (44/1965) in the unfractionated heparin group (P=0.13).

Query_Text_cn: 对TIMI重度出血进行最坏情况分析表明，应用依诺肝素可使出血的几率增加，大约每200例患者增加1例出血患者(依诺肝素组为0.9％[n=18]，普通肝素组为0.4％[n=8]，P=0.05)。
Translation: A worst-case analysis of TIMI major bleeding indicated that the use of enoxaparin may increase the likelihood of bleeding, with approximately one additional bleeding event per 200 patients (0.9% [n=18] in the enoxaparin group vs. 0.4% [n=8] in the unfractionated heparin group, P=0.05).

Query_Text_cn: 进一步分析发现，研究者报告的重度出血两组无显著差异(依诺肝素组为0.4％[n=8]，而普通肝素组为0.3％[n=5]；P=0.42)，但通过独立评价确定的重度出血两组则具有显著差异(分别为0.8％[n=15]和0.2％[n=4I，P=0.01)。
Translation: Further analysis revealed that there was no significant difference in major bleeding reported by investigators between the two groups (0.4% [n=8] in the enoxaparin group vs. 0.3% [n=5] in the unfractionated heparin group; P=0.42). However, major bleeding determined by independent adjudication showed a significant difference between the two groups (0.8% [n=15] vs. 0.2% [n=4], P=0.01).

Query_Text_cn: 在接受早期介入治疗的患者中，依诺肝素组与普通肝素组重度出血的发生率无显著差异。
Translation: Among patients receiving early intervention therapy, there was no significant difference in the incidence of major bleeding between the enoxaparin group and the unfractionated heparin group.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，报告的所有出血却显著增加，这主要是由于研究者确定的轻微出血事件增加所致。
Translation: However, the overall reported bleeding increased significantly, primarily due to a rise in minor bleeding events identified by the researchers.

Query_Text_cn: 治疗前应用一种肝素，随机治疗时又换用另一种肝素不增加出血危险。
Translation: Using one type of heparin before treatment and switching to another type during randomized therapy does not increase the risk of bleeding.

Query_Text_cn: 随机分组后接受不同肝素者在依诺肝素组(275/1940)比在普通肝素组(62/1965)更为常见。
Translation: After randomization, receiving different types of heparin was more common in the enoxaparin group (275/1940) than in the unfractionated heparin group (62/1965).

Query_Text_cn: 在最初接受依诺肝素治疗的患者中，重度及轻微出血的总发生率在单用依诺肝素组为3.0％(50/1665)，而在最初应用依诺肝素后来转为普通肝素的患者中则为3.3％(9/275)。
Translation: Among patients who initially received enoxaparin therapy, the overall incidence of major and minor bleeding was 3.0% (50/1665) in the enoxaparin-only group, while it was 3.3% (9/275) in patients who were initially treated with enoxaparin and then switched to unfractionated heparin.

Query_Text_cn: 意向治疗人群出血的发生率与按照方案进行治疗的人群相似。
Translation: The incidence of bleeding in the intended treatment population is similar to that in the population treated according to the protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 对随机人选Atoz试验A阶段研究的3987例患者进行分析发现，与普通肝素相比，依诺肝素在预防死亡、MI及难治性缺血复合终点事件方面具有1％的绝对优势和12％的相对优势。
Translation: An analysis of 3,987 patients in the A phase of the randomized Atoz trial found that, compared with unfractionated heparin, enoxaparin demonstrated a 1% absolute advantage and a 12% relative advantage in preventing the composite endpoint of death, myocardial infarction, and refractory ischemia.

Query_Text_cn: 这种益处虽然尚未达到判定优趱陛的标准，但是却完全处于非劣势研究的指定界限内。
Translation: Although these benefits have not yet met the criteria for superiority, they are well within the specified boundaries for non-inferiority studies.

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现，在各个亚组人群以及大多数亚组中，依诺肝素均可使风险下降10％~15％，但未达到显著水平。
Translation: We found that in all subpopulations and most subgroups, enoxaparin reduced the risk by 10% to 15%, although the reduction did not reach statistical significance.

Query_Text_cn: 在高危患者、接受保守治疗的患者以及随机前24小时内未接受溶栓治疗的患者中，这种危险下降的幅度更大。由于并未发现依诺肝素具有明显的优越性，因此对上述趋势的解释应该慎重。
Translation: The magnitude of this risk reduction was greater among high-risk patients, those receiving conservative treatment, and patients who had not received thrombolytic therapy within 24 hours prior to randomization. Since no clear superiority of enoxaparin was observed, caution should be exercised in interpreting these trends.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，这些趋势与以往研究结果是一致的，其中包括有关糖蛋白Ⅱb/11Ia抑制剂替罗非班的研究以及依诺肝素与普通肝素对比研究，这些研究均发现依诺肝素对高危患者具有相对较好的效果。
Translation: However, these trends are consistent with previous research findings, including studies on the glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor tirofiban and comparisons between enoxaparin and unfractionated heparin, all of which have found that enoxaparin has relatively better effects in high-risk patients.

Query_Text_cn: 随着抗血小板治疗和溶栓治疗研究的进展，我们应认识到如何将这些治疗措施进行最佳组合，从而用于非ST段抬高ACS患者，这一点很重要。
Translation: With the advancement of research on antiplatelet therapy and thrombolytic therapy, it is important to recognize how to optimally combine these treatment approaches for use in patients with non-ST-segment elevation ACS.

Query_Text_cn: 以往在非sT段抬高ACS患者中进行的普通肝素与依诺肝素(作为替罗非班的辅助治疗)比较试验都是针对安全性而设计的，没有充分考虑临床终点问题。
Translation: Previous trials comparing unfractionated heparin and enoxaparin (as adjunctive therapy to tirofiban) in patients with non-ST-segment elevation ACS were designed primarily to assess safety, without adequately considering clinical endpoints.

Query_Text_cn: 在“替罗非班与依诺肝素联合溶栓治疗试验Ⅱ”(ACUTEII)中，依诺肝素可显著降低需紧急血管重建的难治性缺血的发生率以及不稳定性心绞痛再人院率。
Translation: In the "Tirofiban and Enoxaparin Combined Thrombolytic Therapy Trial II" (ACUTE II), enoxaparin significantly reduced the incidence of refractory ischemia requiring urgent vascular reconstruction and the rate of rehospitalization for unstable angina.

Query_Text_cn: 后一终点并不要求有缺血的客观证据，并且可能与本试验中依诺肝素减少复发性临床缺血的强烈趋势相关。
Translation: The latter endpoint does not require objective evidence of ischemia and may be related to the strong trend observed in this trial for enoxaparin to reduce recurrent clinical ischemia.

Query_Text_cn: “Integfilin与依诺肝素治疗急性冠脉综合征随机研究”(INTERACT)人选了746例患者，对依诺肝素和普通肝素分别与eptifibatide及阿斯匹林联合应用进行了比较。
Translation: The "Randomized Study of Integfilin and Enoxaparin in the Treatment of Acute Coronary Syndromes" (INTERACT) enrolled 746 patients to compare the combined use of enoxaparin or unfractionated heparin with eptifibatide and aspirin.

Query_Text_cn: 该试验最初入选的患者大约有1/3因既往接受溶栓治疗而被方案拒绝，并且该试验既往应用溶栓治疗的平均时间仅为4个小时。
Translation: Approximately one-third of the patients initially enrolled in the trial were excluded due to prior thrombolytic therapy, and the average time from prior thrombolytic treatment in this trial was only four hours.

Query_Text_cn: 在INTERACT试验，治疗7天时依诺肝素在死亡和MI联合终点的获益率达38％，而对死亡、加及心电图改变复合终点的获益率则为19％(ShaunGoodman，书面交流，2003年3月)。
Translation: In the INTERACT trial, after 7 days of treatment, enoxaparin achieved a 38% benefit rate for the combined endpoint of death and myocardial infarction, while the benefit rate for the composite endpoint of death, recurrent angina, and ECG changes was 19% (Shaun Goodman, personal communication, March 2003).

Query_Text_cn: 在AtoZ试验A阶段研究，在以往没有接受溶栓治疗的患者中，随机接受依诺肝素治疗者与随机接受普通肝素者相比，前者7天时三联复合终点的发生率降低了23％。
Translation: In the A phase of the AtoZ trial, among patients who had not previously received thrombolytic therapy, those randomly assigned to enoxaparin treatment experienced a 23% reduction in the incidence of the triple composite endpoint at 7 days compared to those randomly assigned to unfractionated heparin.

Query_Text_cn: 在本研究中，普通肝素组复合事件发生率为9.4％，低于“皮下依诺肝素治疗不稳定型心绞痛和非Q波MI的疗效及安全性试验”(ESSENCE)(23.3％)以及试验(14.5％)，而与INTERACT试验(9.8％)相近。
Translation: In this study, the incidence of composite events in the unfractionated heparin group was 9.4%, which is lower than that reported in the "Efficacy and Safety of Subcutaneous Enoxaparin in Unstable Angina and Non-Q-Wave Myocardial Infarction" (ESSENCE) trial (23.3%) and another trial (14.5%), but similar to that of the INTERACT trial (9.8%).

Query_Text_cn: 这可能与各试验中患者的临床特征以及对治疗指南的依从程度不同有关，本试验是严格遵守指南治疗的。
Translation: This may be related to differences in the clinical characteristics of patients in each trial and the degree of adherence to treatment guidelines; in this trial, treatment was strictly in accordance with the guidelines.

Query_Text_cn: 在AtoZ中，试验A阶段研究和INTERACT试验中，所有入选患者都应用了糖蛋白Ⅱb/Ⅲa抑制剂也可能是这两项试验发现普通肝素组事件发生率较低的原因。
Translation: In the AtoZ trial, the phase A study, and the INTERACT trial, the use of glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors in all enrolled patients may also be a reason why a lower event rate was observed in the unfractionated heparin group in these two trials.

Query_Text_cn: 另外，与以前的研究人群相比，A阶段研究中患者年龄约小3岁，既往有MI史的患者较少。
Translation: In addition, compared with previous study populations, patients in the Phase A study were approximately three years younger and had a lower proportion of individuals with a history of myocardial infarction.

Query_Text_cn: 研究排除了既往应用他汀类药物的患者(进入Z阶段患者)，可能有利于人选低危患者。
Translation: The study excluded patients with prior use of statins (patients entering the Z phase), which may help in selecting low-risk patients.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管接受介入治疗、有效抗血小板和溶栓治疗的患者的比例较高，但两个肝素治疗组出血、输血及血小板减少症的总发生率均较低。
Translation: Despite the relatively high proportion of patients receiving interventional therapy, effective antiplatelet, and thrombolytic treatment, the overall incidence of bleeding, transfusion, and thrombocytopenia remained low in both heparin treatment groups.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究重度出血的发生率略高于以前的两项试验(ACUTE11和INTERACT，均为评价糖蛋白Ⅱb/Ⅲa抑制剂与依诺肝素联合应用安全性的试验)，但在ACUTE11中仅出现3例严重出血事件，而在INTERACT中也仅出现4例。
Translation: The incidence of major bleeding in this study was slightly higher than in two previous trials (ACUTE11 and INTERACT, both of which evaluated the safety of combined use of glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors and enoxaparin). However, only three cases of major bleeding occurred in ACUTE11, and only four cases were reported in INTERACT.

Query_Text_cn: 与以往试验相比，AtoZ试验A阶段研究显示出较低的输血率(与冠状动脉搭桥术无关)，令人放心。
Translation: Compared with previous trials, the Phase A study of the AtoZ trial reassuringly showed a lower rate of transfusion (unrelated to coronary artery bypass grafting).

Query_Text_cn: 试验表明，依诺肝素有增加出血的倾向，但其绝对危险增幅较低。
Translation: Trials have shown that enoxaparin tends to increase the risk of bleeding, but the absolute increase in risk is relatively low.

Query_Text_cn: 每1000例患者中，由内科医生发现的严重出血的危险不足1.6，而根据血红蛋白下降大于5mg/dL确定的严重出血事件则为6/1000。
Translation: Among every 1,000 patients, the risk of severe bleeding detected by physicians is less than 1.6, whereas the incidence of severe bleeding events defined by a hemoglobin drop of more than 5 mg/dL is 6 per 1,000.

Query_Text_cn: 两种不同评价方法计算出的出血率存在差异，强调了清楚界定判定方法的重要性，以及当事件发生率较低时判断界值统计学趋势的临床意义的不确定性。
Translation: The differences in bleeding rates calculated by two distinct evaluation methods highlight the importance of clearly defining assessment criteria, as well as the uncertainty regarding the clinical significance of statistical trends in threshold determination when event incidence is low.

Query_Text_cn: 在本试验中，输血率较低，组间输血率无差别，进一步缩小了依诺肝素可致出血危险趋势增加的临床意义。
Translation: In this trial, the transfusion rate was low, and there was no difference between groups, which further minimized the clinical significance of the trend toward increased bleeding risk associated with enoxaparin.

Query_Text_cn: 这种药物引起出血及输血率差异趋势的不同可能是由于所用出血判定方法(血红蛋白变化与对事件的判定)不同以及普通肝素与替罗非班合用时建议剂量较小(4000U静脉注射及最大900U的初始静点剂量)所致。
Translation: The differing trends in bleeding and transfusion rates associated with this drug may be attributed to variations in the methods used to determine bleeding (such as changes in hemoglobin levels and event adjudication), as well as the relatively lower recommended doses of unfractionated heparin when used in combination with tirofiban (4,000 U intravenous bolus and a maximum initial infusion dose of 900 U).

Query_Text_cn: 本研究的开标设计是其最严重的局限。
Translation: The open-label design of this study is its most significant limitation.

Query_Text_cn: 对于早期治疗，知晓研究药物可以影响多种临床决策(特别在是否需要进行介入治疗方面)。
Translation: For early treatment, knowing the study drug can influence various clinical decisions, particularly regarding whether interventional therapy is necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管两个研究组在导管手术的时间选择和比例方面相似，但是仍会在确定疗效和安全性方面造成选择性偏倚。
Translation: Although the two study groups were similar in terms of the timing and proportion of catheter procedures, selection bias may still occur in determining efficacy and safety.

Query_Text_cn: 因为本研究并不是为明确早期介入治疗期间应用依诺肝素的疗效及安全性这个关键问题设计的因此研究允许随机接受依诺肝素的患者在介人手术时使用普通肝素——这在临床实践很常用。
Translation: Because this study was not designed to clarify the efficacy and safety of enoxaparin during early interventional therapy, it allowed patients randomized to receive enoxaparin to use unfractionated heparin during interventional procedures—a practice that is common in clinical settings.

Query_Text_cn: 这个问题将在规模更大、设计更为细致的临床试验中得到阐明。
Translation: This issue will be clarified in larger-scale and more meticulously designed clinical trials.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究允许24小时内已应用溶栓治疗的患者入选，这一特点亦可能对研究结果产生影响。
Translation: Our study allowed the inclusion of patients who had received thrombolytic therapy within 24 hours, which may also have influenced the study results.

Query_Text_cn: 独立的出血判定资料属于回顾性研究，而且不是原有研究方案的部分，但这是在试验监测阶段发现研究者报告的出血发生率较低时做出的一个正确决策。
Translation: The independent bleeding adjudication data is part of a retrospective study and was not included in the original research protocol. However, it was a correct decision made during the trial monitoring phase when it was observed that the incidence of bleeding reported by investigators was relatively low.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，试验没有全面获取有关氯吡格雷应用的资料，因此，不能确定使用氯吡格雷所致的危险增加或者获益。
Translation: Finally, the trial did not comprehensively collect information on the use of clopidogrel; therefore, it is not possible to determine whether clopidogrel use leads to increased risk or benefit.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究结果支持下述结论：依诺肝素作为普通肝素的一种非劣势替代药物，可以用于非ST段抬高ACS高危患者，这些患者亦适合糖蛋白Ⅱb/IlIa抑制剂治疗。
Translation: The results of this study support the following conclusion: Enoxaparin, as a non-inferior alternative to unfractionated heparin, can be used in high-risk patients with non-ST-segment elevation ACS who are also suitable for treatment with glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors.

Query_Text_cn: 临床必须对依诺肝素的益处与可能造成的影响进行权衡。因为依诺肝素的半衰期较长，所以某些患者使用时具有局限性，例如肾功能损害患者以及需要全面、迅速消除抗凝效果的患者(如接受冠状动脉旁路搭桥术者)。
Translation: Clinicians must weigh the benefits of enoxaparin against its potential impacts. Due to its relatively long half-life, enoxaparin has certain limitations in use for specific patients, such as those with impaired renal function and those who require complete and rapid reversal of anticoagulant effects (e.g., patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting).

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现，采用依诺肝素治疗，每200例患者可以增加1例重度出血的危险。
Translation: We found that treatment with enoxaparin increases the risk of one additional case of severe bleeding for every 200 patients treated.

Query_Text_cn: 这一发现的临床意义不大。因为未见输血的增加，因此其临床意义进一步降低。
Translation: The clinical significance of this finding is limited. Since no increase in transfusions was observed, its clinical relevance is further diminished.

Query_Text_cn: 由于依诺肝素的使用较为简单，能适度减少缺血事件复发，而且对血制品的需要没有增加，因此与普通肝素相比，依诺肝素对接受替罗非班及阿斯匹林治疗的非ST段抬高ACS患者是较为有利的。
Translation: Due to its relatively simple administration, moderate reduction in recurrent ischemic events, and no increased need for blood products, enoxaparin is more advantageous than unfractionated heparin for non-ST-segment elevation ACS patients receiving tirofiban and aspirin therapy.

Query_Text_cn: 于2001年制定的慢性阻塞性肺疾病全球创议(GOLD)标准为COPD的统一诊断和分期提供了一个构架，并在最近得到修订。
Translation: The Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD) standard, established in 2001, provided a framework for the unified diagnosis and staging of COPD and has been recently revised.

Query_Text_cn: 这些标准，大部分与美国胸科协会和欧洲呼吸学会的COPD指南一致。
Translation: Most of these standards are consistent with the COPD guidelines of the American Thoracic Society and the European Respiratory Society.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，这些COPD标准中有些内容尚存争议，其中最突出的即为GOLD中的0期COPD，即具有COPD发生危险的患者。
Translation: However, some aspects of these COPD criteria remain controversial, with the most prominent being Stage 0 COPD in the GOLD guidelines, which refers to patients at risk of developing COPD.

Query_Text_cn: 对于GOLD中0期的认识差异较大，从“对确定COPD高危人群极少有帮助”到“……对医疗有较大帮助”到“……与男性吸烟者病死率增加有关”。
Translation: There are significant differences in understanding Stage 0 in GOLD, ranging from "it is of little help in identifying high-risk COPD populations" to "it is quite helpful in medical practice" to "it is associated with increased mortality rates among male smokers."

Query_Text_cn: 在这方面的争议之一即是否确实存在GOLD中0期COPD。
Translation: One of the controversies in this regard is whether stage 0 COPD truly exists in the GOLD classification.

Query_Text_cn: 在既往的COPD定义中，除具有一些肺功能受损的证据外，尚需存在慢性呼吸系统症状。
Translation: In previous definitions of COPD, in addition to evidence of some degree of impaired lung function, the presence of chronic respiratory symptoms was also required.

Query_Text_cn: 我们从调查数据中获知，大部分肺功能受损者无呼吸系统症状，而大部分有呼吸系统症状者肺功能正常。
Translation: From the survey data, we found that most individuals with impaired lung function exhibit no respiratory symptoms, while most individuals with respiratory symptoms have normal lung function.

Query_Text_cn: 另一个争议是关于症状的，这在定义GOLD中的0期时确有涉及。
Translation: Another controversy concerns symptoms, which were indeed involved in the definition of Stage 0 in GOLD.

Query_Text_cn: 有些作者认为应有慢性支气管炎的症状，这在既往常用于COPD的定义中(例如每年至少3mo咳嗽和咳痰)。
Translation: Some authors believe that symptoms of chronic bronchitis should be present, as was commonly included in previous definitions of COPD (for example, cough and sputum production for at least three months each year).

Query_Text_cn: 亦有其他学者采用更为敏感的定义(即存在任何呼吸系统症状，诸如咳嗽、咳痰、喘息或呼吸困难，且有一定的发作频率)。
Translation: Other scholars have adopted a more sensitive definition, namely the presence of any respiratory symptoms such as cough, sputum production, wheezing, or shortness of breath, with a certain frequency of occurrence.

Query_Text_cn: (Vestbo等建议，将GOLD中0期COPD患者的客观证据定义为具有慢性咳痰的慢性支气管炎人群，而非容易发生者)。
Translation: Vestbo et al. suggest that, within the GOLD classification, objective evidence for stage 0 COPD should be defined as the population with chronic bronchitis characterized by chronic cough and sputum production, rather than those merely at risk.

Query_Text_cn: 另一些作者认为呼吸系统症状预示患病率、COPD的发生及病死率增加，而与肺功能无关。
Translation: Other authors believe that respiratory symptoms indicate increased morbidity, incidence of COPD, and mortality, but are unrelated to lung function.

Query_Text_cn: 在本期CHEST(第71页)中，Stavem等研究着眼于与GOLD中0期COPD的定义和预后有关的几个问题。
Translation: In this issue of CHEST (page 71), Stavem et al. focus on several questions related to the definition and prognosis of stage 0 COPD as outlined in GOLD.

Query_Text_cn: 根据他们的最初分析，Stavem等将GOLD中0期COPD定义如下：发生于肺功能正常的人群，但对提问“你是否每年大部分时日经常咳痰(从你的胸部)，至少3mo？”获肯定的答案。
Translation: According to their initial analysis, Stavem et al. defined stage 0 COPD in GOLD as occurring in individuals with normal lung function who answered "yes" to the question: "Do you cough up phlegm (from your chest) on most days for at least 3 months each year?"

Query_Text_cn: 这导致了无意义的校正后死亡危险性增加［风险比(HR)1.19，95%CI0.91～1.57］。
Translation: This resulted in an increased risk of death after meaningless adjustment [hazard ratio (HR) 1.19, 95% CI 0.91–1.57].

Query_Text_cn: 令人惊奇的是，当对GOLD中0期COPD采用更为敏感的定义即“任何呼吸困难、咳痰，或新近咳嗽和咳痰增加”，校正后的死亡危险性增加(HR1.35，95%CI1.11～1.64)。
Translation: Surprisingly, when a more sensitive definition of GOLD stage 0 COPD—namely, "any dyspnea, sputum production, or recent increase in cough and sputum"—was applied, the adjusted risk of mortality increased (HR 1.35, 95% CI 1.11–1.64).

Query_Text_cn: 该文的证据提示，呼吸系统症状可预测病死率。
Translation: The evidence in this article suggests that respiratory symptoms can predict mortality rates.

Query_Text_cn: 在该研究中，因采用更为敏感的定义致使死亡危险性增加，此与预想的结果相反，而更为完整的定义应包括病情较轻的患者。
Translation: In this study, the use of a more sensitive definition led to an increase in mortality risk, which was contrary to the expected outcome, as a more comprehensive definition should include patients with milder conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 这种结果的原因不明，可能与合并心血管或肌肉骨骼系统的疾病有关，亦可能是烟草烟雾易感性的标记物，或可能与其他未知或无法测定的因素有关。
